title: Physician
description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Physician to deliver Neko's preventive-care model to members in Washington, DC, using advanced, non-invasive technology and clinical expertise to identify health risks early and translate findings into action plans that genuinely change what a member does next. This is a deeply collaborative role at the intersection of clinical excellence, member experience, and a conviction that catching things early changes lives. You'll work closely with Operators, APPs, and cross-functional partners to deliver a connected, insight-driven member experience.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Comprehensive preventive health screenings delivered using Neko's high-resolution skin imaging, cardiovascular assessments, and AI-powered decision support — with consistent quality across every member visit.

  • Personalized, action-oriented health plans created from screening data, translated into next steps the member actually takes — measured by member follow-through and downstream outcomes.

  • Member education on dermatological and cardiovascular risk factors and lifestyle strategies that lands — measured by how the member felt about the consultation, not just the clinical findings.

  • Clinical oversight and escalation support provided to APPs, raising the bar for clinical quality and team performance across the clinic.

  • Cross-functional collaboration with Operators, APPs, and care teams that improves continuity of care and the end-to-end member experience.

What We're Hiring For

  • Genuine, personal commitment to preventive medicine — not just as a specialism, but as a way of practicing. You think it's wrong that this isn't how everyone practices medicine.

  • Member-first instinct — you take the member experience personally, not just procedurally, and measure a consultation's success by how the member felt, not only by the findings.

  • Team-lifting collaboration — you make the people around you better by showing up consistently, sharing what you know, and caring how the team performs as a whole.

Minimum Requirements

  • Active District of Columbia medical license.

  • Board certified in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or equivalent.

  • At least 1 year of post-residency experience.

  • Recent outpatient experience (at least a year in the past 5 years).

  • Comfort working in a tech-forward, fast-moving clinical environment.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and mental health coverage.

  • Complimentary full Neko scan for you and eligible family members.

  • CME benefits.

  • Flexible time off.

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market‑facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.

Hiring Process

Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement

Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.

title: Senior IT Network Engineer
description:
We are a crowdfunded company and have a dedicated and enthusiastic community of backers who are helping us create the “Best Damn Space Sim Ever”. We want to build the best we can deliver and we believe wholeheartedly in the value of exceptional diverse talent.

Senior IT Network Engineer

Founded in 2012, Cloud Imperium Games creates cutting-edge videogames that defy expectations. We're currently developing Star Citizen, a record-breaking multiplayer online space sim, and Squadron 42, a cinematic single-player adventure set in the same universe. Join us as we break boundaries and make video game history.

Cloud Imperium Games is looking for a skilled and talented IT Network Engineer to own our corporate network across our studios in Manchester, Austin, Frankfurt, and Montreal!

What do our IT Network Engineers do?

  • Own the corporate network across all sites: switching, routing, wireless, firewalls, VPN, and inter-site connectivity.
  • Manage network performance for high-throughput workloads — large Perforce syncs, build artefact movement, and GPU workstation traffic.
  • Design and maintain network segmentation and zero-trust-ish access in partnership with the Security function.
  • Lead monitoring, capacity planning, and documentation to build a resilient network architecture.
  • Manage vendors and circuits for ISPs and network hardware.
  • Provide cross-coverage of the wider corporate IT estate and participate in an on-call rota for critical incidents.

What does a good IT Network Engineer look like to us?

A true passion for networking and infrastructure is a must, and we would also like it if you:

  • Have deep, expert-level network engineering experience: enterprise switching and routing, BGP and OSPF, firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Aruba, Junos, Arista or similar), wireless, and VPN. CCNP-calibre as an illustration.
  • Have experience designing and securing multi-site networks, ideally moving high volumes of data between locations.
  • Carry a genuine full-stack baseline across Windows systems, identity and access, cloud, and endpoint — and are quick to learn where you are light.
  • Are comfortable with network automation and infrastructure as code (Python, Ansible, Terraform or similar).
  • Have cloud networking exposure across GCP, Azure, or AWS.
  • Are calm and methodical under pressure during outages, with strong root-cause discipline.

We are always keen to hear from passionate network engineers, so join the 'verse and become our latest Star Citizen!

CIG Diversity Statement

CIG is a global company, staunchly committed to cultivating a culture and workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, lifestyles, and perspectives. Together, we are creating a space where authentic recognition, appreciation, and understanding of the importance of diversity is fostered by everyone. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to build a team that represents all walks of life, and we want every employee to bring all the things that make them unique to the work environment. The universe is as vast and varied as the people in it, and it's our differences that make it special.

Fraud Statement

We are aware of people receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from CIG. These types of fraud can be carried out through false websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal info like bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money for the purchase of business equipment.

If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities, as well as reaching out to us at info{@}cloudimperiumgames.com with any information you may have.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Kulsbjerg Skole søger lærer til barselsvikariat i vores specialklasse
description:
På Kulsbjerg Skole søger vi en engageret og kompetent lærer med erfaring eller lyst til at arbejde i det specialpædagogiske felt.

Vores specialklasser
Specialklasserne ligger fysisk på afdelingen i Stensved og er placeret ved siden af hinanden. Der arbejdes i klasseteam og som et samlet S-team. Det samlede S-team består pt af otte fagpersonaler; fire lærere og fire pædagoger. Du bliver den 9. fagperson. Målgruppen er elever, der har behov for at blive støttet socialt, fagligt og emotionelt. Der er pt 18 elever i klasserne, fordelt på de tre grupper med mulighed for yderligere holddelinger, når der er behov.

Teamet arbejder tæt sammen, hjælper og støtter hinanden og modtager løbende supervision af kommunens PPR. Der er fokus på at samarbejde med relevante almenklasserne, når det er til fordel for elevernes faglige og sociale læring og udvikling.

Der arbejdes tæt sammen med forældrene om at give den enkelte elev de bedste udviklingsmuligheder.

Om dig
  • Du er uddannet lærer og har erfaring med eller lyst til at arbejde specialpædagogisk, gerne med linjefag i dansk
  • Du er dygtig til at skabe relationer
  • Du er rolig, anerkendende og kan se bag om elevers adfærd
  • Du er en holdspiller
  • Du er kreativ og tænker tit ud af boksen, når du skal skabe de bedste rammer for eleverne

Om skolen
Kulsbjerg Skole har lige knap 600 elever fordelt på to matrikler, én i Nyråd med 0.-6. klasser og én i Stensved med 0.-9. klasser. Skolen har engagerede forældre, og området er kendetegnet ved et aktivt foreningsliv.

Skolen er fase-opdelt i indskoling, mellemtrin, udskoling og en specialklasserække fordelt i tre grupper. Der er ca. 75 medarbejdere fordelt på de to matrikler. Der arbejdes i klasseteam og fase-team, hver fase har en teamkoordinator.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 27. august 2026
Samtalerne finder sted den 31. august 2026 på Stensved afdeling
Tiltrædelse den 1. oktober 2026

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, eller hvis du ønsker at besøge skolen, kan du henvende dig til skoleleder Dorthea Ryhl Pedersen på 23 80 40 70 eller afdelingsleder Birgit Flygstrup på 29 37 93 75.

Vordingborg Kommune

Vordingborg Kommune er en attraktiv og moderne arbejdsplads beliggende i Danmarks vildeste natur. Her langs Danmarks længste kystlinje mellem historiske købstæder og stærke fællesskaber er vi omtrent 4000 ansatte, der arbejder for at gøre vores kommune til et endnu mere grønt og attraktivt sted at bo og leve.

Vi har fokus på, at hverdagen skal hænge sammen og tilbyder rammerne om et liv i balance. Her får du mange kvadratmeter for færre penge, du kommer tæt på kysten, i spektakulær natur – med et meningsfuldt job. Så kom og vær med!

$3000 sign-on bonus

Produces correspondence, reports, memos, etc. from dictation drafts, models, etc. Proof reads/edits manuscripts, grant applications, academic and professional papers, and other material for appropriate grammar, spelling, format and style.
3. May attend meetings in capacity of recording secretary. Distributes meeting agenda and minutes.

Required:

• Schedules and coordinates inpatient and outpatient visits, procedures, and diagnostic testing, collaborating with patients, caregivers, and ancillary services to ensure accuracy and timeliness.

• Maintains confidential files and records for medical and administrative purposes; coordinates retrieval of records as needed.
• Monitors office supply inventory and ensures basic maintenance of office equipment.

Required:
1. High School diploma or equivalent.
Preferred:
1. Completion of a medical secretary, medical assistant, or related vocational training program.
Experience/Skills:
Required:
1. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
2. Strong organizational, communication, and customer service skills.
3. Ability to maintain confidentiality of patient and organizational information.
4. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred:
1. 1 year of experience in a medical office or healthcare setting.

title: Smed til hydraulik og maskinmontage i Vejle
description:
Er du smed og klar på hydraulik og maskinmontage?

Her får du fast arbejde i Vejle med konstruktioner, montage og samling.

Du bliver en del af en større produktion, hvor metalopgaverne skal passe ind i færdige møbel- og indretningsløsninger. Arbejdet ligger i Vejle, og du arbejder som en del af et hold frem for at stå alene med det hele. Produkterne bruges i erhverv og institutioner, så samlinger, beslag og montage skal sidde ordentligt.

Rollen passer til dig, der kan lide at få teknik og håndværk til at mødes. Hydraulik, maskinmontage og konstruktioner fylder, men det vigtigste er at du kan samarbejde og få tingene samlet rigtigt. Du bliver ikke målt på fine ord, men på om arbejdet holder.

Det får du

Løn: 210-240 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Vejle og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 20 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Hydraulik, montage og konstruktioner

Din hverdag

Dagen drejer sig om fremstilling, samling og montage, hvor delene skal passe sammen i den færdige løsning. Du koordinerer rækkefølgen med holdet, især når hydraulik og maskinmontage skal spille sammen. Hvis noget ikke stemmer, tager I det før det ender som en fejl i samlingen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med hydraulik og maskinmontage
  • Fremstiller og samler konstruktioner i metal
  • Tilpasser dele, så montage og funktion passer sammen
  • Skærer, borer og tilpasser emner efter opgaven
  • Hjælper holdet med reparationer og ombygninger

Her skal du kunne tænke med, når en løsning ikke passer første gang. Det er den slags smedearbejde hvor hænderne og hovedet skal følges ad.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som smed, gerne et par år
  • Kan arbejde i team og tage ansvar for din del
  • Har lyst til hydraulik, maskinmontage og konstruktioner
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med hydraulik eller maskinmontage før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage fat og sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

title: Software Engineer II, Fullstack (International)
description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

The International Accelerator Engineering team is growing, and we're looking for a Software Engineer to join us! We're a full-stack team located entirely in Europe within the same time zone, but culturally rooted in Silicon Valley. We directly improve the financial lives of over 20 million people shaping how Affirm builds Direct-to-Consumer products for Canada, the UK, and future international markets. We build and own various products used by our consumers, like the Affirm App and other Direct to Consumer products across international markets. We are here to make sure we reach and provide useful tools to our users so they can experience honest financial products at their fullest.

Our work is agile and fast-paced, shipping new code to production for millions to use across geographies and rigorously measuring the impact it has on them. This role rewards curiosity, ownership, ability to zoom in and out, switch contexts often, also in an open contribution model, and a builder's mindset. You'll know exactly what your objectives are, you'll have what you need to hit them, and you'll choose your own path to get there, while constantly looking for ways to get AI to increase productivity on a daily basis. You'll learn quickly from experienced teammates and grow your craft on problems that matter at scale.

If you want to build something new and operate it at scale – come join us!

What You'll Do:

· With the support of your team’s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
· You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
· You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

What We Look For:

· You have a total of 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
· You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.
· You have experience designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
· You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
· Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of sports technology as part of a dedicated and dynamic team.

  • Fill in your sections in the match report and all the documents assigned in the check-list;

  • Help the GLT Operator with dismantling activities.

🛠Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
Essential:

  • Proactive, responsible attitude and ability to work on your initiative with minimum supervision

  • Time management skills and ability to work in a high-pressure, procedural, live broadcast environment

  • Ability to liaise with stakeholders professionally and approachable with attention to good communication.

  • Comfortable working in English (reading, writing and speaking) as you may need to interact with colleagues from other countries

Preferred:

  • An interest in sports and/or sports analysis, with a good knowledge of football and the rules of the game

  • Experience working with VT/replay technology desirable, or live event / technical production

  • Prepared to travel locally and, if required, further afield in Italy

  • Driving licence

At Hawk-Eye Innovations, we appreciate and value the importance of potential and growth. If you believe that you excel in certain areas and possess the passion and desire to develop further, we encourage you to apply


⚽Make an Impact in the World of Football

Ready to kickstart your career in sports technology? Apply now and become a part of our Hawk-Eye team! 🏆

This role sits within the Systems Engineering discipline and will support the development and delivery of hardware-focused solutions, including Tactical Communications Systems, military computers and networking electronics.

Working as part of a multi-disciplined engineering team, you will support activity across the full engineering lifecycle — from requirements capture, development, test and acceptance through to in-service support and obsolescence management. The role will involve working across MoD development and delivery programmes, Customer Research and Development, and Internal Research and Development.

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping hardware aspects of system solutions, with responsibilities including:

  • Supporting requirements elicitation, development and interface definition
  • Contributing to design analysis, including functional and physical analysis, alternative solution development and trade studies
  • Supporting the specification of sub-systems, components and cabling
  • Applying open and military standards to the design and development of hardware solutions
  • Supporting the development and delivery of system integration and test activities
  • Working with safety, security, Integrated Logistics Support and system integration teams to deliver a coherent system solution
  • Supporting technical subcontractor and supplier management where required
  • Producing well-structured technical documentation in line with agreed schedules
  • Presenting at progress reviews and contributing effectively in meetings with internal and external stakeholders

We’re looking for someone with broad systems engineering capability and a strong understanding of military hardware environments. You’ll be confident working across technical teams, resolving design challenges and supporting the delivery of practical, robust engineering solutions.

You will bring:

  • Broad competence in systems engineering
  • Experience resolving design challenges
  • Understanding of military hardware, particularly in relation to Tactical Communications Systems, military computers and networking electronics
  • Knowledge and application of open and military standards
  • Understanding of climatic and induced environments
  • Experience engaging specialist engineering disciplines such as Safety, Security and ILS to deliver complete system solutions
  • Methodical analytical fault-finding skills, with confidence working in a technical laboratory environment and following lab rules such as PPE and safe handling requirements
  • Experience with structured design methods
  • Strong teamwork skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multi-disciplined teams
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio
  • Cable specification and design experience is desirable
  • Good understanding of the OSI model is desirable
  • Experience using engineering tools for requirements management and system design is desirable
  • Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models is preferred.

  • Ansvara för koordineringen av samples och produktdata, inklusive beställning, uppföljning, avprovning samt administration i PLM-system och återförsäljares kundportaler.

  • Säkerställa att produktrelaterad dokumentation, såsom materialdata, måttlistor, Care Guides och övriga produktunderlag, är korrekt, uppdaterad och tillgänglig.

  • Driva och följa upp reklamationsärenden samt säkerställa en effektiv dialog och dokumentation med våra leverantörer.

  • Koordinera hållbarhets- och regelefterlevnadsarbetet kopplat till produkter och leverantörer, bland annat genom att samla in, administrera och följa upp hållbarhets- och CSR-dokumentation samt uppmärksamma avvikelser.

  • Vara ett operativt stöd till sälj, marknad och återförsäljare genom att koordinera produktinformation, samples och annan produktrelaterad administration.

  • Bidra till att utveckla och effektivisera våra arbetssätt inom produktadministration, produktdata och produktflöden.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är strukturerad, noggrann och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs med att koordinera många parallella aktiviteter, har lätt för att samarbeta och tycker om att skapa ordning och kvalitet i det dagliga arbetet.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Erfarenhet av produktkoordinering, produktadministration eller liknande roll inom mode, sport eller outdoor.

  • Erfarenhet av PLM-system eller andra produktdataverktyg.

  • Erfarenhet av arbete mot återförsäljarnas kundportaler.

  • Erfarenhet av reklamationshantering är meriterande.

  • Ett strukturerat arbetssätt, god systemvana samt ett öga för detaljer.

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Vad vi erbjuder dig:

Hos Thevea Brands Group blir du en del av ett entreprenöriellt företag med korta beslutsvägar och stora möjligheter att påverka. Du får arbeta nära flera funktioner i verksamheten och spela en viktig roll i att säkerställa effektiva produktflöden och hög kvalitet i våra processer. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team där samarbete, ansvarstagande och utveckling står i centrum.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en kreativ och familjär miljö på vårt huvudkontor i Helsingborg. Du får ta del av förmånliga personalrabatter och förmåner såsom friskvårdsbidrag, lunchförmån och gemensam frukost på kontoret varje onsdag.

Anställningsvillkor

  • Anställningstyp: Heltid & tillsvidare (6 månader provanställning)

  • Anställningsort: Helsingborg

  • Start: Enligt överenskommelse

About Thevea Brands Group

The house of Thevea includes a portfolio of distinctive brands each catering to a unique audience. We are home to Tretorn, Eddie Bauer and also partnering Toalson and Adidas in the Tennis, Padel & Cycling categories. Operating in the Outdoor and Sport segment, the group has an annual turnover of appr 450 million SEK with deliveries to more than 45 countries, Headquarters in Helsingborg and showrooms in Stockholm, Oslo and Venray.

Thevea Leadership

Through Thevea Leadership, we focus on six core competencies: self-leadership, self-awareness, communication, responsibility, clarity, and humility. These values guide how we lead ourselves and others, shaping a culture where collaboration, accountability, and growth are at the heart of everything we do.

Our Beliefs

Ansökan

I denna rekryteringsprocess samarbetar Thevea Brands Group med Qarat. Varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan via annonsen. Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer och skicka gärna in din ansökan senast 20 september 2026. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta Sofia Wargenbrant på 0733 00 86 40 eller sofia@qarat.se. Qarat arbetar kompetensbaserat för att främja en objektiv och icke-diskriminerande rekrytering.

Om Qarat

QARAT är en komplett leverantör av rekrytering, search/headhunting och Interim management med inriktning på chefer & specialister. Vi arbetar med hela rekryteringsprocesser, rådgivare i delar av en process samt med konfidentiella searchprocesser.

Inom ledningsgruppsutveckling /grupputveckling erbjuder vi Sveriges främsta konsulter inom området. Vårt kontaktnät är mycket stort och sträcker sig över många branscher. För oss är inte ett uppdrag för litet eller för stort, vi är prestigelösa i det vi gör och vårt måtto är att alltid överträffa både våra kunders och kandidaters upplevelse.

title: Package Dispatch Supervisor
description:
Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description:

Job Summary
This position is responsible for analyzing and planning a center’s daily package dispatch to ensure timely and efficient dispatch service performance. He/She analyzes previous dispatch results to maximize service performance and to streamline routes. This position has primary responsibility for managing the center’s dispatch systems and processes. He/She reviews data (e.g., stop and volume trends, missed pieces, cost per piece, etc.) to identify dispatch trends and uses these trends to create plans that maximize results. This position records route modifications, such as new streets and customers, to keep plans up-to-date and oversees load modifications to improve service and reduce costs. He/She also develops, updates and monitors dispatch processes and plans using trend and production report data to adjust routes and evenly distribute work. This position works to improve dispatch operations by promoting the implementation of new technology and monitoring dispatch planning system functionality. He/She directly supervises Part-time Dispatch Supervisors.

Job Location: Polar Speed UPS, Unit 2 Belgrave Court, Caxton Road, Fullwood, Preston, PR2 9ZB

Responsibilities:

  • Key holder to the site
  • Review Testo temperature graphs in both chiller and ambient chambers to ensure overnight/over weekend temperatures are correct, following the relevant reporting procedures
  • Align drivers and vehicles to routes
  • Assigning any patient keys, client paperwork and PAT test kits to the driver routes as required
  • Brief and debrief the drivers
  • Resolving any operational issues with the Depot Manager and drivers, such as routing and scheduling issues, driver absence, VOR and consignment problems to minimize the impact on the service
  • Oversee the driver scanning and loading process, assisting as and when required, dependent on shift
  • Ensuring drivers are dispatched within the allocated lead out time
  • Ensuring vehicles are road worthy and safety checks including VC40 for O-Licence vehicles are completed
  • Assisting with operational telephone calls, specifically driver related queries


Qualifications:

  • Minimum category B drivers licence with ideally no more than 3 points
  • Forklift truck licence holder (FLT) - full in house training and certificates will be provided
  • Good knowledge of he organisation and operations
  • Previous experience of temperature controlled warehousing and multi drop driving would be advantageous
  • Good understanding of Tachograph/Digi Card legislation
  • Good organisational and problem solving skills
  • Effective communication and administration skills
  • Team player mentality with the ability to influence others and also to work on own initiative
  • Build effective working relationships with drivers, management and support staff across the whole network
  • Appreciate the need for maintaining confidentiality


Employee Type:

Permanent


UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

title: Head of Common Functions Real Estate
description:
Company Description

AFRY provides engineering, project management, and advisory services that enable the energy and industrial transition and strengthen resilience in society. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine a global reach with local insights and deep sector knowledge to make a lasting impact for generations to come.

Our shared principles - Results driven, Client Centric, Empowering and Accountable - guide us in how we work, grow and succeed together.

Job Description

Are you ready to shape the future of workplaces in a global organization? AFRY is looking for an experienced and forward-thinking leader to take on the role as global Head of Common Functions Real Estate.

This is a unique opportunity to build and lead a newly established global function of approximately 60 employees with significant impact across our organization. You will play a key role in creating future-ready workplaces, driving strategic initiatives, and ensuring operational excellence across our global real estate portfolio (approximately 280 offices worldwide).

As Head of Common Functions Real Estate, you will lead AFRY’s global real estate and workplace agenda, ensuring alignment with business objectives while creating sustainable, efficient, and inspiring work environments.

You will be a member of the Common Functions Leadership Team and work closely with senior leaders and stakeholders across the organization. As the function is newly established, you will have the opportunity to influence structures, ways of working, and long-term strategies from the ground up.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and execute AFRY’s global real estate strategy aligned with business goals
  • Manage the full property lifecycle, including leasing, redevelopment, and portfolio optimization
  • Drive cost efficiency, portfolio performance, and space utilization
  • Manage external partners including landlords, brokers, developers, and advisors
  • Lead workplace strategy initiatives related to hybrid work, employee experience, and future workplace concepts
  • Oversee workplace operations including facilities management, office services, and vendor management
  • Ensure safe, compliant, and high-quality workplaces across all locations
  • Drive workplace innovation, sustainability initiatives, and digital transformation
  • Lead office redesign, relocation, and workplace transformation projects
  • Own budgets and financial performance related to real estate and workplace operations
  • Build, lead, and develop a newly established global team
  • Collaborate with leaders across AFRY and act as a trusted advisor on workplace and portfolio decisions

Qualifications

Who are you?

We are looking for an experienced leader who combines strategic thinking with operational excellence. You are comfortable navigating complex environments and building strong relationships across functions, cultures, and geographies.

To succeed in this role, you likely bring:

  • A university degree
  • 10+ years of experience within Real Estate and Workplace Operations, with a strong understanding of related processes and operations
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams
  • Strong leadership capabilities with the ability to create engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Experience developing and implementing strategies that drive business value
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a results-oriented mindset
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken

Experience from AFRY or similar global matrix organizations is considered an advantage.

Who you are as a leader

We believe you are someone who:

  • Drives change and thrive in building new ways of working
  • Plans and structures work effectively in a complex environment
  • Build networks and create strong stakeholder relationships
  • Communicates clearly and confidently across different audiences and settings

Additional Information

Why join AFRY?

You will join a newly established global organization where you will have a real opportunity to shape both the function and its future direction. You will become part of an experienced and collaborative leadership team and contribute to creating workplaces that support our people and business ambitions around the world.

At AFRY, we believe in creating sustainable solutions for future generations. Through collaboration, innovation, and curiosity, we create meaningful impact every day.

Location: While we have a hybrid working model at AFRY we expect that this role requires significant presence on-site in Solna, Sweden as well as other AFRY locations. Employment type: Permanent Start date: As soon as possible

Ready to shape the future workplace at AFRY? We look forward to hearing from you.

Welcome to submit your application, the deadline is 2026-08-31 Contact person for questions: Gunilla Fridén, Head of Common Functions, email: gunilla.friden@afry.com We kindly ask not to be contacted by staffing and recruitment agencies or salespeople offering additional job advertisements.

At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

title: Director Adjunct în pregătire pentru Director de Magazin - Bacau
description:
Esti pregatit/a sa motivezi si sa coordonezi o echipa alaturi de Directorul de Magazin? Si sa te asiguri ca echipa ta are cea mai buna atitudine de vanzari si ofera clientilor nostri o experienta extraordinara la cumparaturi?

Atunci tu poti fi Directorul Adjunct de Magazin (f/m) pe care il cautam!

CE ITI OFERIM

Ai posibilitatea sa te alaturi unei companii de retail care isi doreste sa fie prima alegere a angajatilor in retail. Noi avem un mediu dinamic unde ideile tale sunt ascultate si esti implicat. Noi consideram dezvoltarea ta ca fiind extrem de importanta.

Ca Director Adjunct in pregatire pentru Director de Magazin vei avea parte de urmatoarele:

De un program de training format din cinci saptamani de pregatire interactiva in toate ariile de care ai nevoie pentru a conduce un magazin JYSK, desfasurat pe o perioada de aproximativ 1 an. Vei avea traineri profesionisti din retail si resurse umane care te vor pregati pe tot parcursul programului. In timpul desfasurarii programului vei fi angajat ca Director Adjunct de Magazin si vei lucra intr-unul dintre magazinele noastre din Bacau.

CE VEI FACE LA NOUL TAU JOB

Vrei sa inveti si sa te dezvolti? Esti pregatit sa iti incepi cariera intr-unul dintre cele mai bune programe de training din Romania in retail? Iti doresti sa ai posibilitatea de a coordona propriul magazin in 1-2 ani?

Esti pregatit sa motivezi si sa coordonezi o echipa alaturi de Directorul de Magazin? Si sa te asiguri ca echipa ta are cea mai buna atitudine de vanzari si ofera clientilor nostri o experienta extraordinara la cumparaturi?

Daca ai raspuns cu DA la intrebarile de mai sus, atunci TU esti Directorul Adjunct de Magazin pe care il cautam pentru a-l pregati sa intre in programul de dezvoltare - Director de Magazin in Training la JYSK in Bacau!

Cunoaste un Director Adjunct de Magazin si afla mai multe despre cum suntem noi ca angajator aici.

CE CAUTAM LA TINE

  • Ai experienta in a invata, motiva si dezvolta o echipa
  • Esti deschis la mobilitate pe o raza de 50 km in zona Bacau
  • Esti pozitiv si ii inspiri si pe ceilalti din jurul tau, creand astfel o atmosfera placuta in mediul in care lucrezi
  • Esti dispus sa iti asumi responsabilitatea de a oferi un serviciu excelent clientilor si de a obtine vanzari extraordinare
  • Intotdeauna te straduiesti sa iti imbunatatesti rezultatele
  • Esti capabil sa iti finalizezi sarcinile: iti pastrezi calmul in situatii stresante si poti coordona echipa pentru a atinge obiectivele stabilite
  • Esti incantat sa vinzi si ai abilitati extraordinare in vanzari
  • Te bucuri de timpul liber din timpul saptamanii si esti pregatit pentru clientii care isi fac cumparaturile in week-end.

ESTE ACEST JOB O OPORTUNITATE PENTRU TINE? Aplica acum!

Procesul de recrutare in Romania:

Toate aplicatiile sunt procesate de catre echipa de recrutare sau de catre manageri. Vei primi feedback despre procesul de recrutare pe adresa de e-mail sau la numarul de telefon cu care ai aplicat.

DESPRE NOI

Credem ca angajatii nostri sunt cheia succesului nostru. De aceea, ne straduim sa oferim oportunitati de dezvoltare, crestere si noi provocari in cadrul JYSK. Inca de cand fondatorul nostru, Lars Larsen, a deschis primul magazin in Danemarca, in 1979, JYSK si-a extins prezenta globala prin magazine fizice si online in intreaga lume.

Cele trei valori fundamentale ale JYSK – Bun Comerciant, Bun Coleg si Spirit Corporatist – exprima comportamentul si atitudinea la care ne asteptam sa le avem unii fata de altii. Avem incredere unii in altii si credem ca in JYSK ai parte de sustinere si incredere, dar si de libertate cu responsabilitate.

De asemenea, suntem mandri sa recompensam implicarea si efortul deosebit al angajatilor nostri. Cu atitudinea potrivita, oportunitatile sunt nelimitate in JYSK.

JYSK accepta pe toata lumea, indiferent de varsta, identitate de gen, rasa, orientare sexuala, etnie si experienta. Impreuna, ne asiguram ca avem o cultura incluziva care incurajeaza, sprijina si celebreaza vocile diverse ale angajatilor nostri. Pentru ca mai multe talente si personalitati unice ne ajuta sa formam o echipa mai puternica.

Pentru mai multe informatii, te rog sa intri pe pagina noastra de cariere.

Pentru a ne ajuta sa evaluam aplicatiile in mod corect si eficient, folosim un sistem automatizat care verifica si decide cat de bine se potriveste fiecare aplicatie cu rolul disponibil.
Acest sistem analizeaza raspunsurile oferite de tine la cateva intrebari pe care le folosim pentru a evalua aplicatia ta. Aceste intrebari au fost create de sistem si revizuite de echipa Talent Acquisition JYSK, iar fiecare intrebare si raspuns are o anumita valoare. Pe baza raspunsurilor tale, sistemul face o clasificare a candidatilor pentru a putea vedea cat de bine se potriveste profilul tau cu jobul nostru disponibil.
Acest lucru ne ajuta sa gestionam toate aplicatiile si sa ne asiguram ca toata lumea este tratata in mod egal. Rezultatul generat de sistem stabileste daca aplicatia ta trece la urmatoarea etapa. Dar nu iti face griji — decizia finala este intotdeauna luata de o persoana.

Daca doresti sa afli mai multe despre modul in care procesam datele tale personale si despre drepturile tale, te rugam sa consulti Politica de confidentialitate.

title: ZoomCrew Event Staff - Phoenix Raceway
description:
PHOENIX RACEWAY

Phoenix Raceway has been the premier motorsports venue in the Southwest since 1964 and hosts two NASCAR race weekends each year. In March, the NASCAR Weekend kicks off the race season at Phoenix Raceway.,. Phoenix Raceway also hosts a variety of events throughout the year, including corporate meetings and conferences, charity events, holiday events, sport, and endurance competitions, driving schools and Segway tours.

This position will support the Phoenix Raceway branded ShowCar and/or Pace Car at Phoenix Raceway ZoomCrew public appearances. Representatives will credibly and responsibly represent oneself as the face of Phoenix Raceway to current and prospective customers. This is a temporary seasonal position and hours will be dependent on the appearance schedule.

Responsibilities/ Duties/ Functions/ Tasks

  • Enthusiastically interact with and educate the public on Phoenix Raceway history, information, and ticket opportunities
  • Assist in the set up and tear down of the display, including loading and unloading of the ShowCar in and out of the hauler (when used)
  • Ensure that display is appropriately supplied with promotional materials and giveaway items
  • Actively collect prospects for future email campaigns
  • Be an expert on the products and services offered by Phoenix Raceway
  • Assist with a variety of Event Experience activations on Phoenix Raceway race weekends
  • Other duties as assigned

Performance Measures

  • Level of enthusiasm and professionalism displayed during interaction with customers
  • Compliance with safety regulations/ procedures
  • Reliability and dependability

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum 18 years of age
  • Currently living in Arizona
  • Post high school education required or equivalent experience
  • Exceptional work ethic, eagerness to learn, and a passion for the sports / motorsports industry
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as scheduled
  • Reliable transportation to and from the track location

Special Position Requirements

  • May require some out-of-town travel

The ShowCar is a fully-functional NASCAR Stock Car which appears throughout the state sixty to one-hundred times annually. The program includes the ShowCar, promotional giveaways, interactive games, and ability to prospect. ZoomCrew members are expected to show up early to help with setup and stay after events for tear down. The position requires you to have a means of transportation to events; they are primarily throughout the Valley but in some instances statewide. The ideal applicant will be sales driven, a people-person, on-time, hard-working, and eager to learn the sport of NASCAR.

Apply Now!

Learn more about this role and our team by applying at for consideration.

We are a company unlike any other. We want you to bring your experience, skills and passion to our close-knit, high-energy environment in which our employees thrive and where you can prosper. We know the key to our success is our employees and we offer highly competitive salaries, a solid benefits package focused on wellness, and opportunities for you to grow and develop both personally and professionally. It won’t take you long to find out that you are on the right track here at NASCAR!

NASCAR is committed to fostering a diverse work environment where all employees feel valued and empowered. NASCAR is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). We seek to attract and retain the best qualified people available. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, genetic information, pregnancy, veteran status or any basis that is protected by applicable law except where a bona fide occupational qualification exists.

Follow us on LinkedIn and X for future opportunities and company news.

We're looking for your voice, your ideas, and your perspective. To help us get to know you accurately and keep the process fair for everyone, we ask that interviews and assessments be completed without the support of AI-generated content or automated assistance.

title: Vejgruppen søger ny kollega
description:
Har du lyst til et spændende arbejde med mange forskellige opgaver indenfor vejområdet, og vil du gerne arbejde på en fantastisk arbejdsplads med gode kolleger, højt til loftet og med mulighed for hjemmearbejde? – så skal du læse videre her!

Først lidt om os…
Norddjurs Kommune er vejmyndighed for de kommunale veje og private fællesveje i kommunen. Vejmyndighedsrollen er placeret hos Vej og Ejendom, en afdeling under Vækst, Klima og Fællesskaber, som er en af kommunens 2 forvaltninger. Vej og Ejendom er opdelt i følgende områder:
  • Vejgruppen
  • Driftskontoret
  • Jura
  • Mobilitet og udvikling
  • Ejendomscentret
  • Administration

Du vil blive placeret i Vejgruppen i et team bestående af 3 medarbejdere, 2 vejingeniører og 1 energiteknolog. Derudover vil du komme til at arbejde tæt sammen med flere af de øvrige teams, som også berører vejområdet, herunder Driftskontoret og Jura-teamet.

Dine nærmeste kolleger vil bestå af både nyere og mere erfarne kræfter, som alle hjælper hinanden. Vi vægter faglig sparring, samarbejde og et godt arbejdsmiljø højt.

I afdelingen har vi generelt en uhøjtidelig omgangstone og en flad organisationsstruktur. Der er stor tillid til medarbejderne, som kommer til udtryk gennem frihed, ansvar og selvstændighed. Der er også gode muligheder for løbende deltagelse i relevante kurser, konferencer og faglige netværk.
Dit arbejdssted vil blive Kirkestien 1, 8961 Allingåbro, hvor Vej og Ejendom er placeret sammen med afdelingerne Plan, Byg og Miljø, samt Kultur, fritid, turisme og biblioteker.

Det faglige vi arbejder med…
Vejgruppen har som vejmyndighed det overordnede ansvar for, at administrere de kommunale veje i Norddjurs Kommune. Vores arbejdsopgaver spænder vidt og bredt, og dækker bl.a.
  • Administration af vejlovgivningerne
  • Vejplanlægning
  • Anlæg af nye cykelstier, byggemodninger og andre vejanlæg på kommunevejene
  • Trafiksikkerhed
  • Færdselstavler og kørebaneafmærkning
  • Større asfaltarbejder
  • Broer & bygværker
  • Godkendelse af eksterne vejprojekter på private fællesveje
  • Vej- og stadionbelysning
  • GIS og digitale kortopdateringer
  • Økonomistyring af projekter
  • Besvarelse af erhvervs- og borgerhenvendelser
Vi projekterer ikke selv, men håndterer anlægsprojekter fra start til slut i tæt samarbejde med rådgivere, entreprenører og kommunens egen driftsafdeling. Derudover udarbejder vi sagsfremstillinger til politisk behandling og deltager i diverse tværgående projekter i forvaltningen.

Om jobbet…
Du får en vigtig rolle i vores team i Vejgruppen, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og fokus på borgerne og andre interessenter er i centrum. Vi er en lille organisation, så der er gode muligheder for, at prøve kræfter med forskellige typer af opgaver og udvikle sig fagligt. Dine opgaver vil variere, og kan omfatte:
  • Projektledelse og tilsyn af anlægsopgaver, såsom:
    • Byggemodninger
    • Krydsombygninger
    • Anlæg af nye veje og cykelstier
    • Klimatilpasningsprojekter
    • Udførsel af andre mindre vejprojekter
  • Godkendelse af eksterne vejprojekter mv.
  • Besvarelse af borgerhenvendelser
  • Sparring med kollegerne om sager og projekter
  • Samarbejde med andre teams og afdelinger i forvaltningen
  • Udarbejdelse af sager til politisk behandling
Afhængig af dine kompetencer, kan du have mulighed for at sætte disse i spil med andre af Vejgruppens arbejdsområder.

Dine kvalifikationer:
Vi lægger vægt på at du:
  • Har gode faglige kvalifikationer inden for flere af de nævnte arbejdsområder
  • Har gode kommunikative evner, både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Kan mestre borgerhenvendelser med venlig imødekommenhed
  • Færdes hjemmevant i Microsoft Office
  • Har gyldigt kørekort
Vi ser gerne, at du har ingeniørmæssig eller anden teknisk baggrund, og erfaring inden for vejområdet. Vi opfordrer også gerne nyuddannede til at ansøge.

Yderligere oplysninger:
Løn og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst. Du vil blive ansat i en 37-timers stilling med arbejdssted ved Kirkestien 1, 8961 Allingåbro. Vi har flexordning, kantineordning og mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage.

Ansøgning fremsendes via Norddjurs Kommunes hjemmeside, og skal være os i hænde senest tirsdag den 8. september 2026.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, så kontakt vejingeniør og afdelingsleder Stig Jarl Jensen, telefon: 20 75 15 03, vejingeniør Anders Bitsch Christiansen, telefon: 20 34 98 31 eller energiteknolog og projektleder Kenni Aabenhuus Jensen, telefon: 20 75 15 45.

Vores Norddjurs
I Norddjurs kommune arbejder vi ud fra værdierne tillid, ordentlighed, udvikling og fællesskab, som er beskrevet i vores organisations- og ledelseskodeks Vores Norddjurs.

De fire værdier er grundlaget for organisationens virke og er med i alt, vi gør. Kodekset sætter en fælles retning og er dét, der binder os sammen. Værdierne lever i den daglige praksis og i den måde vi arbejder og samarbejder på. Værdierne udspiller sig på alle ledelses- og medarbejderniveauer, samt i mødet med borger og omverden.

description:

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

1. Office/Unit/Project Description

UNDP Yemen operates in one of the world’s most complex and protracted crises, where overlapping challenges of conflict, governance, and climate change create deep vulnerabilities for communities across the country. The Country Office’s Climate Change, Water, Energy, and Environment (CCWEE) portfolio is a core pillar of UNDP’s programming, focused on restoring essential services, strengthening local governance, and improving livelihoods through climate-resilient, inclusive, and sustainable development solutions. The portfolio works closely with national and local partners to implement integrated interventions across water, agriculture, energy, and institutional strengthening to address the interlinked drivers of fragility, inequality, and environmental degradation.

In this context, the Integrated Water Resources Management for Enhanced Resilience in Yemen (IWRM-ERA) Project, funded by KfW, aims to strengthen climate resilience and improve water resources management in targeted areas of Taiz and Lahj governorates. The project supports sustainable water management, watershed rehabilitation, community engagement, and climate-resilient livelihoods to improve water security and enhance resilience to climate change.

Furthermore, this position will also provide targeted cross-support to communication and visibility activities for other strategic initiatives under the broader CCWEE portfolio (including GEF, GCF, and other bilateral donors), ensuring unified thematic messaging.

To enhance project visibility, stakeholder engagement, knowledge sharing, and advocacy, UNDP seeks a Communications Analyst to lead the development and implementation of communications and outreach activities.

The Communications Analyst reports directly to one of the Project Managers, while maintaining a direct strategic and operational matrix reporting line to the CCWEE Team Leader to facilitate portfolio-wide thematic synergy.

2. Scope of Work

1-Ensure effective management of communications activities for the CCWEE Portfolio

  • Chart and oversee the implementation of daily communications activities across all CCWEE projects.
  • Draft and publish success stories, articles, press releases and other publications to highlight the portfolio’s achievements and impact.
  • Coordinate with project teams to develop social media posts, infographics and multimedia content reflecting CCWEE achievements and lessons learned.
  • Ensure timely updates of portfolio and project fact sheets, website pages, newsletters and other outreach materials.
  • Work with implementing partners and project Responsible Parties to generate content (text, photos, video) that aligns with UNDP guidelines and narrative.
  • Provide communications advice to project teams to maximize visibility and ensure consistency.
  • Support and contribute to the Country Office’s overall communications priorities and campaigns, ensuring CCWEE activities are integrated into corporate messaging as needed

2- Ensure implementation of strategic communications plan

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive Strategic Communications Plan for the CCWEE portfolio, targeting key audiences (e.g. government stakeholders, donors, communities, media).
  • Lead the production of communications materials and donor-facing products (e.g. brochures, reports, presentations), including managing photo and video documentation. This involves procuring and coordinating photographers, videographers and designers to create assets for use by regional and HQ partners. For example, similar roles have handled procurement and deployment of consultants to produce photos, videos, animations and other communications products.
  • Coordinate closely with the UNDP Yemen Communications & Advocacy Team to ensure that CCWEE messaging and outreach activities align with the Country Office’s communications strategy and UNDP branding.
  • Emphasize CCWEE’s development and resilience work – not just humanitarian relief – helping to shift the narrative towards long-term solutions for climate, water and environmental challenges.

3- Promote advocacy and communications campaigns

  • Design and roll out innovative advocacy and awareness campaigns linked to CCWEE priorities (e.g. water conservation, renewable energy, biodiversity). This includes social media campaigns timed to international observances (Climate Week, World Water Day, etc.), policy dialogue events, and project launches.
  • Plan and execute national-level advocacy initiatives to promote CCWEE themes and influence public and stakeholder understanding. Campaigns should engage diverse media channels and community networks.
  • Develop creative content (videos, photo essays, blog series) to increase engagement. For example, the Analyst will “produce information and communications products (e.g. press releases, articles, speeches, stories, blogs, fact sheets, etc.), including proposing topics, collecting information from the field, audience targeting, writing and editing content.

4- Ensure donor relations and reporting

  • Regularly update donors on communications activities and work directly with communication focal points on planning, requirements and operational requirements.
  • Assist the team in the editing and formatting of official project reports.
  • Review and polish written content produced by the portfolio to enhance coherence, tone, and readability in line with UNDP standards.

5- Ensure editorial support and quality control and support knowledge sharing

  • Assist CCWEE teams by editing and formatting official reports, concept notes and policy briefs to ensure clarity, coherence and alignment with UNDP standards.
  • Review and edit written content (in English and/or Arabic) produced by the portfolio, enhancing tone, style and accuracy. All materials must be consistent with UNDP’s corporate guidelines and narrative.
  • Maintain an organized archive of CCWEE communications outputs (photos, videos, articles, social media posts) for reference and reuse

  • Make sound contributions to knowledge networks and communities of practice. Support compiling and systematizing project knowledge, products and tools as well as their wide distribution to partners.

    The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the office and the organization.

Applicants with a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) are required to have a minimum of two (2) years of relevant professional experience in mass communications, media, journalism, tv/radio/electronic media
Desired skills in addition to the competencies covered in the Competencies section

title: AWS Academy Regional Lead, AWS Academy
description:
The Regional Higher Ed Lead is the single point of ownership for AWS Academy within an assigned geographic territory. This role is accountable for growing and managing a portfolio of higher education institutions, advising on technical curriculum and cloud/AI strategy, and serving as the trusted advisor connecting institutions to the right combination of AWS education programs. You will own the institutional relationship end-to-end — from pipeline development through onboarding through long-term account health — while defining the technical standards and requirements that ensure institutions successfully implement and deliver Academy courses. You will work across AWS teams (sales, public sector, partner organizations, curriculum, and platform engineering) to bring coordinated value to higher education institutions in your region.


Key job responsibilities
Institution Pipeline & Business Development

Identify, prospect, and onboard new institutions into AWS Academy. Build and manage a pipeline of prospective institutions from inquiry through active enrollment. Grow adoption within existing accounts by expanding program presence into new departments and degree programs. Coordinate with AWS Sales field teams on Academy opportunities and identify areas of collaboration with public sector, public policy, and partner organizations to create scalability.

Account Management & Relationship Ownership

Serve as the primary point of contact for all institutions within the territory. Drive retention, expansion, and educator readiness across assigned accounts. Build long-term relationships with institutional stakeholders — department chairs, deans, and provost-level leadership. Shepherd dormant institutions back to active status. Ensure educator nominations and readiness-to-teach milestones are met. Track regional KPIs including learner completions, institution growth, and educator engagement.

Technical Advisory & Curriculum Strategy

Advise institutions and educators on AWS cloud and AI curriculum architecture, course sequencing, and how Academy programs map to degree requirements. Communicate technical training standards and curriculum development best practices to institutional partners. Understand and articulate technical aspects of LMS integration (LTI protocols, Canvas configuration, SSO/SAML), lab environment requirements (Vocareum, AWS Labs), and platform capabilities. Define technical requirements for institution setup and ensure institutions can successfully deploy and deliver Academy courses.
Program Execution & Cross-Functional Coordination

Execute global business development and event playbooks locally — including AWS Jams, hackathons, and vibe coding sessions. Coordinate with the Technical Enablement Lead on content standards and educator readiness requirements. Work with the Business Development & Strategy Lead on go-to-market motions and marketing activities in-region. Advocate internally for institutional needs across AWS teams. Connect institutions to the right combination of AWS programs — Academy, Education Equity Initiative, Cloud Clubs, Skills to Jobs — based on institutional needs.


A day in the life
As a Regional Higher Ed Lead, you own AWS Academy across your territory. You start by reviewing portfolio health—pipeline, learner completions, educator readiness. You advise a department chair on how AWS cloud and AI curriculum maps to their degree programs, then dive into technical setup: LMS integration, SSO/SAML, and lab environments in Vocareum. In the afternoon, you sync with Sales on a joint opportunity, align with the Technical Enablement Lead on educator readiness, and plan an in-region AWS Jam. You re-engage a dormant institution and connect a new prospect to the right AWS programs. You own each relationship end-to-end.


About the team
AWS Academy helps higher education institutions prepare students for in-demand cloud and AI careers by providing ready-to-teach curriculum, hands-on labs, and industry-recognized certifications—free to institutions worldwide. We partner with universities and colleges to embed cloud skills into degree programs, equipping educators to teach the technologies shaping the future.

title: Project Manager, Engineering & Construction
description:
The Virginia Passenger Rail Authority (VPRA) is a political subdivision established by Chapter 1230 of the 2020 Acts of Assembly. VPRA is responsible for promoting, sustaining, and expanding the availability of passenger and commuter rail services in the Commonwealth, including all administrative and fiduciary responsibilities for Virginia's state-supported passenger rail services. The VPRA also funds Virginia Railway Express (VRE) and administers all capital expansion projects, infrastructure, and land acquisitions related to the multi-billion-dollar Transforming Rail in Virginia initiative, which will double Amtrak and VRE service in Virginia over the next decade. The VPRA acts as a "responsible public entity" for the acquisition, construction, improvement, maintenance, or operation, or any combination thereof, of a "qualifying transportation facility" under the Public­ Private Partnership Act of 1995.

Are you a civil engineer looking for your next opportunity? Do you have a background in rail? If so, VPRA is looking for you! The Engineering & Construction Team is looking for a Project Manager to plan and execute existing work and develop new projects, ensuring on-schedule, within-budget completion while adhering to VPRA's contractual obligations. This position will develop the scope and technical sections of proposal and procurement documents, participate in contract negotiations, and oversee the delivery of the project plan as assigned in support of the multi-billion dollar Transforming Rail in Virginia program of projects throughout the Commonwealth of Virginia.

In addition to solid project management skills, the keys to success in this position will be strong organizational and planning skills, knowledge of design and construction, the ability to monitor deliverables for adherence to client criteria, and execution of all business, technical, fiscal, and administrative functions. The Project Manager may also provide oversight support for projects implemented by Amtrak, CSXT, Norfolk Southern (NS), and the Virginia Railway Express (VRE).

This full-time position may be based in Alexandria or Richmond, Virginia. Applicants based in Northern Virginia are eligible for a 15% geographical pay differential.

Responsibilities

Under the direction of the Senior Director of Projects, the Project Manager will:

  • Lead the oversight of all activities associated with projects throughout Virginia, which involves coordination with CSXT, NS, VRE, Amtrak, and Federal, State, and local entities, including right-of-way and utilities.
  • Establish and oversee contracts with project support (GEC) and engineering and construction contractors while assuming full responsibility for and managing the project's budget, schedule, quality, and safety.
  • Develop reports of project schedules and budgets and project updates/status reports for reporting to the Senior Director of Projects, the COO, and the CEO for VPRA as required.
  • Develop project scopes, fees, and schedules for design contracts.
  • Establish and maintain schedules and deadlines, holding self, stakeholders, and teams accountable to the set budgets and schedules.
  • Lead projects from planning, development, design, and construction, including construction management and quality, as well as project close-out and post-implementation phases.
  • Employ an understanding of rail and transit operations, including the environmental review process, to develop solutions with the support of the Director of Planning.
  • Ensure all project deliverables are complete and coordinated through quality reviews in compliance with VPRA's quality program.
  • Support VPRA's Mission and the Commonwealth at large via our Transforming Rail in Virginia Program
  • Demonstrate a track record of success in leading and implementing similar railroad and transit projects with the following clientele: WMATA, VRE, Amtrak, Class 1 freight owners, and similar entities.
  • Review, monitor, and understand architectural design and operational information and present and review this information with staff, management, and stakeholders.
  • Occasional statewide travel may be required for project-related tasks and nationally for conferences.

Required Education:

  • BS/BA degree in a related field

Preferred Education:

  • Professional engineering license in Virginia or the ability to obtain one within six months of hire.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP)

Required Experience:

  • A minimum of 10 years of direct, relevant project management experience leading multi-million-dollar infrastructure Projects in the Transportation industry, preferably Rail Transit, Freight Rail, or Passenger Rail.
  • Experience with engineering and design activities for passenger rail projects and familiarity with railroad engineering principles related to track and station elements.
  • Experience managing contractors from procurement through contract close-out.
  • Solid understanding of heavy civil/structural engineering principles and construction practices, and experience applying them to achieve successful project outcomes.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and understand engineering drawings and specifications, including geotechnical, grading/drainage, trackwork, structures, electrical, signalization, stormwater management, and sediment/erosion control.
  • Ability to perform independent, detailed reviews of technical and engineering documents, including plans, specifications, submittals, schedules, budgets, contract documents, and official correspondence, and respond to the same as appropriate.
  • Ability to conduct independent research into engineering-related matters, prepare reports, present findings, and make recommendations.
  • Ability to provide engineering and project management support on several projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with a project team to achieve stated goals and objectives.
  • Knowledge of procurement methodology and experience developing the technical portions of procurement documents.
  • Proficiency in MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Internet Explorer, MS Project, Bluebeam Revu, and other project management tools.
  • Ability to communicate verbally effectively and efficiently, and in writing, to support board meetings, public meetings, and internal management requirements.
  • Knowledge of federal, state, and local transportation policies, funding, and legislative and regulatory requirements related to freight and rail Projects, including 49 CFR, Subtitle B, Ch. II and AREMA guidelines.

Preferred Experience:

  • Familiarity with MS SharePoint, Primavera P6 scheduling (or comparable system), and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software.
  • Direct experience leading the design and construction of passenger and commuter rail infrastructure.
  • Relevant design, construction, and operations experience with Class 1 railroads, specifically CSX Transportation and Norfolk Southern Corporation.
  • Active membership and participation in AREMA as a Committee Member on one or more of AREMA's technical committees or similar experience.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
Amsterdam, Rotterdam, hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

This role is part of our Experience & Engineering team based in the Netherlands. We combine our skills in developing future-ready technical solutions with our expertise in creating beautiful designs to deliver exceptional and engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients like Gant, Inter Milan, bol.com and Just Eat Takeaway.

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer who can build the best cloud platforms for our clients and project teams and can maintain our existing solutions in the smartest way possible. Someone who can switch gears quickly and knows how to come up with automatic workflows to help our teams to accelerate in their work.

As a Cloud Engineer, you search together with your colleagues for the best solutions which you independently translate to the perfect end result. You are responsible for building next level cloud platforms and setting up CI/CD pipelines. You work closely with your SRE colleagues to handover the operations to them. You know how to create long-term simplicity and automate everything so your team can deliver quality to our clients. Technology is transforming fast and that is why we are looking for someone who is eager and motivated to work and experiment with new techniques.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the infrastructure implementation/migration process from sprint 0 to go-live;
  • Collaborate to support a smooth integration and long-term operational efficiency;
  • Ensure best practices are established and deliver high quality work
  • Collaborate effectively with our clients teams, including developers questions, to facilitate cross-team communication and ensure a seamless transition;

title: Senior / Principal EIA Consultant (Aviation)
description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A little more about your role…

Air transport is vital to the economy and the daily lives of millions—regionally, nationally, and globally. At WSP, we draw on experience from working on over 8,000 aviation projects for over 350 national and international airports in over 40 countries. We are also proud administrators of ACI’s Airport Carbon Accreditation programme, reinforcing our commitment to sustainable aviation.

As one of the largest environmental consultancies in the UK, you’ll get the opportunity to contribute to landmark aviation projects and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. You’ll be encouraged to explore new ideas in a culture that values curiosity and diverse perspectives.

With the continued growth of the UK aviation sector comes increased scrutiny and a more complex consenting environment. As a Senior or Principal Consultant in our Environmental Consents team in London, you’ll play a role in navigating this landscape—supporting airport expansion through strategic planning, environmental advice, and technical studies.

You’ll contribute to some of the UK’s most significant and transformative aviation infrastructure projects, delivering services such as planning applications, Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), airspace change proposals, and support for DCO examinations and planning inquiries to name a few.

This is a post which is of strategic significance for our business and represents a challenging and exciting opportunity to identify, win and deliver multi-disciplinary inputs for aviation projects. We need people with creative spirit, a dedicated approach and a solid grounding in environmental design, assessment and management at any stage of the development project lifecycle.

Join a great organisation

As a Senior or Principal Consultant, you will collaborate with a diverse team of technical specialists and design professionals to manage environmental contributions across project designs and assessments. You will be instrumental in improving the environmental performance for a range of aviation projects.

The role would suit an enthusiastic individual looking to influence, manage and deliver environmental elements of aviation projects. You will have responsibility for managing projects including tasks relating to bidding, project team management, project delivery, and financial management.

  • Managing the delivery of a diverse range of environmental inputs into aviation projects including planning applications, EIA, airspace change proposals, and support for DCO examinations and/or planning inquiries.
  • An awareness of and experience in the delivery of environmental inputs into projects including EIA screening requests and scoping reports, environmental constraints studies, environmental management plans and Environmental Statements.
  • Building relationships with clients and identifying opportunities to provide support in areas such as resourcing, programming, strategy development and project delivery.
  • Undertaking activities to secure new work, including preparing proposals, contributing to strategic-bid preparation, and participating in business development opportunities.
  • Supporting the development of innovative techniques to shape the way we do our business whether through Digital EIA, Technical Excellence, Future Ready EIA etc.
  • Inspiring and upskilling junior colleagues to support their career development.
  • Promoting an inclusive workplace, demonstrating an understanding of Health and Safety whilst living the values of our health, safety, and wellbeing culture.
  • Undertaking actions that contribute towards the success of the WSP business strategy, whilst being self-motivated towards goals relevant to the role, team, and your projects.

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…

  • A relevant environmental degree level qualification in EIA, or similar.
  • Achieved or demonstrably working towards Practitioner or Chartered Environmental Status and Full membership of IEMA, or similar qualification with a relevant professional body.
  • Demonstratable experience of undertaking EIA for aviation schemes with limited supervision, including under a range of UK planning regimes such as the Town and Country Planning Act and the Planning Act 2008.
  • Demonstrates the ability to apply programme knowledge to effectively coordinate tasks across technical teams, external clients, stakeholders, and partner organisations, while consistently delivering projects or tasks on time and within budget, in full compliance with business management procedures.
  • Ability to lead and contribute to meetings with the wider technical team and external clients and stakeholders.
  • Experience in coordinating a suite of environmental surveys required to support an EIA for aviation schemes, with knowledge of the associated Health and Safety requirements.
  • Experience in bid preparation and responding to client change requests with appropriate fee adjustments for aviation projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong report writing and review capabilities, attention to detail, and a focus on quality assurance

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.
