Job Description

Role Summary The Senior Android Platform Engineer is responsible for building and maintaining the foundational infrastructure that powers our mobile banking application ecosystem. You will not just be building app features; you will be building the tools, core libraries, and architectural frameworks that empower feature teams to deliver at scale. Your work will directly impact developer velocity, app performance, and the structural integrity of a highly regulated, secure banking application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Developer Experience (DX) & Tooling: Design and implement internal tools, foundational libraries, and SDKs. Analyze and optimize Gradle build logs and processes to significantly reduce build times for the broader engineering organisation.
  • Architecture & Modularisation: Drive the decoupling of legacy code into a highly modular architecture, ensuring clear boundaries and optimised dependency graphs.
  • Core UI & Frameworks: Build and optimise core, reusable Jetpack Compose components and design systems utilised across multiple feature squads.
  • Feature Management Infrastructure: Implement and maintain robust wrapper API architectures for feature flag management, ensuring safe, decoupled release cycles and phased rollouts.
  • Quality & CI/CD: Contribute to the automation of CI/CD pipelines. Write extensive unit and integration tests for platform-level code to prevent regressions in the shared codebase.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: 15+ years of Android engineering, with specific experience working on platform, infrastructure, or core architecture teams.
  • Deep Technical Expertise: Advanced knowledge of Kotlin, the Android SDK, and deep familiarity with Gradle build system internals and performance profiling.
  • Architecture & Scale: Proven experience navigating and refactoring large, complex, multi-module codebases.
  • Security & Compliance: Strong understanding of mobile security best practices (keystore, encryption, obfuscation) required for banking/FinTech applications.

Lead Android Engineer (Mobile Platform)

Role Summary The Lead Android Platform Engineer sets the technical vision and architectural strategy for our mobile banking platform. You will act as the technical authority on mobile infrastructure, driving initiatives in CI/CD automation, scalable modularisation, and platform security, while ensuring the ecosystem meets the rigorous demands of the UK banking sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Strategy & Governance: Define and enforce architectural standards, writing Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) to guide the technical evolution of a shared codebase supporting hundreds of concurrent contributors.
  • Infrastructure Leadership: Lead major infrastructure overhauls, including advanced modularisation strategies, dependency management at scale, and comprehensive CI/CD pipeline automation.
  • System Integration & Safety: Architect robust, standardised integration patterns for third-party tools and internal systems.
  • Cross-Team Enablement: Partner with Engineering Managers and Product Owners across various feature domains to identify platform bottlenecks, resolve integration conflicts, and plan the technical backlog.
  • Mentorship & Advocacy: Elevate the engineering standards of the entire mobile organisation. Mentor senior platform engineers and evangelize best practices in performance profiling, memory management, and secure coding.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: 15+ years of mobile engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership in a platform or core infrastructure role within a high-scale environment.
  • Scale & Complexity: Expert-level experience managing shared mobile codebases for 100+ engineers, resolving complex Git workflows, and optimising build infrastructure at an enterprise scale.
  • FinTech/Banking Acumen: Deep understanding of the compliance, regulatory, and security requirements inherent in building financial applications.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex infrastructural needs into business value, advocating for technical debt reduction and architectural investments to senior stakeholders.

title: Associate Director of Development – Leadership Giving
description:
Job Summary:

Reporting to the Director of Development, the Associate Director of Development raises philanthropic gifts in support of the Harvard Graduation School of Education’s mission of preparing leaders in education and generating knowledge to improve student opportunity, achievement, and success.

The Associate Director will focus on raising flexible support that enables HGSE to deliver on its mission, managing a portfolio of prospects that includes those who are, or have the potential to become, leadership level donors ($10,000-$25,000 annually or $100,000- $250,000 multiyear pledges). The Associate Director will develop and manage a portfolio of ~200 donors/potential donors through all stages of donor engagement.

The Associate Director of Development is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy and limited guidance to develop multi-step prospect strategies to secure gifts. These strategies may require collaboration with colleagues in other Harvard schools to engage donors interested in HGSE’s work. In addition, the Associate Director will be creative in identifying new potential donors beyond the traditional HGSE and Harvard donor base.

This position requires a bias for action and making the ask, a high level of organization, professionalism, and mastery of the objectives of leadership gift/flexible use fundraising.

Success will be measured by the incumbent’s ability to move donors from qualification to cultivation to solicitation and close leadership gifts.

Job-Specific Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategies for increasing leadership giving for funding around priority areas.
  • Identify and qualify potential donors—in collaboration with our AA&D Research Team colleagues—and work with donors at every stage of engagement.
  • Move prospects toward solicitation and completes assigned solicitations on the agreed upon timeline. This includes conducting at least 125 one-on-one visits and building toward securing 20 (twenty) $25,000+ commitments toward HGSE priorities annually.
  • Travel with and provide staffing support for the Dean and members of the faculty on behalf of fundraising efforts.
  • In collaboration with others, plans and executes select events related to the cultivation, solicitation and/or stewardship of leadership gift prospects and donors.
  • Write briefings, proposals, donor correspondence and updates that shape and reflect fundraising strategies, with support and collaboration from colleagues.
  • Serve as a member of the Development team by participating in group strategy discussions, providing project leadership when requested by management, sharing information with colleagues and contributing to the achievement of the overall goals of HGSE.
  • Through effective sharing of information and building of trust, collaborate with colleagues across the University to identify and engage alumni of other Schools who would be interested in the work of HGSE.
  • In concert with the overall fundraising needs for HGSE, works periodically on special projects in collaboration with the development and communications colleagues.
  • Achieve annual performance metrics including visit targets and funding goals to be set each year.
  • Works with Development Coordinator to keep track of plans and outreach in the AA&D database, to ensure transparency and effective pipeline management. Provide timely follow-up and debriefs after meetings.
  • Actively build knowledge of HGSE and relationships with colleagues across the School by attending campus events and activities, reading HGSE publications and pursuing other avenues for professional learning and growth.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • 5 years of progressively responsible experience in fundraising and/or related field where skills are easily transferable, including direct solicitation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel roughly 40% of the time (and conduct effective meetings over video and phone, when necessary. Occasional evening and weekend work required.
  • Applicants wishing to be considered must supply a cover letter in addition to their resume and indicate meeting basic qualifications.

Additional Qualifications and Skills

Demonstrated experience and effectiveness in individual donor fundraising and volunteer management. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of both higher education and philanthropy, and bring a proactive, entrepreneurial approach to fundraising and a genuine passion for HGSE’s mission.

Must be an innovative and creative strategic contributor with strong listening skills and the ability to collaborate and persuade.

Proven interpersonal skills with ability to build and strengthen diverse relationships; motivate, engage and work with donors and volunteers, School and University leaders, faculty, and staff.

Strong results orientation and proven track record in setting and achieving ambitious goals.

Superb organizational, prioritization, public speaking, presentation, written and oral communication skills. Due to frequent interaction with high level donors, senior administrators and faculty, the candidate must maintain confidential information and use sound judgment.

Ability to operate both autonomously and in a team, understanding individual success as part of a larger team’s success, with high levels of professionalism, collegiality and self-motivation.

Computer literacy required; must have experience with Window and databases.

title: 3 læger i introduktionsstilling, Afdeling for Patologi, Rigshospitalet
description:
Har du lyst til at finde ud af, om patologi skal være dit speciale?

Vi kan tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende hverdag på en afdeling med fokus på diagnostik, forskning og uddannelse. Stillingen er vagtfri.

Hvis det er noget for dig, så søg en introduktionsstilling på Afdeling for Patologi, Diagnostisk Center, Rigshospitalet. Vi kan tilbyde ansættelse fra 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Hvad laver vi:

Afdelingens opgave er at stille diagnoser på væv og celler samt at udføre obduktioner. Diagnoserne stilles på baggrund af en indledende makroskopisk vurdering efterfulgt af mikroskopi, som for det meste foregår digitalt, suppleret af specialfarvninger og immunhistokemiske undersøgelser. I tiltagende omfang anvendes også molekylærbiologiske undersøgelser som en del af udredningen.

Diagnostik af kræftprøver dominerer, men også andre sygdomme diagnosticeres på afdelingen. Afdelingens læger udarbejder patologibeskrivelserne, og ved diagnostik af kræft omfatter disse beskrivelser vigtig information om tumortype, størrelse og udbredning, hvilket danner klinisk basis for den videre kirurgiske eller medicinske behandling. For mange tumorers vedkommende laves f.eks. undersøgelse af prognostiske eller prædiktive markører. Resultatet af disse undersøgelser guider klinikerne til den bedste behandling af den enkelte kræftpatient.

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

  • En grundig introduktion til specialet
  • At blive en del af gruppen af uddannelseslæger med 6 introduktionslæger, 10-12 hoveduddannelseslæger og 5 ph.d.-studerende
  • At du har rig adgang til supervision fra engagerede speciallæger
  • Et godt læringsmiljø med fast undervisning mindst en gang ugentligt samt månedlig journal club
  • Mulighed for at deltage i forskningsprojekter
  • En personlig vejleder
  • Et godt tværfagligt miljø med gensidig respekt imellem faggrupper
Vi forventer af dig:

  • At du har interesse, nysgerrighed og lyst til at lære mere om patologien
  • At du aktivt bidrager til din egen og andres uddannelse
  • Gode tværfaglige samarbejdsevner
  • At du bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • At du er læge og har gennemført din KBU
Om Afdeling for Patologi

Afdeling for Patologi er en del af Rigshospitalets Diagnostiske Center og yder højt specialiseret diagnostik for Rigshospitalets afdelinger, Bispebjerg Hospital og Bornholm. Desuden modtages prøver fra praksissektoren samt fra Færøerne og Grønland.

Rigshospitalet er hele Danmarks hospital med mange højt specialiserede afdelinger, hvor forskning, udvikling og undervisning prioriteres for at sikre en højt specialiseret diagnostik og patientbehandling. Afdeling for Patologi er en aktiv afdeling med en engageret lægestab og et godt samarbejde med afdelingens øvrige personalegrupper.

Afdeling for Patologi ledes af en afdelingsledelse bestående af en chefbioanalytiker og en cheflæge. Afdelingen har ca. 200 ansatte heraf ca. 60 læger, 3 professorer samt bioanalytikere og laboratoriemedhjælpere, sekretærer, obduktionsteknikere, kemikere og molekylærbiologer.

Afdelingen er beliggende på 2 matrikler. Det diagnostiske arbejde foregår i Teilum bygningen på Rigshospitalet, mens vores eksperimentelle forskningsenhed, Bartholin Instituttet, er beliggende på BRIC på Ole Maaløes vej.

Alle faggrupper arbejder i fællesskab for at give patienterne den bedst mulige diagnostik, og vi lægger stor vægt på det gode samarbejde med høj grad af service og kvalitet inden for vores 3 kerneydelser; diagnostik, forskning og uddannelse.

Løn

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til overenskomsten for underordnede læger indgået mellem Yngre Læger og Danske Regioner.

title: Scientific Engagement Partner
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Scientific Engagement Partner is a key, field-based Medical Affairs role that develops broad medical & scientific expertise within given Disease/Therapeutic Areas (Breast Cancer). Moving beyond standard scientific exchange, you leverage convincing clinical engagement to build solid scientific belief among Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and guide the appropriate integration of our innovative therapies into clinical practice.

This role requires acting as a scientific catalyst with clinicians through convincing clinical engagement, acting as a bridge to overcome barriers in the patient journey and ensuring the appropriate scientific understanding of our innovative molecules. The Scientific Engagement Partner contributes to the disease area medical strategy in collaboration with the disease area Medical Lead and prepares/executes a regional medical plan in line with this medical strategy. The role is expected to ensure medical/scientific expertise and independence from promotional objectives in all their decisions.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Common Responsibilities

  • Allocate approximately 80% of working time to direct field engagements.

  • Develop and execute structured Regional Account Plans and territory strategies.

  • Conduct strategic scientific profiling, segmentation, and mapping of key centers and TAEs to build sustainable, long-term scientific partnerships and deliver tailored, high-impact clinical interactions.

  • Collaborate with oncologists, clinical pharmacists, and oncology nurses to provide peer-to-peer educational support on administration protocols, patient management best practices, and the clinical/operational rationale for subcutaneous formulations, ensuring seamless integration into daily hospital workflows

  • Establish early scientific foundations for upcoming pipeline molecules by mapping key referral networks, communicating complex clinical rationale to key centers, and preparing the medical ecosystem for novel therapeutic paradigms well ahead of commercial availability

  • Serve as a medical resource to help HCPs navigate non-standard or early-access channels by providing compliant scientific data and clear medical guidance to address urgent, unmet patient needs

  • Identify unmet medical needs within the current treatment landscape. Leverage compelling clinical evidence to create a sense of scientific urgency, shift clinical mindsets, and accelerate the appropriate clinical integration of innovative therapies.

  • Help identify physician practices, needs, preferences, and views of the current treatment landscape. Utilize strong clinical engagement skills to establish scientific belief in innovative molecules and serve as a scientific bridge for their appropriate integration into clinical practice.

  • Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to physicians, and that are aligned with Roche strategies.

  • By overseeing the patient journey, act as a system thinker to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverage this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.

  • Collect insights from TAEs during clinical visits and scientific activities in the responsibility area and share these insights with relevant units.

  • Have high medical competence, to understand current medical knowledge and marketing strategy. Keep their information up to date at all times through internal trainings and independent scientific resources in a responsibility therapeutic area.

  • Cooperate closely with Disease Area Medical Lead in medical processes to support product teams in a given therapeutic area (preparing a medical presentation, etc.) and support implementation of planned actions (advisory board, regional / national / international scientific activities, digital medical projects, etc.).

  • Respond to unsolicited written questions from HCPs in accordance with local laws, regulations and codes and Roche SOPs, facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require.

Other Responsibilities

  • Understand and act in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other directives, SOPs and guidelines) and apply them to his/her daily practice.

  • Act entirely in compliance with Competition Law and Roche Code Of Conduct in carrying out all duties.

  • Take necessary precautions for adherence to legislative requirements (Regulation on The Promotional Activities for Medicinal Products for Human Use, Law on the Protection of Personal Data and industry code requirements on promotion and ethics).

  • Ensure that any kind of personal data of the patients shall not be accessed; in case any exceptional situation occurs, all kinds of patient data shall be kept in compliance with local privacy regulations and the Company privacy rules/principles.

  • Follow up on Environment, Health and Safety issues; abide by the related policies and attend related trainings when necessary.

Qualifications/Experience

  • Medicine, pharmacy, or dentistry degree

  • Fluency in Turkish and English

  • Field experience is preferred

  • Proven capability in strategic account planning, long-term TAE partnership building, and data-driven territory segmentation

  • Demonstrated ability to drive scientific urgency, challenge the status quo, and shift clinical behavior through robust and convincing scientific discourse.

  • Strong, convincing communication and clinical engagement skills capable of creating scientific belief and delivering clinical value to physicians.

  • Proven capability in field planning, territory management, and data-driven TAE segmentation.

  • Strong skills for digital engagement & communication

  • Strategic thinking and agile approach focusing on improvement and solutions

  • System thinker and deep listener

  • Lead mindset leveraging the internal and external networks to create value

  • Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment

  • Collaborative and experienced in stakeholder management

  • A robust ethical mindset and a good understanding of relevant compliance principles and regulations

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer / Data Scientist – Agentic Systems
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

About the Role

At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering & Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.

In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~6 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Full-Stack AI Engineer / Data Scientist with a deep sense of ownership. Rather than being a narrowly specialized Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or MLOps Engineer, you will combine these skill sets. You will build agentic generative AI systems and classical ML systems end-to-end, taking accountability from concept and exploratory data analysis all the way to production releases and monitoring.

Core Tech Stack & Scope

This role involves working deeply with multimodal foundation models, advanced agentic workflows (including Agent-to-Agent/A2A communication), Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, other emerging AI technologies, and MLOps subsystems. You will utilize cloud services (AWS and multicloud) alongside vector, graph, and traditional databases to develop scalable and robust AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic & GenAI Application Development:

  • Design and build advanced AI agentic systems, state machines, search-based conversational systems that solve complex business problems.
  • Develop workflows leveraging Large Foundational Multimodal Models to process and reason across text, audio, and video modalities.
  • Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients to standardize context exchange between agents, data sources, and external tools.
  • Collaborate with AI Architects, Product Owners, and fellow developers to integrate AI capabilities into scalable, fair, and ethical end-user applications focusing on relevance and real-time performance.

Full-Stack Engineering & Agentic SDLC:

  • Leverage AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles, maintaining high productivity across frontend, backend, and infrastructure tasks.
  • Take end-to-end accountability for features: write high-quality, production-ready Python (and occasionally TypeScript) code with comprehensive testing and documentation.
  • Manage the DevOps/MLOps lifecycle: containerize applications using Docker, configure CI/CD pipelines, and architect high-throughput, reliable cloud-native solutions on AWS/multicloud.

Data Science, EDA & Strategy:

  • Perform thorough Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to understand dataset characteristics, uncover patterns, detect biases, and identify data quality issues.
  • Use statistical and visualization techniques to inform feature engineering, model selection, and optimization of foundation model-based applications.
  • Design robust data pipelines to curate, preprocess, and structure diverse datasets that maximize LLM effectiveness and reduce bias.

Algorithm Development & Optimization:

  • Design, customize, optimize, and fine-tune LLM-based and traditional AI algorithms for specific use cases (e.g., text generation, summarization, AI agents, sequence modeling).
  • Lead advanced prompt engineering strategies, utilizing zero-shot, few-shot and other paradigms to optimize model outputs without extensive fine-tuning.
  • Implement pre-generative AI models (e.g., classification, clustering, regression) when they provide a more efficient, interpretable, or cost-effective solution compared to LLMs.
  • Optimize model inference speed, reduce latency (cold start reduction, caching strategies), and manage resource usage across cloud architectures.

Evaluation, Observability & Continuous Improvement:

  • Conduct rigorous experimentation (A/B testing) and implement automatic metric pipelines (e.g. BLEU/ROUGE, RAG retrieval accuracy, human rating frameworks, etc.) to evaluate generative and multimodal systems.
  • Implement real-time algorithms monitoring and observability practices, ensuring visibility into pipelines behavior, drift detection, and anomaly identification using telemetry tools.
  • Translate complex technical results into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, driving data-driven decision-making.

Practical Skills Required

Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering and Data Science, with exposure to generative AI, agents and classical ML.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience generative large language models and agents.
  • Proven experience managing the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle and deploying models at scale.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery.

Technical Skills:

  • Programming: Advanced production-grade proficiency in Python. Additional proficiency in TypeScript is considered an advantage.
  • AI/GenAI Frameworks: Deep expertise with LangChain or similar LLM orchestration frameworks, agentic system design, and state machine logic.
  • Cloud Platforms: Practical experience designing cloud solutions on AWS (familiarity with multicloud is a plus), utilizing GenAI-specific services (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker).
  • Databases: Strong knowledge of vector databases (e.g., AWS OpenSearch), graph databases, Snowflake, SQL, NoSQL, and data lakes.
  • Software Engineering Best Practices: Expertise in API design, CI/CD, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, and rigorous automated testing.
  • Data Skills: Strong background in statistics, data manipulation, synthetic data generation, and feature engineering.

Capabilities:

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent analytical skills to tackle complex engineering and statistical challenges.
  • Ownership & Leadership: Deep sense of accountability, eager to define architectural patterns, and able to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary.
  • Consulting: Abilities to work closely with stakeholders across the enterprise to consult on the technological approaches to their business problems.
  • Ethics: Strong understanding of biases, fairness, hallucination mitigation, and responsible AI deployment.

Qualifications

The successful candidate should:

  • Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., Ph.D., or equivalent in Computer Science, Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Be deeply passionate about AI, staying continuously up-to-date with the latest developments in foundational models, agentic approaches, and classical ML.
  • Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, thriving in a fast-paced environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary.
  • Be a great communicator, able to present complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+.
  • Be ready to span their work times across the Central European Timezone on occasion, when necessary.

Why Join Us?

  • Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge agentic AI technologies in a highly visible Roche RDT function.
  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career by taking ownership of complex, high-impact end-to-end AI systems.
  • Collaborative Culture: Be a part of a diverse and inclusive team that values technical excellence, cross-functional collaboration, and rapid innovation.

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. title: Maintenance Engineer III
description:
Job Summary

The Maintenance Engineer III is responsible for performing advanced maintenance, repair, and troubleshooting tasks on complex systems within a healthcare facility. This role ensures the reliability and safety of critical infrastructure, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, medical gas, and/or emergency power systems. The Maintenance Engineer III also leads maintenance projects, ensures compliance with healthcare regulations, and provides mentorship to junior engineers.

Essential Functions

  • Conducts rounds of all areas, including equipment rooms and mechanical rooms, to ensure security and proper functioning of systems.
  • Performs advanced maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on critical systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, medical gas systems, backup power, elevators, lighting, and/or other infrastructure.

  • Coordinates with hospital departments, contractors, and vendors to ensure maintenance activities align with hospital priorities and do not disrupt patient care.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.

Qualifications

  • Associate Degree or formal training in facility maintenance, mechanical systems, or a related field preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of maintenance, repair, and troubleshooting techniques for complex building systems.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements, including Joint Commission standards, OSHA regulations, infection control procedures and fire safety codes.
  • Proficiency in using CMMS software for managing work orders and tracking maintenance activities.

title: UI/UX Developer, Platform UI Team
description:
Role in one sentence

A UI/UX developer who designs and builds the front end of a new integration product with a node-based, AI-assisted design. The role turns complex technical workflows into a simple, usable interface.

Why this profile

This is a greenfield build. The product has no existing front end to inherit or extend. This person takes user interaction and design guidance and turns it directly into working code. Design and code stay in one continuous loop.

Must-haves

  • 5–9 years of experience in UI/UX development, with real ownership of shipped, complex products.

  • Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js. Builds and maintains component libraries.

  • Experience building node-based or canvas-style interfaces. Drag, connect, wire, zoom, pan. Familiar with libraries like React Flow, or has built equivalent canvas interactions from scratch.

  • Experience designing multi-mode interfaces. The same product adapts to different user types and still feels like one coherent product.

  • Comfortable with real-time UI: WebSocket-driven updates, live logs, streaming states, optimistic UI.

  • Experience building complex dynamic forms, validation (e.g., React Hook Form, Zod), and multi-step drawer/modal workflows for deeply configurable nodes.

  • Strong grasp of design systems: typography, spacing, component consistency, dark-mode theming, accessible color contrast.

  • Works directly from a REST API. Understands API contracts and flags gaps early.

  • Solid UX fundamentals: information hierarchy, progressive disclosure, error states, empty states, loading states. Designs for edge cases with the same care as the main flow.

  • Reviews own designs critically and explains interaction choices with clear reasoning.

  • Fluent English. Works well in a small, fast-moving technical team.

Nice-to-haves

  • Exposure to workflow builder UX patterns (e.g., data mapping/field wiring, payload schema previews, or step-by-step execution debugging).

  • Familiarity with canvas performance optimization techniques (managing high node/edge counts without FPS drops) and state management libraries (e.g., Zustand, Redux).

  • Familiarity with Node.js runtime environments and full-stack JavaScript workflows, aiding local prototyping and API mocking.

  • Familiarity with conversational/chat UI patterns - keeping a chat panel and a visual canvas in sync.

  • Experience with AI-assisted products - showing confidence scores, model output, or human-review/approval gates in a UI.

  • Familiarity with FastAPI or similar Python backends- reads endpoint docs and reasons about data shape.

  • Exposure to workflow/automation tools (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool) as a user or builder.

  • Experience designing for a technical, developer-facing audience - comfort with technical typography systems (e.g., IBM Plex Sans/Mono).

Tech stack

  • Frontend: React, Next.js

  • Backend/API: Node.js, REST + WebSocket, OpenAPI-based

  • Visual canvas: Node/edge-based workflow builder (React Flow or equivalent)

  • Styling: Component-based design system, dark-mode-first, technical typography

  • Auth: OIDC/OAuth2

title: Specialistläkare i psykiatri | Konsultuppdrag Göteborg
description:
Om Nova Psykiatri

Nova Health Group grundades med en vision om att revolutionera psykiatrin och behandling av psykisk ohälsa. Vi strävar efter att erbjuda en modern och patientcentrerad vårdupplevelse. Vi vill erbjuda bästa Europas bästa utredning och behandling för personer med ADHD, Autism och annan psykiatrisk problematik. Vi arbetar idag mot våra patienter med varumärkena Nova Psykiatri och Karla Psykiatri, men med fler företag på gång inom gruppen.

Dagens psykiatri präglas av traditionella metoder och ett ofta långsamt arbetssätt, där tekniska framsteg och patientens behov sällan står i fokus. Många patienter har svårt att navigera i ett komplext offentligt system eller vänder sig till stora vårdgivare där de riskerar att bli en anonym siffra i mängden. Vi har valt att göra saker annorlunda genom att sätta patienten i centrum och erbjuda psykiatrisk vård med en femstjärnig service. Vår strategi bygger på patientupplevelse, kvalitet och effektivitet, där vi använder modern teknik och innovativa arbetsmetoder för att ständigt förbättra och utveckla vår verksamhet.

Vårt engagerade team är kärnan i vår verksamhet och består främst av psykologer, läkare och sjuksköterskor. Nova grundades 2024 och har idag 70+ medarbetare – och vi växer snabbt. Nu söker vi fler drivna personer som vill vara med och forma framtidens psykiatri tillsammans med oss. Vi lägger mycket fokus på att anställa Sveriges duktigaste medarbetare, men även att folk ska trivas bättre här än någon annanstans.

Novas vision är att visa hur psykiatri kan fungera, för såväl patienter som för medarbetare. Vi tror det går att göra mycket bättre. Vi drivs av att hela tiden förbättra patientnöjdheten, hålla hög kvalitet, och samtidigt höja effektiviteten genom minskad administration. Vi tror att vi når allt detta genom att ha kul tillsammans, våga göra misstag, samt genom att våga sträva mot att vara bäst på det vi gör.

Om uppdraget

Vi söker en specialistläkare i psykiatri som vill arbeta som konsult hos oss i Göteborg, med fokus på fysiska läkarbedömningar vid neuropsykiatriska utredningar för både barn och vuxna.

Omfattningen för uppdraget ligger inledningsvis på cirka 10% (ca 4 tim/vecka), men behovet kan komma att öka. Det går bra att samla ihop arbetet till heldagar, exempelvis att man arbetar en heldag varannan vecka. Vi växer snabbt och ser goda möjligheter att utöka omfattningen framöver för den som vill och har utrymme.

Som specialistläkare gör du den medicinska bedömningen inom ramen för våra neuropsykiatriska utredningar. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med psykologer och andra kliniker i ett team som värdesätter kvalitet, effektivitet och en riktigt bra patientupplevelse.

Vi har smarta digitala verktyg och effektiva processer som minimerar administration, så att du kan fokusera på det kliniska arbetet.

Vem du är

Vi söker en specialistläkare i psykiatri som vill arbeta med neuropsykiatriska utredningar hos oss i Göteborg.

  • Kan utreda en bred patientgrupp: barn/ungdomar och vuxna

  • Erfarenhet av neuropsykiatriska utredningar med bred frågeställning är meriterande

  • Trivs med att arbeta självständigt och värdesätter frihet under ansvar

  • Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Som person är du

Effektiv – Du uppskattar smarta arbetssätt och digitala verktyg som frigör tid för det som faktiskt gör skillnad.

Serviceinriktad – Du ser patienten som någon vars förväntningar du alltid vill överträffa, och du vill hela tiden förbättras.

Kvalitetsdriven – Du nöjer dig inte med "good enough" utan strävar efter noggranna och välgrundade bedömningar.

Varför Nova

Du får vara med på en resa där vi bygger Europas bästa bolag inom mental health – och faktiskt hjälper människor på riktigt.

  • Flexibelt konsultuppdrag som passar att kombinera med annan verksamhet

  • Moderna digitala verktyg och minimal administration

  • Ett växande bolag med goda möjligheter till utökad omfattning över tid

Sök idag och hjälp oss att bygga framtidens psykiatri. Vi rekryterar löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan nu!

title: PhD Scholarships in “live” electron microscopy in catalysis at the atomic-scale - DTU Physics
description:
Are you driven to observe catalysts in action atom-by-atom, in real time, under realistic conditions? Do you want to use state-of-the-art electron microscopy to answer fundamental questions at the frontier between catalysis, chemical, materials and quantum sciences?

We are recruiting PhD scholarships to explore catalytic materials using state-of-the-art operando, atomic-resolution transmission electron microscopy (TEM).

Why join VISION?
At VISION, you will join a highly collaborative, international, and interdisciplinary research environment where advanced electron microscopy and spectroscopy, microfabricated reactors, catalysis, cluster science, and computational modelling come together to reveal how catalysts function at the atomic scale.

This is an exceptional opportunity for ambitious researchers who want to shape the frontier of “live” electron microscopy and wants to build foundation for independent academic or corporate research career.

Your Impact
Catalysts are metastable nanomaterials. Their active surface sites dynamically restructure during adsorption and reaction of molecules. However, many of these processes remain hidden because they occur at the atomic scale and in real time.

Your research will address this challenge by using the new VISION PRIME electron microscope, a state-of-the-art instrument designed for operando and low-dose-rate atomic-resolution TEM studies.

You will contribute to a deeper mechanistic understanding of catalytic processes and help guide the design of next-generation catalyst materials.

What You’ll Do
Depending on your background and interests, you will undertake research activities such as:
  • Performing operando, low-dose-rate TEM to capture real-time atomic-scale catalyst dynamics
  • Advancing ultrasensitive imaging and spectroscopy of gas–surface interactions, molecular adsorption, and active-site formation
  • Fabricate and use microfabricated reactors for realistic catalytic environments
  • Visualize, quantify and interpret nanoparticle restructuring, vibrations, and surface dynamics
  • Develop and apply Python-based image/data analysis tools for large time-resolved TEM datasets
  • Establish quantitative links between 3D atomic structure, dynamics and catalytic functions of single nanoparticles
  • Collaborate with computational researchers to atomic-scale mechanisms, kinetics, and strategies for stabilizing active catalytic structures
  • Contribute to high-impact scientific publications and present your results at international conferences.
  • Take an active role in shaping new research directions within the VISION environment.

Qualifications
We favor candidates with a degree in physics, chemistry or materials science. Candidates must have documented skills in atomic-resolution transmission electron microscopy. Candidates should also have documented experience in one or more of the following areas: microfabricated devices, 2D materials, catalysis and/or surface science. Strong skills in scientific programming, e.g. using Python, is expected.

The candidate has obtained excellent grades in her/his Bachelor and Master educations, demonstrated outstanding problem-solving abilities, and good communication skills in both spoken and written English. Moreover, the candidates should also have proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a research team on a relevant scientific question.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment
The scholarships for the PhD degree are subject to academic approval, and the candidates will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education.

Assessment
The assessment will be made by Professor Christian D. Damsgaard, Professor Jakob Kibsgaard, Professor Joerg Jinschek and Professor Stig Helveg.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. The allowance will be agreed upon with the relevant union. The period of employment is 3 years, and the starting date is as soon as possible (according to mutual agreement).

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Professor Christian D. Damsgaard (e-mail: cdda@dtu.dk), Professor Jakob Kibsgaard (email: jkib@fysik.dtu.dk), Professor Joerg R. Jinschek (email: jojin@dtu.dk), and Professor Stig Helveg (email: stihe@dtu.dk).

You can read more about VISION at and DTU Physics at

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU.

Application procedure
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 30 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale

Incomplete applications will not be considered. You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

The Center for Visualizing Catalytic Processes (VISION) is funded by the Danish National Research Foundation and located at DTU Physics. VISION is developing and applying a new unique platform for visualizing catalytic nanoparticles and reactions at the atomic-level by integrating cutting-edge electron microscopy, microfabricated nanoreactors, nanoparticle synthesis and computational modelling. This approach enables new, direct operando observations that are urgently needed to advance mechanistic insight into catalytic processes at the atomic-scale.

VISION’s activities are centered around a new one-of-a-kind electron microscope, housed in DTU’s new "Climate Challenge Laboratory" building. The new laboratory hosts the VISION center, the Surface Physics and Catalysis section, the CatTheory section and the newly established Pioneer Center, CAPeX, as a vibrant collaborative research environment with internationally leading scientists in the fields of catalysis and power-to-X.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Bliv lærer på Langsøskolen
description:
– og gør en tydelig forskel for børn og unge

Har du lyst til at arbejde tæt på børn og unge, der har brug for voksne med ro, faglighed og stærke relationelle kompetencer?

Og motiveres du af at være en del af et stærkt fagligt og kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi sammen skaber læring, trivsel og udvikling?

Så er du måske den lærer, vi søger til en stilling på Langsøskolen. Vi søger en lærer til en fast stilling til Langsøskolens udskoling. Stillingen indeholder matematik, håndværk og design, historie og gerne tysk.


Langsøskolen

På Langsøskolen arbejder vi med et tydeligt pædagogisk ståsted med afsæt i KRAP. Det betyder, at vi møder børn og unge med en anerkendende tilgang og tager udgangspunkt i deres ressourcer, forudsætninger og aktuelle deltagelsesmuligheder. Vi er optaget af at skabe små og store skridt i elevernes faglige, sociale og personlige udvikling.

Vores skole ligger mellem sø, skov og by, og det bruger vi aktivt. Udeskole er en naturlig del af vores pædagogiske praksis, og Langsøskolen er netop blevet certificeret som Udeskole.

Du bliver en del af teams og professionelle læringsfællesskaber, hvor lærere og pædagoger samarbejder tæt om elevernes læring, trivsel og udvikling. Vi lykkes bedst, når vi lykkes sammen – og når vi tør være nysgerrige på både elevernes og vores egen praksis.

Vores mål er at styrke barnets selvtillid og selvværd, så det enkelte barn får de bedste muligheder for at udvikle sig til et selvstændigt og livsdueligt menneske. Vi vægter fællesskabet højt, og alle børn skal opleve sig som en værdifuld del af et fællesskab.

For at trives i stillingen skal du kunne skabe ro, retning og relationer i en hverdag, hvor elevernes behov kan være forskellige fra dag til dag. Du skal have lyst til at involvere dig i eleverne og deres forældre og til at indgå i et tæt samarbejde med kolleger, hvor fælles refleksion, fleksibilitet og tydelighed er afgørende for, at børnene og de unge lykkes.


Vi leder efter en lærer, der:
  • Tør være ambitiøs på elevernes vegne og fastholde troen på deres udviklingsmuligheder
  • Har stærke relationelle kompetencer og kan skabe tillid, tryghed og tydelighed
  • Bidrager aktivt til det professionelle læringsfællesskab i et tæt og engageret samarbejde med både lærere og pædagoger
  • Indgår aktivt i undervisningen og i arbejdet omkring børnene, herunder konflikthåndtering
  • Ser barnets handlinger som mestringsstrategier og kan være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag adfærden
  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat og kan justere indsatsen efter barnets overskud, dagsform og situationen omkring barnet
  • Formulerer sig klart og præcist i både skrift og tale og selvstændigt tager ansvar for handleplaner, elevplaner, undervisningsplaner og notater
  • Kan indgå i et åbent forældresamarbejde for at skabe den bedste skoledag for børnene
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og tager aktivt ansvar i teamsamarbejdet
  • Har en undersøgende og nysgerrig tilgang til undervisning og læring

Hos os bliver du en del af:
  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og et tydeligt fokus på pædagogisk udvikling
  • Et kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi bakker op, hjælper hinanden og udvikler os sammen
  • Et udviklende og inspirerende samarbejde i teamet og på skolen som helhed
  • En travl, men meningsfuld hverdag, hvor der også er plads til grin, og hvor vi vægter både faglig og social læring højt
  • Et tæt og vigtigt forældresamarbejde, der er med til at skabe sammenhæng omkring barnets skoleliv

Yderligere information:
Vil du vide mere om Langsøskolen og vores pædagogiske ståsted, anbefaler vi, at du besøger vores hjemmeside .

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Kirsten Garsdal Hedeby på tlf. 2012 5097 eller skoleleder Jakob Kleist på tlf. 5136 3422

Ansøgningsfrist: torsdag den 10. september 2026. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt torsdag den den 17. september 2026.

Tiltrædelse pr. 1. november eller snarest muligt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Vi foretrækker, at du sender din ansøgning online.
Klik på Ansøg. Vedhæft din ansøgning og relevante bilag.

Vi indhenter offentlig straffeattest på den person, vi ønsker at ansætte.

We are looking for a Digital Change Demand & Capability Lead who is strategic, collaborative and results-driven to join us in our Digital Technology team, based in our HQ office in Brussels, Belgium.

About the role

As our Senior Digital Change & Transformation Lead, you will play a key role in shaping how digital change is delivered across the organization. You will help evaluate and prioritize change management demand across a broad portfolio of digital initiatives, ensuring projects receive the right level of support, expertise, and resources.

You will also help strengthen change management capabilities across the company by developing methodologies, building internal expertise, and driving consistent adoption practices. This is a unique opportunity to combine digital transformation experience, change leadership, operational excellence, and stakeholder engagement in a highly visible role.

Who you'll work with

You will be working in a team dedicated to enabling successful digital transformation across the business. You will partner closely with digital technology leaders, project teams, communications specialists, talent professionals, and external partners to ensure employees are ready to embrace change and realize the value of new technologies.

You will collaborate with stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies, helping create a scalable and sustainable approach to digital change while contributing to the evolution of our transformation practices.

What you'll do

  • Lead the intake, assessment, prioritization, and resource planning of change management requests across a large portfolio of digital initiatives
  • Partner with project and business leaders to assess change impacts, adoption risks, organizational readiness, and support requirements
  • Develop and maintain change management methodologies, tools, standards, and guidance to ensure consistency across transformation initiatives
  • Build internal change management capabilities through learning programs, onboarding, coaching, and capability development initiatives
  • Monitor demand, resource allocation, adoption metrics, and portfolio performance to support effective decision-making and governance
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through analytics, automation, and digital tools that enhance change management practices

  • Experience with information technology service management processes, agile ways of working, and digital technology delivery environments
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills across all organizational levels

title: Support Engineer III, SIG, Security Integrations Group (SIG)
description:
Amazon Worldwide Physical Security (PhySec) apart of Amazon's Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is looking for a highly motivated, detail oriented individual to provide application support, troubleshooting, and customer issue resolution for the Security Integrations Group (SIG).

This individual will work with other engineers to support Amazon Operations' physical security system infrastructures, including: access control, video management systems, visitor management, and incident management systems.

The Security Integrations Group is a 24/7 operation, and shift work will be required, potentially including nights and weekends.

Key job responsibilities
- Day-to-day support operations of a fast-paced complex distributed physical security infrastructures
- Responding to telephone, ticket and e-mail requests in a professional, efficient manner
- Performing various programming and technical project / administrative related activities on the security systems
- Following standard procedures for proper escalation of issues to the appropriate teams
- Reviewing and recommending logical and technical design as defined by documented standards
- Documenting knowledge in the form of knowledge base Wiki articles
- Ability to work shifts that include holidays and weekends
- Participating in an on-call rotation

A day in the life
Your day kicks off with a shift change briefing — a quick sync with the outgoing engineer(s) to review any open high-severity tickets, ongoing projects, and overnight events. You check the team calendar for scheduled events, review your ticket queue, and log into the contact support portal. The days moves along as you and the team you are a part of are solving physical security operational issues across the Americas. You update your shift notes, brief the incoming engineering peers on any open items, and log off knowing that the global SIG team will carry the mission forward seamlessly through the night. No two days are the same, but every day matters.

Who Thrives Here

- Problem solvers who love diagnosing and fixing complex technical issues under pressure
- Customer-obsessed engineers who take pride in rapid, high-quality service delivery
- Self-starters who can prioritize competing demands and manage their time effectively
- Collaborators who communicate clearly across time zones and teams
- Lifelong learners who are energized by mastering new systems and technologies

Ready to Protect What Matters?

If you're passionate about physical security technology, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to make a tangible impact at one of the world's most innovative companies — SIG is looking for you.

Join us. Secure the future.

About the team
Security Integrations Group (SIG), a part of Worldwide Physical Security (PhySec), is primarily an engineering team for Amazon's physical security systems across the globe, but also participates in the design, development, deployment, and project management aspects of these systems. SIG provides 24/7 customer support for physical security systems. SIG provides 24x7 support via support engineering teams based in North America, Australia, and Europe. Engineers are available in-office at all times.

Our team’s mission is to lead and unify Amazon's physical security capabilities worldwide by setting strategic frameworks, standards, and processes that enable regional physical security teams and support functions to protect Amazon's end-to-end supply chain. Through continuous innovation in security technology, methodologies, and automation, the organization drives consistent, scalable, and data-driven improvements supporting Security & Loss Prevention (S&LP) performance while supporting business initiatives in a fast-changing operating environment.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Harvard College Communications & Marketing, this role oversees editorial planning, content creation, and storytelling initiatives across multiple communications channels and audiences.

The Associate Director is responsible for establishing and managing a comprehensive annual content strategy and editorial calendar, ensuring content aligns with Harvard College priorities and advances a clear, authentic, and affirmative narrative. The role leads editorial operations, supervises content and editorial staff, manages content production workflows, and uses performance analytics to continuously improve content effectiveness and audience engagement.

Working closely with College leadership and cross-functional communications teams, the Associate Director identifies strategic storytelling opportunities, develops content that highlights the impact and mission of Harvard College, and contributes to reputation-building efforts through proactive, high-quality communications.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Content Strategy and Editorial Leadership

  • Develop and lead a comprehensive content and editorial strategy that advances Harvard College priorities and strategic objectives.
  • Translate institutional goals and initiatives into a cohesive annual content plan that includes story themes, audiences, formats, channels, collaborators, timelines, and success measures.
  • Establish editorial priorities and ensure content supports an authentic, engaging, and affirmative narrative about Harvard College.
  • Maintain a long-term editorial vision while balancing emerging opportunities and institutional needs.

Editorial Planning and Content Production

  • Develop, maintain, and manage a comprehensive annual editorial calendar.
  • Lead editorial planning processes and oversee the creation, assignment, editing, and publication of content across multiple communications channels.
  • Write, edit, and assign stories and content while establishing clear expectations, deadlines, and quality standards.
  • Ensure content is accurate, engaging, audience-focused, and aligned with brand and editorial guidelines.
  • Coordinate content production schedules and workflows to support timely and effective execution.

Team Leadership and Staff Development

  • Supervise, coach, and develop editorial and content staff.
  • Establish performance expectations, conduct performance evaluations, and support professional growth and development.
  • Manage workload distribution and prioritize resources to meet organizational goals and deadlines.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture focused on creativity, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Promote editorial excellence and innovation across the team.

Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration

  • Partner with College leadership, faculty, administrators, and communications colleagues to identify and develop strategic storytelling opportunities.
  • Collaborate with communications, marketing, digital, media relations, and creative services teams to ensure integrated communications efforts.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on content strategy, editorial planning, and audience engagement.
  • Build strong relationships across Harvard College to facilitate content development and information sharing.

Analytics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and evaluate content performance across communications channels.
  • Develop and disseminate regular reports, including editorial planning updates, monthly look-ahead reports, and performance summaries for College leadership.
  • Analyze audience engagement, content effectiveness, and communications trends to inform future strategies.
  • Translate data and analytics into actionable recommendations that improve content quality, reach, and impact.
  • Establish and track key performance indicators for content initiatives.

Reputation Building and Strategic Storytelling

  • Partner with the Senior Director, Harvard College Communications & Marketing to maintain awareness of emerging issues and reputational risks.
  • Identify opportunities to proactively address challenges and strengthen institutional reputation through strategic storytelling.
  • Develop content that highlights Harvard College’s mission, community, achievements, and impact.
  • Ensure storytelling efforts support broader communications, engagement, and reputation goals.

Process Improvement and Editorial Excellence

  • Continuously assess and improve editorial workflows, tools, governance, and best practices.
  • Implement processes that increase efficiency, consistency, and quality across content operations.
  • Stay current on content strategy, digital storytelling, audience engagement, and communications trends.
  • Recommend and adopt innovative approaches that enhance content effectiveness and operational performance.

Working Conditions:

  • This position will be based on our campus in Cambridge, MA. Our office works on a hybrid schedule, and this role will be on-campus four days per week.
  • Complying with the office’s work location requirements is a condition of continued employment. All remote work must be performed in a state in which Harvard is registered to do business (CT, MA, MD, ME, NH, NY, RI, and VT).
  • Occasional evening and weekend work may be required to support major initiatives, events, or institutional priorities.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in journalism, higher education communications, content strategy, editorial operations, marketing communications, or a related field.
  • Experience supervising, managing, and developing professional staff.


Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Strong editorial judgment and storytelling expertise across multiple formats, channels, and audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience leading editorial strategy and managing content production.
  • Experience with content management systems, editorial planning tools, analytics platforms, and digital communications channels preferred.
  • Experience interpreting analytics and audience insights to drive content strategy and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing content strategies that support organizational goals.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong people management skills, including coaching, mentoring, performance management, and team development.
  • Proven project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across a complex and highly decentralized organization.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality, consistency, and brand standards.


  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Education
  • Other Information: Applicants are strongly encouraged to submit a cover letter.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 058. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

title: Apulaismyymäläpäällikkö, 37.5h/vko, JYSK Raisio
description:
Koetko motivoituvasi esihenkilövastuusta?

Meillä ratkaisee asenne ja tavoitteellisuus oppia uutta sekä tehdä tulosta. Meillä apulaismyymäläpäälliköt saavat vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden kasvaa. Meillä voit luoda uraa, ja tavoitella tulevaisuudessa omaa myymälää. Jos olet valmiina tarttumaan haasteisiin, tämä voi olla juuri sinun paikkasi.

Tutustu ja lue lisää apulaismyymäläpäällikön työstä JYSKissä.

APULAISMYYMÄLÄPÄÄLLIKÖN TYÖ JYSKISSÄ

  • Olet vastuussa myymälän myynnillisestä johtamisesta, B2B-myynnistä ja koulutat tiimiä jatkuvasti eri JYSK konseptien tiimoilta.
  • Tavoitteet ohjaavat työtäsi: meillä jokaisella on selkeä suunta ja halu ylittää odotukset.
  • Toimit tiiviisti myymäläpäällikön työparina, ja saat vastuullisesi myös esihenkilövastuita ja –tehtäviä.
  • Toimit hyvänä esimerkkinä koko tiimille, priorisoit ja valtuutat viikoittaisia työtehtäviä tiimin kesken, tuet työvuorosuunnittelussa, huolehdit kampanjavaihdoista, tiimin tiedottamisesta, seuraat tunnuslukuja ja teet tarvittavia toimia sekä pidät huolta että myymälä on aina kaupallinen ja valmiina asiakkaita varten.
  • Viikoittaisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu myös aktiivinen palautteenantaminen tiimille auttaen heitä onnistumaan työssään.
  • Työ vaatii hyvää peruskuntoa, mutta saat käyttöösi parhaat työvälineet ja tiimin tuen.
  • Monipuolisuutta – myymälä, varasto, kampanjat… tylsyys ei kuulu sanavarastoomme.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA

  • Sinulla on motivaatiota tehdä töitä esihenkilönä ja johtaa tiimiä tuloksiin omalla esimerkilläsi.
  • Kokemus ja näytöt esimerkiksi vuorovastaavan tehtävistä katsotaan eduksesi.
  • Olet myyntihenkinen, ja tuloksellisuus sekä tavoitteiden ylittäminen ovat sinulle tärkeitä asioita työssäsi. Haluat myös myydä ja menestyä joka työvuorossa.
  • Tunnet muiden kouluttamisen, perehdyttämisen ja opastamisen osaksi omia vahvuuksiasi.
  • Siedät keskeneräisyyttä, koska tekemistä on paljon ja kaikkea ei aina voi saada valmiiksi kerralla.
  • Olet parhaimmillasi kiireessä ja nopeatempoisessa ympäristössä. Tykkäät nopeatempoisesta työtahdista ja yllättävistäkin työtehtävistä kesken työvuoron.
  • Olet aloitteellinen ja itsenäisesti toimeentarttuva, sekä saat energiaa tiimityöstä ja omien tavoitteidesi ylittämisestä.
  • Olet joustava sekä tehtävien että työtuntien ja työaikojen suhteen. Töitä tehdään vaihtelevasti eri vuoroissa aamulla, illalla kuin viikonloppuisinkin.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE

  • Palkkaus kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.
  • Peruspalkan ja lisien lisäksi apulaismyymäläpäälliköillä on oma vuosittain määriteltävä bonusohjelma
  • Kattavalla perehdytysohjelmalla sekä myymäläpäällikön tuella opit nopeasti työn, voit näyttää taitosi sekä kasvaa ja kehittyä tulevaisuudessa myymäläpäällikön tehtäviin.
  • Työvuorosuunnittelumme tukee palautumista ja työssäjaksamista.
  • Meillä on turvallinen työympäristö, jossa työn fyysisyyttä on auttamassa erilaisia apuvälineitä, ja aktiivinen ja avoin keskustelu myymälässä tukee henkistä jaksamista ja hyvää yhteishenkeä.
  • Meillä on töissä hauskaa ja vauhdikasta. Saat ympärillesi loistavat tiimikaverit.
  • Henkilökunta-alennus, työterveyspalvelut, vuosittainen Edenred liikunta- ja kulttuurietu, JYSK Awards -palkintogaala.
  • Mahdollisuuden kilpailla, voittaa ja juhlia tiimin kanssa – kyllä, meillä on kisat ja palkinnot!
  • Olemme vakavarainen vähittäiskauppaketju, joka tarjoaa vahvan pohjan rakentaa monipuolista uraa tulevaisuudessa omien kykyjesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan.
  • Apulaismyymäläpäälliköille järjestetään vuosittain oma kokous- ja koulutuspäivä Vantaan pääkonttorilla, jolloin pääset verkostoitumaan muiden apulaismyymäläpäälliköiden kanssa.

Työnantajan toimintaohjeiden ymmärrys ja suorassa asiakaspalvelukontaktissa toimiminen edellyttävät tehtävään valitulta hakijalta hyvää kirjallista ja suullista suomenkielentaitoa.

Mahdolliset tiedustelut: Myymäläpäällikkö Jasmiina Siikarla, SMF903@jysk.com

REKRYTOINTIPROSESSI

Hakemuksia käsitellään aktiivisesti jo hakuaikana. Hakemukset käsitellään luottamuksellisesti rekrytoivan

Hakemuksia käsitellään aktiivisesti jo hakuaikana. Valinta tehtävään tehdään heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä. Viestimme sinulle sähköpostitse hakuprosessin etenemisestä viiden (5) arkipäivän sisällä hakemuksesi lähettämisestä.

Jos pääset seuraavaan vaiheeseen, se on ajasta ja paikasta riippumaton videohaastattelu, jossa pääset kertomaan lyhyesti lisää itsestäsi. Kutsu videohaastatteluun lähetetään sähköpostilla, joten seuraathan sähköpostiasi. Jos saat henkilökohtaisen kutsun videohaastatteluun, siihen tulee vastata kolmen (3) päivän sisällä.

Hakemukset käsitellään luottamuksellisesti rekrytoivan esihenkilötiimin toimesta.

MEISTÄ

Me uskomme, että avainasemassa menestykseemme ovat työntekijämme. Siksi tarjoamme jatkuvasti koulutusta ja erilaisia urapolkuja. Sen jälkeen, kun perustajamme Lars Larsen avasi ensimmäisen myymälänsä Tanskassa vuonna 1979, JYSK on laajentunut maailmalaajuiseksi ketjuksi. Meillä on myymälöitä ja verkkokauppoja ympäri maailman.

Kolme JYSKin perusarvoa – kauppias, kollega ja yrityshenki – ilmaisevat käyttäytymistä ja asennetta, joita voimme odottaa toisiltamme. Luotamme toisiimme, ja uskomme valtuuttamiseen vapaudella ja vastuulla tehdä. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijöidemme pitkistä työurista ja sitoutumisesta. Olemme tutkitustikin yksi Suomen parhaista työpaikoista. Oikeanlaisella asenteella, JYSKissä on tarjolla monenlaisia mahdollisuuksia. Lue lisää arvoistamme linkin takaa: JYSK työpaikkana ja arvomme

Kannustamme kaikkia hakemaan avoimia tehtäviämme sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä taustasta, uskonnosta tai muista henkilökohtaisista ominaisuuksista riippumatta. Lue lisää monimuotoisuustyöstämme linkin takaa: Monimuotoisuustyö JYSKissä
