title: IT Project Manager - ERP
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job description

The Delivery Management Professional (SE7) provides expert guidance on complex deliveries, drives efficiency improvements, influences stakeholder decisions, and mentors others to achieve strategic alignment and support team growth. In this role, you will navigate organizational complexity to define and communicate comprehensive solution visions and roadmaps for large-scale and strategically critical initiatives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Program Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, STE, or Agile Coach.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

  • Scope / (Content Leadership): Provides expert guidance and strategic direction on defining and managing scope for complex or high-impact initiatives. Develops, implements, and champions scope management strategies, frameworks, and best practices for relevant initiatives. Oversees the management of significant scope changes, ensuring strategic alignment and minimal disruption, while proactively identifying and driving improvements to scope-related processes for enhanced delivery efficiency.

  • Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of complex and strategic delivery problems across boundaries, eliciting complex needs and influencing decisions. Accountable for delivery management on significant initiatives, defining strategic solutions, and driving consensus through persuasive communication and facilitation. Proactively identifies strategic opportunities and risks, and mentors colleagues on problem-solving.

  • Stakeholder Management: Identifies key stakeholders, including senior management, across organizational boundaries and analyzes complex stakeholder networks. Develops and executes comprehensive stakeholder engagement and communication plans. Influences stakeholder decisions related to delivery, navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and builds strong collaborative relationships across the organization.

  • Impact/Strategy: Provides consistent leadership and significant impact across major products within a product line or domain. Drives significant impact on projects and programs by embedding Agile best practices and leading organizational change initiatives. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, fosters a culture of innovation, and proactively proposes improvements to help implement strategic objectives.

  • Complexity / (Product Size): Manages complex projects or services, potentially across domains, and leads delivery within a program or large initiative. Manages highly complex delivery involving multiple dependencies, opportunities, and risks. Handles ambiguous delivery requirements and leads the implementation of delivery frameworks while navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.

  • Business/Technical ability: Possesses in-depth business knowledge and understanding of market trends to shape delivery strategies that achieve strategic business objectives. Drives business process improvements and innovation, and leads the implementation of Agile frameworks and other delivery best practices. Manages large-scale, complex delivery programs and innovates delivery methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Qualifications

Education / Experience

  • Proven track record operating in a Delivery Management archetype (e.g., Program Manager, STE, Agile Coach) with extensive experience managing large-scale, complex delivery programs.

  • Experience in embedding Agile best practices and leading organizational change initiatives across product lines or domains.

  • Demonstrated success in building and maintaining strong relationships with key senior stakeholders and cultivating collaboration across organizational boundaries.

Technical / Business Skills

  • In-depth business knowledge and an understanding of market trends, with the ability to shape delivery strategies to achieve strategic business objectives.

  • Expertise in leading the implementation of Agile frameworks, delivery methodologies, and other best practices.

  • Advanced analytical skills to lead the analysis of complex, cross-boundary delivery problems and evaluate strategic solution options.

Additional Qualifications

  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to drive consensus on solutions and navigate conflicts to achieve alignment.

  • Strong coaching and mentoring capabilities; acts as a mentor for less experienced professionals, providing constructive feedback and guiding them in complex scope management and problem-solving.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Dansklærer til indskolingen og mellemtrinnet til Trekløverskolen, afdeling Græse Bakkeby
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn?

På Trekløverskolen, afdeling Græse Bakkeby, søger vi en uddannet lærer til indskoling og mellemtrin med interesse for inkluderende læringsmiljøer og specialpædagogisk praksis.

Vi har aktuelt ikke en ledig danskklasse, der venter på dig, men det kommer. Til gengæld har vi en masse skønne børn, som mangler en engageret lærer til fag som håndværk og design, idræt, svømning, co-teaching og musik. Du behøver bestemt ikke at kunne dække alle fagene, men vi vil meget gerne høre, hvad du brænder for, og hvilke kompetencer du kan byde ind med.

Stillingen vil både indeholde undervisning i almenområdet og opgaver i vores mellemformer, hvor du bliver en del af et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med dygtige kolleger omkring elevernes trivsel, læring og deltagelse.

Om mellemformerne
Vores mellemformer rummer elever, der enten er fuldtids- eller deltids tilknyttet. Du indgår i et tæt samarbejde med en fast pædagog, og sammen skaber I tydelige, relationsstærke og strukturerede læringsmiljøer for elever, som i perioder har brug for rammer uden for den almene klasse.

title: Pædagog til KKFO Bjerget med faste opgaver i indskolingen på Kirkebjerg Skole i Vanløse
description:
Vi søger en engageret og innovativ pædagog, som har mod på at arbejde i et nogle gange hektisk, men spændende og udviklende arbejdsfællesskab, hvor fagligheden og organisationen vægtes højt og der samtidig er plads til humør og arbejdsglæde.

Kirkebjerg Skole er en skole, som både har en almen og en specialklasserække med i alt ca. 1000 børn. Skolen er populær og meget søgt. Vi har brobygning/overgangsforløb for kommende skolebørn med tre børnehaver, som hører til vores skoledistriktet.

Om os
KKFO Bjerget er normeret til 330 børn fra 0.-3.klasse, fordelt på tre afdelinger. Vi er beliggende i to selvstændige huse rundt om Kirkebjerg Skole og har attraktive arealer til mange forskellige aktiviteter både ude og inde. Vi er en mangfoldig og stabil medarbejdergruppe med mange forskellige kompetencer og vi er ca. 26 ansatte.

I dagligdagen samarbejder Institutionens tre afdelinger tæt sammen på en række områder, hvor vi synes at det giver mening, men vi er samtidig fysisk opdelte, for at skabe ”det små i det store” - altså overskuelighed, nærvær og tryghed for børn og ansatte. Vi vægter organisationen og den fritidspædagogiske faglighed højt. Vi gør dertil vores bedste for at skabe en god stemning og høj arbejdsglæde på alle vores tre afdelinger.

Alle afdelinger er aldersintegrerede og modtager hele klasser. På KKFO'en vil du være fast tilknyttet afdeling Gården, som modtager fire klasser og har otte ansatte. Stillingen indeholder øremærkede timer, hvor du i samarbejde med en lærer og et lærerteam understøtter klassefællesskabet og er med til at forbedre og udvikle deltagelsesmulighederne for alle børn.

Både skole og KKFO arbejder med at implementere tankerne i forvaltningens dagsorden om ”Mangfoldige børnefællesskaber”, for at flere børn kan blive en del af et alment miljø. Vi arbejder ud fra børnesynet: ”Børn gør det så godt de kan”.

Vi er en institution, hvor vi arbejder med udvikling af faglige arbejdsfællesskaber ud fra en anerkendende tankegang, samt arbejder målrettet mod, hvad der har bedst effekt for barnets trivsel og udvikling.

Vi har et tæt og velfungerende samarbejde med skolen og lærerne, som vi kontinuerligt udvikler på.

Hvad forventer vi af dig?

  • Du er en pædagog, der er fagligt velfunderet, empatisk og aktivt vægter arbejdsfællesskabet og samtidig kan lide at samarbejde på tværs af aldersklasser og skole/KKFO. Pædagogisk erfaring er godt, men vi ser det ikke som en forudsætning for at søge stillingen
  • At du brænder for at være med til at udvikle trygge og udviklende rammer for børns fritidsliv og skolegang
  • At du kan se vigtigheden af det optimale samarbejde mellem skole, KKFO og forældre
  • At du evner og tør sætte tydelige rammer for børnefællesskabet
  • At du aktivt orienterer dig om og arbejder ind i dagsordenen ”Mangfoldige Børnefællesskaber”, som vores forvaltning har lanceret
  • Har du dertil en naturlig lyst til at sætte fokus på udendørs aktiviteter eller har en kreativ åre, betragter vi det som et plus. Vi vil gerne blive bedre til at udnytte vores udendørs rammer
Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

  • Vi arbejder efter årsnorm
  • En personalegruppe, som glæder sig til at tage imod dig og sammen udvikle rammer for det gode børneliv
  • Et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor nogle af nøgleordene er humor, varme og professionalisme
  • Tydelig ledelse og kommunikation, så vi kender hinandens forventninger, ønsker og ambitioner
  • En KKFO/skole, hvor vi aktivt arbejder med principperne i MED-aftalen (medindflydelse/-bestemmelse/-ansvar)
  • En KKFO, hvor vi arbejder målrettet mod at højne fagligheden, blandt andet gennem programmerne KIDS, BOB o.lign. samt udvikling og efteruddannelse
  • At blive en del af et anerkendende følgeskab, som bygger på et stort engagement omkring kerneopgaven
  • En institution der blandt andet gerne vil udbygge de musiske og kreative tilbud til børnene
Vi arbejder generelt ud fra en anerkendende tankegang og tilgang til børnene.

På Bjerget har du mulighed for at være med til at præge dagligdagen og sætte dine pædagogiske ideer i spil.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og inden for rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

Stillingen er på 33 timer ugentligt og ønskes besat pr. 1. september 2026 eller snarest derefter.

I forbindelse med ansættelse indhenter vi børne- og straffeattest samt reference.

Mere information
Du kan læse mere på vores hjemmeside her.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, inden du sender din motiverede ansøgning, eller ikke kan vente med at se stedet selv, er du velkommen til at kontakte KKFO-leder Jesper Boysen på 27 11 69 42 - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig eller give en hurtig rundvisning.

Søg stillingen via linket senest søndag den 30. august 2026
Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler løbende.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
Wil jij met jouw technische kennis de brug slaan tussen product en klant in een ambitieuze hardware-startup die de glastuinbouw verduurzaamt? Als Application Engineer ben jij het eerste technische aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten en het salesteam.

BAAN · FULLTIME · ROTTERDAM

THERMELEON | Richting klimaatneutrale glastuinbouw

Ons product – de Thermeleon Warmtebatterij – is een innovatieve etmaalbuffer voor kassen. Het verbetert de energie-efficiëntie van kassen door de overtollige warmte strategisch te hergebruiken tijdens de dag-nachtcyclus. Zo verlagen we het aardgasgebruik substantieel en is er een hogere klimaatgelijkheid over de kas heen. In deze rol ben jij de technische schakel tussen ons Sales-team en onze klanten (telers). Je beantwoordt zelfstandig de meerderheid van de technische vragen die vanuit sales binnenkomen, en zorgt ervoor dat alleen de complexere vraagstukken bij het Tech-team terechtkomen. Je valt onder Operations en werkt nauw samen met zowel Sales als het technische team.

Tasks

WAT GA JE DOEN

Je bent eerstelijns technisch aanspreekpunt voor vragen die vanuit Sales binnenkomen

Je vertaalt technische vraagstukken naar heldere, begrijpelijke antwoorden voor klanten en salescollega's

Je handelt zelfstandig het grootste deel van de technische vragen af die vanuit sales binnenkomen

Je herkent en prioriteert complexere technische issues en zet deze gestructureerd door naar het Tech-team

Je ondersteunt Sales bij offertes, demo's en klantgesprekken waar technische diepgang nodig is

Je denkt actief mee over hoe het technische proces en de klantvraag beter op elkaar aansluiten

Requirements

WAT WE ZOEKEN
Je hebt een technische studie-achtergrond (bijvoorbeeld Werktuigbouwkunde, Natuurkunde, Chemical Engineering of vergelijkbaar)

Je hebt affiniteit met klantcontact en commercieel inzicht

Je bent een sterke communicator die technische inhoud helder over kan brengen aan een niet-technisch publiek

Je bent zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht, en schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en klantrelatie

Ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol (bijvoorbeeld Technical Sales, Asset Reliability Specialist, Application Engineer) is een pré

Passie voor duurzame innovatie en hardware

Benefits

WAT WIJ BIEDEN

Je bouwt het data-platform vanaf de grond af aan, met veel eigen inbreng in tooling en architectuur

Ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidende rol binnen het team

Je werkt aan een concreet, impactvol probleem: het optimaliseren van het energieverbruik van kassen

Een inkijkje in een startup: bijbehorende financiering, subsidies, etc.

Multidisciplinaire samenwerking: met Sales, Operations en het R&D-team

ONS TEAM

Thermeleon bestaat uit een enthousiast en gevarieerd team dat is gedreven door een duurzame ideologie en een passie voor de glastuinbouw. Momenteel bevinden we ons in de startup-fase, waarbij de metingen bij de klant in een high-tech kas in volle gang zijn. Om te blijven leren (van elkaar), organiseren we elke vrijdag een 'Therming Sessie' om kennis te delen en de week af te sluiten.

We zijn onderdeel van het duurzame-startup innovatieprogramma van de Europese Unie (Climate-KIC) en ontvangen ook subsidie van het NWO-domein Toegepaste en Technische Wetenschappen (TTW) in samenwerking met de TU Delft.

WERKLOCATIE

Ons kantoor bevindt zich in de monumentale Van Nellefabriek in Rotterdam.

DIVERSITEIT

Wij streven naar diversiteit in het team! Dit geldt zowel in opleiding, achtergrond, specialisatie, en man/vrouw verdeling. Onderzoek toont aan dat mannen zich zelfverzekerd genoeg voelen om te solliciteren als ze aan 60% van de eisen voldoen, terwijl vrouwelijke kandidaten alleen solliciteren als ze elke box aantikken. Dus als deze rol bij je past maar je je nog niet helemaal zeker voelt over de criteria: we horen graag van je!

title: Engineer, Privileged Access Management
description:
Bring more to life.

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

At Danaher, an Engineer, Privileged Access Management builds, configures, operates, and troubleshoots the PAM platform. Strategy and architecture are set by leadership and the PAM Architect/Global Lead; the Engineer executes within that design, onboarding privileged accounts and operationalizing least privilege. The Engineer works independently on assigned scope and coordinates with system owners across teams with their own environments.

This position reports to the Global Lead, Identity Security and is part of the enterprise-wide Danaher Information Security (DIS) in Pune/Bangalore and will be an onsite role.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Engineer/operate PAM platforms: safes, policies, connectors, session recording, password rotation, discovery jobs, endpoint privilege policies, and integrations.

  • Build automation (PowerShell/Python, REST APIs) for onboarding, rotation, and reconciliation.

  • Contribute to reference-pattern implementation defined by the Architect; feed operational reality back into design.

  • Support the sustainability model: runbooks, health checks, and managed-account ownership records.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

  • 9+ years of cybersecurity or IT experience with hands-on privileged access management.

  • Hands-on experience operating enterprise PAM platforms (such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or Delinea): onboarding, vaulting, password rotation, session recording, and discovery.

  • Experience with Active Directory, Windows/Linux administration, and cloud IAM in support of privileged account management.

  • Experience automating PAM tasks with scripting (such as PowerShell or Python) and REST APIs.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience with endpoint privilege management or cloud PAM.

  • CyberArk Defender/Guardian, Security+, or a cloud security certification.

  • Experience supporting global or multi-business-unit environments.

- Onboard privileged/service accounts; manage safes, policies, and connectors.
- Triage failed rotations, vaulted-credential issues, and access-workflow failures.
- Remediate orphaned/shared/admin accounts; run and tune discovery jobs.
- Monitor privileged activity; support incident response and change control.
- Collect audit evidence; document configurations and runbooks.
- Coordinate with Windows/Linux, AD, and cloud owners on account integration.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

The Perfusion Department actively involved in the Transplant (Heart, Lungs & Liver), Organ Regeneration, ECLS and Ventricular Assist Device Programs. Our suite of ORs incorporates state-of-the-art-technology to assist the surgical teams in handling the most complex cases. We have an environment where creativity and innovative case management are encouraged.

This opportunity is not for everyone, but for those with the desire, motivation, and energy, it will be a life-changing experience.

Duties

  • Maintains and optimizes circulatory support and homeostasis of patients requiring cardiopulmonary bypass in cardiac and non-cardiac procedures by utilizing theoretical knowledge and technical skills to assemble, calibrate and operate the heart lung machine
  • Assembles, operates, and monitors myocardial preservation during CPB
  • Accesses the needs of patients and independently respond to and deliver appropriate therapies
  • Provides additional therapeutic services such as:
    • Administering under prescription, various medical gases, anesthetics, drugs, blood products, and crystalloid solutions
    • Induced hypothermia and hemodilution of various degrees
    • Operating and monitoring of Ventricular assist devices
    • Isolated chemotherapeutic limb perfusion; and more
  • Demonstrates and understands the operational theory/procedures and performance characteristics of equipment to facilitate their effective and efficient operation in accordance to patient’s requirement
  • Ensures the quality of the practice and safety standards is maintained
  • Utilizes specialized knowledge to participates in professional development, teaching and education activities within Perfusion Services
  • At minimum, completion of a BSc degree with a diploma in Cardiovascular Perfusion
  • Certification (or eligibility of certification) with the Canadian Society of Clinical Perfusion (CSCP)/or American Board of Clinical Perfusion (ABCP)
  • Thorough knowledge of the theory and practice procedures, instruments, equipment, and special techniques
  • Specialized knowledge of extracorporeal physiology and mechanics (both adult and pediatric) required
  • Knowledge of applicable Hospital and departmental policies, procedures, guidelines, protocols and practices
  • Excellent judgement, problem recognition, and problem solving-skills
  • Effective time management skills with the ability to organize work and set priorities for self and others
  • Highly developed expertise and effective communication with all other health team members are essential in making the frequent, critical decisions required during the course of a bypass or other related perfusion procedures
  • Ability to work both effectively and accurately, adapting under stressful conditions in a fast-paced team environment
  • Demonstrated interest in continuing education

In addition to working alongside some of the most talented and inspiring healthcare professionals in the world, UHN offers a wide range of benefits, programs and perks. It is the comprehensiveness of these offerings that makes it a differentiating factor, allowing you to find value where it matters most to you, now and throughout your career at UHN.

  • Competitive offer packages
  • Government organization and a member of the Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP )
  • Close access to Transit and UHN shuttle service
  • A flexible work environment
  • Opportunities for development and promotions within a large organization
  • Additional perks (multiple corporate discounts including: travel, restaurants, parking, phone plans, auto insurance discounts, on-site gyms, etc.)

Current UHN employees must have successfully completed their probationary period, have a good employee record along with satisfactory attendance in accordance with UHN's attendance management program, to be eligible for consideration.

All applications must be submitted before the posting close date.

UHN uses email to communicate with selected candidates. Please ensure you check your email regularly. At University Health Network (UHN), artificial intelligence technologies may be used to assist in the screening, assessment, and selection of candidates for this position.

Please be advised that a Criminal Record Check may be required of the successful candidate. Should it be determined that any information provided by a candidate be misleading, inaccurate or incorrect, UHN reserves the right to discontinue with the consideration of their application.

UHN is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive recruitment process and workplace. Requests for accommodation can be made at any stage of the recruitment process. Applicants need to make their requirements known.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

title: Senior Digital Strategist, Atlantic Records
description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

Job Title: Senior Digital Strategist, Atlantic Records

A little bit about our team:

Atlantic Records UK is home to some of the most iconic UK artists from household names such as Ed Sheeran, Charli xcx & Fred Again… to emerging names such as Barry Can’t Swim Erin LeCount and Maisie Peters.

You’d be joining the Atlantic UK digital team, who work hand in hand with marketing and our US counterparts to construct our artist campaigns; driving amplification online, growing audiences and galvanising fan communities forming around our artists. We’re looking for a highly dynamic digital marketeer with an innate curiosity to think two steps ahead of a constantly landscape, break artists and deliver best-in-class campaigns.

Your role:

As a Senior Digital Strategist, you will be the driving force behind the end-to-end planning and execution of first-class campaigns for our artists, focused on engaging and growing their audience online. You’ll work in collaboration with a wide variety of stakeholders to ensure all touchpoints across social, content, community building, 1st-party data and creator strategy are leveraged to grow and engage fanbases. This role is a fantastic opportunity to further grow your skills as an experienced digital marketeer in a super dynamic and creative environment whilst deliver campaigns for some of the world’s most exciting artists.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Manage a roster of artist campaigns; delivering digital marketing strategies covering the full spectrum of social, community, direct-to-fan and influencer marketing.

  • Work closely with artists and managers to architect end-to-end (ideation, production, and distribution) content strategies for their campaigns across all major social platforms - actively contributing to the creative process.

  • Drive the strategic direction and daily management of artist social media accounts, ensuring content is platform-native and optimised for engagement.

  • Construct powerful content ecosystems around an artist beyond their owned social channels - encompassing asset supply and strategy around HQ, third-party and fan pages.

  • Collaborate with the Direct-to-Fan and Community team to develop strategies and initiatives to grow and utilise our artist’s 1st party data as well as build and nurture fan communities across platforms like Discord, Reddit etc.

  • Work closely with the Creator marketing team on influencer strategies, helping to identify briefs and key creators / pages to drive track-level usage and artist awareness.

  • Source and collaborate with the best content creators and independently manage social-first content shoots, briefing suppliers, and ensure quality deliverables.

  • Work closely with our social partners to deliver on platform support and best in class strategy across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap

  • Own campaign tracking, documentation, and reporting on assigned projects.

  • Maintain constant use of data and insight tools to inform strategic decisions around your campaigns.

About you:

  • You love music.

  • You are a true digital native deep with an understanding of marketing principles, best practice and growth tactics.

  • An avid social media consumer with your finger on the pulse of internet culture.

  • You have significant experience of working across music marketing campaigns with a proven track record of success.

  • You are innately curious, constantly driving towards new and evolved ways of approaching artist marketing with a strong interest in emerging trends.

  • You are organised with an ability to manage tasks effectively and meet deadlines.

  • You are a proactive learner, eager to develop your skills in digital marketing and the music industry.

  • You are a clear communicator and a collaborative team player.

  • You are data minded, and can use data to inform marketing decisions / report on campaign progress.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience in creating or commissioning social-first content first-hand.

  • Familiarity with digital marketing tools and analytics platforms.

  • Label, management or agency experience working directly with artists.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite


WMG is committed to inclusion and diversity in all aspects of our business. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and will evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religion or belief, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, disability, pregnancy, childbirth or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Programme Manager
description:
The Senior Programme Manager will lead the successful delivery of complex, high-value programmes within the UK TacCIS and wider defence, engineering and technical delivery environment. The role is responsible for driving programme performance across time, cost, quality, risk, financial and contractual commitments, while leading multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors and suppliers both directly and through subordinate managers.

The role requires strong programme governance, stakeholder management and customer leadership, with regular engagement at senior internal and external levels. The postholder will oversee programme planning, delivery assurance, financial control, risk and opportunity management, performance reporting and continuous improvement across a portfolio of medium to high complexity projects.

In addition to delivery responsibilities, the Senior Programme Manager will support business growth through capture, bid and proposal activity, ensuring opportunities are aligned to customer needs, business strategy and long-range planning objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the successful delivery of complex, high-value programmes across time, cost, quality, risk and contractual commitments.
  • Manage programme teams, subcontractors, suppliers and delivery partners both directly and through subordinate managers.
  • Establish robust programme governance, planning, reporting and performance controls across the portfolio.
  • Own programme financial performance, including budgets, forecasting, cost control, EAC/ETC, cash and margin.
  • Identify, assess and manage programme risks and opportunities, ensuring mitigation plans are implemented and escalated where required.
  • Act as a senior interface with customers, users, internal stakeholders, suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Provide clear, timely and accurate programme reporting to support senior decision-making.
  • Lead cross-functional delivery teams across engineering, commercial, supply chain, finance and project controls.
  • Ensure contractual deliverables, milestones, KPIs and customer commitments are met.
  • Support business growth through capture, bid and proposal activity for new and follow-on opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement across programme delivery, governance, team performance and customer outcomes.
  • Align programme delivery with wider business strategy, long-range planning and organisational objectives.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience in complex programme delivery, strong commercial and financial acumen, proven leadership of cross-functional teams and supply chains, and the ability to operate confidently across both Waterfall and Agile delivery environments. Experience in Tactical Communications, defence, engineering or similar complex technical domains would be advantageous.

  • Extensive experience delivering complex, high-value programmes, including leadership of multidisciplinary teams and supply chains.
  • Proven track record of leading programme delivery through subordinate managers, including governance of project and programme managers.
  • Experience managing strategic programmes and/or portfolios of low to high complexity, within a structured delivery and governance framework.
  • Demonstrable experience of financial management and commercial accountability at programme level.
  • Experience of leading or contributing to strategic capture and proposal activities for follow-on or new business opportunities.
  • Degree-qualified in a relevant discipline (e.g. Engineering, Business, IT) or equivalent experience.
  • Professional certification (e.g. APM PMQ/APMP, SAFe Agilist or equivalent) is advantageous.
  • Evidence of ongoing professional development aligned to programme leadership and delivery excellence.
  • Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models is preferred.

Salary for this position is £76,000 - £96,000, depending on experience plus our excellent flexible benefits package.

We offer hybrid working - for this role ideally we are looking for an average of 2 days per week per month on site.

We pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose, offering impressive benefits:

  • A compressed nine-day fortnight and compressed hours - which means every other Friday off.
  • A personalized career development plan, alongside regular progress reviews - supporting and valuing your progression within the Company.
  • A flexible working environment where your contributions are recognized and rewarded with flexible benefits

We believe in maintaining a diverse workplace - inclusive of beliefs, cultural background, job experiences, thoughts and ideas. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we welcome you to join our inclusive team!

Our success is fuelled by our colleagues and the wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills they bring to the Company.

We are a Disability Confident Employer, as such we offer an interview to disabled people who meet the minimum criteria for the job.
Please email disabilityconfident@gd-ms.uk if you would like your application to be considered under the DC Scheme.

All successful/appointed applicants must be able to obtain a level of UK Security clearance that is appropriate for the role and undertake suitable Right to work checks

title: UN Women: Project Officer, Colombo, Sri Lanka, N-PPSA8, National Partner Personnel Service Agreement
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.

Working for the empowerment and rights of women and girls globally, UN Women’s main roles are:
• To support inter-governmental bodies, such as the Commission on the Status of Women, in their formulation of policies, global standards and norms.
• To help Member States implement these standards, standing ready to provide suitable technical and financial support to those countries that request it, and to forge effective partnerships with civil society.
• To lead and coordinate the UN system’s work on gender equality, as well as promote accountability, including through regular monitoring of system-wide progress.

UN Women has been working in Sri Lanka since 2014, marking a decade of service dedicated to advancing gender equality and women’s empowerment in the country. In our collective efforts to uphold women’s rights, we work collaboratively with the Government of Sri Lanka and other partners to develop national policies, conduct research and advocacy, and deliver programming on women’s economic empowerment, women’s leadership in governance and decision-making, Women, Peace and Security, and preventing violence against women and girls. Our goal is to help every woman and girl achieve her full potential, and build a more inclusive, just and equal Sri Lanka.

In Sri Lanka, UN Women is implementing programmes – such as the five-year project titled “THRIVE: Together for Her: Resilience-building, Inclusivity, and Voices for Equality in Sri Lanka” – to strengthen the economic and social resilience of women who are marginalized by equipping them with the resources needed to navigate and recover from crises, insecurity, and the impacts of climate change. UN Women’s work encompasses three main outcomes: a) Women’s enterprises are resilient to climate impacts and crises, b) Shifts in community attitudes towards the perception of women and positive behaviour change to advance gender equality and women’s empowerment, and c) Women’s participation in leadership and decision-making.

Under the guidance and direct supervision of the Head of Office and with matrix management by the Programme Management Analyst, the Project Officer contributes to the effective management of UN Women project(s) and provides substantive inputs to programme design, formulation, implementation and evaluation. He/she will be responsible for coordinating, implementing, and monitoring the implementation of the assigned project(s) led by UN Women.

Scope of Work:

1. Coordination and implementation of the project:
• Support the various assessments undertaken by the project in its initial stage and ensure strong coordination with relevant stakeholders in ﬁnalising the project deliverables and meeting project targets.
• Coordinate timely and effective implementation of the project, including daily management and delivery of project outputs;
• Support the development and monitoring of interventions at the individual, household and community levels to shift harmful social norms and promote positive behaviour change;
• Support the development of advanced capacity development programmes for women entrepreneurs, with a focus on adapting to the crisis and ensuring business continuity or diversiﬁcation;
• Liaise with other UN agencies, government counterparts and partners in coordinating and implementing project activities.

2. Technical and ﬁnancial management, monitoring and reporting
• Assist the Head of Ofﬁce / Programme Management Analyst in the management of budgets, administration and procurement-related matters and functions in accordance with UN/UN Women rules and regulations;
• Coordinate the contracting of project services to implementing agencies, ensuring compliance with UN procedures; oversee the release of funds to counterparts, liquidation of funds and other processes;
• Periodic monitoring meetings with government and non-government partners;
• Monitoring, analysis and evaluation of technical and ﬁnancial reports from partners, including technical and management support;
• Assist in analysing quality of project design and implementation for improvement, and periodically update the project monitoring framework incorporating reviews, lessons learned, and best practices;
• Regular ﬁeld visits and liaison with the UN Women Regional Ofﬁce for Asia and the Paciﬁc;
• Preparation of internal and external technical reports, research publications and briefs including donor reports; documentation of activities, outputs and outcomes on a regular basis.

3. Strategic partnerships, advocacy and knowledge management
• Support the development and strengthening of partnerships with UN agencies, government institutions, and civil society programme/project implementation and other stakeholders;
• Analysis and research of information on donors, preparation of substantive briefs, concept notes or project proposals on possible areas of cooperation, identiﬁcation of opportunities for cost-sharing and joint programming.
• Identiﬁcation and synthesis of good practices and lessons learnt linked to the project outcomes, and incorporating these to reﬁne project strategies.
• Coordinate development of knowledge management strategies, advocacy products and methodologies on responding in crisis contexts.
• Organise advocacy campaigns with implementing partners.

4. The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation.

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: The position carries no supervisory responsibilities.

Competencies :

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

• Knowledge of programme management
• Knowledge of procurement processes, systems, administrative rules and regulation
• Excellent verbal and written communications skills in English and Tamil, including the ability to prepare succinct analytical documents (project concept notes, research reports, donor reports etc.)
• Excellent understanding and knowledge of laws, policies, programmes and instruments to advance gender equality in Sri Lanka.
• Strong coordination and facilitation skills with various stakeholders
• Ability to create, edit and present information in clear and presentable formats
• Ability to manage data, documents, correspondence and reports information and workflow
• Strong financial and budgeting skills
• Ability to perform work of confidential nature and handle a large volume of work
• Excellent IT and web-based management skills
• Strong research skills will be an asset.

Qualifications:

Education and Certification:
• Master’s degree or equivalent in Gender, Women’s Studies, Development Studies, International Relations, Law, Human Rights or a related field in Social Sciences is required.
• A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.
A project/programme management certification would be an added advantage.

Experience:
• At least 1 year of progressively responsible work experience in providing substantive technical inputs and implementation of projects related to gender equality and women’s
empowerment is required.
• Relevant technical experience in Sri Lanka in development programme/project implementation, coordination, monitoring and evaluation, budgeting, and donor reporting
is required.
• Experience in providing substantive technical input on gender equality and women’s empowerment for programme design, research, and/or national policies, actions plans or strategies for Sri Lanka is required.
• Experience in results-based management is required.
• Experience in conducting/facilitating multi-stakeholder initiatives and coordinating with a wide range of stakeholders, including government, civil society and non governmental organisations, women groups, and local communities in Sri Lanka is required.
• Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and spreadsheet and database packages, experience in handling of web-based
management systems is required.
• Experience in the use of a modern web-based ERP System, preferably Oracle Cloud, is desirable.
• Experience in and familiarity with the United Nations system and its coordination mechanisms is desirable.
• Familiarity and experience working with civil society organisations and networks in Sri Lanka working to advance gender equality is desirable.

Languages:
• Fluency in English is required.
• Fluency in local languages (Sinhala/Tamil) is required.
• Fluency in Tamil is highly desirable and will be considered an added advantage.
• Knowledge of another official UN language is desirable (French, Arabic, Chinese, Russian or Spanish).

Statements :

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process.

title: UK Public Sector Lead
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is building economic infrastructure for the internet. We help organizations of every size move money, manage revenue, and build global financial services.

The Public Sector team builds Stripe’s presence in markets where organizations deliver essential services to millions of people. In the UK, public sector organizations collect taxes and tuition, enable transit, distribute funds, support charitable giving, and modernize citizen services. The team helps these organizations improve how they collect, manage, and disburse funds.

What you’ll do

As the UK Public Sector Lead, you will build and lead Stripe’s public sector go-to-market motion in the UK. You will define how Stripe serves central government, local government, devolved administrations, public bodies, higher education, utilities, transport, charities and not-for-profit organizations, and adjacent regulated organizations.

You will combine market knowledge, commercial judgment, and operational leadership to build trusted relationships, win meaningful business, and establish the operating model needed to serve public sector customers. This role reports to the Global Head of Public Sector and will help launch Stripe’s UK public sector motion in 2027.

Responsibilities

  • Define Stripe’s UK public sector strategy, including priority segments, customer problems, routes to market, commercial opportunities, and the capabilities needed to succeed

  • Build relationships across government, public bodies, procurement ecosystems, industry associations, systems integrators, and advisory partners

  • Work with senior customer decision-makers to understand their payment, revenue, digital service, and financial infrastructure needs, and develop solutions with Stripe teams

  • Guide strategic opportunities through public sector procurement, contracting, security, compliance, and stakeholder alignment requirements

  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Go-to-Market, Alliances and Channels, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Operations to prepare Stripe to support public sector customers

  • Turn recurring market requirements into priorities for onboarding, risk, contracting, procurement, implementation, support, and product development

  • Build the positioning, account strategy, partner ecosystem, sales plays, internal processes, and success metrics that support growth in the UK and inform Stripe’s global public sector strategy

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Experience working in or selling to the UK public sector, including government, public bodies, education, transport, utilities, charities and not-for-profit organizations, or other regulated institutions

  • Established senior relationships across the UK public sector, its partner ecosystem, and relevant procurement or policy communities

  • Experience delivering complex outcomes across multiple stakeholders and working through public sector procurement, contracting, compliance, risk, and implementation requirements

  • Experience leading senior cross-functional stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product, Sales, Partnerships, and Operations

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, strategic judgment, and experience working directly on market-building initiatives

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience launching a product, organization, market, vertical, or strategic go-to-market motion

  • Experience in payments, financial services, enterprise software, digital transformation, or platform technology

  • Familiarity with UK public procurement frameworks and common contracting vehicles

  • Experience working with systems integrators, consulting firms, implementation partners, or public sector technology ecosystems

  • Experience turning customer and regulatory requirements into scalable products, processes, or commercial models

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer I - Platform Foundations
description:
Meet Core Services - Labs
Core Services owns the systems the rest of Fetch builds on: developer experience, the core domains behind catalog, e-receipts, and fraud, and the AI platform work that is changing how the company operates. Our teams are small relative to the number of teams depending on what we ship, which shapes how we make decisions and where we hold a high bar.

Labs is the AI collective inside Core Services, spanning innovation, automation, and enablement. Our job is to make AI genuinely usable inside Fetch: agentic systems that do real work, the infrastructure those agents run on, and the products that put them in front of the people who need them. This role sits on the pack focused on agentic analytics.
The engineers here come from a mix of backgrounds — product and platform engineering, ML, and data. Deep AI experience is not a prerequisite for this role; strong product engineering judgment is, and there's real AI depth available to anyone who wants to grow into it. What we consistently care about is adoption.

About the role
You'll join the team that builds FAST, Fetch's internal AI analytics platform. FAST puts an analytics agent in front of business users so they can answer real data questions in plain language instead of waiting in a queue for an analyst. It's also a product that has to earn the trust of people who will not tolerate a wrong number.

This is a fullstack role centered on the product around the agent. You'll build and own new features, new integrations, and the services and interfaces that turn a capable agent into something people rely on day to day. The work spans the stack but leans towards backend.

We're a small team, and you'll own the features you ship. Engineers here upskill one another across domains, and AI-assisted workflows have made that ramp faster than it has ever been. You'll work alongside fullstack and ML engineers building a product that serves Fetch. Over time, and depending on where the platform goes, there's a path into the agent layer itself: evals, capability expansion, and the accuracy work that determines whether any of this succeeds.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Fetch (Role Responsibilities):
  • Design, build, and ship product features across the FAST platform, with the majority of your work in Python services and APIs.
  • Own backend-dominant fullstack work end to end, including the Svelte frontend surfaces that expose it.
  • Build the data models, integrations, and service architecture that turn a working agent into a product people rely on.
  • Improve FAST's reliability, maintainability, and architecture.
  • Raise the bar on backend and product engineering craft within the team through code review, design discussion, and hands-on pairing.
  • Bring clear tradeoff thinking to design and architecture decisions, and turn ambiguous product needs into concrete implementation plans.
  • Improve how the team ships, including where AI-assisted workflows meaningfully improve quality and speed.

In your Toolbox (Minimum Requirements):
  • 4+ years of hands-on fullstack engineering experience in a medium to large engineering environment.
  • Strong backend experience, ideally in Python.
  • Working experience with modern frontend development and the ability to contribute confidently to Svelte or a comparable framework.
  • Comfort owning work across the stack: product features, service integration, and the implementation details in between.
  • Solid grounding in distributed systems or systems-level engineering concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a tradeoff to someone who doesn't share your context.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and drive work to completion without every task assigned.
  • Track record of collaborating effectively across backend, frontend, and machine learning disciplines.
  • Interest in using AI tools and agentic workflows to improve engineering speed, quality, and maintainability.

Nice to haves/Bonus Points (Preferred Requirements):
  • Experience building real-time or near-time OLAP applications
  • Production experience with Svelte, or with another TypeScript framework.
  • Experience building products on top of LLMs or agentic systems.
  • Exposure to data, analytics, BI, or experimentation tooling.
  • Experience with Go.
  • Experience on teams that balance product delivery against platform evolution.

Compensation: At Fetch, we offer competitive compensation packages including base, equity, and benefits to the exceptional folks we hire. The base salary range for this position is $162,198 - $190,821. Discover our benefits and how our employees live rewarded at .

title: Senior Analyst - Loan Operations
description:
About Citco:

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. title: Buyer
description:
Working Pattern: Typically 5 days in the office, with core hours flexible between 8am-6pm.

The Role
The role involves developing a commercially successful product range by building strong relationships with suppliers and analysing data to plan across all categories. Collaboration with designers and merchandisers is key to this process.

Utilising specialist functions like product technology and sourcing, the aim is to create outstanding products. Working closely with the e-commerce team, optimisation of online sales through tone of voice, imagery, and other tools is essential. Liaison with the Marketing team for campaign and e-commerce shoots within department budgets is crucial. Managing the critical path for product development and selection, and swiftly identifying new product opportunities are priorities. Effective team management, resource delegation, and motivation are central to success. Frequent travel is required to source the best products and prices, with regular sign-off on ranges.

What You’ll Take On
With our online business constantly growing, Total Platform continuing to strengthen and our retail stores remaining distinguished for our customer base, our buyers have a big responsibility to create attractive and profitable product ranges across the business. They collaborate with our Designers, Merchandisers and Technologists to put together stylish new collections for every season.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Buyer to join the team. This team is full of industry experts who live and breathe all things Womenswear! Our Womenswear team has years of experience in the industry! This role will be a platform for an experienced, self motivated Buyer to embrace the challenge of starting and nurturing a successful and very fast paced department from the start. You will be responsible for planning and buying the product, delivering agreed KPIs for sales, markdown and profit. The job would be based in our Enderby office, Leicester.

What You’ll Bring
The role requires the ability to manage multiple product ranges effectively and a clear understanding of brand DNA. You should ideally be an experienced buyer with strong analytical and planning skills . You should be able to easily identify the latest trends for this category and have a comprehensive understanding of the market competition.

An in-depth knowledge of our industry is essential. A proven track record in identifying opportunities to streamline the critical path and trade ranges in-season is crucial. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, are necessary for effective collaboration. An enthusiastic attitude and a team-player mindset are valued attributes in this role. We would ideally like to bring in an Buyer with expert knowledge in this industry.

title: Product Programme Manager
description:
Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 Alpha - our rapidly developed humanoid platform now running in real industrial pilots - and we’re growing the team to take it even further.

About the Role

Humanoid is seeking a highly driven and experienced Product Programme Manager to join our Product Department. This critical role will lead the end-to-end development and delivery programme and relevant product-related projects for Humanoid's next-generation bipedal humanoid robot fleet solution – from Alpha prototype to production version, and from early adoption to mass deployment and further to different version obsolescence.

As the anchor for the development, launch and deployment process, you will drive cross-functional coordination across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Marketing teams to ensure that the solution is delivered on-time, on-cost, on-quality, and on-spec.

This is a highly collaborative role, requiring deep expertise in programme delivery and budget management across both technical and non-technical workstreams, as well as in product lifecycle for products that combine cutting edge hardware and software technologies. You will work closely with Engineering's Technical Programme Managers (TPMs), who own the detailed technical execution of the mechanical, actuation, controls, perception and other AI systems that underpin safe and reliable bipedal locomotion, manipulation and interaction, to ensure their workstreams are integrated into the overall programme plan, as well as other key stakeholders. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a structured delivery and product-oriented mindset, and the ability to operate confidently across a diverse stakeholder landscape.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the full lifecycle programme management of the humanoid robot fleet solution development & deployment – from planning, design, prototyping, testing, manufacturing to launch, early to mass deployment, version update to obsolescence or repurposing.

  • Act as the central coordination point between Product, Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Marketing, Business Development and Finance to align resources, schedules, and deliverables.

  • Develop and maintain programme plans, risk registers, dependency maps, and stage gates to ensure structured and transparent delivery.

  • Champion best-in-class governance, reporting, and communication processes to ensure all stakeholders remain informed and engaged.

  • Identify and mitigate programme risks and issues early to maintain momentum and resolve delivery challenges.

  • Support the Product Department in defining scope, prioritisation, and trade-off decisions throughout the development & deployment cycles.

  • Drive alignment between cross-functional teams and facilitate decision-making to unblock issues across technical and operational domains.

  • Own programme budget planning and management across development, testing, tooling, and deployment phases – building and maintaining the budget, tracking actual spend against plan, forecasting variances, managing change control on cost impacts, and reporting budget performance to senior stakeholders.

  • Partner with Engineering's Technical Programme Managers (TPMs) to drive delivery of the bipedal locomotion, whole-body control, sensor integration, and safety/certification workstreams – ensuring their technical plans and test campaigns are reflected in the overall programme schedule and dependencies, with progress reported transparently to stakeholders. TPMs own the detailed technical execution and design decisions; this role owns the programme-level integration, sequencing, and accountability for outcomes.

  • Work with Engineering TPMs, Supply Chain, and Finance to manage the commercial, budget, and schedule aspects of supplier/partner relationships for critical bipedal subsystems (actuators, gearboxes, batteries, sensors), and to translate technical KPIs (e.g. locomotion performance, MTBF, production readiness) into programme-level cost, schedule, and quality reporting.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Manufacturing, Industrial Design Engineering or a closely related technical discipline.

  • 7+ years of experience in programme or project management roles within technology or product development environments, preferably in Robotics or Consumer electronics environments, having followed different stages of product lifecycles.

  • Formal project management qualification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).

  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, multi-disciplinary hardware and/or software product development programmes.

  • Strong experience in managing cross-functional teams spanning engineering, operations, manufacturing, finance, and supply chain.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and evolving environment, driving clarity and direction across multiple teams.

  • Experience owning or managing programme budgets for complex hardware/technology programmes, including cost tracking, forecasting, and reporting.

  • Experience partnering with technical/engineering leads (e.g. Technical Programme Managers) on complex hardware programmes – ideally including legged or bipedal robotics, or closely related fields such as locomotion research or actuator-driven mechatronic systems – with enough technical fluency (actuators, controls, sensors, robotics safety standards) to translate technical risk into programme impact and make informed scope and trade-off decisions, without requiring hands-on engineering ownership.

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience working on or managing a bipedal or legged humanoid robot programme, from prototype through to production and deployment.

  • Experience with mass-production ramp-up of complex robotic or mechatronic hardware, including supplier qualification and manufacturing scale-up.

  • Familiarity with simulation-to-real transfer, digital twin practices, or reinforcement-learning-based control as used in modern humanoid development.

What We Offer

  • Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale.

  • 30+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown).

  • Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care.

  • Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings.

  • Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office.

  • Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics.

  • Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.
