title: Cateringmedewerker
description:
Collega gezocht

Bij Cito helpen wij om leren zichtbaar te maken. Een leven lang. Op diverse momenten hebben we je geholpen een volgende stap te zetten. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan je Cito-toetsen op de basisschool of je eindexamens op de middelbare school.

Zet jij je volgende stap niet alleen met Cito, maar ook bij Cito?

Bij Cito geloven we in een wereld waarin iedereen een eerlijke kans krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen. In onze organisatie mag en kan iedereen zichzelf zijn. Samenwerking tussen mensen met verschillende talenten zorgt ervoor dat we het beste halen uit iedereen. Want juist door onderlinge verschillen kun je elkaar versterken. Daarom heeft Cito oog voor al zijn medewerkers, hun ambities en capaciteiten.


Cito is een hybride organisatie: het bestaat uit een Stichting (met een wettelijke taak) en een BV (waarmee we actief zijn op de markt). De afdeling Facilitair valt onder de Stichting. Als je meer over de organisatiestructuur wilt lezen kun je terecht op onze website.

Ter versterking van ons team zoeken we iemand met culinaire feeling, praktische horeca-skills en oog voor kwaliteit. In ons bedrijfsrestaurant Culi Maire verzorgen we dagelijks een smakelijke lunch voor collega’s, huurders en gasten. Cito serveert jou een mooie kans: een functie als cateringmedewerker bedrijfsrestaurant (18 uur per week).

Ben jij een ervaren allround cateringmedewerker die energie krijgt van goed eten, gastvrijheid en een soepel draaiend bedrijfsrestaurant? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek!

Werk je daarnaast aan een eigen foodconcept, startup of cateringactiviteiten? Ook dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren. We staan open voor ondernemende kandidaten die hun praktijkervaring willen combineren met een vaste rol binnen ons team.

Wat ga je doen?

Als cateringmedewerker

  • help je mee onze facilitaire horeca continu te verbeteren, denk je actief mee en draag je ideeën aan.

  • zorg je voor een goede organisatie rondom onze lunchvoorzieningen, vergaderservices en borrels.

  • bewaak en verbeter je de kwaliteit van eten en service.

  • signaleer je trends op het gebied van gezond, lekker, lokaal en verantwoord eten en past deze slim toe.

  • laat je jouw passie zien in de keuken én aan de counter. Je bereidt en presenteert gezonde, verse en smaakvolle lunchgerechten en zorgt voor een sprankelende interactie met onze gasten.

  • werk je van maandag t/m vrijdag tussen 08.30 en 14.30 uur. De diensten plannen we samen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een organisatie waarin iedereen zichzelf mag en kan zijn
    Binnen Cito streven wij naar een sfeer waarin iedereen welkom is en hebben wij oog voor al jouw ambities en capaciteiten.

  • Een contract van 18 uur per week.

  • Inschaling in schaal 5 van onze Cito-cao, afhankelijk van je ervaringsniveau
    Je salaris is daarbij tussen de € 1.187,- en € 1.622,- bruto per maand bij een 18-urig dienstverband.

  • Opname in het Algemeen Burgerlijk Pensioenfonds, waarbij Cito 70% van de inleg verzorgt

  • Een jaarlijks Individueel werknemersbudget (IWB) ter waarde van ongeveer 85% van je bruto maandsalaris, inzetbaar voor bijvoorbeeld een opleiding naar eigen keuze, extra verlof of extra inkomen

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van € 1.750,- bruto bij een 36-urige werkweek

  • Een volledige vergoeding van je woon-werkverkeer met het openbaar vervoer of een gemaximaliseerde kilometervergoeding van 50 km per enkele reis, ongeacht het gebruikte vervoermiddel

  • Goede ontwikkel- en opleidingsmogelijkheden

  • Een laptop en een smartphone, of een telefoonvergoeding van € 10,- per maand

  • De mogelijkheid om op voor jou belangrijke religieuze, niet-christelijke feestdagen verlof op te nemen

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Je hebt ervaring of interesse in de vega(n) keuken.

  • Je hebt een natuurlijke focus op duurzaamheid.

  • Je volgt actief trends op foodgebied en je weet die om te zetten in gezonde ambachtelijke gerechten.

  • Je toont verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van je werk.

  • Je hebt een representatieve, enthousiaste en ondernemende houding.

  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Contactgegevens
Bert Dozeman, cateringbeheerder, vertelt je graag meer over deze vacature. Bert is telefonisch te bereiken op (026) 352 12 20. Onze HRM-afdeling weet alle ins en outs over de sollicitatieprocedure. Zij is bereikbaar via vacatures@cito.nl.

Wil je solliciteren?

Wij geloven in een wereld waarin iedereen een eerlijke kans krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen. Om dit te kunnen waarmaken zet Cito zich in voor het bevorderen van een inclusieve werkomgeving. Wij geloven dat de diversiteit van onze medewerkers bijdraagt aan het waarmaken van onze missie. We moedigen je dan ook aan om op deze functie te solliciteren ongeacht je achtergrond of identiteit, ook als je vindt dat je nog niet aan alle functie-eisen voldoet.


Wil je meer weten over op welke wijze onze sollicitatieprocedure (gericht op eerlijk selecteren) is ingericht of hoe wij omgaan met je persoonsgegevens? Ga dan naar onze website. Hier kun je ook onze cao en gedragscode vinden.

Deze vacature heeft geen vastgestelde sluitingsdatum; we spreken doorlopend kandidaten en de vacature staat open tot we de juiste kandidaat hebben gevonden.

title: Finance Specialist
description:
Key Responsibilities:

Accounting & Financial Operations:

Process invoices, payments, expenses, bank transactions, and other day-to-day accounting activities in accordance with company policies and applicable European accounting requirements.

Accounts Payable & Receivable:

Support supplier and customer accounting, reconcile outstanding balances, monitor payment schedules, and assist with collection and payment follow-ups.

Vehicle & Dealership Finance:

Maintain accurate financial records related to vehicle purchases and sales, inventory movements, trade-ins, deposits, commissions, and other dealership transactions.

Financial Reporting & Reconciliations:

Prepare regular financial reports and management information, perform bank and ledger reconciliations, and investigate discrepancies.

European Market Compliance :

Support VAT, invoicing, documentation, and other financial compliance requirements relevant to international transactions and European markets.

International Transactions:

Assist with cross-border payments, supplier/customer settlements, foreign-currency transactions, and financial documentation for European business partners.

Stakeholder & Operational Coordination:

Act as a finance point of contact for sales, procurement, logistics, operations, management, suppliers, customers, and external partners; coordinate information, resolve operational issues, and ensure smooth execution of financial processes.

Process Improvement & Team Support:

Maintain accurate accounting records, support month-end closing, improve financial processes, and collaborate with sales, procurement, logistics, and management teams across international operations.

title: Business Analist Veiligheid, Milieu en Kwaliteit
description:
Vacature Business Analist Veiligheid, Milieu en Kwaliteit

Als Business Analist binnen Veiligheid, Milieu en Kwaliteit (VMK) verbind je processen, gebruikersbehoeften en digitale oplossingen. Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en IT en vertaalt vragen uit de organisatie naar slimme, werkbare verbeteringen in onze applicaties. Krijg jij energie van analyseren, structureren en verbeteren in een maatschappelijk relevant domein? Dit betreft een hybride functie voor 32-40 uur, met als standplaats Arnhem. Jij maakt het net veiliger bij Alliander.

Jij maakt het net professioneler als Business Analist

Je komt terecht in het Veranderteam VMK (Veiligheid, Milieu en Kwaliteit), waar je samen met de Product Owner en het scrumteam werkt aan het verbeteren en beheren van SaaS-applicaties binnen het VMK-domein. Deze applicaties ondersteunen collega’s bij veilig, zorgvuldig en efficiënt werken. Jij zorgt ervoor dat processen, functionaliteiten en gebruikerswensen goed op elkaar aansluiten.

Als Business Analist VMK breng je structuur aan in complexe vraagstukken en maak je de vertaalslag naar duidelijke oplossingen. Je schakelt met gebruikers, analyseert processen en werkt verbeteringen uit die direct bijdragen aan veiligheid, kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, met iedereen. En als Business Analist VMK werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben je bezig met het:

  • analyseren van processen en gebruikersvragen en deze vertalen naar duidelijke requirements en workflows;
  • ondersteunen van eindgebruikers bij vragen over de VMK-applicaties en het signaleren van verbeterkansen;
  • inrichten en bewaken van rollen, rechten en autorisaties binnen de applicaties;
  • implementeren en verbeteren van workflows, formulieren, statussen, notificaties en andere functionaliteiten;
  • testen van nieuwe of gewijzigde functionaliteit, inclusief het opstellen van scenario’s en het vastleggen van bevindingen;
  • opstellen en beheren van gebruikersdocumentatie.

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander
Wist je dat Alliander bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die samen werken aan een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energienet? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers in Nederland. Alles wat we doen, doen we met oog voor de mensen die op ons rekenen: onze klanten. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken we de energietransitie mogelijk, voor en mét onze klanten.

Een mindset waarin alleen het beste goed genoeg is kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jou dat. Binnen deze functie versterk jij de stafafdeling Veiligheid, Milieu en Kwaliteit (VMK). De afdeling staat voor ‘iedereen veilig thuis’ en het samen met de organisatieonderdelen verbeteren van processen en kwaliteit met minimale impact op onze omgeving. Daarmee levert Veiligheid, Milieu en Kwaliteit een belangrijke bijdrage aan de ambitie van Alliander om veel meer werk te kunnen verzetten.

De ART (Application Release Train) VMK brengt specialisten samen op het snijvlak van veiligheid, kwaliteit, data en digitale oplossingen. Samen werk je aan inzichten en verbeteringen die helpen om incidenten te voorkomen, risico’s eerder te herkennen en veiligheid en kwaliteit steviger te verankeren in onze processen.

Jij maakt het net energieker
Werken met de nieuwste technieken en innovaties. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw wens om te innoveren? Klinkt goed! Zeker als je dit aanvult met:

  • hbo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als business analist, functioneel analist of vergelijkbare rol in een complexe organisatie;
  • sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om gebruikersbehoeften scherp te analyseren en te vertalen naar duidelijke oplossingen;
  • ervaring met Agile werken, bijvoorbeeld binnen Scrum of SAFe, en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met een Product Owner, scrumteam en gebruikersorganisatie;
  • affiniteit met IT-systemen, SaaS-applicaties en digitalisering, bij voorkeur met ervaring in functioneel beheer, applicatie-inrichting of procesoptimalisatie;
  • een analytische en nauwkeurige manier van werken, met interesse in veiligheid, milieu en kwaliteit of de motivatie om je snel in dit domein te verdiepen.

Voor jou nèt beter geregeld

Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek:

  • een salaris van € 4.672,- tot € 6.674,- bruto per maand (schaal 9).
  • jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past.
  • 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, ruim aan te vullen vanuit je IKB.
  • een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris.
  • elk jaar een DI-budget van € 700,- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport of hobby, verduurzaming en vergroening van je huis, of het verlichten van je studieschuld bij DUO. Jij bepaalt waar jouw budget naartoe gaat.
  • een pensioenopbouw bij ABP, speciaal voor de overheid en het onderwijs. Wij betalen 70% van jouw pensioenpremie.
  • Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over Alliander en al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Voor jou net wat meer informatie

Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton op deze vacature. Vanwege de vakantieperiode kan het wat langer duren voordat je een reactie van ons krijgt. Bij veel reacties sluiten we de vacature mogelijk eerder.

Een assessment of screening kan onderdeel uitmaken van jouw sollicitatieprocedure. In onze screeningsvoorwaarden vind je meer informatie.

title: PICOP Paraplanner
description:
Chase de Vere is a national, award-winning independent financial advice firm established in 1969. We offer tailored, whole-of-market solutions and provide expert financial advice to individuals and businesses.

Our purpose is to help clients "be future confident," which also means empowering our employees with the tools, support, and opportunities to thrive in their careers.

At Chase de Vere, we value excellence, integrity, and personal growth. Joining our team means being part of a supportive environment where your professional development is prioritised, and your contributions are recognised. If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact and grow your career, consider Chase de Vere. Together, we help clients achieve financial security and peace of mind for the future.

Researching, analysing market trends and report writing, Chase de Vere PICOP paraplanners work closely with our advisers to deliver independent financial strategies for individuals, trustees, and deputies in relation to personal injury and clinical negligence cases. Supported by our experienced paraplanning management and development team, you will have the opportunity to work on a wide range of client cases of varying complexity, continually developing your skill and expertise.

Our paraplanning teams have exceptional technical and industry knowledge with many having secured their Level 4 Diploma in Regulated Financial Planning, and some continuing their studies towards Chartered. Whilst these qualifications are important, the role of a paraplanner requires so much more – the ability to work independently, a keen eye for detail and a real passion to provide the best independent financial research and advice for our clients.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Technical knowledge is essential in this role, so it is a requirement that you have secured a number of your financial planning (R0) qualifications and be striving to complete your Diploma in Regulated Financial Planning.
  • Experience in a paraplanning role is essential, so we would require you to have worked as a paraplanner for a minimum of 2 years.
  • Teamwork and collaboration are vitally important within this role. If a member of your team is in the midst of a complex report and an urgent piece of work comes in, our paraplanners go above and beyond to help one another out.
  • Given the sensitive nature of our clients circumstances, empathy and compassion are key components when working within the PICOP team.
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced environment whilst maintaining excellent attention to detail.

WHAT YOUR ROLE WILL INVOLVE

Our paraplanners are critical to our business and the work they do is hugely valued by our clients. Alongside preparing recommendations, our paraplanners review our clients’ finances on an annual basis, asses their exposure to risk and update their financial strategy to reflect their changing circumstances.

Your day-to-day role

  • Conducting research on clients’ financial planning arrangements, both existing and recommended, to ensure that the client’s needs and objectives are met.
  • Undertaking investment portfolio analysis, which includes areas such as drawdown analysis
  • Verifying periodical payments have been calculated correctly by the Defendants.
  • Prepare Personal Injury Trust reports and Trust review reports within the desired timescales.
  • Compiling investment, pension and protection illustrations, projections and associated documentation.
  • Writing technical and accurate suitability reports and client service agreement letters
  • Ensuring client files comply with both FCA regulations and our internal policy and procedures.

By joining Chase de Vere, you’ll have a progressive career with great benefits and a nurturing culture that makes you part of something special.

Alongside a competitive salary with the opportunity to earn an annual bonus, we also provide the below benefits:

  • 25 days annual leave (increases to 30 days with service) plus Bank Holidays

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Life assurance – 4 x annual salary

  • Comprehensive induction and training programme

  • Funded exams and paid study leave

  • A wide range of voluntary flexible benefits to suit your individual needs

  • The option to buy additional holiday days

  • Cycle to work Scheme

  • Paid volunteering days each year

  • Employee Assistance Programme with access to a 24/7 helpline

  • Access to our free mortgage service, through our internal mortgage team

  • Our Employee Forum and Diversity & Inclusion group

  • Local and companywide events in support of our company charities

title: Data Engineer (Fitness Industry)
description:
Company Background

Our client is a global leader in the fitness and active lifestyle industry, providing equipment and solutions that help people lead healthier and more active lives. The company’s portfolio includes well-known brands covering gym training, strength equipment, rehabilitation, indoor cycling, and recreational activities. Its products are distributed in more than 120 countries, supporting fitness clubs, wellness facilities, rehabilitation centers, and individual users worldwide.

Project Description

The project focuses on redesigning a system that collects, transforms, and synchronizes data from multiple sources to streamline processes and reduce infrastructure costs. The solution helps health clubs manage fitness equipment, analyze equipment usage and exerciser behavior, deliver software updates, configure equipment across facilities, and send service notifications.

Technologies

  • SQL
  • BigQuery
  • BigQuery Pipelines
  • Google Cloud Functions / Google Cloud Run
  • Google Cloud Dataflow
  • PostgreSQL
  • Cloud SQL
  • Linux

What You'll Do

  • Design and maintain BigQuery pipelines for operational and analytics use cases, including partitioned data marts consumed by APIs;
  • Develop software components supporting data import, export, and synchronization operations;
  • Automate data import, export, and processing tasks using Google Cloud Functions, containerized workloads, or equivalent managed Google Cloud services;
  • Design and implement on-demand data migration APIs;
  • Coordinate data migration activities with other teams and team members;
  • Assist teams with extracting data from their existing systems;

Job Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience working with BigQuery in production environments;
  • Hands-on experience building pipelines from PostgreSQL to BigQuery for operational and analytics use cases;
  • Experience designing partitioned data marts consumed by APIs, not only BI tools;
  • Experience optimizing BigQuery costs through clustering, incremental models, and scheduled jobs;
  • Experience with dbt;
  • Background in IoT, device usage, or subscription analytics;
  • GCP Professional Data Engineer certification is a plus;
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher;

What Do We Offer

The global benefits package includes:

  • Technical and non-technical training for professional and personal growth;
  • Internal conferences and meetups to learn from industry experts;
  • Support and mentorship from an experienced employee to help you professional grow and development;
  • Health insurance;
  • Sports activities to promote a healthy lifestyle;
  • Flexible work options, including remote and hybrid opportunities;
  • Referral program for bringing in new talent;
  • Work anniversary program and additional vacation days.

This dog training position focuses on:
  • Private, in-home dog training sessions
  • Dog behavior support and behavior modification
  • Integrating training into real-life care environments

You'll play a key role in shaping how dog training is delivered across the entire company!

Our Training Philosophy

We are a force-free, fear-free, science-based dog training company. That means:
  • Positive reinforcement as our primary dog training method
  • Prioritizing emotional safety, agency, and trust
  • Reducing stress, not suppressing behavior

Our company does not use or allow:
  • Prong, choke, or shock collars
  • Startle, intimidation, or correction-based training methods
  • Dominance theory or "alpha" training frameworks

This approach aligns with modern behavioral science and humane dog training standards, which emphasize reinforcing desired behaviors over fear- or pain-based techniques.

Responsibilities
  • Conduct private, in-home and real-world dog training sessions
  • Address dog behavior challenges including: Reactivity, Fear & Anxiety, Overstimulation, Leash Skills & Engagement
  • Create customized, humane behavior modification plans for each dog
  • Coach dog owners and clients with clarity and empathy

Qualifications

Required:
  • Strong foundation in learning theory and canine behavior science
  • Deep understanding of canine body language
  • Working knowledge of behavioral thresholds, triggers, and nervous system regulation
  • Belief that dog training should improve a dog's emotional state, not just its behavior
  • Strong communication skills with both dogs and human clients
Preferred:
  • CPDT-KA, KPA-CTP, IAABC, or Fear Free Certification — or equivalent hands-on, force-free training experience
  • Hands-on experience with dog behavior cases (beyond basic obedience)
  • Experience working directly with clients in private dog training settings

Note: This role is built around force-free, science-based methods. If you identify as a "balanced trainer" who uses correction-based tools or techniques, this won't be the right fit.

Benefits
  • W-2 employment (not contractor)
  • Competitive hourly pay aligned with Seattle living wage standards
  • Paid training and continuing education opportunities
  • Career growth path into senior trainer/program development roles

Apply today to join a Seattle dog training team raising the standard of humane pet care!

title: SMART Automation Sustainment Technician
description:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with computer technology.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

title: Specialist, POM Product Owner II
description:
Specialist, Loans Modeling and Analytics (Structured Debt/CLO)

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Specialist, Loans Modeling and Analytics to join our Corporate Trust Analytics team. In this critical role, you will leverage your expertise in debt markets and quantitative modeling to drive accuracy, efficiency, and actionable insights across model and investor report development for CLO and loan products. This role is located out of our Houston, TX or Pittsburgh, PA office.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Develop, maintain, QC, and enhance CLO compliance and waterfall models, including detailed analysis of coverage tests, collateral quality tests, concentration limits, payment structures, and cash flow mechanics to ensure adherence to indenture provisions.
  • Analyze and interpret complex legal documents such as CLO indentures, offering memoranda, and related transaction documents, providing comments around modeling and analytical matters.
  • Build and analyze investor reports and dashboards that detail compliance tests, noteholder distributions, asset-level information, and other key metrics, enabling timely and transparent communication with stakeholders.
  • Utilize quantitative modeling techniques and predictive analytics to calculate and assess CLO portfolio performance, risk exposures, and stress test under various scenarios.
  • Work with internal teams, client reference data, and other external data providers to integrate and validate datasets, ensuring high data integrity for model inputs and outputs.
  • Perform statistical and trend analyses to identify model discrepancies, optimize performance, and implement enhancements to address issues in alignment with evolving market conditions and transaction structures.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on transaction requirements and support ad hoc reporting and analytics requests.
  • Champion continuous improvement and data-driven innovation by identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency and supporting strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing team capabilities.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, or related quantitative discipline or the equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2-3 years of experience in financial data analysis, structured finance, corporate trust, CLOs, leveraged loans, or related products with a strong focus on quantitative modeling and analytics.
  • Basic understanding of CLO products and transaction types such as new issue, refinancings, and resets and familiarity with related concepts.
  • Beginner proficiency in programming languages such as VBA, Python, R, and/or SQL for coding payment and compliance rules, automating workflows, and building robust analytical tools with strong desire for further development.
  • Experience in quantitative finance and technology preferred with advanced skills in MS Excel (including macros, advanced functions, and data manipulation), SharePoint, Alteryx, Power BI, or other platforms to develop dynamic reports, analytics, and visualizations.
  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to apply quantitative techniques and predictive analytics to structured credit products.
  • Strategic thinker with excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear insights for diverse audiences.
  • Maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail to ensure the integrity of financial models and reports.

title: Flyver til rengøring i Favrskov Kommune 25 timer om ugen
description:
"I Forenede har vi fokus på, at vores medarbejdere går glade på arbejde"

Forenede Service søger en fleksibel flyver til rengøringsområdet i Favrskov Kommune, som kan træde til dér, hvor behovet opstår.

Flyverens primære funktion er at sikre stabilitet og kontinuitet i den daglige rengøring. Vedkommende skal kunne afløse ved sygdom og ferie, dække ind ved øvrigt fravær samt hjælpe, når der opstår ekstra eller akutte behov.

Flyveren vil ikke være fast tilknyttet ét bestemt sted, men skal kunne arbejde på tværs af de lokationer, hvor der er behov for ekstra hjælp.

Hvor mange timer skal du arbejde, og hvornår skal du starte?

Stillingen er på 25 timer om ugen og mødetiden kan også forekomme i weekenden.

Der er opstart hurtigst muligt.

Hvilket område skal du arbejde med og hvad er din rolle?

Dine opgaver vil (bl.a.) bestå af:

  • Daglig rengøring på kommunens forskellige lokationer
  • Afløsning ved sygdom og andet fravær
  • Ferieafløsning
  • Ad hoc-rengøringsopgaver
  • Praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med den daglige drift
  • Ekstra rengøring ved særlige behov
  • Hjælp på områder med midlertidig spidsbelastning
  • Løbende vedligeholdende rengøring

Flyveren skal være en fleksibel ressource, der kan sættes ind med kort varsel, og som er indstillet på, at arbejdssted og opgaver kan variere fra dag til dag.

Det kræver en medarbejder, der kan arbejde selvstændigt, hurtigt finde sig til rette på forskellige arbejdssteder og samtidig levere en stabil og ensartet kvalitet.

Formålet med funktionen er at skabe større fleksibilitet i den samlede rengøringsdrift og reducere sårbarheden ved sygdom, ferie og uforudsete hændelser, så den nødvendige rengøring fortsat bliver udført.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har erfaring med rengøring og service og tager ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Du er engageret i dit arbejde og møder kolleger og kunder med et smil
  • Du kan kommunikere mundtligt og skriftligt på dansk eller engelsk
  • Du har kørekort
  • Du er fleksibel


Vi tror også at følgende kan gøre dig glad:

  • Firmabil med gulplader
  • Startløn og eventuelle tillæg jf. Serviceoverenskomsten.
  • Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring
  • Oplæring og mulighed for dansk kursus, AMU-kurser eller erhvervsuddannelse med løn
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi hylder forskelligheden
  • Et trygt og sikkert arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi følger faste procedurer for at passe på dig
  • Mulighed for at leje attraktive ferieboliger i både ind- og udland (fx Lalandia eller Østrig).

Hvordan søger du jobbet?

Du søger ved at klikke på den blå knap "Ansøg". Du bedes uploade CV og ansøgning.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Serviceleder Maj-Britt på mail: mabr@forenede.dk.


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Vores værdier udgør fundamentet for vores kultur og er: Ansvar - Engagement - Omtanke

Det betyder, at vi tager ansvar for at sikre, at der er gjort ordentligt rent og vedligeholdt så vi leverer kvalitetsservice hos vores kunder. Vi viser engagement ved at have et professionelt udtryk, som betyder at vi fremtoner ordentligt og præsentabelt og bruger de metoder der oplæres i. Vi bruger omtanke ved at vise hensyn og respekt for de mennesker vi møder, og som vi hver dag gør en forskel for.


Velkommen til Danmarks største privatejede Facility Service virksomhed

Forenede Service A/S er en mangfoldig virksomhed, der beskæftiger ca. 2.600 medarbejdere, som repræsenterer +80 forskellige nationaliteter. Vores medarbejdere servicerer flere hundredtusinder personer, når de dagligt leverer services inden for rengøring, kantine og ejendomsdrift til offentlige og erhvervsvirksomheder i Danmark.

Forenede Service A/S er en del af Forenede koncernen, som er en familieejet servicekoncern med en omsætning på mere end DKK 3 mia. Forenede Koncernen leverer omsorgsydelser og Facility Service gennem virksomhederne Forenede Service i Danmark og Forenede Care i Danmark og Sverige.

title: PE and Sports Intern (Johannesburg)
description:
Nova Pioneer is looking for a superstar PE and Sports Intern to assist with different sports at our Johannesburg Schools.

You will support the Sports Coach in delivering an exceptional 21st Century physical education and sports experience for our students. You will assist with coaching, training sessions, sports activities, competitions and events, while gaining practical experience in sports coaching and youth development.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop your coaching and leadership skills while being part of an innovative network of schools that is developing generations of innovators and leaders who will shape the African Century.


About Nova Pioneer

Imagine a world in which every young person across Africa attends a school that truly sets them up for success in the 21st century. A school that cares about individual students and allows them to explore the world around them. A school that focuses more on developing skills than on memorizing content. At Nova Pioneer, we have done more than just imagine this future, we are bringing it to life. Nova Pioneer is a pan-African, independent network of schools offering high-quality, accessible education from pre-primary through secondary school. Nova Pioneer uses a unique, enquiry-based learning approach that encourages students to ask “why” instead of telling them the “what”. It allows them to form their own thinking through exploration, investigation and collaboration. Nova Pioneer currently has 15 schools in South Africa and Kenya with a vision to launch 100 schools and reach tens of thousands of students across the African continent in the next decade. To learn more visit

Key responsibilities for the role include:

  • Support the Sports Coach and Regional Sports Coordinator in implementing the school’s sports programme and activities.
  • Assist with the planning and execution of sports training sessions, fixtures, competitions and events.
  • Support the Sports Coach in preparing activities and equipment for each session in line with the curriculum, schemes of work and lesson plans.
  • Assist with delivering age-appropriate sporting activities that promote students’ physical, mental and social development.
  • Support the Sports Coach in instructing students individually and in groups, using appropriate teaching and coaching methods.
  • Assist with student supervision during sports sessions, playtime, arrival, dismissal, lunch and other activities as required.
  • Assist with coordinating and maintaining the sports calendar, including training sessions, fixtures, competitions and events.
  • Accompany sports teams on trips, fixtures and competitions as a chaperone or assistant coach, under the guidance of the Sports Coach.
  • Assist in identifying opportunities for students to participate in sporting activities, friendly matches and competitions.
  • Support the planning and execution of inter-house and inter-class sports competitions and the annual Sports Day.
  • Assist with the preparation and management of matches, tournaments and other sporting events.
  • Support the Sports Coach in developing and strengthening school sports teams.
  • Assist with implementing training programmes and drills during sports training sessions.
  • Support students with understanding the rules, regulations, techniques and appropriate use of sports equipment.
  • Take and maintain accurate attendance records for sports training sessions and activities.
  • Assist with maintaining an organised inventory of sports equipment and report damaged, missing or additional equipment requirements to the Sports Coach.
  • Monitor students while using sports equipment and facilities to promote safe and responsible use.
  • Assist the Sports Coach in observing and recording students’ participation, progress and development.
  • Provide appropriate care and support to students and help maintain a safe, inclusive and positive environment during sporting activities.
  • Support the Sports Coach with basic first-aid procedures and reporting of injuries, in line with school procedures and training.
  • Encourage positive behaviour and support the Sports Coach in addressing behavioural concerns appropriately.
  • Report any student concerns, incidents or safeguarding matters to the Sports Coach or relevant line manager.
  • Assist with preparing sports-related resources, communications and documentation for students, parents and school staff.
  • Support the Sports Coach with sports-related administrative tasks, including record keeping, scheduling and event preparation.
  • Participate in relevant meetings, professional development sessions and training workshops to develop knowledge of the Nova Pioneer model and culture.
  • Work collaboratively with teachers and other school staff to support students’ participation and development through sport.
  • Practise and model Nova Pioneer culture and values when engaging with students, colleagues, parents and other stakeholders.
  • Take initiative to learn and develop coaching, leadership, communication and sports administration skills under the guidance of the Sports Coach.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Sports Coach or Manager in support of the school’s sports programme.


About You

Skills and Qualifications required

  • Currently studying towards or recently completed a qualification in Sports Science, Human Movement Science, Kinesiology, Physical Education, Education or a related field.
  • Previous experience working with children or teenagers through sport, education, coaching or community programmes would be advantageous.
  • Basic first-aid training or certification would be advantageous.
  • Knowledge or experience in one or more sporting codes.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work effectively with students, teachers, coaches and other school staff.

Core Skills and Competences

  • Passionate about sport, physical activity and developing young people.
  • Basic knowledge of sports coaching techniques, rules and skills.
  • Willingness to learn and develop coaching and leadership skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build positive relationships with students and colleagues.
  • Patient, energetic and enthusiastic when working with children and teenagers.
  • Organised and able to assist with multiple activities, training sessions and events.
  • Team player who works collaboratively and is willing to support the Sports Coach and wider school team.
  • Flexible and open to change, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced school environment.
  • Proactive in identifying opportunities to support students and improve sports activities.
  • Able to receive and apply feedback and demonstrate a growth mindset.
  • Excited about Nova Pioneer’s organisational culture and committed to continuous learning and development.

Additional Skills and Requirements

  • You are excited about our organisational culture—and in particular, you are fired up to challenge yourself by embracing mutual vulnerability and a firehose of feedback
  • You have a desire to further develop your leadership skills and apply them to transform the lives of African youth

How to Apply:

Does working at Nova Pioneer excite you? If so, then apply now!

To apply, please complete the form on the right hand side of this page. We cannot process applications that are emailed to us.

Please note: Where a copy of your resume is required, copying and pasting from a formatted document e.g. Microsoft Word may not result in the formatting transferring correctly to the final resume. You are encouraged to attach your resume in Microsoft Word® or PDF format to protect formatting.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the right candidate is identified. Only qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Working at Nova Pioneer

Nova Pioneer is committed to the achievement and maintenance of diversity and equity in employment. Nova Pioneer is a place where our people experience tremendous growth, fast! We invest heavily in the growth of our people because it leads to greater mastery in both us and our students. “Novaneers” work harder and work longer hours than most schools but as a result, the growth they experience is extraordinary. We offer consistent and ongoing personal development and provide clear career pathways that ensure that our people are always achieving their personal and professional best. Nova Pioneer has a highly energetic, entrepreneurial environment where our people get to bring their creative and innovative ideas to life. We look for people who are flexible and who are able to adapt and respond quickly to adversity with a positive, can-do attitude (there are no problems, only solutions!). We welcome challenges and roll with the punches because it makes us, and our students, better. There is no problem too big for us! We work hard but we also have a lot of fun together. We bring infectious energy and enthusiasm to everything we do because joy fuels the hardest work and learning. Read more about our culture principles here.

Please Note:

  • Nova Pioneer may appoint and/or expire the posting of this advertisement at their own discretion.
  • If you have not been contacted within 30 days of the closing date of this advertisement please consider your application as unsuccessful.

Nova Pioneer, in line with the POPIA (Protection of Personal Information Act) will attempt to ensure the confidentiality of all applicants for this role. All reasonable measurements will be in place to protect personal information but it will be used for recruitment and employment purposes. By submitting your application with Nova Pioneer, you are recognising and accepting this disclaimer


.

title: Teamleder til Kultur og Kommunikation i Center for Ejendomme
description:
Har du kommunikation som stjernetegn og organisation i ascendanten? Synes du, at tingene helst skal være svære for at være sjove? Og kan du bygge bro mellem strategi og praksis? Så brug fem minutter på at læse med her.

Rolle og ansvar
Kultur og Kommunikation er et nyt team i Stab og Strategi, i Center for Ejendomme, og du bliver dets første teamleder. Teamet er skabt ved at samle vores kommunikations- og organisationsudviklingskompetencer, så vi kan styrke kommunikation, kultur og forandring.

I skal videreføre det arbejde, vi allerede har sat i gang i forhold til for eksempel:

  • Opdatering af interne nyhedsbrevsformater
  • Anvendelse af sociale medier
  • Håndtering af pressesager
  • Ledelsesevalueringer og ledelsesudvikling
  • Employer Branding og rekruttering
  • Fælles ledelsesgrundlag og ledelsesrådgivning
Nogle projekter er næsten i mål. Andre går vi stadig og skruer på. Vi leverer solidt på vores opgaver og har høje ambitioner. Nu vil vi styrke vores fælles retning og arbejde mere langsigtet. Her spiller du en central rolle

Vi forventer, at du kommer med en baggrund indenfor journalistik eller kommunikation. Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har erfaring med udvikling og forandringer i en kompleks organisation, gerne i det offentlige. Du er erfaren og fagligt robust, og du har tidligere varetaget ledelsesopgaver. En relevant lederuddannelse er et fortrin.

Ledelsesopgaven
Ud over selv at bidrage til den daglige opgaveløsning skal du ryste Kultur og Kommunikation sammen og etablere nye, fælles rutiner og arbejdsgange. Dine teammedlemmer kender hinanden godt, men er endnu ikke fuldt etableret som samlet team.

Teamet ønsker en teamleder, der er ambitiøs og er god til at oversætte strategiske prioriteringer til en tydelig retning. Derudover ønsker de sig en empatisk og fagligt inspirerende sparringspartner, der sætter fokus på deres faglige udvikling.

Samtidig træder du ind som redaktør for Center for Ejendommes interne og eksterne kommunikation. Du skal lægge retningen for kommunikationen på vores kanaler, sikre at opgaverne bliver fordelt og leveret, samt at kvaliteten er høj.

På det personlige plan skal du desuden bidrage med positiv energi, veludviklede sociale antenner og evne til at skabe samarbejde på tværs af forskellige fagligheder.

Du kommer til at indgå i ledergruppe på fire bestående af en enhedschef, en beredskabschef og to teamledere (herunder dig), som alle er forankret i Stab og Strategi.

Sammen omsætter I Center for Ejendommes strategiske prioriteringer til konkrete leverancer, der hænger sammen og ofte løses i tæt samarbejde i Stab og Strategi og med inddragelse af ledere og medarbejdere på tværs af organisationen.

Et stærkt fagligt og socialt miljø
Stab og Strategi består af i alt 16 kolleger med forskellige faglige baggrunde, der tror på, at gode resultater skabes gennem tillid, samarbejde og et godt kollegialt fællesskab.

Det er derfor vigtigt for os, at teamorganiseringen ikke fører til siloer. Vi vil fortsat arbejde på at inddrage hinanden og bruge hinandens perspektiver, samtidig med at vi udvikler vores faglige styrker i de enkelte teams.

Vi har en uformel og god omgangstone og prioriterer også det sociale i hverdagen. Stoltheden er i Center for Ejendomme er stor og sammenholdet er stærkt. Derudover tilbyder vi kantineordning, frugt, fri parkering og alt det kaffe og te, du kan drikke.

En særlig mulighed lige nu
Frem mod 2027 bliver vi en del af en ny fælles organisation på tværs af Region Hovedstaden og Region Sjælland – Region Østdanmark. Det betyder nye samarbejder, nye måder at arbejde på og behov for stærk inddragelse og koordinering.

Her får du og dit team en nøglerolle i at være med til at lægge grundlaget for en ny organisation, Ejendomme og Byggerier, der bygger på det bedste fra bygge- og driftsorganisationerne i de to nuværende regioner.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker i henhold til nedenstående overenskomst. Startlønnen kan variere afhængigt af din anciennitet, erfaring, uddannelse samt arbejdsstedets geografiske placering.

Overenskomst:
Overenskomst for Journalister og fotografer - 33.19.1
Overenskomster for akademikere ansat i regioner m.v. 33.01.1

Stilling:
Journalister, bachelor i journalistik og cand.public linje A
Akademikere med kandidat

Udover startlønnen kan du have:

  • ret til tillæg efter lokale forhåndsaftaler.
  • ret til særydelser, fx tillæg for aften-, nat- og weekendarbejde.
  • mulighed for at forhandle individuelle tillæg afhængigt af stillingen samt din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer.
Arbejdsstedet er CEJ-Huset, Stationsalléen 42, 2. sal i Herlev - lige ved Herlev Station.

Yderligere oplysninger
Ansøgningsfristen er 6. september 2026. Vi har sat tid af til 1. samtaler den 11. september 2026 og til 2. samtaler den 16. september 2026.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er velkommen til at kontakte chef for Stab og Strategi Christoffer Godt-Hansen på tlf. 21741005 eller på christoffer.godt-hansen@regionh.dk.

Ansættelsesprocedure
Du søger stillingen ved at uploade din ansøgning, CV og relevante uddannelsesbeviser via link i annoncen.

Om Center for Ejendomme
I Center for Ejendomme er du med til at skabe, drive og optimere de fysiske rammer for patienter, pårørende og personale i Region Hovedstaden.

Vores opgaver spænder fra drift af komplekse installationer til udvikling af langsigtede, bæredygtige løsninger - med ét fælles mål: At få hospitalerne til at fungere 24/7 året rundt.

Vores arbejde er en forudsætning for, at sundhedspersonalet kan fokusere på deres kerneopgave – at udrede, behandle og redde liv. Derfor arbejder vi blandt andet med kritisk infrastruktur, forsyningssikkerhed, beredskab, modernisering og grøn omstilling.

Se og læs mere om Center for Ejendomme her.

title: General Services Attendant
description:
This one-of-a-kind position includes cross-training as door attendants, patient transporters, garage attendants, on and off campus lab couriers, and shuttle drivers.
The General Service Attendant is often the first point of contact that patients and visitors will encounter upon their arrival to Mayo Clinic. It is imperative the interaction is respectful, professional, positive, and empathetic. Must value teamwork and contribute to the cohesion and alignment within the General Services team. Employees should always demonstrate sound judgement including navigating and adapting within urgent situations.

Attendants aid in traffic flow while meeting patients and visitors at the entrances of patient buildings that are a part of our main campus to ensure that they are directed to their appointments properly. Using hand-held devices, the transporter will escort patients/visitors that are in use of a wheelchair and transport them to their necessary destination using great care. Duties include upon request, patient stair escorts, patient stretcher transports, and patient hospital bed transports as part of our Centralized Transport Team. Patient status can range from ambulatory to immobilized. A working knowledge of wheelchairs and gurneys including safe patient handling is a major responsibility.

On a daily basis, on- and off-site laboratory runs are performed. Must make timely specimen pick-ups and deliveries using safety protocols, showing professionalism, and providing respect to all lab areas.

Shuttle drivers must learn and follow safety protocols when operating shuttles. Shuttle drivers pick-up and drop-off employees as well as patients. Employees must learn and understand how to use all shuttle mechanics, including the wheelchair lift. Excellent communication skills to our dispatch center and fellow shuttle drivers are an absolute must in this position.

General Service Attendants must be able to adapt quickly to any changes in procedure or equipment in a positive manner. Must demonstrate willingness to remain flexible while performing tasks and duties as requested by supervisor or other leadership. It is also necessary to take initiative, display maturity, and offer sound judgement.

High School diploma or equivalent required. Previous work history of customer service preferred. Must learn and understand Mayo Policies and Procedures as well as new information regarding job expectations. Learn and understand lab policies and procedures for handling lab items for transport. Must possess excellent communication skills. Must be able to work independently as well as in a group setting with minimal supervision. Ability to do considerable walking and pushing is required. Must be able to tolerate sitting, driving, walking, carrying and/or pushing during your shift. Must be able to lift 50 pounds without assistance.

Valid Driver's License required.

This vacancy is not eligible for sponsorship/we will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position. Mayo Clinic DOES NOT participate in the F-1 STEM OPT extension program.

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Datastream and Database Migration Services (DMS) are serverless Google Cloud services that make data easily accessible for replication and migration. The Data Movement Platform acts as the foundation for these services, providing a fast and secure way to move data from various sources to destinations using scalable message queues and connectors.

As part of the Sources group within the Data Movement Platform, you will develop and enhance the infrastructure used to stream data. You will take ownership of the design, implementation, and post-production care of new infrastructure services and features.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
End Date

Friday 14 August 2026

We Support Flexible Working – Click here for more information on flexible working options

Flexible Working Options

Hybrid Working

Job Description Summary

The purpose of the Engineering Lead is to support the Lab leadership and the teams within their area to deliver against the strategy and their delivery commitments. Colleagues in these roles must come from an Engineering background, and this position represents the conscious decision of an Engineer to progress down the management track of the Y-shaped model. This allows these colleagues to start building up the broader set of skills required to operate in a engineering management position, not all of which will be developed under the Software Engineer role. However, they will remain deeply technical, providing technical guidance to teams and making sure that they make the right technology choices, though the broader set of responsibilities will often (though not always) take them away from actual coding on a very regular basis.

Job Description

  • About the Customer Data Services Platform

    We're the team that looks after the customer data for the whole of Lloyds Banking Group. Our mission is to make this data available for the right purpose with the appropriate confidentiality and always ensuring a phenomenal engineering experience based on performance, resilience, and integrity.

    The systems we support, underpin almost everything we do as Lloyds Banking Group. We maintain these systems with the highest standard, with an ambition to take ownership of the operational support 24/7 using SRE principles.

    The Customer Data Services (CDS) platform operates within the CIO Enabling Services and our purpose is to ‘Enable the Bank to gain value from data by providing safe and efficient Group-wide data capabilities and services’. We work closely in partnership with our colleagues in the Chief Data & Analytics Office (CDAO).

    The CDS platform is responsible for maintaining, transforming and innovating the infrastructure and software required to ensure that our Customer data, API platforms and technological capabilities meet the bank's needs now and in the future.

    Our core technologies are:

  • Mainframe using COBOL
  • API platform using Java
  • Commercial customer management database using Java

  • We maintain and develop a couple of database systems ; DB2, IBM MDM and Oracle and various tooling for middleware management

    Our target is to start with a cloud first (private and public) approach in our hosting strategy and to transform our systems from a monolith to a microservice based system whilst decommissioning our legacy services and systems. For data and analytics our public cloud target is Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and the Lab’s scope includes building a customer system of engagement out there.

    The Lab at its core delivers scaled integration events of large scale acquisitions / divestments, e.g. with our colleagues in Insurance & Wealth; changes to the Customer master architecture to support change within value streams to integrate into our Customer Architecture e.g. APIs into the architecture or mainframe data structure within the OCIS database across all divisions within the Group and, modernising our technology and associated delivery methods through upgrades or movement to private and public cloud.

    Here's how you'll make a difference…

  • You will learn our business, so that you can always put our customers first and maximise our value to them.
  • You will think strategically, understanding a complex and heterogeneous technical environment, and thus how to leverage emerging technology.
  • You will advise on, and make, hard prioritisation calls.
  • You will establish productive, enduring relationships with external and internal partners.
  • You will immerse yourself in the code, to better support your teams.
  • You will lead teams, shaping their vision, driving innovation, encouraging collaboration and ensuring your engineers are enabled to work to their best.
  • Your teams will always deliver.

  • Why Lloyds Banking Group:

    We’re on an exciting journey to transform our Group and the way we’re shaping finance for good. We’re focusing on the future, investing in our technologies, workplaces, and colleagues to make our Group a great place for everyone. Including you.

    What you’ll need

  • Broad and deep software engineering experience in enterprise environments.
  • Specific technical experience with Enterprise Java and Oracle databases.
  • The ability to be "hands on" - delving into the code to challenge and improve your teams’ output.
  • Rapid learning skills - this is a sophisticated and demanding environment.
  • A ‘can do’ attitude to forge delivery out of ambiguity.
  • A passion to drive a modern and inclusive working environment.

title: Specjalista ds. Analiz Sprzedaży

title: Lead Engineer
description:
The Lead Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day technical leadership of the engineering team, ensuring delivery of engineering work packages in alignment with strategic objectives, cost constraints, schedule commitments, and performance requirements. The Lead Engineer will work alongside the Programme Manager who will have overall Programmatic schedule and cost management responsibilities for the Project and will be the Technical customer facing for the programme and will ensure that e scope of the programme is maintained and delivered through all phases of the engineering activities.

Click here for the full job description

Salary for this position is £63,072 to £85,000, depending on experience plus our excellent flexible benefits package.

We believe in maintaining a diverse workplace - inclusive of beliefs, cultural background, job experiences, thoughts and ideas. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we welcome you to join our inclusive team!

title: To sygeplejersker søges til 37 timers stilling i et meget velfungerende Psykiatrisk Ambulatorium.
description:
Trives du med de ambulante arbejdstider og har samtidig lysten til at have enkelte vagter på et psykiatrisk sengeafsnit, muligheden for selv at strukturere din arbejdsdag, selvstændighed, udvikling, høj faglig kvalitet og forskellige patientforløb?


Lidt om vores ambulatorie

Vi er et engageret og tværfagligt psykiatrisk ambulatorium under Psykiatrisk Center Glostrup, beliggende på Gl. Kongevej på Vesterbro. Vores optageområde dækker Valby og Hvidovre, og vi arbejder efter F-ACT modellen (Flexible Assertive Community Treatment), der sikrer helhedsorienteret og tilpasset behandling til den enkelte patient.

Vi tilbyder ambulant behandling til patienter med ikke-psykotiske lidelser, psykosediagnoser, dobbeltdiagnoser samt patienter med dom til ambulant behandling. Vores arbejde er præget af høj faglighed, tæt samarbejde i teamet og fokus på patientens recovery.


Dine opgaver og ansvarsområder i FACT-teamet

Du bliver primær kontaktperson for ca. 25-30 patienter og er medansvarlig for tilrettelæggelse af patientforløb. Du har udekørende dage ca. 1 gang om ugen sammen med en kollega. Du varetager selvstændigt individuelle patientsamtaler i hjemmet eller i ambulatoriet.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være;

  • Psykoedukation
  • observation af symptomer
  • pårørendekontakt
  • virkning/bivirkning i forhold til medicin
  • afholdelse/deltagelse i netværksmøder
  • fokus på skadereduktion i forhold til rusmidler
En stor del af patientkontakten foregår ude og indebærer også akutarbejde og hurtige beslutninger i patienternes eget hjem. Du skal derfor kunne trives med at træffe beslutninger på egen hånd eller med supervision over telefonen.

Vi arbejder recoveryorienteret og har i patientbehandlingen stort fokus på den personlige og kliniske recoveryproces.


Vores forventninger til dig

Vi forventer, at du har en stor forståelse for målgruppens kompleksitet og er god til at møde patienterne, der hvor de er og har blik for deres ønsker og behov.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, recoveryorienteret og være aktivt deltagende i et tværfagligt team
  • Har lyst til tværfagligt og tværsektorielt samarbejde
  • Har erfaring med arbejde i psykiatrien efter endt uddannelse
  • Kan planlægge egen arbejdstid i forhold til rammerne og prioritere dagens opgaver
  • Gerne har erfaring med rusmiddelproblematik
  • Har evt. interesse i gruppebehandling
  • Har erfaring fra behandlingspsykiatrien
  • Har lyst og interesse i udvikling og forbedring af patientbehandlingen

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et velfungerende psykiatrisk ambulatorium man har lyst til at være en del af
  • Mentorordning og uddannelsesplan over to år
  • Et alsidigt arbejde med både samtaleforløb i ambulatoriet og opsøgende funktion
  • Dygtige stabile kolleger med en høj faglighed, humor, betænksomhed og alt muligt andet
  • Gode samarbejdsrelationer
  • Fokus på sammenhæng imellem arbejde og privatliv
  • Mulighed for at deltage i forbedringer & udvikling af patientforløbene
  • Fast supervision i teamet
  • Fast planlagt undervisning i team og afsnit
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling og til besættelse d. 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale.

Du ansættes i henhold til overenskomst for ikke-ledende personale på Sundhedskartellets område med lønindplacering som sygeplejerske. Du er under ansættelsen omfattet af den til enhver tid gældende arbejdstidsaftale indgået mellem Regionernes Lønnings- og Takstnævn og Dansk Sygeplejeråd.

Ambulatoriet har åbent i dagtimerne mandag-fredag. Din arbejdstid vil derfor primært ligge inden for dette tidsrum. Du ansættes i blandede vagter med primært dagvagter.

Som nyansat sygeplejerske bliver du i øvrigt knyttet til et specifikt døgnafsnit, hvor du indgår i vagtarbejdet lørdag og søndag hver 6. uge. Vi sørger naturligvis for at klæde dig godt på til opgaven. Det sker i form af et individuelt introprogram, vidensdeling og sparring med kolleger. Og så sker det i form af løbende kompetenceudvikling med afsæt i dine erfaringer og behov.

Du ansættes som sygeplejerske i Region Hovedstaden med tjeneste indtil videre på Psykiatrisk Center Glostrup, Psykiatrisk Ambulatorium, Gl. Kongevej 33.


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Søg stillingen via linket her på siden. Du bedes uploade CV og andre relevante dokumenter sammen med din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 8. september 2026.

Søg allerede i dag – vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende.

Ønsker du at vide mere om stillingen og ambulatoriet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Mai Berg Hansen på tlf.: 26 30 04 26, eller via mail: mai.hansen@regionh.dk

Region Hovedstaden sætter mennesket først. Vi giver plads til forskellighed og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge, uanset køn, alder, etnicitet, religion, seksualitet eller funktionsnedsættelser.

title: Smed til hydraulik og maskinmontage i Herning
description:
Vil du have firmabil, fast arbejde og smedearbejde i stål?

Vi mangler en smed til hydraulik og montage i Herning.

Du lander i et hold, hvor smedearbejdet hænger tæt sammen med både konstruktion, montage og færdige løsninger til byggeriet. Arbejdet ligger på erhvervssiden, og opgaverne kræver at mål, samlinger og finish sidder ordentligt. Der er også en faglig tyngde omkring svejsning, dokumentation og materialer, så det er et sted for dig, der kan lide at nørde detaljen uden at gøre det fint. Du arbejder ikke alene hele dagen, men i makkerpar og sjak hvor opgaven styrer bemandingen.

Rollen passer godt til en smed, der både kan tage fat i maskinmontage og tænke konstruktionen igennem. Det er ikke samlebåndsarbejde, for hydraulik, samling og tilpasning kræver at du bruger hovedet undervejs. Firmabilen er en del af pakken, og hverdagen er fast nok til at du ved hvad du møder ind til.

Det får du

Løn: 200-240 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Herning og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 30 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Hydraulik, montage og konstruktion

Din hverdag

Dagen veksler mellem hydraulik, maskinmontage og konstruktionsfremstilling, hvor delene skal samles rigtigt første gang. Du aftaler rækkefølgen med makkeren eller sjakket, får styr på målene og sørger for at samlingerne holder til næste trin. Når dokumentation eller materialekrav spiller ind, tager du det med i arbejdet fra start.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Monterer og samler hydrauliske dele og maskinkonstruktioner
  • Fremstiller og samler stålkonstruktioner efter opgaven
  • Læser mål og tilpasser emner, så montage og finish passer
  • Skærer, borer og tilpasser konstruktioner i stål
  • Arbejder sammen med makker eller sjak om større samlinger

Hvis noget ikke passer, er det vigtigt at du siger til med det samme. Her er der brug for en smed, der hellere retter en fejl tidligt end afleverer noget halvt.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som smed
  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring med hydraulik, maskinmontage eller konstruktion
  • Kan arbejde i makkerpar og sjak
  • Møder stabilt og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både montage og konstruktionsarbejde før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tænke praktisk og få tingene samlet ordentligt.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Software Engineer III, Search Quality
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.
  • Write product or system development code.
  • Collaborate with peers and stakeholders through design and code reviews to ensure best practices amongst available technologies (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
  • Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
  • Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
  • Implement solutions in one or more specialized ML areas, utilize ML infrastructure, and contribute to model optimization and data processing.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
  • 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.
  • 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
  • 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • Experience developing accessible technologies.

title: Begeleider Grift 2 | Gehandicaptenzorg | MVB/EMB | 8-20 uur | Rhenen
description:
Wil jij werken in een warme en betekenisvolle omgeving waar geen dag hetzelfde is?
Op Grift 2 maak je écht het verschil voor bewoners met een intensieve zorgvraag.
Jouw rust, aandacht en betrokkenheid zorgen voor vertrouwen en veiligheid.

Jouw rol als Begeleider

Je werkt op een kleinschalige woonlocatie waar bewoners intensieve begeleiding en verzorging nodig hebben.

Dit betekent dat je:

  • Bewoners ondersteunt bij ADL-zorg en eetmomenten, inclusief omgaan met slikproblematiek

  • Inspeelt op complexe zorgvragen zoals psychiatrische problematiek en moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag

  • rRust, structuur en veiligheid creëert door jouw houding en manier van begeleiden

  • Werkt vanuit de visie van Gentle Teaching, gericht op relatie en vertrouwen

  • Goed kijkt naar signalen van bewoners en hier sensitief op reageert

  • Samenwerkt met collega’s en, waar nodig, met Grift 4

  • Bewoners ondersteunt in hun eigen regie en welzijn

Dit bieden we jou

  • Een jaarcontract, met uitzicht op een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd

  • Een salaris van minimaal €2.597,- tot € 3.635,- bruto per maand (FWG 35) op basis van 36 uur
    Per 1 november 2026 ontvang je een loonsverhoging van 2%!

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de cao Gehandicaptenzorg

  • 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering

  • 144 vakantie-uren en 57 uur balansverlof per jaar (op basis van 36 uur)

  • Vergoeding voor de kosten van je VOG

  • Een werkkostenregeling met fiscaal voordeel tot € 450,- (bijvoorbeeld voor een (elektrische) fiets)

  • Een introductiecursus Gentle Teaching

  • Ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Een prachtige werkomgeving midden in de natuur

Dit neem je mee

  • Een zorggerelateerd mbo‑diploma op minimaal niveau 3 of 4

  • Affiniteit met mensen met een verstandelijke beperking en complexe zorgvragen

  • Je kunt de-escalerend werken en omgaan met moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag

  • Je bent geduldig, rustig en kunt goed aansluiten bij de bewoner

Hier ga je werken

Grift 2 - 4 bestaat uit twee geschakelde woningen op het mooie, groene terrein van Zideris in Rhenen. Er wonen 10 bewoners van 40 tot 60 jaar. Grift 2 biedt beschutte begeleiding aan mensen met een meervoudige beperking. Grift 4 richt zich op bewoners met meer zelfstandigheid. Nabijheid van begeleiding, een rustige sfeer en een voorspelbare dagstructuur zijn belangrijk. Bewoners hebben een eigen kamer, delen sanitair en gebruiken samen de huiskamer.

Over Zideris

Bij Zideris werk je in de gehandicaptenzorg op een plek waar jij wordt gezien. Als professional én als mens. Wij geloven dat goed werkgeverschap begint bij vertrouwen, ruimte en eigenaarschap. Pas als jij jezelf kunt zijn, kun je er echt zijn voor een ander. Je werkt in een kleinschalig team, dichtbij huis, waar je elkaar kent, samen leert en samen verantwoordelijkheid draagt. title: Senior Tax Specialist (f/m/d)
description:
Senior Tax Specialist

Join us now as Senior Tax Specialist in Frankfurt or Munich within the Fund Administration and Operational Business Support – Product Taxation and Tax Operations.

About the Job

The position sits within the Global Tax Function for Product Taxation and Tax Operations, which forms part of the Global Fund Administration and Operational Business Support team. This team is responsible for the Operations Value Chain and serves as a Global Centre of Competence for selected overarching topics within AllianzGI Global Operations. The main focus of the role is to act as a Subject Matter Expert for product taxation, ensure tax compliance in our investment countries, and analyse and coordinate the impact of tax changes across the relevant Value Chain.

What you do

  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert on all product tax-related topics concerning AllianzGI fund products, including AIFs, UCITS funds, and alternative investment structures, for AllianzGI stakeholders and clients, as well as relevant service providers
  • Analyse upcoming tax law changes and their impact on AllianzGI’s business and products
  • Coordinate tax changes across the relevant Value Chain, including service providers
  • Manage and further develop the Internal Control System for Taxation, including the design and maintenance of tax controls
  • Support process harmonisation measures across relevant tax processes at European and global levels.

What you bring

  • Certified tax advisor
  • Academic background or comparable qualifications
  • Preferred 5 to 6 years in Business Consulting with profound knowledge of Asset Management and Tax Operations.
  • Knowledge related to the Investment Process (front to back) and the related taxation areas
  • Experience in managing projects preferred with Taxation backgrounds
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Proven Project Management Skills

Allianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our clients and for the world around us. If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment.
