title: Product Designer
description:
About your role 👀

As the second Product Designer at Pogo, you'll help lead the product design and creative direction for our new consumer insights product, which allows brands/retailers to connect with millions of purchase-verified consumers. This platform will ultimately be used by some of the largest companies in the world.

Specifically, you will:

  • Design core product experiences end-to-end, from early exploration through launch and iteration for our up-and-coming B2B platform and consumer app with 3 million users (and growing)

  • Craft polished, delightful interfaces that build trust and showcase the power of our data and AI technology

  • Sweat the details - layout, typography, spacing, color, motion, interactions

  • Help define the product roadmap and lay the foundations for our design language, systems, and culture.

  • Find creative ways to ship high-quality work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous, startup environment

  • Be 1 of 2 designers (for now), working cross-functionally with engineering and GTM

💎 We're looking for the best talent out there, so we're offering above-market salaries & equity.

About you 👩‍🚀

  • Experience designing software products.

  • Bonus if you’ve done this at a startup, or have designed AI interactions before!

  • Bonus if you have experience designing enterprise-grade products.

  • You design quickly and efficiently, using Figma to gain super powers and reach “escape velocity design”. When needed, you make near-term tradeoffs and take shortcuts - even though you have strong design vision and awareness of how to improve the product later.

  • You’re a design nerd at heart. You have a very high bar for design quality and strong opinions about what “great” looks like. You actively seek out the best-designed best products/designers, constantly collecting references from Twitter, Mobbin, and beyond. And you bring that level of rigor and polish into your own work.

  • You actively use LLMs like as ChatGPT or Claude in your design workflow.

  • You’re relentless in pursuing the best solution - willing to explore, iterate, and even scrap a lot of your own work if it means creating a stronger product.

  • You’re a full-stack designer. You've designed experiences from scratch and know how to bring it to life working cross-functionally with product and engineering.

  • You have strong product intuition and have a knack for creating experiences that index on simplicity and clarity. At the same time, you're willing to re-consider your initial intuition as you get more user data.

Why you might be excited about this opportunity 🙌

  • Work on the design for an up-and-coming enterprise product. Our enterprise demand is growing, and we are in the early stages of building a product that will ultimately be used by some of the largest companies in the world. You’ll use qualitative interviews and direct customer feedback to shape product decisions and design solutions tailored to enterprise needs.

  • Design matters a lot to us. You won't be fighting uphill battles to convince people why design matters, and you'll be joining a team that values best-in-class design. Fun fact: one of our co-founder’s first dream jobs was to be a furniture designer (and has designed a lamp!).

  • Be surrounded by amazing product thinkers. We believe product thinking is critical for everyone on our team at our stage. From our engineers and our customer support to our co-founders - our entire team has a unique obsession and knack for product thinking.

  • Quick feedback loops. Unlike designing enterprise software or working in big tech, launch and get user feedback on what's working and what's not in a matter of hours.

  • Shape our design culture from the ground up. As one of our early team members, you'll play a huge role in defining our culture, processes and traditions.

Why you might not be excited about us 👎

  • Priorities may shift quickly. Oftentimes, we're tackling very ambiguous problems that don't have clear-cut answers. While we make calculated bets, we have a strong culture of experimentation and we'll pivot as necessary based on what we're seeing in the data and what we're hearing from our users.

  • You will be one of two designers (for now!). While we have an extraordinary Lead Product Designer (former Figma, Slack & Glean), we don't have the typical design management overhead or user researchers. We're looking for someone that gets energized by learning independently and working in tiny teams.

  • At times, you’ll need to design things in a day. We live and breathe a value called “Calculated Speed”, which involves iterating and shipping weekly, rather than spending months going through complex processes or lengthy builds. Our engineers are some of the best in the world, which means anything you design today may be shipped next week.

  • We expect more than 9 to 5 - raw hours make an impact at our current stage. That said, we trust each team member to create a flexible work schedule that allows them to be most productive while accommodating other priorities outside of work. We also strongly encourage time off to recharge the batteries: in addition to unlimited PTO, we've implemented a minimum 20 days vacation policy 🌴

title: Civic Engagement Director
description:
Civic Engagement Director
Job Announcement

Organization Overview
For 27 years, the East Bay Alliance for a Sustainable Economy (EBASE) has been at the forefront of economic and racial justice, fostering a Thriving East Bay where all people and families have safe homes, healthy communities, and sustainable work that supports basic needs and ensures dignity. As an anchor organization in the region, EBASE boasts a strong track record of cultivating alliances among community organizations, labor unions, worker centers, faith institutions, and government leaders, and developing the leadership and capacity of Black and Brown communities, low-wage workers, and tenants.

With an experienced and committed staff and board, EBASE has launched a ten-year long-term agenda to build power toward a Thriving East Bay, focused on Worker Power & Liberation, Housing as a Human Right, and Community Governance. To advance these pathways amidst tumult and crises, EBASE is integrating a community of care and safety approach to our base building and coalition building in order to meet the immediate needs of workers and tenants as we cultivate an economy and governance rooted in dignity and care. EBASE partners with and shares staff with East Bay Action, a 501(c)(4) organization that builds voter power in the East Bay. EBASE is a founding member of the PowerSwitch Action national network.

Position Description:
The Civic Engagement Director leads EBASE civic engagement, electoral, and political power-building strategies in the East Bay cities and within the counties of Alameda and Contra Costa. The Director coordinates voter engagement, field programs, endorsement processes, alliance building and participation, staff training, and campaign infrastructure in service of organizational campaign goals and long-term power-building goals. This role works closely with campaign teams, communications staff, organizing staff, finance, legal/compliance partners, and senior leadership. The position may supervise Civic Engagement Campaign Coordinator(s), field staff, and volunteers. This position reports to the Executive Director.

Strategy & Oversight for Campaigns & Organizing
● Develop and oversee implementation of civic engagement power-building strategies in the East Bay. Current geographies of focus include Concord, Contra Costa County, Oakland, and Alameda County.

● Coordinate with EBASE campaign teams to develop annual civic engagement goals and workplans that build political and voter power in service of long-term goals and purpose. Engage staff in shaping civic engagement goals and workplans as needed. Experiment with creative civic engagement tactics that integrate communities of care and safety, joy, and culture into voter contact, communications, events, and political power-building.

● Coordinate implementation of civic engagement campaigns, which could include coordinating among allies, working with communications staff to implement communications strategy, and/or overseeing field/voter contact.

● Manage endorsement processes. Coordinate with campaign directors, communications staff, and allies.

● Oversee voter outreach canvass when needed. Supervise field teams who will manage and lead all aspects of dates, scripts, turf, tech, etc.

● Support the development of organizational systems and infrastructure to support and ensure C3-compliant civic engagement activities.

Partnership and Coalition Building
● Develop and sustain relationships with key allies, including community organizations, labor unions, and elected officials, towards building co-governing coalitions and alliances.

● Represent EBASE with civic engagement partnerships and develop partnerships that advance organizational goals. These may include participating in Lift Up Contra Costa, Bay Rising Oakland Rising, and other tables.

● Support the success of key civic engagement alliances that are critical for EBASE's long-term agenda.

Supervision and Leadership Development
● Supervise 1-2 Civic Engagement Campaign Coordinator(s). Conduct weekly check-ins, troubleshoot workplans, conduct evaluations, and create leadership development plans. Support supervisees in accessing training opportunities.

● Lead trainings and activities for EBASE staff on electoral organizing and on the political landscape. Train EBASE staff, members, interns, and volunteers on electoral organizing, voter contact, political landscape, campaign messaging, and field systems.

● Build a strong culture of clarity, accountability, teamwork, political education, and care within the civic engagement program.

Organizational Leadership & Compliance
● Provide leadership to develop the civic engagement program annual budget, including potential sources and allocation of staff time to achieve identified goals.

● Oversee approved civic engagement campaign activities within budget and provide timely updates to senior leadership, finance, and compliance partners.

● Provide timely information to finance, operations, and legal/compliance teams to support appropriate use of funds, FPPC reporting, lobbying reports, and other compliance needs.

● Co-lead compliance efforts with the Finance & Operations director, including reviewing legal compliance with attorneys, ensuring communications are compliant, and tracking necessary reporting.

● Participate in fundraising with foundations, donors, and allies as needed. Organizational Development and Personal Administration

● Participate in weekly staff meetings, internal trainings, mandatory all-staff meetings, and retreats.

● Contribute to fundraising activities, including event planning and implementation, grassroots donor outreach and appreciation, etc.

● Support EBASE’s “all hands on deck” culture in which both campaign and development staff request active participation from all staff during critical moments of work. This may include attending community mobilizations, participating in voter outreach, making grassroots fundraising asks or other activities. Approximately 1-2 activities/month.

● Maintain personal organization systems. Complete reimbursements, timesheets & lobbying reports.

Experience and Abilities Needed
● At least 5 years of organizing leadership experience, including in worker organizing, basebuilding, leadership development, and strategic campaigns.

● Experience leading civic engagement, electoral, issue advocacy, voter outreach, or community organizing programs. Experience with voter contact tools, field planning, campaign data, endorsement processes, and campaign communications.

● Demonstrated ability to manage staff, consultants, volunteers, field programs, and multi-organization coalitions.

● Strong understanding of local East Bay politics, racial and economic justice issues, labor and community organizations, and movement-building strategy.

● Flexible, creative and willingness to adapt, try new approaches and collaboration to run effective moments in the current context.

● Ability to balance strategic leadership, relational organizing, staff development, compliance awareness, and implementation details. Strong fidelity to goals and purpose.

● Commitment to building power with low-income workers, tenants, immigrants, formerly incarcerated people, Black and brown communities, and faith-rooted leaders.

● Ability to implement from vision to action; strategic thinker with excellent judgment, attention to detail, and ability to manage campaigns in a dynamic environment.

● Highly relational and emotionally intelligent, with a principled and collaborative approach.

● Demonstrated ability to lead complex processes and make courageous, clear decisions.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

● Strong facilitation skills for inclusive, clear, and action-oriented meetings. Collaborative and aligned with organizational goals.

Must live in or be willing to relocate to the East Bay and have a valid driver's license and access to a vehicle. Familiarity with regional and statewide partners is preferred. If you don't meet all the criteria above but still feel your experience could be a good fit for the role, please apply. We recognize that candidates who don't check every box can add value to our team.

Compensation and Benefits
The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $110,000 annually (based on experience), with an annual 3% cost-of-living adjustment, budget permitting. EBASE provides a generous and competitive package of benefits valued at approximately $25,000, including:

● Fully paid health, dental, and vision insurance

● A 401(k) retirement plan, with 4-8% employer contribution

● Generous paid leave, including
○ 12 vacation days/year, increasing to 20 days/year with tenure
○ 8 personal days/year
○ 12 sick days per/year
○ 18 paid holidays/year plus an end-of-year office closure

● A 3-month sabbatical with full salary available after 5 years of service

● Professional development opportunities.

EBASE offers an inclusive work environment that values teamwork, high-quality work, and a shared commitment to social justice. EBASE staff work in a hybrid model with at least 3 days/week in the office. This position is based in Oakland, CA.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The priority deadline is September 15. Applications are only accepted on our jobs portal https://ebase.applytojob.com/apply.

title: MOT Lead
description:
Job Title: MOT Lead
Craft: MOT
Reports to: Foreman
Exempt Status: Non-Exempt (Hourly)

Position Objective/Description:
Performs a variety of traffic control duties and related tasks for MOT and construction crews under the direction of a crew foreman.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Perform flagging and other traffic control duties as directed
  • Direct traffic safely around and through a construction site
  • Set up lane closures/detours etc.
  • Set up barrels/cones and barricades on job site
  • Monitor safety conditions throughout jobsite
  • Load, unload, or distribute materials, machinery, or tools to and from designated locations
  • Signal operators of construction equipment to facilitate alignment and movement of materials
  • Assist craft workers, such as carpenters, ironworkers, plasterers and masons, as needed
  • Record and report any instances of unsafe drivers
  • Maintain clean work area by disposing of trash and debris properly.
  • Perform daily maintenance and safety checks of equipment.
  • Promote and adhere to the company’s safety program.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
  • Ability to operate a variety of tools and equipment such as hand tools, power tools and motorized equipment.
  • Ability to listen, follow directions, and have a willingness to continue to enhance skills
  • Able to communicate effectively with jobsite supervisor and co-workers
  • General knowledge of road construction processes.
  • Demonstrate a safety first attitude. Strict adherence to safety requirements and procedures.
  • Display a professional and courteous attitude to co-workers, supervisors, and the general public
  • Ability to work nights and weekends when necessary
  • Must have reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned worksites

Physical Demands:
  • Regular physical effort, including extended standing for at least 8 hour shift
  • Intermittent sitting; and regular walking on at construction site.
  • Occasionally twist, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to perform duties
  • Occasionally reach above shoulder level
  • May lift and carry small objects under 10 pounds on a regular basis
  • Agility, balance, and manual dexterity, as well as arm-hand steadiness
  • Able to hear and respond to oral instructions in a noisy environment.
  • Regularly use hands and fingers to handle, feel or operate objects, tools or controls; reach and grasp
  • Excellent hand, eye and foot coordination.
  • Good vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus

Education / Experience:
  • High School diploma or general education degree (GED)
  • Experience working as MOT Flagger, or equivalent laborer experience.
  • Active Driver’s license
Work Environment:
Regularly works in outside weather conditions, including extreme heat and humidity. Frequently works near heavy equipment and moving mechanical parts and is frequently exposed to wet or humid conditions and vibration. Work may involve exposure to a variety of substances found on construction site such as oil, grease, gasoline, concrete and diesel fuel. Periodically exposed to fumes, lubricants, airborne particles and dust. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.

title: Head of UK Pricing Governance
description:
Job Description

Supporting the Head of Pricing, UK, and in collaboration with the UK Actuarial function through matrix reporting to the Deputy Chief Actuary, UK to:


Define, Drive and Influence Governance for UK Pricing

  • Support the strategic objectives of the UK Pricing Team as defined each year and aligned to broader strategic objectives for the UK Business by developing and maintaining an appropriate Governance & Controls framework.
  • Assess current practices against needs and expectations, including regulatory requirements.
  • Raise awareness and knowledge of governance and control expectations across the UK Pricing team.
  • Design enhanced governance through appropriate forums, documentation, reporting and controls.
  • Ensure value add implementation, which meets the needs of the team and the wider organisation, without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Monitor behaviours against required expectations to evidence a robust, but pragmatic governance and controls environment.
  • Working with the Performance Management function, support technical development of appropriate pricing metrics to allow performance monitoring within the Governance framework through relevant forums and/or committees.
  • Promote the benefit of pragmatic governance practices across the team.
  • Demonstrate Sompo Values in delivery and performance.

Support Actuarial & Pricing Leadership to:

  • Promote strategic development and opportunity across the team.
  • Promote the actuarial value proposition across the organisation.
  • Develop and maintain the appropriate knowledge and behaviours across the team.
  • Support group wide initiatives regarding pricing development, ensuring appropriate consideration for UK governance requirements within the context of strategic objectives and regulatory expectations.
  • Support a positive and pro-active team environment which thrives through an understanding of opportunity, alongside responsibility and accountability.
  • Demonstrate and role model expectations for teams through early-stage leadership behaviours.
  • Contribute the pricing perspective to customer focused groups and committees, to meet regulatory requirements concerning aspects such as product design and consumer outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Performance

  • Account Pricing Support.
  • Model Development Activity.
  • Business Planning.
  • Underwriting Risk Parameterisation.
  • Portfolio Metrics & Analysis.

Customer focus/environmental awareness

  • Ensure the team has sufficient awareness of the governance and controls required to support the business.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders in the team, Actuarial Function more broadly and across other function to promote the value proposition of the Governance & Controls framework.
  • Appropriately communicate requirements in a way that is relevant to the audience.
  • Maintain strong interpersonal skills.
  • Look for opportunities to collaborate with other functions to support better outcomes for Sompo collectively, considering where pricing knowledge and skills could be valuable beyond core responsibilities.
  • Networking with counterparts within Sompo to encourage sharing and adopting of best practice.

Policy, process, & procedures

  • Operate in accordance with Actuarial Professional Standards.
  • Open and co-operative with the FCA, PRA and other regulators.
  • Act in accordance to Sompo values.
  • Observe proper standards of market conduct.
  • Contribute to the development, enhancement and maintenance of internal standards and governance frameworks for UK Pricing.
  • Adhere to internal requirements and policies relevant to the role including pricing policies and referral criteria
  • Contribute to improving internal pricing processes through continuous improvement and supporting broader strategic projects.
  • Ensure understanding and support adherence to policies and procedures.

Leadership

  • Demonstrate Sompo UK Leadership support as a senior member of the UK Pricing team, supporting actuaries and analysts across the department, and working with senior leadership to promote the vision, goals and strategy for the UK Pricing function.
  • Provide input to strategic thinking around the development of the team to meet and exceed requirements and provide the best service to the business.
  • Provide point of contact for pricing governance across the business and functions, connecting with senior leaders who have a contribution or an interest in pricing governance.

People Management

  • Provide information to senior actuarial leadership on resourcing, delivery and performance to support broader team management.
  • Provide a clear vision for the team with regards to pricing governance aligned to the broader vision from the Head of Pricing, UK.
  • Support the UK Pricing team’s business towers on governance related matters, training and peer review.
  • Ensure clear requirements and expectations are set for the pricing actuaries to ensure the team can meet governance requirements both collectively and individually.
  • Support broader development of junior members of the UK Pricing team through training and team events.
  • Ensure clear communication of UK pricing governance to pricing teams operating across Sompo and provide support for efficient implementation of the requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, & EXPERIENCE

Qualifications

  • BSc in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science, or Similar.
  • Qualified Actuary (FIA or equivalent) or a Part Qualified Actuary who has demonstrated capabilities through extensive experience and prior roles.

Experience

  • Good previous experience of individual case pricing and pricing models within a general insurance environment.
  • Demonstratable capability of working closely with other members of the team and other functions to support day to day governance activity and deliverables.
  • Significant knowledge of pricing performance metrics and how they can be utilised in terms of performance measurement and governance.
  • Understanding of regulatory requirements in respect of case pricing, planning and performance including appropriate governance requirements.
  • Good understanding of Financial Services Industry best practice in actuarial analysis, modelling and underwriting
  • Demonstratable capability to develop the required understanding of Sompo business and processes relevant to the role.
  • An ability to identify potential risks and support mitigation through development and implementation of appropriate controls relevant to the role.

Skills

  • An ability and interest in promoting the Actuarial & Pricing value proposition across key stakeholders in the business.
  • The capacity to pro-actively support a team to ensure appropriate influence and drive regarding pricing governance.
  • A desire to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and additional value add for the team and for stakeholders.
  • Appropriate levels of knowledge of MS Excel, Access, Powerpoint and Word.
  • Knowledge or the ability to develop knowledge within the wider team, as required, of relevant programming languages.
  • A deep understanding of actuarial techniques relevant to the role, as well as other parts of the Actuarial Function which could be impactful on pricing.
  • Excellent communication.
  • Ability to persuade and influence stakeholders and collaborators in the support of day-to-day business decisions.
  • Excellent report writing skills, and the drive to ensure appropriate documents are in place to enable Pricing actuaries to meet internal requirements as well as meeting Professional standards.

title: Engineer II Electrical & Electronics Engineering X
description:
Job Title

Senior Electrical Engineer – Design & Application (Medium Voltage Switchgear)

Job Purpose

To execute detailed design and application engineering of Medium Voltage (MV) switchgear, ensuring compliance with IEC standards, accurate protection relay engineering, and timely project delivery.

Key Responsibilities 1. Design & Engineering

  • Prepare and review SLDs, GA drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and interlocking logic for MV switchgear (AIS/GIS up to 36kV or company scope).
  • Perform busbar sizing, short-circuit withstand calculations, and thermal considerations.
  • Ensure compliance with IEC 62271 series and other applicable IEC standards.
  • Support standardization by using approved engineering templates and libraries.

2. Protection & Relay Engineering

  • Selection and application of numerical protection relays.
  • Perform relay setting calculations (OCR, EF, REF, UV/OV, directional, differential as applicable).
  • Configure and program protection relays as per project protection philosophy.
  • Develop trip matrix and interlocking logic.
  • Support protection coordination studies (ETAP / DigSILENT preferred).
  • Assist during FAT and commissioning for relay validation and troubleshooting.

3. Application Engineering

  • Review customer technical specifications and prepare compliance statements.
  • Identify technical deviations and propose optimized solutions.
  • Support sales and project teams with technical clarifications.

4. Testing & Project Support

  • Prepare and review routine test procedures.
  • Support factory acceptance tests (FAT).
  • Provide technical support during manufacturing and site-related queries.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • 8–12 years of experience in MV switchgear design and protection engineering.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of IEC 62271 series and IEC protection standards (IEC 60255).
  • Hands-on experience in numerical relay programming (ABB / Siemens / Schneider or equivalent).
  • Knowledge of protection coordination studies.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD / EPLAN or equivalent tools.

Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented with high engineering accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Good communication skills for cross-functional coordination.

title: Technical Lead, RSV Vaccine Introduction Project
location: Ethiopia, Addis Ababa Country Program Office
description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here

PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.


PATH in Ethiopia is currently implementing various high impact projects with the aim of saving and improving the lives of the most vulnerable and underserved women and children in the country.

PATH seeks to recruit a Technical Lead for RSV Vaccine Introduction Project. The Technical Lead will technically lead the Support for RSV Vaccine Decision-Making in Ethiopia. S/he will provide support to the MIRNA team and the national and subnational EPI team for timely introduction of RSV vaccine into the routine Immunization program.

The Technical Lead will be based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia and will be responsible for providing overall technical support for MIRNA team and EPI team in generating required evidence that will support evidence-based decision-making for the introduction of RSV Vaccine. The technical lead will report to the Project Director, Vaccine and Immunization Programs.

Key Roles

  • Partner with MIRNA team to generate health economic evidence to inform MOH RSV MI prioritization decision-making and ongoing NITAG recommendation refinements as applicable.

  • Review, summarize and contextualize WHO SAGE recommendations related to RSV vaccine introduction to contribute to the RSV Evidence Compendium informing Ethiopia’s NITAG.

  • Contribute to the evidence synthesis presentation to Ethiopia’s NITAG.

  • Support MIRNA key policy stakeholder mapping with enhanced granularity and evidence dissemination among policy stakeholders.

  • Assist in developing an A&C strategy in collaboration with MIRNA and the MOH.

  • Develop standardized advocacy tools in partnership with MIRNA colleagues.

  • Facilitate an A&C workshop.

  • Partner with EPI on Gavi application dossiers for NVI and scale-up.

  • Customize the generic NVI readiness assessment tool, and support the technical oversight of readiness assessments.

  • Support the Immunization Service Desk head in preparing a presentation to Ethiopia’s ICC.

  • Disseminate RSV maternal vaccine readiness assessment findings and strategic recommendations to the national TWG, NVI task force, and key immunization partners (e.g., WHO and UNICEF) to inform the national rollout roadmap.

  • Develop TOR that define the specific mandate (from EPI, Maternal Health, and Child Health service desks) and meeting frequency for the coordination body.

  • Participate in regular RSV TWG meetings and ensure the systematic documentation of proceedings, resolutions, and follow-up actions.

  • Represent PATH in official meetings and workshops.

  • Other tasks assigned by the immediate supervisor

Required skills, knowledge and experience

  • Master’s degree or higher in monitoring and evaluation, health informatics, public health, Epidemiology, Statistics, and/or other relevant disciplines.

  • Minimum ten (10) years’ experience in public health programming, policy or research, with at least five (5) years’ experience in project management in the area of immunization and maternal/child health programs,

  • Substantial experience in project planning, management, data management, M and E required.

  • Experience in research and evaluation of public health programs (qualitative and quantitative)

  • Advanced level experience with statistical software (e.g. SPSS, Stata, Epi Info) and MS Office Suite

  • Excellent understanding of country health management information system

  • Proven ability to create and maintain effective working relationships with government, partners, donors and international organizations at various levels.

  • Skilled in successfully working with geographically dispersed teams and working in a multi-cultural environment.

  • Experience in facilitating meetings and moderating complex discussions with a variety of stakeholders (including religious and clan leaders) preferred.

  • Excellent analytical and report writing skills.

  • Good presentation/communication skills,

  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work as part of a team, including cross-cultural teams.

  • Ability to travel to regions and abroad.

8001-531-42-i-04

Om afdelingen
Ortopædkirurgisk Afdeling, Aalborg Universitetshospital varetager højt specialiserede funktioner og har undervisningsforpligtigelse for læger i basis- og hoveduddannelse samt for medicinske studenter indenfor ortopædisk kirurgi.
Afdelingen har 32 stationære sengepladser i Hospitalsbyen. Aalborg Universitetshospital og er et level 1 traumecenter med modtagelse og behandling af multitraumatiserede patienter i Region Nordjylland.
Læger i introduktionsstilling deltager i mellemvagten, som er en tilstedeværelsesvagt på operationsgangen samt i skadestuen. Dagsfunktion er enten i allokeret sektor eller som supervisor i skadestuen.


Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En stilling med fokus på læring, udvikling og faglig progression
  • Et trygt og velfungerende arbejdsmiljø
  • Tæt kontakt til erfarne kolleger – vi arbejder i et team med flad struktur og god stemning
  • For den rette uddannelseslæge vil der være mulighed for stor operativ aktivitet.
Vi har, i ortopædkirurgien, specielt fokus på den praktiske del af lægernes uddannelse, og den ansatte vil blive indplaceret i relevante fagområder for uddannelsesplanerne i introduktionsstillingen.

Som introduktionslæge vil du have ophold i traume, sår/infektion/amputation, hånd og idræts-sektoren.
Uddannelse i fagområdet for håndkirurgi foregår på Farsø Sygehus, Aalborg Universitetshospital.

Deltagelse i traumeteamtræning og præhospitalskursus i beredskab anses som en del af uddannelsen og betales derfor af afdelingen. ATLS og AO kan søges og evt medfinansieres

Vi forventer et stort engagement af dig som introduktionslæge, men tilbyder omvendt et psykologisk trygt lærings- og arbejdsmiljø. Vi vægter det kollegiale sammenhold højt på afdelingen, og der afholdes også sociale arrangementer uden for arbejdstiden.

title: Senior Product Manager, Borrower Experience
description:
Here at Lower, we believe homeownership is the key to building wealth, and we’re making it easier and more accessible than ever. As a mission-driven fintech, we simplify the home-buying process through cutting-edge technology and a seamless customer experience.
With tens of billions in funded home loans and top ratings on Trustpilot (4.8), Google (4.9), and Zillow (4.9), we’re a leader in the industry. But what truly sets us apart? Our people. Join us and be part of something bigger.

Job Description
We're seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the Borrower Experience workstream, a top company priority to streamline the process of applying for a loan, getting an instant offer, completing many of the steps to close a loan in a self-guided digital experience where our expert loan officers are only a click away. This application process is the front door for how we meet many potential borrowers, whether they’re coming from organic traffic on a site like Lower or Movoto, a partnership, or other paid channels. It’s a business-critical product surface with the opportunity to make an outsized impact on our business.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to EVP of Program and Product Management for Lower. You'll own end-to-end delivery of major feature sets within the workstream, as well as write and refine detailed requirements for a cross-functional team. You’ll define what success looks like beyond shipping, like improving conversion throughout the application funnel and into Lower's mortgage products, automatically ingesting borrower information to reduce friction, and progressively improving a borrower’s ability to self-serve. You'll present regularly to execs to align on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress.

Responsibilities
  • Own the product strategy for the borrower experience, translating an established long-term vision (closing a loan entirely online) into a sequenced, shippable crawl/walk/run roadmap from current state.
  • Use customer data, market context, and business goals to prioritize the roadmap and anticipate borrower needs and competitive positioning.
  • Build and maintain alignment across the cross-functional team (engineering, design, data) from sprint rituals to leadership updates.
  • Make sound tradeoffs even with incomplete data on evolving systems in collaboration with the cross-functional team and vendors.
  • Proactively unblock the cross-functional team and adjust plans as constraints evolve; define success by measurable outcomes, not just shipped features.

Requirements
  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of end-to-end delivery for a complex, consumer-facing or data-driven product.
  • Track record of managing ambiguity: defining MVP scope and sequencing a roadmap in phases rather than waiting for full clarity.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort defining and tracking success metrics tied to business outcomes, not just output.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to flex between exec-level updates and detailed technical requirements.
  • Fintech, mortgage, or real estate industry experience.

Strongly Preferred (but not required)
  • Experience partnering across multiple engineering orgs or codebases at once (e.g., separate frontend, backend, and platform teams).
  • Experience with personalization, recommendation, or pricing/offer engines.


Location
With locations in Columbus, OH and Austin, TX, we're looking for someone able to work in-person on a hybrid basis. While in market candidates will be reviewed first, we are open to considering remote candidates who demonstrate an exceptional level of product expertise, as well as strong communication and collaboration skills, with willingness to travel periodically.

title: Serviceassistent til rengøring som afløser i Randers SØ i hverdage og weekender
description:
"I Forenede har vi fokus på, at vores medarbejdere går glade på arbejde"

Forenede Service søger en serviceassistent til rengøring som afløser hos vores kunde i Randers SØ til hverdags- og weekendarbejde.Vil du have et job, hvor du er glad for at gå på arbejde, og hvor vi tilbyder tryghed via grundig oplæring og mulighed for kurser og uddannelse?

Forenede Service søger en serviceassistent til rengøring som afløser hos vores kunde i Randers SØ til hverdags- og weekendarbejde.

Hvor mange timer skal du arbejde, og hvornår skal du starte?

Det er både morgenrengøring og eftermiddagsrengøring i hverdage og weekender. På sigt vil der evt. blive mulighed for at tilbyde fast timer.

Der er opstart hurtigst muligt.

Hvilket område skal du arbejde med?

Dine opgaver vil (bl.a.) bestå af:

  • Afvaskning af gulve med gulvvaskemaskine og alm. gulvvask og aftørring af inventar samt rengøring af toiletter, omklædning, kantine og baderum

Hos os løfter vi i flok og det betyder, at vi bakker op om hinanden og hjælper til, hvis behov opstår fx under kollegers sygdom og ferie. Du bliver en del af et team, der sammen leverer den standard og kvalitet, der er aftalt med kunden.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har erfaring med rengøring og service og tager ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Du er engageret i dit arbejde og møder kolleger og kunder med et smil
  • Du kan kommunikere mundtligt og skriftligt på dansk eller engelsk
  • Du er klar til at stå klar som afløser

Vi tror også at følgende kan gøre dig glad:

  • Startløn og eventuelle tillæg jf. Serviceoverenskomsten.
  • Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring
  • Oplæring og mulighed for dansk kursus, AMU-kurser eller erhvervsuddannelse med løn
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi hylder forskelligheden
  • Et trygt og sikkert arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi følger faste procedurer for at passe på dig
  • Mulighed for at leje attraktive ferieboliger i både ind- og udland (fx Lalandia og Østrig).


Vores værdier udgør fundamentet for vores kultur og er: Ansvar - Engagement - Omtanke

Det betyder, at vi tager ansvar for at sikre, at der er gjort ordentligt rent og vedligeholdt så vi leverer kvalitetsservice hos vores kunder. Vi viser engagement ved at have et professionelt udtryk, som betyder at vi fremtoner ordentligt og præsentabelt og bruger de metoder der oplæres i. Vi bruger omtanke ved at vise hensyn og respekt for de mennesker vi møder, og som vi hver dag gør en forskel for.

Hvordan søger du jobbet?

Du søger ved at klikke på den blå knap "Ansøg". Du bedes uploade CV og ansøgning.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Serviceleder Maj-Britt på tlf. 21 67 86 64 eller mail mabr@forenede.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!


Velkommen til Danmarks største privatejede Facility Service virksomhed

Forenede Service A/S er en mangfoldig virksomhed, der beskæftiger ca. 2.600 medarbejdere, som repræsenterer +80 forskellige nationaliteter. Vores medarbejdere servicerer flere hundredtusinder personer, når de dagligt leverer services inden for rengøring, kantine og ejendomsdrift til offentlige og erhvervsvirksomheder i Danmark.

Forenede Service A/S er en del af Forenede koncernen, som er en familieejet servicekoncern med en omsætning på mere end DKK 3 mia. Forenede Koncernen leverer omsorgsydelser og Facility Service gennem virksomhederne Forenede Service i Danmark og Forenede Care i Danmark og Sverige.

title: Supervisor - Reconciliations
description:
About Citco:

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About the Team & Business Line:

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Your Role:

  • Support all new Client and Fund launches and migrations.
  • Proactively act as main liaison with Clients and Internal and External stakeholders to drive results and deliverables.

About You:

  • Strong financial instruments knowledge – OTCs, Fixed Income, loans, and derivatives product knowledge preferred.

  • Supervisory and coaching skills.

  • Ability to organize and prioritize tasks that focuses on the goals of the department and organization.

Your well being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

title: Strategy Associate
description:
Purpose of the Job

The Strategy Associate will work directly to the co-CEOs, turning Ocorian's strategic priorities into work that is properly planned, sequenced and delivered. The role is the connective tissue between intent and execution: it takes the decisions made at Group level and makes sure they land in the business, on time and with evidence of impact.

Ocorian is a global business of more than 2,000 colleagues across 20+ countries, serving thousands of clients across asset manager services, private wealth and corporates and issuer services.

The role exists to give the co-CEOs high-quality execution capacity. It structures initiatives, builds the plan in patnership with accountable business owners, chases the detail, and facilitates delivery of expected outcomes.

This is a hands-on, early-career role with unusually senior executive exposure. In practice the Strategy Associate will be working directly with the executive team, seeing how a global regulated financial services business is actually run, and trusted with real ownership of workstreams from the outset.

Main Responsibilities

Strategy Execution

  • Facilitate strategy setting and articulation with the co-CEOs and the executive team
  • Translate Group and service line strategic priorities into clear workplans with named owners, milestones, dependencies and success measures.
  • Scope new initiatives with the sponsoring executive: problem statement, options, resource requirement, timeline and expected value.
  • Maintain a single, current view of the progress of the strategic agenda and report at executive leadership
  • Follow through on decisions taken in executive forums so that actions are assigned, understood and completed

Analysis, Insight & Support to the co-CEO

  • Prepare analysis on markets, competitors, clients and internal performance to inform strategic choices.
  • Turn complex or incomplete information into a clear
  • Draft papers, presentations and briefing notes for the executive team, the Board and, where appropriate, external audiences.
  • Own a small number of discrete projects end to end on behalf of the co-CEO.
  • Handle confidential and commercially sensitive material with complete discretion.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  • Two to four years' experience in a business manager, project management, strategy, programme or chief of staff type role - in a financial or professional services, consulting, banking or fintech start-ups or scale-ups
  • Strong academic record; a relevant degree or professional qualification is welcome but not essential.
  • Structured problem solving: able to take an ambiguous question, break it down, and reach an answer defensible through data and factual analysis.
  • Exceptional PowerPoint and presentation skills: able to build a clear, well-designed executive and board-level decks
  • Clear, concise written English, and comfort drafting for an executive and Board audience.
  • Project management discipline - plans, actions, owners, dates, follow-up
  • Confident with senior stakeholders across cultures and time zones,
  • Genuine interest in financial services, outsourcing solutions and practical application of AI tools
  • Comfortable exploring and using AI tools day to day and being a champion for new use cases and adoption
  • Entrepreneurial ownership: happy to roll sleeves up, be in the detail personally, and finish things without being chased.
  • Organised when priorities move at short notice, keeping track of everything in flight.
  • Quick to learn an unfamiliar subject to a useful level of depth.

All staff are expected to embody our core values that underpin everything that we do and that reflect the skills and behaviours we all need to be successful. These are:

title: Director of Revenue Enablement Job Description | Aligned
description:
About Aligned

Aligned builds the category-defining AI Deal Workspace that transforms how modern revenue organizations execute B2B deals. Founded on the absolute conviction that sales isn’t complex but buying is, Aligned replaces the chaotic mess of fragmented email threads and file links with a single buyer-facing workspace for each deal.

Every month, over 70,000 sellers and 1 million buyers run their transactions through Aligned’s #1 Digital Sales Rooms (DSRs) on G2, delivering 30% faster sales cycles and a 15% increase in win rates for enterprise teams.

Aligned is scaling at a rare market velocity, tripling its ARR year-over-year while maintaining best-in-class gross revenue retention. We are backed by tier-one partners like NFX, Hetz Ventures, and JAL Ventures, and have recently closed a $60M Series B funding round led by PeakSpan Capital to accelerate our expansion into AI-driven buyer enablement. We operate with a lean, exceptionally high-caliber team that values direct communication, high execution standards, and absolute ownership.

About the Role

Aligned is hiring a Director of Revenue Enablement to own the selling system behind our revenue organization: every asset, training program, certification, and coaching rhythm that determines how well our sellers execute. This is not an L&D seat, and it is not a content administration role: it is a position for a proven top seller who discovered that their highest leverage is making an entire team sell the way they did.

Enablement at Aligned is intentionally structured around four pillars: Revenue Assets & Selling System, Training, Certification & Ramp, Coaching & Execution Rhythm, and Customer & Buyer Enablement. You inherit founder-built foundations, not a blank page: the sales deck, playbook, battlecards, mutual action plan templates, and deal-room templates that won our first hundreds of customers were designed by the CEO — and today they sit without an owner while the product and the market move weekly. The gap is not zero-to-one vision; it is an owner who can take founder-quality assets and turn them into an institutional system.

One more thing makes this seat unusual. Aligned sells buyer enablement: our customers buy us to run their best deal execution and deliver the best buying experience. That means our own selling motion must be the reference implementation of the category. You own that standard.

You will report directly to the CEO, operate inside the revenue leadership team, and carry a mandate to measurably lift quota attainment and compress ramp time across a sales organization scaling toward 20 AEs and a BDR engine growing toward 18 heads.

What You Will Own

1. Revenue Assets & Selling System

  • Asset Ownership: Own the full arsenal end-to-end: sales deck, discovery frameworks, competitive battlecards, objection-handling systems, ROI and business-case templates, mutual action plans, and Aligned room templates. Founder-quality bar, built with your own hands.
  • Competitive Weaponry: Author the head-to-head assets that win bake-offs — battlecards, trap-setting talk tracks, objection counters — in partnership with Product Marketing, refreshed at the speed the market moves and proven inside live cycles.
  • Buyer-Facing Craft: Build the mutual action plans, business cases, and Digital Sales Room templates our reps run every deal through. Our rooms are our demo; every buyer touchpoint you design is also product marketing.
  • A Living System, Not a Library: Govern versioning and adoption, and kill stale content ruthlessly. A rep should never wonder which deck is current.

2. Training, Certification & Ramp

  • Onboarding Architecture: Design the ramp path from day one to full productivity, with certification gates at every stage — measured in time-to-first-deal and time-to-full-quota, and built to compress both.
  • Persona & Methodology Mastery: Build and teach how we sell to a CRO versus a RevOps leader versus an enablement leader: discovery depth, gap-based selling, and multi-stakeholder orchestration. Taught, tested, and certified — not hoped for.
  • Product-to-Field Velocity: The product ships fast. You translate every release into field-ready narrative, talk tracks, and demo motion in days, not quarters.
  • Certification Discipline: Nobody carries our message uncertified. Live role-play gates, not slideware quizzes.

3. Coaching & Execution Rhythm

  • Film Review Engine: Institutionalize call review as a program: structured film sessions on real calls, run at a cadence reps attend because they get better, not because attendance is mandatory.
  • Skill Coaching: Diagnose and close individual skill gaps — discovery depth, multi-threading, negotiation — in partnership with sales leadership, with lift visible in stage conversion and win rates.
  • Ramp Cohort Support: Own the enablement path of every ramping AE so no seller is left to figure it out alone.

4. Customer & Buyer Enablement

  • Customer Success Enablement: Build the renewal narrative system, QBR frameworks, ROI evidence libraries, and expansion plays for our CS organization. Retention conversations deserve the same craft as new business.
  • Cross-Functional Intake: Run the quarterly enablement planning rhythm with Sales, CS, and Marketing leadership: requests stack-ranked, capacity protected, priorities explicit.
  • Voice of the Field: Convert live deal patterns, competitive signal, and rep feedback into sharper positioning, in partnership with Marketing and Product.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days

  • Quality Bar Reset: A flagship asset — the sales deck or a head-to-head battlecard — is rebuilt and shipped to the field within the first 30 days, and reps notice the difference.
  • Ramp Path v1: The structured onboarding and certification path is live, with the current ramping cohort running through it.
  • Coaching Cadence Live: Film review runs on a weekly rhythm, and top performers show up voluntarily.
  • Trust Established: Reps pull you into deals and ask for your feedback before big calls. That is the leading indicator this role is working.

In 6–12 months

  • Attainment & Ramp: Ramp time is measurably compressed and documented, and the middle of the attainment curve has moved up. Enablement’s impact shows in the number, not in activity reports.
  • An Institutional System: Assets, training, certification, and coaching run as infrastructure that no longer depends on the founder’s personal involvement, and every new seller ramps through it.
  • Full Revenue Coverage: Renewal and expansion conversations run on the same quality of narrative and evidence as new business.
  • Field Gravity: Enablement at Aligned is treated as an unfair advantage: reps cite it in why they stay, and candidates cite it in why they join.

Requirements

1. Proven Selling Record

  • Tenure: 6–10 years in B2B SaaS, including 4+ years carrying quota on complex, multi-stakeholder deals in the $50K–$250K ACV range.
  • Attainment: A documented top-decile record you will walk us through deal by deal. Quota scars are the license to coach; reps can smell their absence instantly.

2. Craft & Program Expertise

  • Founder-Grade Asset Craft: A portfolio of decks, battlecards, mutual action plans, and business cases where you can isolate exactly what you personally authored. We will go through it line by line.
  • Methodology Command: Fluency deep enough to teach — and to critique — at least one modern selling system (gap selling, Challenger, MEDDICC, or equivalent). You know where each one breaks.
  • Program Architecture: You have built onboarding, certification, or training programs with before-and-after evidence on ramp time or attainment — not just delivered sessions someone else designed.
  • Buyer Enablement Fluency: Deep grounding in mutual action plans, business cases, and committee-based selling; ideally you have run deals through digital sales rooms. PLUS — you have sold to GTM buyers — CROs, sales leaders, RevOps — and know what it means to pitch a professional evaluator of pitches.

3. Execution & Character

  • Player-Coach: You build with your own hands and ship weekly. This is a hands-on-keyboard role for at least the first 12 months; if your first instinct is to hire a team, this is not your seat.
  • Coaching Presence: You can hold a room of skeptical top performers on the merits. Expect us to reference-check with reps you enabled, not the executives you reported to.
  • Chose the Craft: You stepped out of a closing seat — or are ready to — because building the system that makes ten sellers great compels you more than the next commission check, and your explanation for why is convincing.
  • Bias to Ship: You know which 80% to ship this week instead of which 100% to ship next quarter.
  • Communication: Native-level English with exceptional writing and deck craft. Your documents should sell without you in the room.

Leading a team of senior product leads, you'll shape product strategy, oversee product development and work across business, technology, risk and operations teams to bring new propositions to market and improve existing products.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Head Product Lead to lead the strategy, development and ongoing management of our Personal Current Account product portfolio.

This is a high-impact leadership role within Everyday Banking, responsible for some of the most important customer products in the Group. You'll shape the future of our current account propositions, ensuring they continue to meet customer needs, deliver strong commercial outcomes and align with evolving regulatory requirements.

The role sits at the heart of product ownership, bringing together proposition development, pricing, governance, risk management and product performance. You'll play a key role in determining how our products evolve, using customer insight, market intelligence and business performance data to inform strategic decisions and investment priorities.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:

  • Leading the strategy, development and lifecycle management of our Personal Current Account products.

  • Defining and evolving customer propositions, pricing strategies, product features and customer benefits.

  • Finding opportunities to improve customer experience, customer outcomes and commercial performance.

  • Developing product roadmaps and prioritising investment decisions to maximise value.

  • Ensuring products remain aligned to governance, risk and regulatory requirements throughout their lifecycle.

  • Leading product reviews, regulatory change implementation and control activities.

  • Building strong partnerships across business, technology, operations and risk teams.

  • Managing important supplier and partner relationships that support the product portfolio.

  • Leading, coaching and developing a team of product leaders and specialists.

  • Representing the portfolio within senior leadership and governance forums.


This is a role for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, balancing customer, commercial and regulatory considerations and leading through change. You'll bring a pragmatic approach to decision making and be comfortable operating in a fast-moving and highly regulated environment. Insights from the hiring manager highlight that this role is central to ownership of core current account products, with significant accountability for proposition, pricing, governance and regulatory oversight across the portfolio.


ABOUT US

Like the modern Britain we serve, we're evolving. Investing billions in our people, technology and data capabilities, we're creating a purpose-led organisation that helps Britain prosper.

Our colleagues are passionate about making a difference to customers, businesses and communities across the UK. Together, we're building a more sustainable and inclusive future whilst transforming the way we deliver products and services.

Product Strategy & Product Management

Commercial Decision Making

  • Strong commercial awareness, with experience balancing customer needs, business goals, technology considerations and risk requirements to drive sustainable growth and customer value. Experience managing budgets, forecasts and investment decisions.

Data-Driven Insight & Customer Focus

  • Ability to use customer insight, market intelligence, experimentation and performance data to identify and explore opportunities, improve customer outcomes and inform strategic decision making.

Risk & Regulatory Management

  • Experience operating within a regulated and controlled environment, with strong governance, risk and regulatory awareness across the product lifecycle. This role has significant accountability for product governance, pricing and regulatory compliance.

Stakeholder Management & Influencing

  • Proven ability to build strong relationships and influence senior collaborators across business, technology, operations and risk functions, aligning priorities and driving successful outcomes.

People Leadership & Organisational Capability

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams, building capability and creating an inclusive environment where colleagues can learn, collaborate and thrive through change and complexity


ABOUT WORKING FOR US

Our ambition is to build a purpose-led organisation where skilled people can do their best work and make a real difference for customers. We value diverse perspectives, encourage continuous learning and empower colleagues to shape the future of our products and services.

This is a fantastic opportunity to lead at scale, influence strategic direction and help build high-performing product teams that deliver meaningful outcomes for customers, colleagues and the business!

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We keep your data safe. So, we'll only ever ask you to provide confidential or sensitive information once you have formally been invited along to an interview or accepted a verbal offer to join us which is when we run our background checks. We'll always explain what we need and why, with any request coming from a trusted Lloyds Banking Group person.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

title: Laatoittaja Rovaniemelle
description:
Laatoittaja Rovaniemelle

Hei, juuri sinä!

Me etsimme asiakkaallemme laatoittajia Rovaniemen alueelle vaihteleviin työkohteisiin.

Mistä on kyse?

Etsimme asiakkaallemme laatoittajia monipuolisiin työtehtäviin Rovaniemen alueelle. Työ sopii laatoituksen ammattilaiselle, joka hallitsee työtehtävän itsenäisesti ja tekee työnsä huolellisesti. Työtehtäviin kuuluu monipuolisia laatoittajan töitä erilaisissa kohteissa. Työmaat sijaitsevat pääasiassa Rovaniemen alueella, mutta kohteita on myös muualla Lapissa, esimerkiksi Muoniossa ja Ivalossa. Reissukohteissa työntekijälle järjestetään majoitus.

Odotamme hakijoilta aiempaa kokemusta laatoitustöistä sekä kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja huolellisesti. Työssä vaaditaan voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti. Työt alkavat heti ja kestävät arviolta vuoden loppuun saakka.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Kuinka haen Carrotille?

Voit jättää hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta. Jos olet jo aiemmin jättänyt hakemuksen Carrotille, voit hakemuslomakkeen kautta myös kirjautua sisään käyttäjätunnuksillasi ja päivittää aiempaa hakemuspohjaasi jättääksesi hakemuksen tähän työpaikkaan. Carrotille työhakemuksen jättäminen on helppoa ja nopeaa. Kartoitamme osaamisesi ja toiveesi työpaikan suhteen, ja tarjoamme sinulle yhdellä hakemuksella yhteydet satoihin työpaikkoihin, sekä koko elämän mittaisia urapolkuja!

Tarvittaessa lisätietoja tästä työpaikasta saat soittamalla Janne Tauriaiselle numeroon 0400 406 633, ark. klo 9-16.

Jos sinulla on kysyttävää työpaikkoihimme, työnhakuun tai palveluihimme liittyen, löydät yhteystietomme myös osoitteesta

Nähdään Carrotilla!

Carrot on nopea, välittävä ja vastuullinen työelämän kumppani, jonka tärkeimpänä tavoitteena on olla luomassa hyvää työelämää kaikille. Tarjoamme valtakunnallisesti henkilöstövuokraus-, rekrytointi- ja ulkoistuspalveluita sekä toimimme strategisena HR-kumppanina asiakkaillemme. Carrot on toiminut jo vuodesta 1998.

description:
Vi på Kiwa söker nu en engagerad och teknisk kunnig besiktningsingenjör till vårt team i Stockholm. Du kommer att spela en viktig roll i att säkerställa säkerheten hos trycksatta anläggningar inom kraftvärme-och processindustrin- ett arbete med stor betydelse för båda våra kunder och samhället.

Om rollen:

Som besiktningsingenjör hos oss får du ett självständigt och varierat arbete där du:

  • Arbetar med större anläggningar inom kraftvärme- och processindustrin
  • Får utökat ansvar för dessa kunder, vilket innebär att du planerar och samordnar kontroller i nära dialog med både kunder och olika delar av Kiwas organisation.
  • Bidrar med expertis inom riskbedömningar, fortlöpande tillsynsprogram och andra tekniska bedömningar
  • Planerar och rapporterar ditt arbete självständigt – med stor frihet och eget ansvar
  • Du utgår hemifrån och har möjlighet att själv styra dina arbetsdagar. För att underlätta ditt arbete erbjuder vi tjänstebil eller förmånsbil.

Har du vad som krävs?

Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och gillar att möta människor. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt, men uppskattar också samarbete och att vara en del av ett team. Du är noggrann, strukturerad och trygg i att fatta egna beslut.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Teknisk gymnasieutbildning eller examen som högskoleingenjör/sjöingenjör
  • Material- och svetskunskaper – förståelse för svetsmetoder och materialegenskaper
  • Projektledning och kundsamordning – vana att planera och koordinera kontroller med större kunder och interna team
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
  • B-körkort

Det är starkt meriterande om du arbetat med ackrediterad kontroll. Det är även meriterande om du har arbetat som drift- och/eller underhållingenjör, IWS, IWT, Flygtekniker, Sjöingenjör, Kyltekniker.

Vad kan du förvänta dig av oss i gengäld?

Kiwa är idag ett av de mest framgångsrika företagen inom besiktning, provning, certifiering och teknisk konsultation vilket är tack vare våra medarbetare som genom sitt engagemang och sin kunskap bidrar med säkerhet och hållbarhet till våra kunder och även till samhället. Därför satsar Kiwa mycket på sina anställda och deras utveckling. Genom ditt dagliga arbete, intressanta projekt och utbildningar kommer du och din kompetens ständigt att utvecklas när du är en del av Kiwa! Hos oss är laget före jaget viktigt och tillsammans skapar vi en positiv arbetsmiljö där vi alla är en del av en större gemenskap, Kiwa-gemenskapen!

  • Trygg och stabil anställning- Kiwa har kollektivavtal
  • Generöst friskvårdsbidrag
  • Ersättning för bland annat läkarvård, vaccinationer och möjlighet till en grundlig hälsoanalys
  • En timbank så du kan vara ledig när du vill- inte bara när kalenderns röda dagar infaller
  • Möjligheten att åka med på Kiwas skidresa tillsammans med ca 100 härliga kollegor

Så här söker du

Ansök via vår hemsida och registrera ditt CV.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Sista ansökningsdag är 30/9.

För frågor gällande rollen kontakta enhetschef Daniel Ohlsson på tfn. 0104793175 eller maila rekryteringsansvarig Sofia Kjellström på sofia.kjellstrom@kiwa.com

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Inför den här rekryteringen har vi noga övervägt våra annonseringsvägar och vill därför undanbe oss kontakt med rekryterings- och annonsförsäljare.

Om Kiwa

We ARE Kiwa- Är du?

För oss på Kiwa är vår värdegrund, ARE, utgångspunkten i allt vi gör. Ambitious, Reliable och Engaged. Känner du dig bekväm i vår värdegrund, strävar efter att skapa förtroende och trovärdighet mot kund och hos dina medarbetare och är samhällets och individens säkerhet i samhället viktigt för dig?

Kiwa är idag ett av de mest framgångsrika företagen inom besiktning, provning, certifiering och teknisk konsultation. Vi är en global aktör med lokal förankring. Vi har starka kundrelationer och hög service med ett fokus på säkerhet, teknik och hållbarhet. Vi har ett brett utbud och erbjuder tjänster inom processäkerhet, fastighets- och lyftsäkerhet, lantbruk samt inom livsmedels- och byggbranschen. Som koncern är vi verksamma i över 40 länder och har ca 12 000 anställda runt om i världen. I Sverige har vi ett tjugotal kontor mellan Kiruna och Malmö där totalt 900 medarbetare arbetar tillsammans för ett säkrare samhälle.

Övrig information

Kiwas målsättning är att ha en arbetsplats som är drogfri. Därför genomför vi slumpmässiga alkohol- och drogtester under året.

title: ER Tech 11a-11p Full Time
description:
Job Summary

The Emergency Room (ER) Technician provides essential support to the Emergency Department by assisting with patient care under the supervision of licensed nursing staff. This role ensures the department operates efficiently by maintaining a clean, organized, and well-stocked environment while fostering effective communication with the care team.

Essential Functions
  • Provides direct patient care in the emergency department by performing a variety of clinical interventions and technical procedures, including but not limited to: splint application, Foley catheter insertion, blood glucose monitoring (accuchecks), vital sign collection, electrocardiograms (EKGs), and intravenous (IV) insertion, in accordance with scope of practice and under the direction of licensed clinical staff.
  • Assists with patient transport to and from units, procedural areas, or discharge destinations, ensuring safety and timeliness.
  • Maintains a clean and organized environment by adhering to infection control standards, restocking supplies, and ensuring equipment is operational.
  • Communicates effectively with patients, families, and the care team, promptly reporting changes in patient status or concerns to appropriate personnel.
  • Documents patient care activities accurately and efficiently in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.
  • Responds to emergency situations promptly, assisting the care team with necessary tasks to ensure patient safety.
  • Utilizes personal protective equipment (PPE) and adheres to all safety protocols to protect patients, staff, and self.
  • Supports unit operations by performing clerical tasks, such as managing communication systems, maintaining records, and assisting with administrative duties as needed.
  • Collaborates with ancillary services and external agencies to facilitate seamless patient care and departmental operations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • Technical School completion of Nursing Assistant, EMT, Phlebotomy, or Medical Assistant courses required
  • Certified Nursing Assistant, certified Basic EMT, certified Phlebotomist, or certified Medical Assistant preferred
  • 0-1 years of clinical experience required
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Ability to remain calm and think clearly during stressful situations.
  • Working knowledge in emergency management or other medical training.
  • Knowledge of safety guidelines, sterile techniques and infection prevention procedures.
  • Ability to recognize, analyze, and solve a variety of problems.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of patient rights and laws, including but not limited to, HIPAA and EMTALA.
  • Ability to prioritize and organize tasks according to unit's needs.
  • Ability multi-task and prioritize work.
  • Strong self-initiative to assist with whatever is needed.
Licenses and Certifications
  • EMT - Emergency Medical Tech required or
  • LP - Licensed Paramedic required
  • BCLS - Basic Life Support issued by American Heart Association (AHA), American Red Cross (ARC), or American Safety and Health Institute (ASHI) required
  • CNA - Certified Nursing Assistant preferred or
  • CPT - Phlebotomy Technician Certification preferred

title: I-stilling til Psykiatrien Vest, Psykiatrien i Slagelse
description:
Der er kortere til Vest end du tror – er du nysgerrig på psykiatrien kan du blive vores nye I-læge.

Har du lyst til at prøve kræfter med psykiatrien som klinisk speciale og forskningsfelt? Så er du måske vores nye lægekollega i Psykiatrien Vest.

Vi har tre I-stillinger med tiltrædelse 1. november eller efter nærmere aftale. 3800ZV1-50-i-03, 3800ZV1-50-i-06 og 3800ZV1-50-i-10

Vores I-stillinger består af en intensiv akut periode (6 måneder) i vores psykiatriske akut modtagelse (PAM) og en periode (6 måneder) ved alment eller specialiseret sengeafsnit.

Det daglige arbejde vil primært bestå af selvstændig stuegang og vagtarbejde, begge dele under supervision af hoved vejleder og klinisk vejleder.

Der tilbydes derudover et kognitivt psykoterapiforløb og tilhørende individuel supervision på 10-15 gange samt mulighed for gruppe supervision.

Vi tilbyder et veletableret og alsidigt undervisningsprogram samt mulighed for selv at undervise.

Region Sjællands Psykiatrisk Forskningsenhed ligger også i Psykiatrisygehuset, og der bliver et dynamisk lægeligt og tværfagligt forskningsmiljø, der omfatter psykoterapi, psykopatologi, retspsykiatri, personlighedsforstyrrelse, tidlig opsporing ved psykose og forskning på tværs af psykiatri og somatisk.

Der er mulighed for at deltage i I-kursus, grundkursus i psykoterapi og forskningsworkshops.

Hvem er vi?

Psykiatrisygehuset ligger tæt ved det somatiske sygehus, som vi samarbejder med klinisk, forsknings- og undervisningsmæssigt.

Psykiatrien Vest har en busordning mellem København og Psykiatrisygehuset i Slagelse, med stop i DGI-byen og Valby. Bussen kører på alle hverdage og er rettet mod læger, specialpsykologer og psykologer under specialuddannelse i psykiatri. En del af transporttiden indgår i arbejdstiden, og der er en afgift pr. tur.

Hvem er du?

Vi ønsker engagerede yngre læger, der ser mulighederne inden for det psykiatriske speciale og har gennemført KBU.

Tidligere vikariat i psykiatrien som lægestuderende er et plus. For rette ansøgere vil der være gode muligheder for længere tids tilknytning til Psykiatrisygehuset i Slagelse.

Du bliver en del af Psykiatrien Vest under Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital:

En organisation i udvikling med ca. 520 ansatte. I Vest er der hovedfunktioner for voksne over 17 år inden for akutmodtagelse, døgn-, og ambulante funktioner. Psykiatrien Vest har derudover specialfunktioner inden for behandling af affektive tilstande, traumatiserede flygtninge, PTSD og oligofreni. Vi har en Fusionsklinik/Steno-diabetes-psykiatrienhed og arbejder specielt tæt sammen med Holbæk og Slagelse sygehuse. Psykiatrien Vest har egen forskningsenhed med en professor i klinisk farmakologi og flere ph.d.-studerende. Derudover indgår vi i en del projekter, der bl.a. skal sikre tættere samarbejde med vores kommuner og politi. Vi arbejder målrettet med at få nedbragt anvendelsen af tvang og her er samarbejdet med somatikken også vigtigt. Vores ønske er en psykiatri med fokus på recovery, inddragelse af patienter og netværk, høj faglighed, etik og uddannelse. Dertil kommer målet med at skabe de bedst mulige læringsmiljøer for vores forskellige uddannelsesforløb for læger, sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter m.m. samt sikre et sundt og sikkert arbejdsmiljø for patienter og medarbejdere.

Yderligere information

Såfremt du ønsker yderligere oplysninger om stillingen så kontakt gerne vores uddannelsesansvarlige overlæge Taus Biba. Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler løbende.

Du kan her læse mere om Psykiatrien Vest.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen hører under overenskomsten: Underordnede læger. I forbindelse med ansættelse i Psykiatrien indhentes reference.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.
