title: Project Officer (Open to Internal & External Applicants)
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP is the UN’s global development network, an organization advocating for change and connecting countries to knowledge, experience, and resources to help people build a better life. UNDP is on the ground in about 170 countries and territories, working with national counterparts on solutions to global and national development challenges.

In the programme countries, UNDP supports stabilization, state-building, governance and development priorities in partnership with the host governments, the United Nations system, the development partners and other partners to help the country to achieve sustainable development by eradicating poverty in all its forms and dimensions, accelerating structural transformations for sustainable development and building resilience to crises and shock.

UNDP has worked in India since 1951 in almost all areas of human development, from systems and institutional strengthening to inclusive growth and sustainable livelihoods, as well as sustainable energy, environment, and resilience. UNDP’s programmes continue to fully integrate a global vision for catalytic change with India’s national priorities. With over 30 projects on the ground in almost every state, today UNDP India works to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals by transforming traditional models to do development differently. In a rapidly changing global environment, the work of UNDP and the broader UN family aligns with the Government of India's new national development vision, India 2030, and builds upon the Sustainable Development Goals. UNDP India's country programme for 2018 -2022 has three major focus areas:

  • Inclusive growth
    • Environment and energy
    • Strengthening systems and institutions

These are supported by a framework of renewed partnerships and blended finance solutions, a pool of financial and technical resources for greater impact and scale, and South-South expertise.

You are invited to join a team of dedicated development professionals whose primary role is to support the India to achieve the 2030 Agenda. As part of the UNDP team, your focus will be to work with multiple stakeholders to find the country specific solutions that lead to sustainable development and to ensure no one is left behind - and we reach those furthest behind first.

UNDP is looking for individuals who have communication, analytical, planning and implementation capacities that can address links, choices and connections across many issues and sectors. We seek individuals who can apply global best practice to national contexts. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic, motivated, and committed to making a positive contribution to Development in India.

Office/Unit/Project Description The Plastic Waste Management Programme (PWM) is designed to minimize negative impacts of plastic pollution and its risks to environment and human health in India. The aim is to enhance sustainable plastic waste management (segregation/collection/recycling) practices through a socio-technical model in line with Swachh Bharat Mission in India, while ensuring compliance with regulations and ensuring improved use of resources. The project targets institutionalization of waste pickers (safai saathis) through improved governance mechanisms, capacity building and improved social conditions. The project also targets community engagement to enhance responsible waste disposal behaviour, and cross-stakeholder engagements for improved action on plastics. To achieve the project objective and outcomes, the project is structured in 4 components:

  • Component 1 aims to strengthen policy frameworks, institutional systems, and data capabilities to improve national and urban governance of plastics and waste management..
    • Component 2 focuses on design and implementation of pilots for improved materials management in close coordination with project stakeholders through demonstration of scalable BEP/BAT models
    • Component 3 is directed mainly to improve socio-economic conditions for waste pickers by enhancing social protection, formal recognition, and gender-responsive support systems through institutionalized service delivery mechanisms.
    • Component 4 aims towards developing knowledge management, monitoring and communication mechanisms based on in-built adaptive feedback system during the project duration.

Job Purpose and Scope of Work

Under the overall guidance and supervision of the Project Specialist, Circular Economy and Chemicals Management, the incumbent will lead and provide strategic, technical, and operational support for the design and implementation of programme interventions under the Circular Economy portfolio. The position will be responsible for ensuring effective programme planning, implementation, performance management, and stakeholder coordination, in alignment with UNDP policies, donor requirements, and national priorities. The role will drive integration of circular economy approaches, climate co-benefits, and gender equality and social inclusion (GESI), while strengthening partnerships, policy engagement, and knowledge systems to deliver sustainable and scalable programme results.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Programme Planning, Delivery and Performance Management
    • Lead planning and end-to-end implementation of assigned project components in alignment with project documents, donor requirements, and UNDP policies.
    • Ensure delivery of outputs and outcomes against approved workplans, timelines, and results frameworks.
    • Analyse programme performance, risks, and challenges, and lead adaptive management to strengthen effectiveness and impact
  • Technical and Analytical Leadership
    • Provide technical leadership to integrate circular economy approaches, climate co-benefits, social inclusion and SDG alignment into programme design and delivery.
    • Develop analytical inputs, technical frameworks, and implementation tools to strengthen programme quality.
    • Support innovation and application of best practices to enhance programme impact, scalability and sustainability.
  • Programme Operations and Resource Management
    • Lead development and monitoring of Annual Work Plans (AWPs), ensuring alignment with budgets, procurement, and recruitment plans.
    • Oversee end-to-end procurement processes, including development of Terms of Reference (ToRs), technical specifications, and participation in technical evaluations.
    • Ensure effective contract management and vendor performance.
    • Lead financial planning, budget utilization, and expenditure tracking to ensure efficient and compliant use of resources.
    • Provide guidance and oversight to project staff and consultants to ensure effective delivery.
  • Partnerships and Resource Mobilization
    • Establish and manage strategic partnerships with government, ULBs, private sector, civil society, and development partners.
    • Identify and leverage opportunities for convergence, co-financing, and programme scale-up.
    • Lead and contribute to resource mobilization through development of proposals, concept notes, and partnership frameworks.
    • Participate in relevant technical forums, consultations, and stakeholder platforms.
  • Policy Engagement, Thought Leadership and Capacity Development
    • Lead policy engagement, research, and advocacy in Circular Economy and related thematic areas.
    • Provide strategic inputs to policy dialogue and support development of evidence-based policy and programme frameworks.
    • Design and oversee capacity-building initiatives to strengthen institutional systems and stakeholder capabilities.
    • Position programme insights to influence policy and sectoral discourse.
  • Ensure Knowledge Management, Inclusion, and Reporting
    • Oversee development and dissemination of knowledge products, including case studies, tools, and best practices.
    • Strengthen data systems and digital tools for monitoring and learning
    • Ensure systematic integration of gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) across programme interventions and outcomes.
    • Lead preparation of high-quality reports, donor communications, and visibility outputs demonstrating programme results and impact.
  • Risk Management, Compliance and Quality Assurance
    • Ensure compliance with UNDP rules, audit requirements, and risk management frameworks.
    • Identify and mitigate operational, fiduciary, and programme risks.
    • Strengthen quality assurance mechanisms to ensure high standards in programme delivery and reporting
  • The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement Reporting to: Project Specialist – Circular Economy and Chemicals Waste Management, (NPSA 10) Reportees to this position (if applicable): Operations and Finance Associate, NPSA 7 UNVs

Competencies

Core Competencies

  • Achieve Results: LEVEL 2: Scale up solutions and simplifies processes, balances speed and accuracy in doing work
  • Think Innovatively: LEVEL 2: Offer new ideas/open to new approaches, demonstrate systemic/integrated thinking
  • Learn Continuously: LEVEL 2: Go outside comfort zone, learn from others and support their learning
  • Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 2: Adapt processes/approaches to new situations, involve others in change process
  • Act with Determination: LEVEL 2: Able to persevere and deal with multiple sources of pressure simultaneously
  • Engage and Partner: LEVEL 2: Is facilitator/integrator, bring people together, build/maintain coalitions/partnerships
  • Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 2: Facilitate conversations to bridge differences, considers in decision making
  • People Management: UNDP People Management Competencies can be found in the dedicated site.

title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Role in one sentence

A hands-on infrastructure lead who owns the Kubernetes-native foundation for Rojo's New Integration Products. This covers the cluster, IaC, secrets, identity, messaging, and observability.

This is a greenfield build. There's no legacy infra and no existing conventions to inherit. Every foundational decision gets made once, by this person, and lived with for years. That takes someone senior enough to set direction and own it. As we scale, this person will build and lead a team. Right now, the focus is architecture. The person writes the Terraform, configures the cluster, debugs the Kafka broker.

The infra has to cover several key pillars from day one:

  • Tenant Isolation: Namespace-per-tenant, default-deny network policy, per-tenant secrets, and identity realms.

  • Hybrid & On-Prem Deployment: Hosting central control planes in the cloud while supporting deployment across on-premises or private cloud customer environments.

  • Durability & Messaging: Kafka as the backbone for event-driven components.

  • EU Data Sovereignty: Region, encryption, audit trails, and self-hosted vs. managed choices that hold up under GDPR and EU AI Act rules.

  • Observability: Every span, log, and metric traceable per tenant across all deployed environments.


Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience owning production infrastructure end-to-end at a startup or scale-up. Ideally as an early or first infra hire with full accountability.

  • Kubernetes Expertise (Managed & On-Prem): Strong experience with cloud-managed K8s (EKS/GKE) as well as self-hosted, bare-metal, or lightweight distributions (e.g., K3s, Rancher, OpenShift) for on-premise setups. Deep grasp of namespace-per-tenant patterns, ResourceQuota/LimitRange, NetworkPolicy (default-deny), Pod Security Admission, and autoscaling.

  • Hybrid Networking & Connectivity: Experience with secure cross-environment networking (VPNs, mTLS, reverse proxies, WireGuard) to establish reliable communication between cloud control planes and on-premise execution nodes.

  • Terraform / IaC: Modular design (network / cluster / IAM / tenant-namespace / addons), remote state with locking, and state-splitting for blast-radius control. Treats IaC as a long-lived codebase.

  • Apache Kafka: Production experience (ideally KRaft mode). Broker sizing, replication/AZ placement, Schema Registry, DLQ/DLT, and retry topology.

  • Identity & Secrets Infrastructure: An OIDC/RBAC identity provider (e.g., Keycloak) with per-tenant realm patterns. A secrets manager (e.g., Vault) with Kubernetes-native auth and zero-hardcoded-secrets enforcement.

  • CI/CD: Practical experience with pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), lint/test/build/push/deploy flows, OIDC-based cloud auth, and secret-scanning pre-commit hooks.

  • Observability Infrastructure: OpenTelemetry Collector deployment patterns and a metrics/logs/traces stack (e.g., Prometheus, Loki, Tempo) built to be tenant-aware across hybrid environments.

  • Leadership & Independence: Sets technical direction, defends architecture choices (e.g., node pool strategy, partitioning, IAM boundaries), and prioritizes ruthlessly without needing a pre-built roadmap.

  • Language: Fluent English. Works well directly within a small, fast-moving technical team.


Nice-to-haves

  • GitOps Patterns: Experience with multi-cluster management and GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) for deploying and maintaining workloads across multi-region or on-prem environments.

  • Multi-tenant Regulated SaaS: Experience with compliance (finserv, healthcare, public sector), data residency, audit logging, and encryption-at-rest requirements.

  • Integration/ESB Runtimes: Familiarity with engines like Apache Camel or durable-execution/workflow orchestration engines (e.g., ).

  • API Gateways: Rate limiting, mTLS termination, per-tenant quotas.

  • AI/LLM Infrastructure: Basic familiarity with vector databases, self-hosted inference, or GPU node pools.


Tech stack

  • Orchestration: Managed Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) + On-Prem/Lightweight K8s (K3s/Rancher)

  • IaC & GitOps: Terraform, ArgoCD/Flux

  • Messaging & Data: Apache Kafka (KRaft mode)

  • Identity & Secrets: Keycloak (OIDC/RBAC), HashiCorp Vault

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo

Great people rarely fit completely into job descriptions.

If you’re curious, driven, and excited by what we’re building, apply - even if your experience doesn’t match every bullet point.

Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger teams, and better outcomes for our customers.

Come build with us.

GOOD MANUFACTURING PRACTICES AND OTHER

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word; experience working with graphics
  • Data entry experience
  • 2 + years of ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) experience
  • Ability to analyze data/inventory.
  • Ability to multi-task in a challenging environment
  • Specific attention to detail, accuracy, and safety.

title: Scientific Industry Officer (specialkonsulent) til Institut for Matematiske Fag
company: KU- SCIENCE - CHEM og MATH og NBI-HCØ
description:
Institut for Matematiske Fag på SCIENCE på Københavns Universitet søger en Scientific Industry Officer (specialkonsulent) med tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026.

Vi søger en engageret Scientific Industry Officer til at styrke samspillet mellem akademisk forskning og industrien inden for kvante-teknologier og innovation. Stillingen er en nøglerolle i et ambitiøst uddannelsesinitiativ, der sigter mod at udvikle og implementere kvante-uddannelser med fokus på anvendelse, tværfaglighed og innovation. Stillingen vil være placeret på forskningscenteret QMATH, der arbejder med den matematiske forståelse af kvante-forskning.

Arbejdsopgaver
Som Scientific Industry Officer vil du have ansvar for at:

  • Koordinere og facilitere samarbejder mellem akademiske institutioner, industripartnere og offentlige aktører for at sikre, at uddannelsesinitiativerne er praktisk anvendelige og industri-relevante.
  • Udvikle og implementere kurser, workshops og andre uddannelsesaktiviteter, der integrerer innovation, iværksætteri og karriereudvikling i kvante-teknologier.
  • Styrke industri-samarbejder ved at organisere matchmaking-events, praktikforløb og gæsteundervisning med virksomheder og startups inden for kvante-teknologi.
  • Være forperson for vores QIS-Industry Advisory Board. Du kan læse mere om QIS-uddannelsen her: .
Vi forventer
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en relevant akademisk baggrund, helst med erfaring inden for kvante-teknologier, innovation eller industri-samarbejder.
  • Har erfaring med projektledelse og koordination, helst inden for uddannelse, forskning eller industri-samarbejder.
  • Har stærke netværks- og relations byggende evner til at etablere og vedligeholde samarbejder med eksterne partnere.
  • Er initiativrig, selvstændig, proaktiv og kan kommunikere med alle.
  • Taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau.
Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har:

  • Erfaring med udvikling af uddannelsesmaterialer eller undervisningsaktiviteter.
  • Kendskab til kvante-teknologier, innovation eller iværksætteri.
  • Erfaring med koordinering og ledelse af følgegrupper (advisory board o.lign.).
Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og meningsfuld stilling i et dynamisk og innovativt miljø, hvor du får mulighed for at forme fremtidens kvante-uddannelser i Danmark.
  • Tæt samarbejde med ledende forskere, undervisere og industripartnere inden for kvante-teknologier.
  • Ansættelse som specialkonsulent.
  • En stærkt engageret arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling og innovation.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker som specialkonsulent i henhold til Cirkulære om overenskomst for akademikere i staten mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikerne. Der vil være mulighed for forhandling af tillæg efter kvalifikationer. Du kan læse mere om lønniveauer i staten på denne side. Den ugentlige arbejdstid er 37 timer pr. uge. Vi har flekstid.

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset med udløb den 31. december 2028. Stillingen er ledig som følge af kontraktudløb for den nuværende Scientific Industry Officer.

Din ansøgning
Ansøgning med bilag skal sendes via Jobportalen (tryk på linket "Søg stillingen" nederst i opslaget) senest den 27. august 2026.

Yderligere spørgsmål
Spørgsmål til stillingen kan rettes til Mette Ahm Sigh på mesi@nexs.ku.dk.

Københavns Universitet har etableret en ny fælles administrativ organisering, som fortsat implementeres. Det indebærer løbende forandringer og udvikling af bl.a. arbejdsgange og samarbejdsflader.

Københavns Universitet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.

title: Business Developement Director
description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

We're seeking a Director, Business Development to own the strategy and day-to-day execution of net-new pipeline generation across the Americas (AMER). You'll direct the BDR team's outbound and inbound lead motions while partnering cross-functionally with Marketing Ops, Sales, and People Development to keep the BDR organization running smoothly and improving continuously.

What you'll do at UiPath

Team Leadership & Lead Management

  • Own the strategy for how and when your BDR team works incoming leads — deciding whether leads are worked all at once or in batches

  • Coordinate directly with Marketing Ops on lead assignment and optimization

  • Monitor BDR KPIs including net-new meetings booked, lead qualification/SLA rates, meeting acceptance, and pipeline created/converted

  • Keep the team laser-focused on net-new acquisition across AMER markets

BDR Onboarding & Enablement

  • Serve as a subject-matter validator on BDR FastStart onboarding programs

  • Review and validate detailed training content covering discovery, objection handling, closing, and roleplaying

  • Support the learning team with input on global BDR enablement initiatives

  • Develop and nurture your team to maximize their effectiveness and career growth

Event & Campaign Support

  • Coordinate BDR pre- and post-event support for major field events across AMER

  • Partner with Demand Generation on event planning (conferences, symposiums, regional events)

  • Align your team's outreach with campaign timing to maximize conversion

  • Drive strategic prospecting initiatives tied to marketing campaigns

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Advocacy

  • Build strong internal relationships with Deal Hub, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing Ops, and Sales leadership

  • Raise operational asks within GTM leadership to secure infrastructure and resources your BDR team needs

  • Influence cross-functionally on matters of significance to the organization

  • Provide timely and constructive feedback to senior management with the ability to persuade

Strategic Execution

  • Maximize coverage within AMER and penetrate organizations with UiPath products

  • Develop and nurture regional partner relationships and leverage GSIs for executive introductions

  • Maintain rigorous 'Tight Operational Command' utilizing Sales Methodologies (MEDDPICC and CoM)

  • Update and maintain Salesforce CRM with accuracy and consistency

  • Continuously incorporate automation into daily workflows and team processes

What you'll bring to the team

Required Experience

  • Proven experience leading a BDR/SDR team, ideally across multiple AMER markets

  • Track record of driving net-new pipeline generation and meeting/exceeding targets

  • Experience with Salesforce and LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Familiarity with pipeline/CRM tooling and BDR engagement/cadence tools

  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for this role

Core Competencies

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with Marketing Ops, Demand Gen, People Development, and Sales

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

  • High emotional intelligence to work effectively across departments

  • Ability to communicate effectively with high-level decision makers

  • Strong ability to problem-solve and make decisions while navigating ambiguity

Technical Skills

  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in MS Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

  • Deep understanding of BDR metrics, lead management, and pipeline analytics

  • Automation-first mindset

Leadership Qualities

  • Ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • High energy, motivated self-starter who thrives in fast-paced environments

  • Adaptability to changes in roles and responsibilities

  • Proven ability to lead through change and inspire teams

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

title: Vi söker Microsoft-specialister till vårt IT-team!
description:
IT Integration

För att möta framtidens utmaningar har vi valt Microsoft som vår strategiska plattformspartner och har under de senaste åren investerat i moderna lösningar inom M365, Dynamics 365 (F&O och CE), Microsoft Fabric och Power BI.

På den fortsatta resan vill vi vara flera och expanderar därför vårt interna IT-team. Vi söker dig som vill omsätta modern teknik till verklig affärsnytta och hållbar samhällsutveckling!

Om jobbet

För att möta framtidens utmaningar har vi valt Microsoft som vår strategiska plattformspartner och har under de senaste åren investerat i moderna lösningar inom Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations och Customer Engagement), Microsoft Fabric och Power BI.

På den fortsatta digitaliseringsresan stärker vi nu vårt interna IT-team. Vi söker dig som vill omsätta modern teknik till verklig affärsnytta och hållbar samhällsutveckling!

Beroende på din bakgrund och dina intressen kan du arbeta inom något eller flera av följande områden:

Dynamics 365 & Power Platform

Du stöttar i arbetet med att utveckla och förvalta systemstöd till våra affärsprocesser inom ekonomi, inköp, logistik och tillgångsförvaltning och/eller inom försäljning, kundservice och fältservice.

Fokus kommer vara på konfiguration, integrationer med och utveckling av D365 samt med hjälp av Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) effektivisera och utöka användningen av plattformen.

Microsoft 365

Du sätter medarbetarnas digitala vardag i centrum och ser till att våra interna verktyg är säkra, effektiva och sammankopplade.

Fokus kommer vara arkitektur, förvaltning och utveckling av vår M365-miljö (SharePoint Online, Teams, Entra ID, Purview, Copilot, Power Platform).

Fabric & Power BI

Du hjälper oss att strukturera och skapa värde av vår data och skapar förutsättningar för verksamheterna att fatta datadrivna beslut och insikter.

Fokus kommer vara arkitektur, förvaltning och utveckling av vår dataplattform.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT från yrkeshögskola eller högskola och praktisk erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av de områden som beskrivs ovan. Du har god förståelse för hur verksamhetsbehov kan omsättas till tekniska lösningar och ser möjligheterna med modern Microsoft-teknik.

Som person är du nyfiken, pedagogisk och trivs med att samarbeta nära verksamheten. Du arbetar strukturerat, tar egna initiativ och har ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet från energibranschen, men det är inget krav.

Vårt erbjudande

Hos oss får du vara med och driva utvecklingen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle, i en bransch som är en förutsättning för vår välfärd. Vi jobbar tillsammans i trygga team där vi vågar testa nytt, växa och lyckas. Här möter du engagerade människor, en hållbar arbetsplats och möjligheten att kombinera karriär med ett aktivt liv.

På Jämtkraft är du viktig. Vi tänker långsiktigt, vi satsar på dig och vill att du ska trivas och hjälpa oss framåt.

Fler fördelar med Jämtkraft:

  • Jämtkraft är tillräckligt stort för att du ska kunna utvecklas och göra karriär, men tillräckligt litet för att du ska synas, vara viktig och kunna påverka.
  • Vi tar hand om våra medarbetare och har fina förmåner, alltifrån förmånscykel till arbetstidsförkortning och föräldrapenningtillägg.
  • Vi är en erkänt bra arbetsgivare, belönade med certifikatet ”Excellent Arbetsgivare 2025” och ”Karriärföretag 2026”.
  • En ledstjärna för Jämtkraft är att agera hållbart och långsiktigt – det gäller både hur vi tar hand om våra medarbetare, vår miljö och våra affärer.

Jämtkraft bedriver arbete inom en samhällsviktig sektor. Anställningen kan därför innebära att du som sökande behöver placeras i en säkerhetsklass.

Placeringsort: Östersund

Omfattning & anställningsform: Heltid, tillsvidareanställning.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Vill du veta mer?

Vill du veta mer om jobbet är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Henrik Eklund, avdelningschef IT Integration, mailto:Henrik.Eklund@jamtkraft.se eller 073-092 90 77

title: Hydroblasting Technician
description:

Ensures compliance with all Company policies/procedures and maintains/improves good customer relations by providing quality, timely industrial cleaning services. Technicians serve as representative of Thompson Industrial in creating a continuous working relationship with clients/customers.

Why work for Thompson Industrial?

  • Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5!

  • Competitive wages

  • Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment

  • Group 401K with company matching component

  • Own part of Clean Harbors with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (U.S. Only)

  • Operation of special equipment, such as ultra-high-pressure pumps.
  • Operate equipment by energizing the pumping equipment and/or any specialized hydro-blasting and/or chemical cleaning equipment, vacuum trucks & cutting equipment being used on the job.

title: Re-Advertisement UN Women: Programme Analyst, Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, N-PPSA9
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.

UN Women Country Office in the Kyrgyz Republic was established in 2012 to support the Government and other national stakeholders in implementing international and national commitments on gender equality and the empowerment of all women and girls, including the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW), the Beijing Declaration and Platform for Action, UN Security Council resolutions on women, peace and security, and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. Guided by the UN Women Strategic Plan and the Country Strategic Note, and operating within the framework of the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2023–2027, the National Gender Equality Strategy until 2030, and the National Action Plan on UNSCR 1325, the Country Office leverages its triple mandate of normative support, UN system coordination and operational activities to deliver coherent and impactful results.

UN Women Kyrgyzstan implements a programme that promotes women’s leadership and meaningful participation in all spheres of public and private life; eliminates all forms of violence against women and girls; advances women’s full, equal and effective participation in the peace and security agenda and in all aspects of decision-making; strengthens financing for gender equality; and expands women’s economic empowerment. The Country Office also prioritizes gender-responsive humanitarian action, disaster risk reduction and climate change adaptation, and increasingly applies innovation and systems approaches in line with the SDG transformation agenda. UN Women Kyrgyzstan works as a learning and knowledge-sharing organization and promotes an open, collaborative spirit with partners, ensuring synergies across programme interventions, fostering strong and inclusive partnerships, and maintaining a client-focused, results-oriented approach fully consistent with UN Women policies, rules and procedures.

The EU-UN Women Action “Zero VAWG Program” in the Kyrgyz Republic aims to advance gender equality and the empowerment of women and girls by preventing and responding to violence against women and girls (VAWG), through a gender-transformative, community-led approach. The programme prioritizes creating and strengthening leadership spaces for women’s and youth civil society organizations, particularly in rural areas, building on results of the EU–UN Spotlight Initiative (2020–2023), and directly empowering around 140 organizations and 1,400 change leaders, while engaging a wider network of actors and organizations. Its three interlinked components focus on: (i) capacity development to enhance technical, organizational and adaptive leadership for effective EVAWG advocacy and programming; (ii) development and institutionalization of innovative “Zero VAWG” community models, including Standard Operating Procedures; (iii) consolidation and digitization of knowledge on EVAWG through academic, media and other platforms and iv) integrates women economic empowerment initiates. The Action is fully aligned with the Kyrgyz Republic’s international and national commitments, supports the National Gender Equality Strategy (2022–2030) and the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework Strategic Outcome 4, and contributes to UN Women Kyrgyz Republic’s Strategic Note.

Reporting to Project Manager the Programme Analyst contributes to the effective management of UN Women programmes in the CO by providing substantive inputs to programme design, formulation, implementation and evaluation. The Programme Analyst guides and facilitates the delivery of UN Women programmes by monitoring results achieved during implementation and ensuring appropriate application of systems and procedures and develops enhancements if necessary. The Programme Analyst works in close collaboration with the programme and operations team, UN Women HQ personnel, Government officials, multi and bi-lateral donors and civil society ensuring successful UN Women programme implementation under portfolio.

Scope of Work:

1- Contribute technically to the development of programme strategies in the area of EVAW.

  • Provide substantive technical inputs to the design and formulation of programme/ project proposals and initiatives related to prevention and responding to violence against women and girls; and
  • Identify areas for support and intervention related to the EVAWG programme.

2- Provide substantive technical support for the implementation and management of the EVAW programme

  • Provide technical inputs to the annual workplan and budget;
  • Coordinate and monitor the implementation of programme activities;
  • Coordination of the call/request for proposals, including the organization of technical review committees, and capacity assessment of partners;
  • Review, coordinate and monitor the submission of implementing partner financial and narrative reports; and
  • Train partners on Results Based Management and monitor implementation.

3- Provide technical assistance and capacity development to project/programme partners

  • Coordinate and provide technical support in the implementation of programme activities;
  • Develop technical knowledge products;
  • Maintain relationships with national partners to support implementation and expansion of the EVAWG programme; and
  • Identify opportunities for capacity building of partners and facilitate technical/ programming support and trainings to partners, as needed.

4- Provide technical inputs to the monitoring and reporting of the programme/project

  • Monitor progress of implementation of activities and finances using results based management tools;
  • Draft reports on monitoring missions, programme results, outputs and outcomes; and
  • Provide substantive inputs to the preparation of quarterly reports, donor and other reports on outputs, results outputs and outcomes.

5- Provide substantive technical inputs to the management of people and finances of the EVAW programme

  • Monitor budget implementation and programme activity expenditures and perform budget re-alignments/ revisions, as necessary;
  • Provide substantive inputs to financial reports; and
  • Supervise oversee the work of Programme Associates and Assistant.

6- Provide substantive inputs to building partnerships and resource mobilization strategies

  • Provide substantive inputs to resource mobilization strategies; analyze and maintain information and databases;
  • Prepare relevant documentation such as project summaries, conference papers, briefing notes, speeches, and donor profiles; and
  • Participate in donor meetings and public information events, as delegated.

7- Provide technical support to inter-agency coordination On EVAWG to achieve coherence and alignment of UN Women programmes with other partners in the country

  • Provide substantive technical support to the Project Manager on inter-agency coordination related activities by drafting background reports and briefs.

8- Provide substantive inputs to advocacy, knowledge building and communication efforts

  • Develop background documents, briefs and presentations related to EVAWG;
  • Coordinate and organize advocacy campaigns, events, trainings, workshops and knowledge products; and
  • Coordinate the development of knowledge management methodologies, and products on EVAWG.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation.

Competencies :

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

  • Good programme formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation skills
  • Good knowledge of Results Based Management
  • Ability to gather and interpret data, reach logical conclusions and present findings and recommendations
  • Good analytical skills
  • Good knowledge of technical area
  • Ability to identify and analyze trends, opportunities and threats to fundraising

Minimum Qualifications:

Education and Certification:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in social sciences, human rights, gender/women's studies, international development, or a related field is required.
  • A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.
  • A project/programme management certification would be an added advantage.

Experience:

  • At least 2 years with Master’s degree or 4 years with bachelor’s degree of progressively responsible work experience in development programme/project implementation, coordination, monitoring and evaluation, donor reporting and capacity building is required.
  • Experience in the EVAW is desirable.
  • Experience coordinating and liaising with government agencies and/or donors is desirable.
  • [For supervisory positions] Experience leading and coaching staff in international settings is required.
  • Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and spreadsheet and database packages, experience in handling of web-based management systems is required.
  • Experience in the use of a modern web-based ERP System, preferably Oracle Cloud, is desirable.

Languages:

  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Fluency in Kyrgyz is required.
  • Knowledge of another official UN language is desirable (French, Arabic, Chinese, Russian or Spanish).

Candidates who applied in the previous application do not need to re-apply.

Statements :

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process.

title: Technical Lead - Axles Design & Testing
description:
The Technical Lead will play a crucial role in overseeing axle-related activities, collaborating with international teams, and driving projects from inception to implementation. He will be responsible for developing comprehensive test programs, executing validation activities, and ensuring the reliability and performance of axle components.

  • Lead and manage a team of test engineers, providing technical guidance and support.
  • Strong hands-on experience in axle design and development.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive test programs for axle aggregates, subsystems, and components.
  • Plan and execute validation activities for critical axle components, including gears, bearings, and housing casings.
  • Ensure correlation between RLDA, CAE, bench tests, and real-world user profiles for accurate testing and analysis.
  • Conduct bench tests to evaluate the performance, durability, and reliability of axles.
  • Perform failure investigations, damage analysis, and root cause analysis on axle components.
  • Apply measurement technology and statistical tools to estimate reliability and optimize testing processes.
  • Collaborate with international engineering teams, ensuring effective communication and knowledge sharing.
  • Steer cross-functional teams and projects, adhering to timelines and managing risks effectively.
  • BE - Mechanical / Production / Automobile / Mechatronics or equivalent engineering degree.
  • 8-12 years of experience in axle development, testing, or design, with a proven track record.
  • Functional awareness and design competency of axle components and their functions.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to steer projects and provide mitigation plans.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to convey complex technical aspects simply.
  • Analytical mindset with problem-solving abilities and a results-oriented approach.
  • Experience in interacting with global counterparts and a willingness to travel internationally.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes for axle components and an understanding of test methods.
  • Experience in collaborating with test bench suppliers and agencies for test setup and concept development.

title: Lead QA Engineer, S-Pankki
description:
Tervetuloa töihin vähän erilaiseen pankkiin! Haluatko olla mukana kehittämässä pankkipalveluita, jotka tekevät yli kolmen miljoonan asiakasomistajan arjesta sujuvampaa ja helpompaa? Me S-Pankissa haluamme olla asiakkaidemme luotettu paremman arjen kumppani sekä mahdollistaa miljoonille suomalaisille rahakkaampi huominen, ja S-Pankille kasvu uuteen kokoluokkaan. Haluamme haastaa toimialan totuttuja käytäntöjä ja mahdollisuuksia vaikuttaa on valtavasti. Vaikka teemme vaativaa asiantuntijatyötä, emme turhia jäykistele.

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?
Lead QA Engineerinä työskentelet osana S-Pankin laadunvarmistustiimiä ja otat keskeisen roolin datatestauksen kehittämisessä. Osallistut itse käytännön testaukseen, sparraat tiimin asiantuntijoita ja kehität testauksen toimintatapoja yhdessä muun QA-organisaation kanssa. Työssäsi vastaat laadunvarmistuksen eri vaiheista, tukien erityisesti kehityksen aikaista datatestausta.

Datan rooli S-Pankin liiketoiminnassa on merkittävä, ja työlläsi on vaikutusta esimerkiksi päätöksenteon, asiakkaille tarjottavien palveluiden sekä datan laadun ja luotettavuuden kehittämiseen. Toimit laadun puolestapuhujana ja autat kehittämään tapoja, joilla testaus tuo lisäarvoa koko organisaatiolle. Arjessasi teet tiivistä yhteistyötä kehittäjien, tuoteomistajien, liiketoiminnan sekä ulkoisten toimittajien kanssa, ja pääset mukaan uusien teknologioiden ja data-alustojen käyttöönottoon osana datan tulevaisuuden ratkaisuja.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja se solmitaan suoraan S-Pankin kanssa. Työpisteesi sijaitsee S-Pankin pääkonttorilla Vallilassa, ja työskentelemme hybridimallissa Suomen rajojen sisäpuolella. Arjessasi vietät toimistolla noin kaksi päivää viikossa.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa kokemusta datatestauksesta sekä ymmärrystä nykyaikaisista laadunvarmistuksen periaatteista ja menetelmistä. Olet työskennellyt monitoimittajaympäristössä ja sinulla on kyky suunnitella, kehittää ja viedä eteenpäin testauksen käytäntöjä. Lisäksi osaat sparrata muita asiantuntijoita ja tuoda laadun näkökulmaa osaksi yhteistä tekemistä.

Hyödynnät työssäsi teknistä osaamistasi tietokantojen ja datan parissa esimerkiksi SQL:n ja SAS:n avulla. Ymmärrät XML- ja JSON-rakenteita sekä niiden skeemoja, ja tunnet pilviympäristöjä, kuten Azurea, sekä integraatioteknologioita, kuten REST-rajapintoja ja Kafkaa. Tunnet Databricksin ja Microsoft Fabricin kaltaisia data-alustoja ainakin perustasolla ja pystyt soveltamaan osaamistasi datatestauksen kehittämisessä. Lisäksi pystyt tuottamaan ja ylläpitämään testiautomaatiota esimerkiksi Robot Frameworkin tai Playwrightin avulla.

Arvostamme oma-aloitteista, uteliasta ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta. Menestyt tehtävässä, kun osaat toimia sujuvasti erilaisten ihmisten kanssa ja kommunikoida ymmärrettävästi niin teknisille asiantuntijoille kuin liiketoiminnan edustajille. Kokemus finanssialalta tai muusta vahvasti säännellystä toimintaympäristöstä katsotaan eduksi. Työskentelet sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?
Tässä roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan aidosti siihen, miten datatestausta ja laadunvarmistusta kehitetään S-Pankissa. Työskentelet suurten datamäärien, kiinnostavien liiketoimintahaasteiden ja uusien teknologioiden parissa, samalla jättäen oman kädenjälkesi niin toimintatapoihin kuin tulevaisuuden ratkaisuihin. Kehitämme toimintaamme aktiivisesti, joten nyt on erinomainen hetki tulla mukaan rakentamaan seuraavaa vaihetta.

Onnistumisesi tueksi tarjoamme perusteellisen perehdytyksen, jossa sinua tukevat sekä eri sidosryhmät että kokeneet tiimikaverisi. S-Pankki on jo kaksitoista kertaa valittu Suomen vastuullisimmaksi pankkibrändiksi (Sustainable Brand Index). Meille vastuullisuus tarkoittaa myös sitä, että pidämme hyvää huolta työntekijöistämme. S-Pankin taustalla vaikuttava S-ryhmä tarjoaa ison talon ainutlaatuisia voimavaroja ja mahdollisuuksia, mutta arjessa toimimme ketterästi ja meiltä löytyy pienen talon intoa tehdä ja kehittää.

Työn ja muun elämän tasapaino on meille tärkeää. Työskentelemme hybridimallissa, jossa yhdistyvät etätyön ja toimistolla työskentelyn parhaat puolet, ja käytössäsi on myös liukuva työaika. Tarjoamme lisäksi kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä tukea liikunta- ja harrastusmahdollisuuksiin. Työntekijöillämme on myös ostoetu S-ryhmän toimipaikoissa. Näistä on hyvä aloittaa, mutta S-Pankki tarjoaa paljon muutakin. Tutustu meihin tarkemmin: .

Kiinnostuitko?
Mikäli mielenkiintosi heräsi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme lisää. Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin 4.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkistetaan luottotiedot sekä edellytetään turvallisuusselvitys.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointikonsultti Nea Repo, nea.repo@biisoni.fi.

title: Sr. AI/ML Sales Specialist, MENAT AGS Specialist Team
description:
Are you a customer-obsessed builder with a passion for helping customers achieve their full potential? Do you have the business savvy, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning background, and sales skills necessary to help companies transform their industries by positioning Amazon Web Services (AWS) as the Generative AI service provider of choice? Do you love building new strategic and data-driven businesses? Do you want to join Generative AI Specialty sales organization, one of the fastest-growing organization within AWS? Join the MENAT AWS Global Sales organization as a Generative AI and Machine Learning Specialist Seller! As a Generative AI Sales Specialist, you will be at the forefront of driving adoption and revenue growth for AWS's Generative AI services. Your role will involve identifying high-value customer opportunities within a specific territory and engaging with AWS customers to understand their needs and align them with AWS Generative AI solutions. You will leverage your consultative expertise to become a trusted advisor, guiding customers in embedding and deploying AWS Generative AI solutions to unlock new value streams and solve key business problems using AI capabilities. With a passion for developing high-potential opportunities and executing effective strategies, you will own the full-cycle sales engagement plan, from identifying qualified leads to realizing revenue. You will understand a customer’s business initiatives, help craft account plan to achieve those initiatives, identify and drive opportunity win plans to enabling those business initiatives, and ensure successful launch to realize both customer vision and AWS revenue. You will earn trust with Line of Business, Data Science, IT personas and executive leaders. You will understand detailed business drivers in your forecast, and intentionally work the best opportunities that maximize your ability to hit revenue goals. You will maintain an in-depth knowledge of AWS's Generative AI services, leading foundation models and relevant cross-functional areas to build strong relationships with customers. By driving the adoption of Generative AI technologies, you will play a pivotal role in propelling AWS's revenue growth while helping customers stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving technological landscape. You exercise learn & be curious to articulate AWS’ Gen AI strategy and the services we offer to accelerate these workloads. You conduct compelling executive conversations on the transformational possibilities of generative AI and data, while also being capable of helping our customers navigate which services to evaluate for their use-cases. You can describe the “why” and “what” of generative AI use case and technical solutions at a 200 to 300 level, with the detailed “how” being provided by solution architects. You will be the preferred point of contact for cross group functions within the organization for for customers in the region. AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Key job responsibilities
- Accelerate customer adoption by defining and implementing tech domain specific GTM and Sales strategies within your assigned territories and technology domain. Your strategies will leverage AWS Sales and our partner ecosystem.
- Ideate with Data Science, Developers, Line of Business and C-suite leaders, building trust with your deep technical expertise, and following through to help solve their most compelling business problems.
- Act as the front line within your accounts for all specialist customer engagement in your tech domain.
- Create & articulate compelling value propositions that address specific needs of your customers.
- Build and innovate: Co-Develop GTM motions on new product launches and work with product teams on the creation of innovative new services.
- Partner with the world’s biggest system integrators, FM Developers to deliver on customer projects.
- Spearhead market expansion by pinpointing new customer segments and Gen AI use cases
- Collaborate cross-functionally to continuously strengthen AWS's Gen AI value proposition
- Gather voice-of-customer insights to inform product roadmaps and enhance the customer experience
- Drives conversations to build credibility and earn trust with the account teams and customers.
- Drive sales efforts spanning multiple lines of business with decision-making authority and budget ownership.
- Engage systems integrators and closely collaborate with AWS partners to deliver maximum customer value
- Develop and deliver compelling ROI to drive adoption of AWS Gen AI solutions.
- Role require traveling up to 50% (local / international).

A day in the life
You’re surrounded by innovation. You’re empowered with a lot of ownership. Your growth is accelerated. The work is challenging. You have a voice here and are encouraged to use it. Your experience and career development is in your hands. We live our leadership principles every day. At Amazon, it's always "Day 1".

title: Sr. Applied Scientist, Denied Party Screening (DPS), AWS Compliance & Security Assurance
description:
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our mission is to prevent denied entities from transacting with Amazon businesses. We build automatic mechanisms to detect and prevent prohibited transactions with denied entities using a diverse set of algorithms and machine learning techniques. We screen over a billion events every day and develop algorithms which are able to scale and detect suspicious entities . We are still Day 1 and have an exciting road map to build Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (LLM) powered detection and resolution systems to help scale Amazon for years to come.

We are seeking an Sr. Applied Scientist to join our team and help tackle challenging problems at the forefront of machine learning and artificial intelligence. Working closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, data scientists, and domain experts, you will play a crucial role in defining innovative ML/AI-powered customer experiences and solutions. If you have an entrepreneurial mindset, the technical depth to deliver impactful results, and a passion for innovation, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
• Drive the research, design, and development of novel ML/AI models and systems to power critical products and services
• Collaborate cross-functionally to deeply understand business requirements, customer needs, and technical constraints
• Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on ML/AI solutions, iterating quickly based on data and feedback
• Communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders • Mentor and grow a team of talented ML scientists and engineers
• Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in AI/ML and identify opportunities to apply emerging techniques

A day in the life
- Starting the day by reviewing the latest model performance metrics and identifying areas for improvement
- Brainstorming new architectures and approaches with your cross-functional team during a whiteboard session
- Diving deep into a complex dataset, leveraging advanced statistical and AI techniques to uncover hidden insights
- Prototyping a new model and running a series of experiments to optimize its performance
- Preparing a presentation to pitch your latest research findings and recommendations to product and engineering leaders
- Mentoring junior scientists, providing guidance on coding best practices and problem-solving strategies

About the team
Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Naval Architect Engineers and Technologists
description:
Ready to build a career that makes an impact? Fleetway is seeking Naval Architect Engineers and Technologists at all stages of their careers to join our team. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced professional, you'll have opportunities to develop your expertise while contributing to some of Canada's most significant marine and defence initiatives.

We are hiring for opportunities in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia; Ottawa, Ontario; St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador; and Victoria, British Columbia.

As a Naval Architect Engineer or Technologist at Fleetway, you'll contribute to the engineering and technical services that support the sustainment, modernization, and future development of Canada's naval fleet. Working alongside experienced naval experts, you'll apply your knowledge of ship design, structures, systems, and maintenance engineering to solve complex technical challenges and deliver solutions that support mission readiness and long-term fleet capability.

From supporting the maintenance and modernization of existing vessels to contributing to next-generation ship programs, you'll work in a collaborative and flexible environment that encourages continuous learning, technical excellence, and career growth. This is an opportunity to expand your skills, take on increasing responsibility, and contribute to meaningful work that supports Canada's maritime and defence capabilities.

If you're passionate about marine engineering, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and want to help shape the future of Canada's naval fleet, we'd love to hear from you!

  • Analyze engineering changes and assess the impact of modifications to naval ships, systems, and equipment.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent til fast nattevagt på Bregninge Plejecenter
description:
28 timer om ugen – 7-7-ordning – tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale

Efter mange gode år på Bregninge Plejecenter har vores faste nattevagt valgt at gå på pension. Derfor søger vi nu en ny kollega, som har lyst til at tage over og blive en fast del af vores hus.

Har du ro i maven, når resten af huset sover? Er du fagligt stærk, omsorgsfuld og god til at skabe tryghed – også når natten kræver, at du kan bevare overblikket og handle selvstændigt?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Hvem er vi?

Bregninge Plejecenter er et mindre og hyggeligt plejecenter med 31 boliger, hvor nærvær, tryghed og livskvalitet er en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Hos os skal der være plads til både faglighed og hjertevarme. Vi tror på, at den gode ældrepleje skabes i relationerne – med beboerne, de pårørende og hinanden.

Vi er et hus, hvor vi løfter i flok, hjælper hinanden og har en kort vej fra idé til handling. Vi ønsker et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til at stille spørgsmål, tænke højt og bidrage til udviklingen af vores fælles praksis.

Om stillingen

Vi søger en uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent til en fast stilling i nattevagt på 28 timer om ugen i en 7-7-ordning.

Som nattevagt har du en vigtig rolle i at skabe en rolig og tryg nat for vores beboere. Du arbejder selvstændigt og skal kunne bevare overblikket, prioritere opgaverne og reagere fagligt på ændringer i beboernes tilstand.

Samtidig er du en vigtig del af den samlede indsats omkring beboerne, og derfor vægter vi et godt samarbejde og en god overlevering mellem dag-, aften- og nattevagter.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:
  • At skabe tryghed, ro og nærvær for beboerne gennem natten
  • At varetage pleje- og sundhedsfaglige opgaver med udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers behov
  • At observere og reagere på ændringer i beboernes tilstand
  • At dokumentere relevant og fagligt
  • At samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af vagtlag og faggrupper
  • At bidrage til kontinuitet og kvalitet i beboernes samlede forløb
Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Trives med ansvaret og selvstændigheden i en nattevagt
  • Har et godt fagligt overblik og kan prioritere, når flere ting sker på én gang
  • Møder beboerne med respekt, omsorg og nysgerrighed
  • Er stabil og ansvarsbevidst
  • Er en god kollega, der bidrager positivt til samarbejdet
  • Tør spørge, reflektere og bringe din faglighed i spil
  • Har lyst til at være med til at udvikle vores pleje og vores arbejdsplads

For os er det vigtigt, at du ikke kun ser opgaverne – du ser mennesket bag.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

Hos os får du:

  • En fast stilling på 28 timer om ugen i en 7-7-ordning
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed og omsorg går hånd i hånd
  • Gode og engagerede kolleger
  • Mulighed for faglig sparring og udvikling
  • Et arbejdsmiljø med åbenhed, ærlighed og plads til refleksion
  • Mulighed for at tage ansvar og få indflydelse på hverdagen
  • Et mindre plejecenter, hvor vi kender hinanden, og hvor din indsats bliver set og værdsat

Vi arbejder hele tiden på at udvikle vores praksis og skabe de bedste rammer for både beboere og medarbejdere. Derfor leder vi også efter dig, der har lyst til at være nysgerrig sammen med os og bidrage med dine erfaringer og idéer.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af Bregninge?

Ansøgningsfristen er den 15. september 2026.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, eller har du lyst til at høre mere om os og hverdagen på Bregninge Plejecenter, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Afdelingsleder Janni Lyngholm på telefon 21553067

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – og måske byde vores nye nattevagtskollega velkommen på Bregninge Plejecenter.


Om os

I Kalundborg Kommune er vi optaget af, at vores borgere, virksomheder, foreninger og institutioner får den bedst tænkelige service. Det kan vi kun levere hvis vi har dygtige og motiverede medarbejdere. Derfor er vi dedikeret til at støtte medarbejdernes personlige og faglige udvikling, og sikre en dynamisk og fleksibel arbejdsplads.

Hos os er medarbejderne med til at gøre en forskel hver dag, sammen med ca. 3500 kollegaer. Kalundborg Kommune er placeret i noget af Danmarks smukkeste natur – og er samtidig hjemsted for en række af de industrier der bidrager mest til den danske økonomi – med vægt på biotech- og energiproduktion.

Der bor cirka 48.000 mennesker i Kalundborg Kommune, som også er hjemsted for flere og flere uddannelser, der er med til at understøtte udviklingen i kommunen.

Du kan læse mere om Kalundborg Kommune som arbejdsplads Vores medarbejdere finde generelle oplysninger om Kalundborg Kommune Gotokalundborg lytte til vores podcast-serie Karriere på Kalundborgsk Podcast og vodcast


Vi opfordrer alle uanset baggrund, køn, religion mv. til at søge.

----------

I Kalundborg Kommune har vi en generel politik om indhentning af straffeattest.

Ansatte som i deres ansættelse har adgang til personfølsomme oplysninger, skal have privat MitID, fordi de skal identificere sig med deres private MitID Dette for at efterleve den skærpede lovgivning og derved sikre borgernes tillid til, at alle myndigheder, herunder Kalundborg kommune, behandler personfølsomme oplysninger sikkert.

title: Administrativ medarbejder til central funktion i Forsyningstilsynet
description:
Har du stærke administrative kompetencer og trives du i en rolle, hvor du både understøtter driften og hjælper dine kolleger med at løse vigtige opgaver? Har du erfaring med at arrangere møder og andre arrangementer - og vil du gerne arbejde inden for et område med stor betydning for energiforbrugerne og den grønne omstilling? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Forsyningstilsynet!

Vi tilbyder Da vores nuværende sekretær går på pension, søger vi en dygtig og struktureret administrativ medarbejder til at understøtte arbejdet i Forsyningstilsynets center for Transmission, Engrosmarked, REMIT og Internationale forhold (TERI). I TERI bliver du en central del af et center på ca. 25 dygtige medarbejdere, primært jurister og økonomer, som i samarbejde med både danske og europæiske aktører arbejder for at sikre velfungerende energimarkeder til gavn for forbrugere og virksomheder. Du træder ind i et center præget af en stærk faglighed, men vi vægter også arbejdsglæde, faglig udvikling og fleksibilitet højt, lige som vi sætter pris på en uformel tone og plads til grin. Vi har mange opgaver og arbejder hele tiden på at udvikle vores arbejdsgange og processer, så vi kan blive endnu bedre og mere effektive. Du bliver en central del af centeret og du vil få ansvar for en bred vifte af administrative opgaver, der sikrer, at vores sagsbehandling og interne processer forløber effektivt.

Om stillingen En særlig del af din funktion vil være at understøtte vores arbejde med REMIT, som er EU-reglerne om integritet og gennemsigtighed på engrosenergimarkederne. Forsyningstilsynet har en række opgaver i den forbindelse, blandt andet i relation til registrering af markedsdeltagere og besvarelse af henvendelser om reglerne. Du vil være den første, der håndterer henvendelserne i vores fælles REMIT-postkasse. Det indebærer, at du vurderer og besvarer de administrative spørgsmål, som du kan håndtere selv, og sørger for at fordele øvrige henvendelser til de relevante kolleger i REMIT-teamet. Du vil dermed være et vigtigt kontaktpunkt for virksomheder og andre aktører, der henvender sig til Forsyningstilsynet om REMIT. Du vil desuden få et administrativt ansvar for Forsyningstilsynets arbejde med det europæiske register over markedsdeltagere på engrosenergimarkederne - CEREMP. Opgaven vil bl.a. bestå i at administrere og vedligeholde registreringsoplysningerne, følge op på henvendelser og ændringer samt koordinere med REMIT-teamet om registeret. Du vil naturligvis blive grundigt oplært i opgaven og i de relevante systemer og regler.

Derudover får du en nøglerolle i forhold til planlægning og afvikling af møder og seminarer med internationale samarbejdspartnere, og andre administrative driftsopgaver i centeret.
Vi tilbyder en varieret og udviklende stilling, hvor dine opgaver tilpasses dine kompetencer og erfaring, da det er vigtigt for os, at du trives med dine opgaver og i vores fællesskab.

Dine primære opgaver Du får en vigtig rolle i at understøtte centrets arbejde, bl.a. med:

  • Lettere sagsbehandling og koordinationsopgaver
  • Journalisering og posthåndtering i vores digitale systemer
  • Support til selskaber, når de henvender sig med spørgsmål på mail og telefon
  • Første håndtering af henvendelser til REMIT-postkassen, herunder besvarelse af administrative spørgsmål og fordeling af øvrige spørgsmål til REMIT-teamet
  • Administrativt ansvar for CEREMP, herunder registrering, opdatering og vedligeholdelse af oplysninger om markedsdeltagere samt opfølgning på registreringssager
  • IT-support til centerets medarbejdere
  • Onboarding af nye kolleger
  • Bidrag til effektiv drift af centeret, fx opfølgning på mål- og resultatplaner samt budgetopfølgning
  • Mødeplanlægning og praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med afvikling af møder
  • Kalenderstyring, rejsebestillinger og -afregninger
Vi sørger for, at du får en grundig indføring i opgaverne, og du bliver også en del af et team med vores øvrige sekretærer på tværs af Forsyningstilsynet, hvor I sparrer om opgaverne.

Om dig Vi leder efter en struktureret, serviceminded og initiativrig administrativ medarbejder, der kan holde overblik og hjælpe med at sikre en smidig arbejdsdag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en relevant administrativ uddannelsesbaggrund, for eksempel kontoruddannelse med speciale i offentlig administration eller lignende og solid erfaring som administrativ koordinator, PA eller lign.
  • Har gode formidlingsevner såvel mundtligt som skriftligt og gode engelskkundskaber
  • Har stærke IT-kompetencer og erfaring med hele Office-pakken
  • Har erfaring med journalisering og gerne kendskab til ESDH-systemet 360 eller lignende eller mod på at lære det
  • Er grundig, systematisk og detaljeorienteret og god til at prioritere opgaver
  • Har en positiv og proaktiv tilgang og blik for, hvor du kan støtte dine kolleger bedst muligt
  • Er selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst – du tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og følger dem til dørs
  • Trives i en udadvendt funktion med mange kontaktflader og en omskiftelig hverdag.
Derudover vil erfaring som administrativ medarbejder i staten eller en offentlig myndighed være en stor fordel. Erfaring med planlægning af større møder og seminarer, sagsbehandling og koordinering af opgaver vil også være værdifuldt.

Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på faglig udvikling, trivsel og arbejdsglæde I Forsyningstilsynet bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor der er kort til beslutningerne. Vi har en uformel tone og lægger vægt på holdånd, og at være gode kollegaer for hinanden. Vi har fokus på arbejdsglæde og udviklingsmuligheder for den enkelte. Det er vigtigt for os, at du får de bedste muligheder for at anvende dine faglige kompetencer og udbygge din viden. Derfor tilbyder vi både interne og eksterne kurser, evt. suppleret med kursusophold i udlandet.

Vi bor i flotte, renoverede lokaler i Frederiksværk, tæt på skoven, hvor der er gode muligheder for en walk and talk eller en løbetur. Vi har en dejlig have med WI-FI og et træningsrum. Der kører dagligt en medarbejderbus direkte fra København (Nørrebro St.) til din nye arbejdsplads.

Du vil i det daglige opleve en stor grad af frihed og fleksibilitet, som er med til at sikre en god balance mellem arbejde og fritid. Vi er en familievenlig arbejdsplads og du får bl.a. mulighed for hjemmearbejde og for at arbejde under transport.

Du kan læse mere om vores arbejde på www.forsyningstilsynet.dk og bl.a. se videoklip med tre af dine kommende kolleger på www.forsyningstilsynet.dk/job. På samme side er der en oversigt over onboardingprogrammet samt oplysninger om kompetence- og karriereudvikling i Forsyningstilsynet.

Interesseret? Vil du høre mere om stillingen, så kontakt gerne kontorchef Birgitta Bundgaard på bibg@forsyningstilsynet.dk, telefon 4171 5413.

Søg stillingen gennem linket her på siden. Husk at vedhæfte relevante dokumenter, herunder både eksamensbeviser og karakterudskrifter for fuldført uddannelse.

Ansøgningsfrist: 30. august 2026.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Der kan indgå brug af test i rekrutteringsprocessen. Tiltrædelse pr. 1. november 2026 eller efter nærmere aftale.

Din ansættelse vil ske i henhold til fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det statslige Område, samt organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) og de hertil indgåede lokalaftaler.

Forsyningstilsynet ønsker at fremme ligestilling og mangfoldighed. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen, uanset køn, alder og etnisk baggrund.

Afhængigt af dine opgaver kan det blive nødvendigt at indhente en sikkerhedsgodkendelse.

title: Security Officer
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

A romantic hideaway set in a tropical paradise. A gentle ocean breeze floats up the granite hillside and into your tree-house villa, reminding you to take it slow. Whether it’s just the two of you, or the extended family, spend days lounging by your private pool and playing in the turquoise waters of Petite Anse bay, or find bliss at our hilltop Spa, before a sunset meal on a deserted beach. However paradise might look for you, we guarantee you’ll find it here.

Patrol the hotel premises regularly to maintain a visible security presence and deter any potential

security threats.

• Monitor surveillance cameras and alarms to identify and report any suspicious activities or breaches

in security.

• Respond promptly and appropriately to all security incidents, including but not limited to accidents,

theft, disturbances, and emergencies.

• Conduct regular inspections to ensure that all security equipment (such as cameras, alarms, access

control systems, etc.) is functioning properly.

• Enforce hotel policies and procedures to maintain a safe and comfortable environment for guests

and staff.

• Provide excellent customer service and assistance to guests, answering questions, giving directions,

and resolving any security-related concerns.

• Collaborate with other departments, such as front desk, housekeeping, and management, to ensure

a coordinated approach to security operations.

• Assist in the implementation of emergency preparedness plans and evacuation procedures and

conduct regular drills to ensure staff readiness.

• Complete detailed incident reports maintain accurate records of security activities and prepare

necessary documentation for any legal or insurance purposes.

• Stay updated on current security trends, technologies, and best practices, and recommend

improvements to enhance the hotel's security measures.

• Greet and monitor guests, visitors, and staff to enforce authorized access to hotel facilities, premises,

and restricted areas. Follow established protocols when granting or denying access.

• Conduct thorough searches of bags and vehicles according to the hotel's security guidelines, ensuring

the safety of all individuals and property.

• Adhere to all instructions received from supervisors or managers regarding security procedures,

protocols, and any changes in the work environment or circumstances.

• If you possess a valid driver's license, be prepared to transport guests and colleagues to the hospital

during emergencies, ensuring safe and efficient transportation while maintaining a calm and

professional demeanor.
