title: Software Engineer, Mobile, iOS, Maps Monetization
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. title: #EG Senior AI Native Builder

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Strong hands-on engineering ability in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, with experience building and integrating production-grade applications.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.

Good to have

  • Experience in consulting, venture building, startup environments, or innovation teams.
  • Experience deploying AI solutions in enterprise or regulated environments such as aviation, land transport, public safety, telecommunications, or government.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, CI/CD, analytics, and observability.
  • Experience shaping early-stage products with users and iterating based on feedback.
  • Regional exposure, including experience designing or adapting solutions across multiple Asia Pacific markets.

Why Join NCS?

Grow with Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI products that shape the future of technology
  • Collaborate with talented, passionate teams across research, engineering, and design
  • Access continuous learning opportunities and career development pathways

Make an Impact

  • Transform AI research into products that solve real problems for clients and users
  • Drive innovation in a leading Technology Services Firm with regional presence
  • Contribute to building a better future through responsible, human-centred AI

Thrive in Our Culture

  • Experience a human-to-human approach where relationships and collaboration matter
  • Be part of Team NCS, where bold ideas meet practical execution
  • Enjoy a supportive environment that values diversity, inclusion, and respect

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

title: Hoofduitvoerder woningbouw
description:
Jij bent de spil op de bouwplaats. Van de eerste schop in de grond tot de sleuteloverdracht: jij bepaalt de koers. Je kent je mensen, zet je partners aan het werk en zorgt dat iedereen met plezier naar huis gaat. Wij vertrouwen op jouw vakmanschap; jij krijgt de ruimte om te leiden zoals jij het wilt.

Dit wordt jouw baan

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de voortgang en afronding van woningbouwprojecten in jouw regio.

  • Je stuurt je vaste team en onderaannemers aan, zorgt dat ze weten wat er moet gebeuren en motiveert ze om kwaliteit te leveren.

  • Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en veiligheid - zonder logge hiërarchie die je in de weg zitten je doet dit met praktisch overleg zoals de dag start.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met projectleiding, werkvoorbereiding en BIM‑specialisten. Samen maken jullie de plannen waar.

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Den Bosch geloven we dat de uitvoerder het verschil maakt. Daarom geven we jou:

  • Echt zeggenschap; Jij bepaalt hoe het werk wordt uitgevoerd. Wij bieden de ondersteuning, jij hebt het stuur in handen.

  • Vakmanschap en trots; Je bouwt projecten in je eigen regio waar je jaren later nog trots op bent. Je werk is zichtbaar in de buurt waar je woont en leeft.

  • Stabiele basis; We zijn een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf sinds 1855, met een solide financiële basis en een cultuur van veiligheid, kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid. Dat betekent continuïteit en zekerheid voor jou en je team.

  • Gemeenschap; Je werkt in een club van ongeveer 140 collega’s. We kennen elkaar bij naam, luisteren naar elkaar en vieren successen samen.

Meer over Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn.

We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen.

Hier zit je op je plek

Als Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Den Bosch zijn we een zelfstandige werkmaatschappij binnen een groter geheel. Een organisatie van 150 medewerkers die jou als nieuwe collega graag willen opnemen binnen de familie! Samen realiseren we gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie en transformatie - van nieuwbouw tot het verbeteren en vernieuwen van bestaand vastgoed in de regio Noord-Brabant en Limburg.

Als medewerker van Dura Vermeer ben je onderdeel van een club van ontwikkelaars, bouwers, doeners en waarmakers. Duurzame samenwerking staat daarbij voorop: samen plannen maken, samen kennis en successen delen en samen innoveren.


Dit breng je mee

  • Een mbo‑diploma Bouwkunde (of vergelijkbaar)

  • 3–5 jaar ervaring als (hoofd)uitvoerder in woningbouw.

  • Je houdt overzicht, stuurt bij waar nodig en verliest het geheel nooit uit het oog.

  • Je weet dat bouwen mensenwerk is; je gelooft in samenwerken met je team en je omgeving.

  • Ervaring met BIM is mooi meegenomen, maar je leiderschap en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel zijn doorslaggevend.

Deze eisen tonen de richting van het profiel dat wij zoeken voor deze functie. Mocht jij jezelf niet in alle eisen herkennen, maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan gaan we graag met jou in gesprek.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen €5.639 en €7.049 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring.

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens CAO Bouw & Infra).

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de Cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone;

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap;

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card;

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike;

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar bijvoorbeeld ook op het gebied van vitaliteit;

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland;

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical;

  • Een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven;

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen?

Wil jij werken op een plek waar jouw vakmanschap en leiderschap het verschil maken? Ben je klaar om je stempel te drukken op woningbouwprojecten in Brabant?

Bel of app met onze recruiter Anne Goossens via 06‑14316580 of stuur een mail naar a.goossens@duravermeer.nl.

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Den Bosch bouw jij niet alleen huizen, maar ook vertrouwen en trots. We kijken uit naar je verhaal.

Bij Dura Vermeer werven en selecteren we onze kandidaten graag zonder de goedbedoelde hulp van “onderaannemers”. Bij acquisitie behouden we ons het recht voor om meerwerk in rekening te brengen.

title: Supervisor, Fleet Operations
description:
Job Title: Supervisor, Fleet Operations

Job Summary:

This position is responsible for maintaining a safe, reliable, and cost-efficient fleet of vehicles to support the business. The incumbent ensures proper use and care of physical assets, helps to prevent equipment failures, controls costs, manages external vendor relationships, works closely with auto mechanics and internal customers. This role supervises administrative personnel within the department. A primary responsibility of this position is to monitor fleet vehicle equipment maintenance, invoicing, record retention. To do this, the incumbent uses current Fleet Automotive software, preventative maintenance techniques, reviews the results, monitors repairs, and performs vehicle audits to ensure mechanics adhere to safety, regulatory and appearance standards. This position analyzes equipment or vehicle system failures to determine root causes, resolve problems and plans/coordinates equipment repairs with internal/external groups (e.g., drivers, vendors). Another major area of responsibility is to maintain automotive cost effectiveness. Duties include reviewing equipment failures and component replacements to identify trends. This role also supports automotive safety and regulatory compliance by conducting facility audits, following up on issues, and coordinating safety/regulatory training. Vendor related duties include verifying external-vendor repairs, preparing repair orders/estimates and reviewing Fleet system reports for anomalies.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Ensures adequate inventory levels (e.g., parts, tires, etc.) to support business processes.
  • Works with other groups to prevent, identify and resolve equipment/service problems.
  • Adheres to purchasing limits, expense approval procedures, and equipment disposal guidelines to remain within cost plan.
  • Reviews and approves automotive expenses.
  • Determines employee training needs to produce continuous development plans.
  • Provides feedback and support.
  • Conducts performance evaluations and resolves individual/group performance issues.

Job Requirements:

  • U.S. citizen or otherwise authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Employer will not sponsor visas for position
  • Must be located in the same geographic location as the job or willing to relocate
  • Applies legal, regulatory and safety compliance knowledge to reduce company risk
  • Possesses knowledge of mechanical fundamentals, maintenance, diagnosis, and repair to vehicle or aircraft fleet operation
  • Manages equipment repair and oversees the correction of problems with tools, machinery and other standard technical equipment
  • Applies understanding of policies/procedures to situations and operations in a business area
  • Manages inspections of buildings, grounds, equipment, supplies or compliance documents to ensure safety, regulatory compliance, prolonged service life, and appearance
  • Displays knowledge of company structure and operations to resolve problems, make decisions and achieve business objectives
  • Manages physical assets (e.g., machinery, vehicles, equipment, supplies)
  • Evaluates, obtains and allocates physical asset resources, maximizes their use and projects future asset needs
  • Coaches and develops others using career development processes/tools
  • Manages and establishes working relationships with vendors (e.g., suppliers, consultants, contractors) and internal customers (e.g. Accounting, Engineering, etc.)
  • Willing to work flexible shift hours and on the weekends
  • Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) certification
  • Experience repairing vehicles or managing employees that repair vehicles

title: Pricing & Financial Structuring Expert – Saudi Arabia
description:
A leading development finance client of ours, with a strong regional presence, is currently seeking to hire a Pricing & Financial Structuring Expert in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 

 

The successful candidate should own the Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) framework and provide the structuring expertise behind funding, hedging and lending economics. Build and maintain the FTP curve, apply FTP to loan pricing and investment benchmarking, structure internal hedging and funding solutions with the Front Office, and measure the true cost of concessional lending — using the Middle Office analytics engine to advise ALCO on pricing discipline and long-term financial sustainability.

 


Responsibilities:

Funds Transfer Pricing & Pricing 


	Build, calibrate and maintain the market-driven FTP curve (dealer quotes, AA+ Bloomberg benchmark, interpolation across tenors) on the defined refresh cadence.
	Apply the FTP rate at each loan’s Weighted Average Life (WAL) for private-sector and trade-finance loan pricing.
	Benchmark investment performance against FTP at duration and compute sector NIM / loan-book profitability by sector.
	Maintain the pricing methodology and ensure its consistent, policy-based application across borrowers.


 

Financial Structuring 


	Structure internal hedging solutions (IRS / CCS / FX swaps) with the Investment & Hedging desk to convert exposures to the USD/SOFR base. 
	Structure funding instruments and support the design of the short-term funding toolkit. 
	Support equity-duration management and swap-overlay design under the ALM Framework (NII / EVE trade-off), using the analytics produced by Operational Control & Analytics. 


 

Concessionality Monitoring 


	Measure the cost of concessionality using the IMF methodology and  internal opportunity-cost lens (NPV of a concessional / blended versus non-concessional loan).
	Report the cost of concessionality to ALCO to safeguard the Bank’s financial sustainability.


 

Governance & Coordination 


	Present FTP curve updates and pricing / concessionality analysis to ALCO. 
	Coordinate with Operations and lending (pricing application), the Front Office (structuring and execution), Operational Control & Analytics (balance-sheet analytics), Risk and Finance. 


 

Requirements:


	Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Economics, Mathematics or a related quantitative field, a master’s degree is preferred.
	Minimum of eight (8) years’ experience in funds transfer pricing, financial structuring, ALM or treasury quantitative modelling within an MDB or major investment bank.
	Expertise in FTP mechanisms and curve construction, derivatives structuring, and concessionality / NPV analysis.
	Advanced financial engineering and coding (Python, R, VBA, MATLAB); Bloomberg; advanced Excel.
	CFA or FRM certification is a strong asset.
	Proficiency in English and Arabic is required.
	Quantitative & Structuring Ability: builds curves, prices instruments and structures internal solutions. 
	Pricing Discipline & Commercial Judgment: consistent, policy-based pricing and profitability analysis. 
	Financial-Engineering Depth: FTP, derivatives and concessionality modelling. 
	Integrity and Professionalism: high ethical standards and compliance discipline. 
	Communication: translates technical pricing into clear ALCO and Board messages. 
	Teamwork: effective collaboration with the Front Office, Operations, Operational Control & Analytics, Risk and Finance. 


 

Contractual Information:


	Willing and able to relocate to Saudi Arabia for the opportunity. 


 


 

If you wish to apply for the position, please send your CV to Jayde Harty at jharty@caglobalint.com.

Please visit www.caglobalint.com for more exciting opportunities.

title: Fire social- eller sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere søges til Autismecenter Midtjylland
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for mennesker med autisme?

Brænder du for høj faglighed, stærke relationer og for at skabe de bedste rammer for mennesker med autisme? Så har vi måske en plads til dig på holdet.

Vi søger fire social- eller sundhedsfaglige kolleger på 30–37 timer om ugen til tre af vores afdelinger på Fasanvej: Åbo, Bøgebo og Skovbo. Stillingerne ønskes besat snarest muligt, se mere her,

At vi søger fire nye kolleger på én gang, skyldes flere gode udviklinger hos os. Nogle kolleger går på barsel, andre videreuddanner sig – og samtidig har vi valgt at styrke vores faste teams og prioritere flere faste kolleger frem for vikardækning.

Det betyder, at du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi investerer i kontinuitet, faglighed og stærke relationer – både til borgerne og til hinanden.


Om Autismecenter Midtjylland

Autismecenter Midtjylland er Ikast-Brande Kommunes højt specialiserede tilbud for voksne med autisme og andre gennemgribende udviklingsforstyrrelser.

På tilbuddet bor 15 borgere, som har forskellige og individuelle behov for pædagogisk og sundhedsfaglig støtte.

Autismecenter Midtjylland består af både bo- og aktivitetstilbud, og derudover har vi vores eget videnscenter, Autismepaletten, som bidrager til vidensdeling, faglig udvikling og uddannelse, bliv klogere her.

Vi arbejder ud fra en anerkendende tilgang med fundament i blandt andet KRAP, LA2u og neuropædagogik. Borgerne har individuelt tilpassede dagsprogrammer og kommunikationssystemer, og vores pædagogiske arbejde tager altid udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers ressourcer, behov og forudsætninger.


En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed – og plads til humor

Hos os bliver du en del af et tværfagligt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi er afhængige af hinandens forskellige fagligheder og perspektiver.

Vi lægger vægt på, at der er plads til faglig refleksion, nysgerrighed og udvikling – men også til humor og et godt grin i en hverdag, hvor opgaverne til tider kan være komplekse.

Der vil være skiftende dag- og aftenvagter samt weekendarbejde hver anden eller tredje weekend afhængig af afdeling og dine ønsker, se eksempel her.


Vi tilbyder dig

  • Et arbejdsmiljø, hvor trivsel og det gode arbejdsfællesskab vægtes højt
  • En arbejdsplads med en afslappet og humoristisk tone
  • Engagerede og fagligt velfunderede kolleger
  • Et højt specialiseret fagområde
  • Grundig introduktion til borgerne, fagligheden og hverdagen
  • Mulighed for uddannelse og kompetenceudvikling
  • Temadage afdelingsvis med fokus på både faglighed, udvikling og det sociale fællesskab
  • Fælles faglige- og socialdage på tværs af Autismecenter Midtjylland og dage på tværs af Socialafdelingen

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har en social- eller sundhedsfaglig baggrund
  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære – også hvis autismeområdet er nyt for dig
  • Har en positiv tilgang og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er fagligt engageret og har lyst til både at dele din egen viden og lære af andre
  • Kan arbejde struktureret og samtidig håndtere, når hverdagen bliver uforudsigelig
  • Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af både afdelingen og Autismecenter Midtjylland
  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og lyst til at arbejde med dokumentation
  • Er stabil i dit fremmøde
  • Har kørekort

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Medvirke til at sikre høj kvalitet i den pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige indsats
  • Yde daglig pleje, behandling og pædagogisk støtte til borgerne
  • Understøtte borgernes selv- og medbestemmelse og mulighed for et meningsfuldt hverdagsliv
  • Deltage i aktiviteter og ture sammen med borgerne
  • Arbejde systematisk med individuelle pædagogiske mål og tiltag
  • Varetage daglig sundhedsfaglig og pædagogisk dokumentation
  • Bidrage aktivt til faglig refleksion, sparring og udvikling i medarbejdergruppen
  • Samarbejde tværfagligt med kolleger og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere

Skal du være en af vores fire nye kolleger?

Vi søger forskellige profiler, der sammen kan skabe et stærkt team. Det vigtigste er din interesse for autismeområdet og lysten til at bidrage med din faglighed, nysgerrighed og personlighed.

Ansøgningsfrist er 27. august 2026. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Ved ansættelse forbeholder Ikast-Brande Kommune sig ret til at indhente en udvidet straffeattest efter ansøgerens samtykke.

Ved ønske om yderligere information kan der rettes henvendelse til:

Teamleder Jonna Lind Jacobsen
Tlf. 29 33 81 41

Teamleder Maja Tind
Tlf. 22 43 99 85

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – og måske byde dig velkommen på Autismecenter Midtjylland.

title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
description:
We are a crowdfunded company and have a dedicated and enthusiastic community of backers who are helping us create the “Best Damn Space Sim Ever”. We want to build the best we can deliver and we believe wholeheartedly in the value of exceptional diverse talent.

Senior IT Systems Engineer

Founded in 2012, Cloud Imperium Games creates cutting-edge videogames that defy expectations. We're currently developing Star Citizen, a record-breaking multiplayer online space sim, and Squadron 42, a cinematic single-player adventure set in the same universe. Join us as we break boundaries and make video game history.

Cloud Imperium Games is looking for a skilled and talented IT Systems Engineer to support our studios across Manchester, Austin, Frankfurt, and Montreal!

What do our IT Systems Engineers do?

  • Own the corporate server, virtualisation, and storage estate across all sites (Windows Server, Hyper-V or VMware, SAN and NAS).
  • Managing and administering Microsoft security and compliance features, including Defender for Endpoint, Purview, and Conditional Access policies.
  • Manage Active Directory design, Group Policy, and identity plumbing in partnership with the IAM engineers.
  • Operate cloud workloads and platform services (GCP, Azure), including infrastructure as code and patching.
  • Lead system hardening, formal patch management, and backup and restore, including immutable backups and tested restores.
  • Support development infrastructure in partnership with studio teams, including Perforce hosts and build servers.
  • Provide cross-coverage of the wider corporate IT estate and participate in an on-call rota for critical infrastructure incidents.

What does a good IT Systems Engineer look like to us?

A true passion for technology is a must, and we would also like it if you:

  • Have deep, expert-level experience with Windows Server, virtualisation, storage, Active Directory, and the Microsoft 365 stack.
  • Have hands-on experience with the Microsoft stack — Defender for Endpoint, Purview, Conditional Access, and Privileged Identity Management.
  • Have cloud platform experience (GCP, Azure, or AWS) with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep or similar).
  • Carry a solid networking baseline (around CCNA level): VLANs, static routing, and the fundamentals.
  • Are proficient with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Python).
  • Are self-directed and effective in low-maturity, high-change environments.

We are always keen to hear from passionate IT engineers, so join the 'verse and become our latest Star Citizen!

CIG Diversity Statement

CIG is a global company, staunchly committed to cultivating a culture and workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, lifestyles, and perspectives. Together, we are creating a space where authentic recognition, appreciation, and understanding of the importance of diversity is fostered by everyone. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to build a team that represents all walks of life, and we want every employee to bring all the things that make them unique to the work environment. The universe is as vast and varied as the people in it, and it's our differences that make it special.

Fraud Statement

We are aware of people receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from CIG. These types of fraud can be carried out through false websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal info like bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money for the purchase of business equipment.

If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities, as well as reaching out to us at info@cloudimperiumgames.com with any information you may have.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Sr. Engineer Electrical & Electronics Engineering XII
description:
Job Title

Senior Electrical Engineer – Design & Application (Medium Voltage Switchgear)

Job Purpose

To execute detailed design and application engineering of Medium Voltage (MV) switchgear, ensuring compliance with IEC standards, accurate protection relay engineering, and timely project delivery.

Key Responsibilities 1. Design & Engineering

  • Prepare and review SLDs, GA drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and interlocking logic for MV switchgear (AIS/GIS up to 36kV or company scope).
  • Perform busbar sizing, short-circuit withstand calculations, and thermal considerations.
  • Ensure compliance with IEC 62271 series and other applicable IEC standards.
  • Support standardization by using approved engineering templates and libraries.

2. Protection & Relay Engineering

  • Selection and application of numerical protection relays.
  • Perform relay setting calculations (OCR, EF, REF, UV/OV, directional, differential as applicable).
  • Configure and program protection relays as per project protection philosophy.
  • Develop trip matrix and interlocking logic.
  • Support protection coordination studies (ETAP / DigSILENT preferred).
  • Assist during FAT and commissioning for relay validation and troubleshooting.

3. Application Engineering

  • Review customer technical specifications and prepare compliance statements.
  • Identify technical deviations and propose optimized solutions.
  • Support sales and project teams with technical clarifications.

4. Testing & Project Support

  • Prepare and review routine test procedures.
  • Support factory acceptance tests (FAT).
  • Provide technical support during manufacturing and site-related queries.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • 8–12 years of experience in MV switchgear design and protection engineering.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of IEC 62271 series and IEC protection standards (IEC 60255).
  • Hands-on experience in numerical relay programming (ABB / Siemens / Schneider or equivalent).
  • Knowledge of protection coordination studies.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD / EPLAN or equivalent tools.

Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented with high engineering accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Good communication skills for cross-functional coordination.

Why you might not be excited about us 👎

While we make calculated bets, we have a strong culture of experimentation and we'll pivot as necessary based on what we're seeing in the data and what we're hearing from our users.

title: AR Game Designer — Mobile & WebAR
description:
About the Project

We are developing an augmented reality entertainment experience that transforms physical family-friendly, Horror-themed tombstones into interactive monster encounters.

The product combines physical retail merchandise with two levels of digital experience:

Phase One — WebAR: A frictionless 10–15 second cinematic experience triggered by scanning a QR code. The monster appears to emerge directly from the physical tombstone.

Phase Two — Mobile Game: A native iOS and Android experience where players confront monsters in their own environment using a supernatural “Van Helsing-inspired” weapon system, capture them, and return them to their graves.

We are looking for an AR Game Designer to own the gameplay design and help turn the creative concept into simple, compelling, highly repeatable interactions.

What You'll Do

  • Define the core gameplay loop for short-form AR monster encounters.

  • Design intuitive mechanics that work naturally with a smartphone camera and physical tombstone.

  • Develop the interaction between the player, monster, environment, and virtual weapon.

  • Design a supernatural weapon mechanic capable of firing plasma or fantastical energy, weakening/capturing monsters, and dragging them back into their graves.

  • Determine how each monster (3) behaves during encounters and where character-specific mechanics add meaningful value.

  • Design encounters that are immediately understandable and satisfying within approximately 15–30 seconds while supporting longer play sessions.

  • Establish progression, scoring, replayability, difficulty, rewards, and player feedback systems.

  • Explore how leaderboard and competitive mechanics can extend engagement.

  • Help determine whether multiplayer/social gameplay belongs in the initial product or future roadmap.

  • Design onboarding that requires minimal instruction and gets users into the experience quickly.

  • Work closely with AR engineers to design around real-world tracking, mobile hardware, performance, safety, and environmental constraints.

  • Collaborate with animation, VFX, audio, character art, and engineering so gameplay mechanics feel integrated rather than layered onto the experience.

  • Prototype, playtest, evaluate, and rapidly iterate mechanics based on client and user feedback.

  • Help establish systems that can expand beyond Halloween into additional characters, seasonal variants, collectibles, and future experiences.

What We're Looking For

  • Professional experience as a Game Designer, AR Game Designer, Systems Designer, or Gameplay Designer.

  • Experience designing mobile, AR, VR/XR, location-based, or other interactive real-time experiences.

  • Strong understanding of short-form gameplay loops and immediate player feedback.

  • Ability to translate a broad creative idea into clearly defined mechanics, rules, states, and interactions.

  • Strong understanding of player motivation, progression, reward, difficulty, and replayability.

  • Experience designing gameplay around physical movement, camera-based interaction, or spatial environments.

  • Ability to communicate mechanics clearly through design documentation, diagrams, prototypes, and direct collaboration with developers.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving prototype environment where gameplay is continuously tested and refined.

  • A portfolio of work is mandatory.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on Unity experience.

  • Experience with AR Foundation, ARKit, ARCore, 8th Wall, or comparable AR platforms.

  • Experience designing combat, capture, projectile, aiming, or physics-based mechanics.

  • Experience with physical products, toys-to-life, location-based entertainment, or connected collectibles.

  • Familiarity with multiplayer and leaderboard systems.

  • Experience designing family-friendly horror entertainment.

The Design Challenge

The gameplay should be family friendly and simple enough to understand immediately but satisfying enough that players want to do it again.

This is not intended to become a complicated combat game. The “magic” comes from seeing a physical object come alive, confronting the creature in your own environment, and having an interaction that feels responsive, theatrical, and fun.

The physical tombstone, AR character, weapon, VFX, animation, spatial audio, and gameplay should feel like one experience and not separate features.

title: Order Management Assistant
description:
Inleiding:

Als Order Management Assistant bij ArcelorMittal ben jij de brug tussen onze klanten en de duurzame staaloplossingen van de toekomst. In deze rol zorg jij ervoor dat bestellingen vlot en efficiënt door ons Order Management Platform gaan, zodat onze klanten de kwaliteit en service krijgen die ze verwachten. Ben jij klaar om een cruciale rol te spelen in een toonaangevend internationaal bedrijf?

Wat houdt de job in?

In jouw rol als Order Management Assistant bij ArcelorMittal ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verwerken van klantbestellingen en het zorgen voor een efficiënte doorstroom van informatie tussen klanten, het commerciële team en de productieafdelingen. Jij bent de onmisbare schakel die ervoor zorgt dat onze klanten op tijd hun bestellingen bevestigd krijgen.

Concreet ga jij:

  • Bestellingen van klanten in jouw marktgebied inboeken via verschillende systemen zoals SAP, de Real Time Product Configurator en interne IT-tools.
  • Bestellingen verwerken en omzetten naar een SAP-order dat naar de productie en andere afdelingen wordt doorgestuurd voor validatie.
  • Technische productvalidaties uitvoeren en zorgen voor een soepele opvolging van alle bestellingen.
  • Snel schakelen met commerciële netwerken en productiesites om validaties te versnellen en te zorgen voor een tijdige orderbevestiging.
  • Proactief communiceren met klanten via e-mail en telefoon om ervoor te zorgen dat zij altijd op de hoogte zijn van de status van hun bestelling.

Bij ArcelorMittal werk je met geavanceerde technologieën in een dynamische omgeving, waar je voortdurend nieuwe vaardigheden leert. Je werkt voltijds in een glijdend uurrooster, begintijd tussen 7u30 en 9u en eindtijd tussen 16u en 18u30.

Ben jij de geschikte kandidaat?

We zijn op zoek naar iemand die niet alleen communicatief sterk is, maar ook goed kan multitasken en graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt. Jij komt in een team te werken waar samenwerking centraal staat, maar je hebt ook je eigen duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden.

  • Je hebt een professioneel bachelordiploma en zoekt een uitdagende rol waar je kunt leren en groeien.
  • Je hebt een passie voor communicatie, zowel telefonisch als via e-mail.
  • Je beheerst Engels uitstekend; Nederlands, Duits, Frans, Pools of Turks is een plus, maar geen vereiste.
  • Je laat je niet snel uit het veld slaan en weet dringende vragen snel en efficiënt op te lossen.
  • Je bent een teamplayer, maar hebt ook geen moeite om zelfstandig te werken.
  • Je kunt multitasken en hebt een nauwkeurige werkstijl, zelfs in een drukke omgeving.
  • Het werken met verschillende tools en systemen schrikt je niet af.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Je kan starten op interimbasis met optie vast
  • Ervaring bij een belangrijke multinational
  • Een maaltijdvergoeding van €10 per dag en tal van lunchmogelijkheden in het bedrijfsrestaurant
  • Deelname aan winstpremies
  • Een sinterklaascadeau van €35
  • Gratis griepvaccinaties om je welzijn te waarborgen
  • Een fijne werksfeer met collegialiteit en teamwork als speerpunten
  • Opleiding en begeleiding vanaf dag één, zodat jij jezelf verder kunt ontwikkelen en kunt doorgroeien binnen de organisatie

Hoe verloopt de selectieprocedure?

  • Online sollicitatie via onze website
  • Online testing en gesprek met HR
  • Kennismakingsgesprek met de leidinggevende van de afdeling en een rondleiding
  • Contractopmaak

Voel je het al kriebelen om te beginnen? Solliciteer nu!

Diversiteit en inclusie maken ons nóg sterker!
ArcelorMittal Belgium (AMBE) gaat voluit voor gelijke kansen en waardeert diversiteit. We selecteren kandidaten enkel op basis van hun competenties. Je leeftijd, geslacht, etnische afkomst, geaardheid, geloof, beperking, nationaliteit, … beïnvloeden je kans om mee te bouwen aan duurzame circulaire staal oplossingen voor de toekomst niet.

title: Senior kravanalytiker
description:
Vi söker en senior kravanalytiker/kravhanterare för ett uppdrag hos en myndighet i Stockholm.

Uppdragsbeskrivning

Uppdraget är på heltid och innebär en central roll hos myndigheten vid upphandling av ett nytt, modernt och användarvänligt ärendehanteringssystem.

Mundigheten vill minska långa ledtider, manuella moment och stuprör i dagens ärendehantering. Strategin är att först optimera ärendeflöden och processer och därefter addera teknik och automatisering där det skapar tydlig nytta. Du kommer självständigt att planera, leda och genomföra kravarbetet och omsätta verksamhetens behov till ett sammanhållet och upphandlingsbart kravunderlag.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Planera, strukturera och driva kravarbetet genom nulägesanalys, börlägesanalys samt framtagning av kravspecifikation och upphandlingsunderlag
  • Planera och genomföra kravinsamling via workshops, intervjuer, dokumentstudier och vid behov djupintervjuer med användarna
  • Stödja processkartläggning end-to-end och identifiera flaskhalsar, väntetider, manuella moment, rotorsaker och förbättringsområden
  • Analysera vilka förbättringar som bör genomföras genom processförändring respektive systemstöd eller automatisering
  • Dokumentera och strukturera verksamhetskrav och IT-krav samt bryta ned dessa i funktionella och icke-funktionella krav
  • Ta fram use case/användarfallsbeskrivningar för prioriterade ärendeflöden
  • Etablera struktur för prioritering, spårbarhet, ändringshantering, beslutslogg och kravägarskap
  • Ta fram acceptanskriterier för centrala upphandlingskrav
  • Fungera som brygga mellan verksamhet och IT och samverka med bland annat handläggare, jurister, processägare, IT-arkitekt och lösningsarkitekt
  • Bidra till paketering och kvalitetssäkring av krav inför upphandling.

Uppdraget kan beröra processer där sekretessbelagda uppgifter eller känsliga personuppgifter förekommer. Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat med informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och spårbarhet är därför en viktig del av uppdraget.

Obligatoriska krav

  • Du ska ha genomfört minst två (2) uppdrag under de senaste fem (5) åren i rollen som ansvarig eller ledande kravanalytiker vid framtagande av kravunderlag inför upphandling, anskaffning eller systembyte av ärendehanteringssystem eller annat jämförbart komplext verksamhetssystem.
  • Du ska ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av att ta fram kravunderlag och kravspecifikationer som använts i ett upphandlingsunderlag i en offentlig upphandling eller annan jämförbar formaliserad anskaffning av verksamhetssystem. Minst ett (1) sådant uppdrag ska avse statlig myndighet, kommun eller region.
  • Du ska ha dokumenterad erfarenhet från minst två (2) uppdrag av att leda processkartläggning av nuläge och börläge samt omsätta detta till funktionella och icke-funktionella krav, inklusive use case/användarfall, acceptanskriterier och kravspårbarhet. Dessa uppdrag får inte vara äldre än fem (5) år räknat från sista dag att lämna avropssvar.
  • Du ska ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av att i kravarbete beakta och formulera krav kopplade till informationssäkerhet, loggning, spårbarhet och dataskydd i samband med upphandling eller förändring av verksamhetssystem.
  • Du ska ha mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska samt goda kunskaper i tal och skrift på engelska.

Din ansökan

Låter rollen intressant och passande? Ansök i så fall omgående för vi intervjuar löpande och rollen kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Vi kan enbart ta emot och bearbeta din ansökan genom att du registrerar ditt CV i vår portal. Med avseende på GDPR kan vi ej ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Uppdraget är en del av Quest Consulting personaluthyrning.

Om oss

Quest Consulting är ett auktoriserat konsultbolag med kollektivavtal, försäkringar, friskvård och tjänstepension. Vi är specialiserade inom IT, Teknik, HR, Administration och Ekonomi. Vår målsättning är att vara din personliga samarbetspartner och just därför är det så viktigt för oss att arbeta efter våra kärnvärden där våra ledord är att vara Personliga, Nyskapande och Professionella

Key Responsibilities:

I. Job Summary

The Medical Waste Route Driver Swing CDL A is responsible for servicing various accounts in the most professional way, ensuring that customers' needs are met on a continual basis for various waste pickup and supply delivery. Routes can change daily to cover absences, vacation and other service changes. Provides the highest level of customer service possible at all times. May also transport waste from either a WMHS location or customer location, to a transfer location or processing location. All Company assigned vehicles are equipped with camera telematics which include inside and outside cameras. In addition, all vehicles are equipped with ELD (electronic logging device) and GPS (global positioning system).

II. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manages various routes ensuring customers’ waste is picked up in a safe, timely and accurate manner
  • Pick up and transport waste safely according to all federal, state, and local rules and regulations
  • Plans daily schedule based on customers’ needs by reviewing daily paperwork, e.g., manifest, route sheets, previous VCR, etc. provided by the Transportation Manager/Supervisor or Dispatcher
  • Follows routing software route schedule
  • May prepare and load trucks to service select accounts for the day ensuring enough supplies are added
  • Required to secure waste and material as well as unloading trucks at various Stericycle and customer sites
  • Pick up specified waste from each customer site scheduled for the day. Ensures that customers have packaged and prepared the waste according to all federal, state, and local rules and regulations before transporting
  • Provide the highest level of customer service to assigned accounts on a daily basis, communicating any issues to Transportation Manager/Supervisor or Dispatcher for resolution. This includes, but is not limited to re-routes, adjustments in container sizes, training, etc.
  • Ensures waste, supplies, and material handling equipment are secured prior to operating vehicle on public highway
  • Ensures that assigned paperwork is completed legibly, neatly, accurately, and completely and returned to Transportation Supervisor or Dispatcher for processing. Ensures DOT Driver Log is completed, if applicable
  • Communicates with Stericycle Transportation Supervisor and/or Dispatcher regarding any change to route pickups, including address changes, customer not having waste ready for pickup, etc. Ensures that employee covering for specific route is aware of any situations outside the norm in order to provide the highest level of customer service. Reports any problems/issues with accounts to Transportation Supervisor and/or Dispatcher before the close of business each day
  • Performs documented pre-trip and post-trip maintenance on assigned truck prior to leaving or closing for the day. Reports any maintenance problems to Transportation/Dispatcher for follow-up. Use of ELD (electronic logging device) and Geotab to log hours in accordance with DOT guidelines
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities, as assigned


III. Qualifications

A. Required Qualifications

  • 2 years of experience, preferably in driving Trucks and Box Trucks
  • Able to read, write, and speak English well enough to interact with the public, understand traffic signs, respond to official questions, and complete records or reports
  • Must be 21 years of age or older
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) - Class A
  • All CMV/CDL drivers must be able to obtain a medical card by a certified medical examiner


B. Preferred Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED (accredited)

Listed below are key points regarding physical demands, physical and occupational risks, and the work environment of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Standing
  • Walking
  • Lifting
  • Pushing
  • Pulling
  • Crouching
  • Reaching
  • Handling
  • Sitting
  • Talking
  • Hearing

As part of the ongoing employment requirements, the successful candidate may be subject to drug and alcohol testing—including pre‑employment screening, post‑incident evaluations, reasonable suspicion checks, and random testing—in accordance with government regulations and company policies.


V. Benefits
At WM, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and short-term disability. In addition, we offer a stock purchase plan, company matching on a 401(k), and more. Employees also receive paid vacation, holidays, and personal days. Please note that benefits may vary by site.

title: Bliv opsøgende børn- og ungemedarbejder i Viby - UngiAarhus
description:
Du skaber bånd mellem børn, unge, familier og lokalsamfundet i Viby C

Sidder du lige nu og overvejer, om du mon er vores nye medarbejder i marken?

Den professionelle medarbejder, som møder områdets børn, unge og forældre på deres hjemmebane for at lytte, støtte, guide og trække tråde ud i lokalsamfundet mod meningsfulde og givende fællesskaber?

Så læs de følgende fem argumenter for at stoppe overvejelserne og gå i gang med ansøgningen:

  • Du får ansvaret for konkrete indsatser med reelt indhold – Payday, Mellemrumsarbejdet, 17Plus og Familien i fokus er rammen om din hverdag. Du er tovholder, og du er med til at udvikle indsatserne undervejs.
  • Du får frihed – og et stærkt bagland – du strukturerer i høj grad selv dit arbejde, men du har kolleger i den boligsociale helhedsplan, i Klubben Akva og i Myrhuset, som løbende står klar til sparring. Dertil månedlig en-til-en opfølgning og supervision.
  • Du får en hverdag, hvor det er svært at gro ind i væggen – dit arbejde bliver kendetegnet ved en myriade af opgaver og oplevelser, som du definerer i samarbejde med børn, unge, forældre og andre aktører i området.
  • Du tager del i kompetenceudviklende kursusforløb – UngiAarhus og helhedsplanen arbejder hele tiden på at udvikle medarbejderne fagligt. Vi tilbyder løbende kurser i alt fra konflikthåndtering til ungeinddragelse.
  • Du bliver del af et eksperimentarium – vi afprøver sammen nye idéer og metoder inden for kontakt og rekruttering, aktiviteter, kommunikation og synlighed. Inddragelse af og værdi for den enkelte er nøgleordene.

Om jobbet

Du får din daglige gang i boligområderne, hvor du er opsøgende, nysgerrig, støttende og handlingsorienteret. Du arbejder inden for indsatsområderne ’Uddannelse og livschancer’ og ’Kriminalitetsforebyggelse’ i den boligsociale helhedsplan for Viby, med særligt fokus på Viby C.

Du deler opgavefællesskab med den boligsociale børn- og ungemedarbejder, som dækker de to zoner i Viby Syd, mens du varetager indsatsen i Viby C-zonen. Opgavefællesskabet fordrer tæt dialog og samarbejde jer imellem. Sammen med familiemedarbejderen er I den naturlige indgang for aktører, der ønsker at indgå i den samlede børn- og ungeindsats i bydelen.

Dine fire hovedopgaver

Payday

En lommepenge- og fritidsjobindsats, hvor unge gør deres spæde erfaringer med arbejdsmarkedet. Din opgave er at forberede de unge, skabe match mellem dem og lokale jobåbninger og efterfølgende understøtte motivation og fastholdelse. Du samarbejder tæt med forældrene, for opbakning hjemmefra betyder noget – både når jobbet går godt, og når det går skidt. På fritidsjobdelen hjælper du desuden de unge med ansøgning og cv. Dertil ligger der et arbejde i at opdyrke et virksomhedsnetværk, så der løbende er jobåbninger nok til de unge, der er klar.

Mellemrumsarbejdet

Du opsøger børn og unge i deres nærområde. Arbejdet foregår på flere arenaer og bygger blandt andet på et øget samarbejde med skole og klub. Det handler om at møde børn og unge, dér hvor de er, og understøtte koblingerne fra skole til klub, fra klub til fritidsjob og fra grundskole til ungdomsuddannelse. Du er til stede i ’mellemrummet’ mellem områdets forskellige tilbud og hjælper den enkelte med at navigere og koble sig på det, der giver mening – lokale idrætsforeninger, fritids- og ungdomsklub med flere. Undervejs eksperimenterer vi med nye aktiviteter, der tager afsæt i det, der efterspørges, eller som der viser sig behov for.

17Plus

17Plus er et tilbud, der har været kendt i Viby Syd gennem en årrække. Formålet er at understøtte og fastholde de unge i et konstruktivt ungdomsliv via rådgivning og lektiehjælp, så de motiveres til at påbegynde, fastholde og gennemføre en ungdomsuddannelse. Tilbuddet drives og koordineres overordnet af UngiAarhus. De to børn- og ungemedarbejdere er både manpower i åbningstiden og bidrager til koordineringen af det samlede tilbud. Der ligger en særlig opgave i at brobygge unge på tværs af bydelen til tilbuddet.

Familien i fokus

Indsatsen omfatter gruppebaseret læring, familieorienterede events, individuel vejledning og brobygning – herunder deltagelse i familieferie mv. Du løser udelukkende opgaver i Viby C og altid i samarbejde med den boligsociale familiemedarbejder. Brobygning til kommunale samarbejdspartnere og andre aktører er central for at hjælpe familierne ikke bare her og nu, men også på længere sigt. Den individuelle vejledning og brobygning udføres altid med hjælp-til-selvhjælp for øje.

Din profil

Er du pædagogen, der tager fagligheden med ud i boligområdet?

Sidder du lige nu som pædagog og overvejer, om du mon er vores nye kollega i marken?

Den pædagog, som møder områdets børn, unge og forældre på deres hjemmebane for at lytte, støtte, guide og trække tråde ud i lokalsamfundet mod meningsfulde og givende fællesskaber – og som har fagligheden til at forstå, hvorfor det virker?

Så læs de følgende seks argumenter for at stoppe overvejelserne og gå i gang med ansøgningen:

  • Du får lov at bruge din pædagogfaglighed hele vejen rundt – relationsarbejde, forældresamarbejde, gruppedynamikker, brobygning og pædagogisk dømmekraft i situationer, hvor der ikke er en manual. Her er din uddannelse ikke et krav på papiret, men et arbejdsredskab du bruger hver dag.
  • Du får ansvaret for konkrete indsatser med reelt indhold – Payday, Mellemrumsarbejdet, 17Plus og Familien i fokus er rammen om din hverdag. Du er tovholder, og du er med til at udvikle indsatserne undervejs.
  • Du får frihed – og et stærkt bagland – du strukturerer i høj grad selv dit arbejde, men du har kolleger i den boligsociale helhedsplan, i Klubben Akva og i Myrhuset, som løbende står klar til sparring. Dertil månedlig en-til-en opfølgning og supervision.
  • Du får en hverdag, hvor det er svært at gro ind i væggen – dit arbejde bliver kendetegnet ved en myriade af opgaver og oplevelser, som du definerer i samarbejde med børn, unge, forældre og andre aktører i området.
  • Du tager del i kompetenceudviklende kursusforløb – UngiAarhus og helhedsplanen arbejder hele tiden på at udvikle medarbejderne fagligt. Vi tilbyder løbende kurser i alt fra konflikthåndtering til ungeinddragelse.
  • Du bliver del af et eksperimentarium – vi afprøver sammen nye idéer og metoder inden for kontakt og rekruttering, aktiviteter, kommunikation og synlighed. Inddragelse af og værdi for den enkelte er nøgleordene.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Vi tilbyder en tidsbegrænset projektstilling på 37 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse 01.10.2026 eller hurtigst muligt. Stillingen løber frem til 31.12.2027

Det er vigtigt, at du er fleksibel med arbejdstider, da der forekommer både lange arbejdsdage samt aften- og weekendarbejde. Du skal forvente at arbejde, når borgerne og de unge er tilgængelige, og det forventes konkret, at du har en ugentlig aftenvagt i 17Plus.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst mellem KL og BUPL.

Ansøgning

Stillinger i Aarhus Kommune søges elektronisk. Klik på ”Søg job” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgere, der har været indkaldt til samtale, kontaktes personligt umiddelbart efter ansøgningsfristen. Til de øvrige udsendes skriftlige afslag efterfølgende på mail.

Aarhus Kommune ser mangfoldighed som en styrke. Vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset alder, køn, religion, seksualitet og nationalitet til at søge.

Om helhedsplanen

Den boligsociale helhedsplan for Viby bygger videre på erfaringerne fra helhedsplanen for Viby Syd og den lokale områdeindsats i Viby C. Formålet er at understøtte, at boligområderne udvikler sig i en positiv retning, med særligt fokus på områdets børn og unge, områdets voksne og ældre samt områdets foreninger og civilsamfund.

Indsatsen retter sig primært mod at støtte og guide de borgere i området, som endnu ikke har øje for mangfoldigheden af tilbud i henholdsvis kommunalt regi, hos boligforeningen og i de lokale og bydækkende foreninger.


Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Senior kravanalytiker för ärendehanteringssystem
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i ett viktigt förändringsarbete hos en svensk myndighet inom dataskydd och integritetsfrågor. Målet är att skapa ett nytt, modernt och användarvänligt ärendehanteringssystem som kortar ledtider, minskar manuella moment och binder ihop arbetssätt som i dag är uppdelade i separata flöden.

Här börjar arbetet i verksamheten. Först förbättras processer och ärendeflöden, därefter används systemstöd och automatisering där det ger tydlig nytta. Du får en central roll i att planera, leda och genomföra kravarbetet och omsätta behov till ett sammanhållet kravunderlag som fungerar i en formaliserad upphandling. Rollen passar dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT och som vill påverka både struktur, kvalitet och riktning i en komplex och samhällsviktig miljö.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du planerar, strukturerar och driver kravarbetet från nulägesanalys och börlägesanalys till kravspecifikation och upphandlingsunderlag.
  • Du samlar in behov genom workshops, intervjuer, dokumentstudier och vid behov djupintervjuer med användare.
  • Du stöttar processkartläggning end-to-end och identifierar flaskhalsar, väntetider, manuella moment, rotorsaker och förbättringsområden.
  • Du analyserar vad som bör lösas genom processförändring och vad som bör hanteras med systemstöd eller automatisering.
  • Du dokumenterar och strukturerar verksamhetskrav och IT-krav samt bryter ned dem i funktionella och icke-funktionella krav.
  • Du tar fram use case och användarfall för prioriterade ärendeflöden.
  • Du etablerar arbetssätt för prioritering, spårbarhet, ändringshantering, beslutslogg och kravägarskap.
  • Du definierar acceptanskriterier för centrala krav och bidrar till kvalitetssäkring inför upphandling.
  • Du fungerar som brygga mellan verksamhet och IT och samarbetar nära bland annat handläggare, jurister, processägare och arkitekter.
Krav
  • Du har genomfört minst två (2) uppdrag under de senaste fem (5) åren i rollen som ansvarig eller ledande kravanalytiker vid framtagande av kravunderlag inför upphandling, anskaffning eller systembyte av ärendehanteringssystem eller annat jämförbart komplext verksamhetssystem.
  • Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att ta fram kravunderlag och kravspecifikationer som har använts i ett upphandlingsunderlag i en offentlig upphandling eller annan jämförbar formaliserad anskaffning av verksamhetssystem.
  • Minst ett (1) sådant uppdrag har avsett statlig myndighet, kommun eller region.
  • Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet från minst två (2) uppdrag av att leda processkartläggning av nuläge och börläge samt omsätta detta till funktionella och icke-funktionella krav, inklusive use case eller användarfall, acceptanskriterier och kravspårbarhet. Dessa uppdrag får inte vara äldre än fem (5) år.
  • Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att i kravarbete beakta och formulera krav kopplade till informationssäkerhet, loggning, spårbarhet och dataskydd i samband med upphandling eller förändring av verksamhetssystem.
  • Du uttrycker dig mycket väl i tal och skrift på svenska och har goda kunskaper i tal och skrift på engelska.
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år
Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: Physician - Part Time
description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Physician to deliver Neko's preventive-care model to members in New York — using advanced, non-invasive technology and clinical expertise to identify health risks early and translate findings into action plans that genuinely change what a member does next. This is a deeply collaborative role at the intersection of clinical excellence, member experience, and a conviction that catching things early changes lives. You'll work closely with Operators, APPs, and cross-functional partners to deliver a seamless, insight-driven member experience.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Comprehensive preventive health screenings delivered using Neko's high-resolution skin imaging, cardiovascular assessments, and AI-powered decision support — with consistent quality across every member visit.

  • Personalized, action-oriented health plans created from screening data, translated into next steps the member actually takes — measured by member follow-through and downstream outcomes.

  • Member education on dermatological and cardiovascular risk factors and lifestyle strategies that lands — measured by how the member felt about the consultation, not just the clinical findings.

  • Clinical oversight and escalation support provided to APPs, raising the bar for clinical quality and team performance across the clinic.

  • Cross-functional collaboration with Operators, APPs, and care teams that improves continuity of care and the end-to-end member experience.

What We’re Hiring For

  • Genuine, personal commitment to preventive medicine — not just as a specialism, but as a way of practicing. You think it's wrong that this isn't how everyone practices medicine.

  • Member-first instinct — you take the member experience personally, not just procedurally, and measure a consultation's success by how the member felt, not only by the findings.

  • Team-lifting collaboration — you make the people around you better by showing up consistently, sharing what you know, and caring how the team performs as a whole.

Minimum Requirements

  • Active New York State medical license.

  • Board certified in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or equivalent.

  • At least 1+ year of post residency experience

  • Recent outpatient experience (at least a year in the past 5 years)

  • Comfort working in a tech-forward, fast-moving clinical environment.

  • Availability to work Fridays and Saturdays from 7:00am-4:30pm

Benefits

  • Complimentary full Neko scan for you and eligible family members.

  • Flexible time off

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market‑facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.

Hiring Process

Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement

Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.

title: Finishing Operator - 11:20PM-7:30AM, Sun-Thurs
description:
The Finishing Operator has responsibility for functions occurring within the finishing center operations and may be assigned to duties that include packaging slit rolls to customer specifications, operating the manual packaging line, cutting cores, banding, etc. This requires the understanding of Avery Dennison standard packaging practices, and the exact program packing requirements. Higher level roles in the finishing operations include the operation of slitting, rewinding, and/or automated packaging equipment. This position may be required to rotate. This role will be on C Shift 11:20PM-7:30AM, Sun-Thurs.

Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Activities and duties may vary depending upon site specific needs. Essential functions may include, but are not limited to:

  • Sort, label, and package finished goods for shipment per customer specifications, quality requirements, and standard practices
  • Inspect general appearance of finished product
  • Keep area supplied with necessary packaging materials
  • Prepare cores for machine operators
  • Communicate and coordinate necessary information to appropriate shift/department personnel to ensure effective operations
  • Track multiple orders being packed at one time.
  • Perform duties to continuously improve quality and productivity
  • Maintain a clean, safe work area
  • Perform 5S duties and audits
  • Assist in equipment maintenance activities as directed
  • Participate in group problem-solving teams and continuous improvement activities.
  • Perform all other duties assigned by Supervisor

Minimum Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent (GED) or 3+ years of relevant manufacturing work experience.
  • Must be able to follow written and oral instruction.
  • Must regard safety as a core value; must serve as role model for other employees and encourage adherence to safety practices, policies and procedures.
  • Must have strong service and quality focus; address issues effectively when problems arise and take initiative to understand root cause, then communicate / education team in a timely manner.
  • Must be able to actively contribute in a team based environment; encourage open communication and positive interaction with peers and management to effectively reach a common goal.
  • Must demonstrate proficiency in essential tasks of the job and a willingness to learn and share knowledge; must take initiative to cross-train and sustain acquired skills.
  • Must have demonstrated record of flexibility and dependability in order to support production and customer focus.
  • Must be able and willing to work overtime, including short-notice requests.
  • Must demonstrate proficiency with computer applications, especially strong MFG Pro transactional skills.
  • Must be able to obtain Lift Truck Operator’s license.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

Preferred Requirements:

  • 3-5+ year’s previous experience.
  • Solid interpersonal skills, mathematical aptitude, mechanical/technical aptitude and logical problem solving skills.
  • Skilled in working independently in a safe and timely manner necessary.
  • Be motivated towards productivity, safety and quality improvements
  • Experience leading continuous improvement efforts and knowledgeable about ELS Operating Principles preferred.
  • Adaptive, flexible, able to handle ambiguity.
  • Experience working in a team environment.

NOTE: The physical requirements of this role may vary by location. A detailed listing of the physical requirements may be obtained from the local Human Resource contact or the site Occupational Health Nurse.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or other protected status. EEOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.


As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and productive work environment, Avery Dennison requires all final candidates to successfully complete a comprehensive background check and a drug screening. These checks are conducted post-offer and are a condition of employment. All results will be considered in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

title: Engineering Operations Technician
description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

- Technical writing to support change management program

- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

- Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

title: Senior Lead - HR Shared Services
description:
We are looking for a Senior Lead - Shared Services to join our Human Resources group as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

You're building people systems. But are you building the ones that keep 10 million customers' employee promises intact?

M-KOPA has just crossed 10 million customers across Africa, unlocked over $2 billion in credit, and helped 86% of those customers report a better quality of life — many for the first time in their financial lives. None of that happens without an HR Shared Services engine that never drops a beat: contracts issued on time, payroll inputs correct the first time, employee relations cases handled with care and closed cleanly, records that hold up to any audit. That engine is what you'd be running.

What makes this role different

Most HR Shared Services roles are measured on tickets closed. This one is measured on trust — the trust that a contract is accurate, a payroll input is audit-ready, and an employee relations case is handled fairly and confidentially. You'll own the full employee lifecycle operation: onboarding and probation, contracting, records, payroll inputs (including commissions and bonuses), benefits administration (medical, pension, group life, and wellness), offboarding, and ER case administration. You'll also have real license to use data and automation to make that operation better — this role explicitly includes building dashboards, spotting root causes of recurring errors, and piloting AI-enabled workflows with proper governance, not just running the process as inherited.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Head of HR Shared Services

What we need from you

  • Accountability for end-to-end HR Shared Services delivery — records, contracts, payroll inputs, offboarding, and employee relations case administration — with a track record of hitting SLA and quality targets in a fast-moving, multi-country environment.

  • A current Chartered HR Practitioner status with the Chartered Institute of Human Resource Management, Ghana (CIHRM Ghana), paired with demonstrable experience translating policy and business changes into operational processes, templates, and controls that people actually follow.

  • Comfort using data to diagnose service problems and build simple dashboards, plus experience identifying or piloting automation and AI use cases within HR operations — with the judgement to apply proper governance around accuracy, bias, privacy, and auditability.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice.
