  • Provides genuine hospitality and recognition, acts as host/hostess in the work area. Promotes hotel services and products
  • Takes orders for, serves (where applicable, prepares) food and beverages to guests as per hotel standards in a friendly, timely and efficient manner
  • Possesses a high degree of product knowledge and relevant technical skills. Keeps abreast of events in the hotel
  • Anticipates guest needs, offers suggestions and ascertains satisfaction
  • Takes ownership of guest concerns and requests and acts decisively to ensure guest satisfaction when glitches occur
  • Describes food & beverage menu items with interesting and vivid descriptions in a concise, informative and appropriate manner
  • Is highly sensitive to guest preferences; assists in compiling guest history; offers a special service touch when an opportunity is presented
  • Requisitions supplies according to established procedures
  • Accurately posts guest checks, processes payments and adheres to related control procedures in a vigilant manner

Special Requirements

  • Has 1 -2 years of relevant experience in 5 star hotels/resorts or reputable stand alone restaurants
  • Possesses excellent English, math and psychometric abilities
  • Possesses aptitude and upward mobility.
  • Technical education in Hospitality Management is preferred

description:

Job Description:

Job Summary
As an HSE Management Systems Specialist at Hitachi, Ltd., you will be instrumental in developing, implementing, and maintaining robust Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) management systems across our operations. You will ensure compliance with global and local regulations, Hitachi standards, and drive continuous improvement in HSE performance.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain the company's HSE Management System (e.g., ISO 45001, ISO 14001) in line with Hitachi's global policies and industry best practices.

  • Conduct regular audits and inspections to assess HSE compliance, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.

  • Lead the investigation of HSE incidents, near misses, and non-conformities, determining root causes and implementing preventative measures.

  • Develop and deliver HSE training programs for employees at all levels, fostering a strong safety culture.

  • Monitor and analyze HSE performance data, preparing reports and presenting findings to management.

  • Stay abreast of changes in HSE legislation, regulations, and industry standards, advising on necessary adjustments to management systems.

  • Collaborate with various departments (e.g., engineering, operations, HR) to integrate HSE considerations into all business processes.

  • Manage and update HSE documentation, including policies, procedures, risk assessments, and emergency plans.

  • Support the preparation for and participation in external HSE audits and certifications.

  • This role drives a strong safety culture, minimizes workplace risks, promotes employee well-being, and ensures environmental sustainability across operations.

  • The person will be responsible for driving HSE processes, audits, trainings, policies, procedures, standards, trainings, and awareness

  • Must demonstrate leadership skills, collaboration, cultural flexibility/adaptability, etc.

  • Must bring innovative ideas, digitalization, process / system improvement, etc


Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in occupational health and safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 13-19 years of experience in HSE management systems development and implementation, preferably within a multinational or industrial environment.

  • Proven experience with ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 standards; lead auditor certification is a significant advantage.

  • Strong understanding of relevant HSE legislation and regulations (e.g., OSHA, EPA, local environmental laws).

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with all levels of the organization.

  • Proficiency in conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, and HSE audits.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Strong presentation and training delivery skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Accessibility and reasonable accommodation

You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a general inquiry form on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.


This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.


Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment

As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.

Background Screening and Security Checks

As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.

For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. title: Lagerarbetare - Malmö - Extrajobb

Plats: Malmö

Anställningsform: Extrajobb / behovsanställning

Arbetstider: Flexibla arbetstider – dag, kväll eller helg

title: Systemtestare
description:
Sveriges a-kassor söker nu en Systemtestare

Arbetsmarknaden förändras i allt snabbare takt och arbetslöshetskassornas uppdrag har kanske aldrig varit viktigare.

Det finns 24 a-kassor i Sverige. Sveriges a-kassor är deras gemensamma service- och intresseorganisation. Det betyder att vi hjälper a-kassorna med bland annat IT-utveckling, utbildning och opinionsbildning. Syftet är att a-kassorna ska kunna administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen på ett så snabbt och effektivt sätt som möjligt. Sveriges a-kassor sitter i nya fräscha lokaler vid Skanstull samt är en modern arbetsgivare som månar om sina anställda. Vi tycker arbetslivet ska vara hållbart över tid och erbjuder flexibilitet och goda villkor för våra anställda.

På Sveriges a-kassor jobbar vi med att vidareutveckla och förvalta de IT-system som a-kassorna nyttjar i sitt dagliga arbete med att administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen för sina medlemmar.

Vi söker nu en erfaren systemtestare som ska förstärka vår testgrupp. Du kommer att arbeta i en stimulerande miljö hos en viktig samhällsaktör med mycket bra villkor och goda möjligheter att påverka dina arbetsuppgifter och utveckla dig själv. Vi har lokaler centralt på Södermalm i Stockholm men det finns även goda möjligheter till att arbeta på distans.

Tillsammans med övriga anställda och konsulter i testgruppen kommer du att arbeta framför allt med manuella funktionella tester men även med tekniska tester.

Tjänsten är på heltid (37,5 timmar i veckan). Första arbetsdag enligt överenskommelse.

Övrig information
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som startar med 6 månaders provanställning.

Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-09-04. Intervjuer hålls löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag så skicka in din ansökan redan nu. Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta

HR: Nils Boix-Vives, nils.boix-vives@sverigesakassor.se

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innefatta:

  • Avvikelserapportering och omtester

  • Rapportering av teststatus till berörda

  • Dokumentation av testresultat

title: VVS-montør til service og spjæld i Hornsyld
description:
Vil du have firmabil, frihed under ansvar og ordentlig løn?

Vi mangler en VVS-montør til nybyg, renovering og service i Hornsyld.

Du bliver en del af et VVS-hold, hvor hverdagen spænder fra små reparationer til totalrenoveringer. Kunderne er både private, erhverv og industri, så du får en bred rolle med mange typer opgaver. Arbejdet ligger omkring Hornsyld og omegn, og du møder både planlagte projekter og spjæld der skal klares hurtigt. Opgaverne bliver løst med moderne metoder, og der er en klar forventning om stabilt håndværk hver gang.

Du skifter mellem at køre selv og arbejde med makker, alt efter hvad opgaven kræver. Det passer godt til dig, der gerne vil have ansvar uden at stå alene med det hele. Firmabilen følger med jobbet, og kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi du kører ud til opgaverne.

Det får du

Løn: 220-250 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Hornsyld og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 15 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Nybyg, renovering, service og spjæld

Din hverdag

Nogle opgaver er planlagt som nybyg eller renovering, mens andre kommer ind som service og spjæld. Når du kører alene, holder du selv styr på rækkefølgen, og når opgaven kræver to mand, tager du den med makker. Det giver en hverdag, hvor du både skal kunne tænke selv og samarbejde ordentligt.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder på nybyg med VVS-installationer
  • Løser renoveringer i boliger og erhverv
  • Tager spjæld og serviceopgaver hos kunder
  • Monterer sanitet og arbejder med bad
  • Servicerer varme- og energiløsninger

Hvis en opgave viser sig at være større end aftalt, siger du til i tide. Det vigtigste er, at kunderne får en løsning der holder, og at du ikke afleverer noget halvt.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som VVS-montør
  • Kan køre selv ud og løse serviceopgaver
  • Kan arbejde både alene og med makker
  • Taler ordentligt med kunderne

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både nybyg, renovering og spjæld før. Men det vigtigste er, at du møder stabilt og tager ansvar for det du laver.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: NEX Electrical Voltage Tech STX
description:
This posting is for Electrical Voltage Technicians supporting NexTier field operations out of Pearsall, TX

The Qualified Electrical Technician is responsible for maintaining and troubleshooting medium and low voltage systems, control voltage equipment, and computer systems used in oilfield operations. This role involves performing intermediate to advanced tests, maintenance, calibration, and repairs on electrical and electromechanical equipment at field locations while adhering to safety standards and company policies.

Detailed Description:

  • Perform regular and scheduled maintenance on hydraulic fracturing equipment to ensure it remains in good working order.
  • Perform preventive and general maintenance on medium and low voltage switchgear, breakers, power transformers, AC drives, starters, motors, power cables, and disconnects.
  • Troubleshoot issues with power control systems and complex equipment related to switchgear, breakers, power transformers, AC drives, starters, motors, power cables, and disconnects.
  • Perform preventive maintenance and troubleshoot issues with data acquisition, control systems, and network operations.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of proper grounding, cable meggering, and lockout/tagout procedures.
  • Assemble, install, or repair wiring, electrical, and electronic components as needed.
  • Properly use various testers (multimeters, meggers, oscilloscopes) and hand tools to complete assignments.
  • Safely execute wiring techniques for DC/AC systems ranging from 12V DC to 13.8 kV single- and three-phase.
  • Perform emergency repairs on electronics and equipment in the field or yard as required.
  • Ensure proper and safe cable routing.
  • Diagnose electrical problems and determine solutions using wiring schematics, repair manuals, and part catalogs.
  • Inspect, operate, and test equipment and components to identify and correct malfunctions.
  • Test equipment at the manufacturer’s facility to ensure it meets company standards before field deployment.
  • Document repairs, inspections, and testing for all equipment.
  • Maintain a safe work environment, adhering to all QHSE requirements.
  • Perform other job duties as assigned.
  • Participate in or lead safety meetings, hazard hunts, and ensure JSAs are followed.
  • Follow established job policies, procedures, and guidelines, and comply with applicable regulations.

Job Requirements:
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of medium and low voltage electronic test instruments and tools.
  • Familiarity with instrumentation such as flow meters, transducers, densimeters, and controllers.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • Understanding of hydraulic applications as controlled by electronic components and systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics/drawings, P&IDs, and other complex diagrams.
  • Knowledge of networking and radio communications.
  • Strong work ethic, adaptability, and willingness to learn.
  • Ability to read and interpret safety manuals, operational instructions, and policies/procedures.
  • Capability to write reports and simple correspondence and communicate effectively with coworkers, customers, and management.
  • Competence in reading blueprints and schematics for component troubleshooting.
  • Commitment to promoting safety awareness and following QHSE policies and procedures.
  • Knowledge of IEEE 1584 and NFPA 70E standards.

Language Comprehension:
Must understand and speak English at a level sufficient to issue, receive, and respond to both safety and operations-related directions.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Associate degree or relevant industry experience required.
  • Experience: 2 to 7 years of relevant experience required.

Additional Details:
The Qualified Electrical Technician plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability and efficiency of electrical systems in oilfield operations. Success in this position requires a technical background, attention to detail, adherence to safety standards, and the ability to adapt to changing conditions. The minimum qualifications differ by level, reflecting progressive experience and responsibilities.

title: VP Care Delivery
description:
Who We Are

Protera Health is a fast-growing digital health company reimagining musculoskeletal care. Founded by orthopedic surgeons and value-based care experts, we combine technology, evidence-based clinical pathways, and personalized human care team support to help patients with back, neck, and joint conditions improve function, reduce pain, and live better lives.

Our multidisciplinary virtual care team includes medical providers, physical therapists, health coaches, and other healthcare professionals. Our aim is simple: treat patients as we would our own loved ones.

The Role

Protera Health is seeking a Vice President of Care Delivery to lead our virtual clinical team and own the day-to-day delivery of patient care.

This leader will be accountable for the clinical organization end to end, including workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, clinician management, quality, patient experience, clinical performance, and care-delivery improvement initiatives.

The ideal candidate is experienced in musculoskeletal care, and one who has worn many hats through progression into clinical leadership. We will also consider an exceptional healthcare leader with substantial experience directly managing multidisciplinary clinical teams.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the direction for the clinical organization while remaining close enough to the work to support clinicians, address performance concerns, resolve barriers, and ensure that clinical initiatives are successfully implemented.

What You Will Own

Clinical Team Leadership

  • Serve as the primary leader and manager of Protera’s Physicians, Advanced Practice Providers, Physical Therapists, coaches, and other care-delivery team members.

  • Establish clear expectations, accountability, communication practices, and performance standards.

  • Coach and develop clinicians while promoting clinical excellence, professionalism, collaboration, and self-management.

  • Conduct performance reviews and promptly address performance, conduct, or reliability concerns.

  • Build an effective clinical leadership structure as the team grows.

Hiring, Staffing, and Capacity

  • Develop clinical staffing and capacity plans based on enrollment, patient demand, growth projections, access standards, quality, and cost.

  • Own clinician selection in partnership with the Operations and People teams.

  • Recruit, interview, hire, onboard, and retain high-performing clinicians.

  • Ensure that new clinicians are appropriately trained and prepared for independent patient care.

  • Maintain reliable coverage while balancing clinician workload, patient access, quality, and efficiency.

Quality and Clinical Performance

  • Own the consistent delivery of high-quality, patient-centered care across the clinical organization.

  • Establish and monitor standards for clinical quality, documentation, patient experience, and clinician performance.

  • Lead chart audits, case reviews, quality-improvement efforts, and clinician performance plans.

  • Monitor clinical outcomes, patient engagement, satisfaction, access, productivity, documentation timeliness, and escalation trends.

  • Identify performance gaps and implement corrective and preventive actions.

  • Partner with physician leadership on clinical protocols, complex cases, scope-of-practice matters, and clinical governance.

Care-Delivery Operations

  • Ensure patients move reliably through the care journey from initial evaluation through treatment, follow-up, escalation, and program completion.

  • Improve clinical workflows, scheduling practices, interdisciplinary handoffs, and escalation pathways.

  • Resolve day-to-day barriers affecting patients or clinicians.

  • Ensure that clinical policies and standard operating procedures are practical, current, and consistently followed.

  • Build care-delivery systems that support growth without compromising clinical quality or patient experience.

Projects and Cross-Functional Execution

  • Lead clinical initiatives from design through implementation, measurement, and refinement.

  • Translate company priorities into clear projects, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data, Operations, Enrollment, and Client teams to improve programs and launch new services.

  • Represent the clinical team in decisions involving workflows, platform functionality, patient experience, and service design.

  • Ensure that new initiatives are effectively adopted by the clinical team and produce their intended results.

Who You Are

  • Seven or more years of experience in digital health care delivery operations, or a related field.

  • Significant experience directly managing clinicians and multidisciplinary healthcare teams.

  • Demonstrated success hiring, onboarding, coaching, evaluating, and developing clinical team members.

  • Experience building scalable clinical workflows, quality programs, and performance-management systems.

  • Strong understanding of clinical quality, patient safety, documentation, access, and patient experience.

  • Track record of owning KPIs and delivering measurable improvements.

  • Ability to lead multiple projects from concept through execution.

  • Strong judgment, organization, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and responsibilities evolve.

  • Hands-on, accountable, collaborative, and willing to personally address problems when needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in musculoskeletal, orthopedic, rehabilitation, or pain care.

  • Experience leading a remote or multistate clinical workforce.

  • Background in digital health, virtual care, value-based care, or technology-enabled healthcare.

  • Experience with patient-reported outcomes, clinical analytics, and quality improvement.

Logistics

  • Work Environment: Fully remote, requiring a private professional workspace and reliable high-speed internet. Occasional travel may be required for leadership meetings, team gatherings, or company event

  • Authorized and able to work in the Unites States

Why Protera

  • Lead and shape a growing multidisciplinary clinical organization.

  • Build the systems that determine how patients experience their care.

  • Work directly with experienced clinical, operational, and technology leaders.

  • Fully remote work: work from your home or other private, secured area to help fit your lifestyle

  • Competitive compensation, equity and bonus opportunities based on your experience and results delivered

  • Paid Time Off (PTO): Generous paid time off that includes vacation days and holidays

  • Equity options to benefit from company growth

  • Healthcare benefits and 401(k) retirement plan to keep you well and planning for the future

  • Being part of a mission-driven company focused on delivering the care we would want for our own families.


Note: This job description is intended as a guideline and may evolve based on organizational needs. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed based on business considerations. Compensation may vary from the target range and is based on multiple factors, including individual experience, location, pay-equity considerations, and other relevant considerations.

Protera Health is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage respect and harmony among employees and prohibit harassment or discrimination of any kind.

title: Mission Partner - Policing & UK Government
description:
About Adarga

Adarga is one of the UK’s most exciting Artificial Intelligence (AI) companies. Headquartered in London, and with an outstation in the US, Adarga works at the cutting edge of the AI revolution, specialising in information intelligence. Our technology addresses the integral need for defence, national security, and commercial organisations to interpret fast-proliferating, worldwide data sources at breakneck speed - a vital capability for understanding emerging threats, mitigating risk, and remaining competitive in today’s increasingly complex geopolitical environment.

Adarga’s world-class team has combined cutting-edge natural language processing, machine learning, and network science technology into a fully scalable software product that can extract, connect, and contextualise information at a speed and scale previously unimaginable.

The role

We are looking for a dedicated Mission Partner to join our established sales team in London, focused on the wider public sector, including Policing and the UK Intelligence Community (UKIC). You will build out and convert an exciting pipeline across police forces, law enforcement bodies, Home Office, and the UK’s intelligence and security agencies, partnering closely with clients to align Adarga’s technology to their most strategic requirements. As Adarga’s footprint grows internationally, this role may also involve engaging European defence, security, and NATO-adjacent bodies. You will report to the CRO and join the team of Mission Growth experts.

What will you be doing?

  • Develop a deep understanding of Adarga’s product offering and how to align it to the most strategic requirements of Policing, Law Enforcement, and UK Intelligence Community customers

  • Plan and implement a full-cycle sales strategy targeting new customer acquisition and expansion within the install base across regional police forces, the National Crime Agency, Home Office, and UKIC

  • Apply your track record of implementing AI, Machine Learning, and software solutions into National Security, Law Enforcement, and UK Central Government

  • Build industry knowledge that leads to improved solution selling, strategic alignment, and growth across multiple public sector segments

  • Develop deep insights regarding customer use cases, internal decision-making nuances, budget cycles, and other key information necessary to close the sale and shape the success of this vertical

  • Consistently ensure a balanced pipeline of multiple opportunities against quarterly and annual growth targets, working closely with sales and marketing

  • Plan and execute events to help build fruitful external relationships across law enforcement and the wider public sector

What do you need?

  • Excellent knowledge of the Policing, Law Enforcement, and/or UK Intelligence Community sectors

  • Deep knowledge of relevant commercial frameworks and commercial routes in UK HMG (e.g. Crown Commercial Service frameworks, G-Cloud)

  • A proven track record of selling enterprise software/SaaS solutions in a fast-paced, competitive market

  • Demonstrated success selling complex SaaS solutions, ideally using the MEDDIC sales methodology or similar industry methodology practices

  • Deep understanding of the complexities around deploying products and technology integrations into National Security and Law Enforcement organisations

  • Existing relationships across Policing, Home Office, or UKIC (highly desirable)

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to operate in a collaborative team environment

  • Experience working within a scale-up organisation (highly desirable)

This role requires experience within the public sector vertical, ideally across Policing or UKIC. This is a hybrid opportunity with an expectation of being in our London office twice a week. Travel to related client sites (UK only) is expected.

The successful candidate will possess strong analytical and financial modeling skills, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for understanding consumer behavior, emerging brands, retail trends, and product innovation.

The successful candidate will work directly alongside a seasoned Senior Analyst with 26 years of sell-side experience and 18 years at Jefferies, gaining valuable mentorship while contributing to a highly regarded research franchise.   • vystyti klientų savitarnos sprendimus, paslaugų katalogą ir informacijos prieinamumą, inicijuoti klientų aptarnavimo procesų skaitmenizavimą ir automatizavimą;
  • valdyti gamintojų, vartotojų ir kaupimo įrenginius plėtojančių klientų prijungimo prie elektros perdavimo tinklo paslaugas bei užtikrinti susijusių įsipareigojimų vykdymą ir teisės aktuose nustatytų terminų laikymąsi;
  • kurti, stebėti ir analizuoti klientų patirties bei paslaugų veiklos rodiklius, jų pagrindu inicijuojant procesų ir paslaugų tobulinimą;
  • spręsti sudėtingas ir nestandartines klientų situacijas, konstruktyviai derinti lūkesčius, šalinti procesines kliūtis ir užtikrinti sklandesnę kliento patirtį, laikantis reguliacinių ir techninių reikalavimų.
  • aukštasis universitetinis išsilavinimas;
  • sėkminga B2B klientų santykių, klientų patirties ar paslaugų valdymo patirtis vidutinėje arba didelėje organizacijoje, kuriant ir plėtojant ilgalaikius santykius su klientais ir partneriais, suprantant jų verslo poreikius bei valdant lūkesčius;
  • B2B klientų santykių valdymo ir jų poreikių koordinavimo patirtis, įgyta klientų valdymo, pardavimų ar projektų valdymo srityje;
  • kompleksinių klientų aptarnavimo ir paslaugų teikimo procesų valdymo patirtis, gebėjimas identifikuoti kliūtis ir inicijuoti procesų tobulinimą;
  • vadovavimo patirtis, gebėjimas telkti, ugdyti komandą ir vesti ją pokyčių bei rezultatų link;
  • patirtis koordinuojant skirtingų funkcijų komandas ir užtikrinant efektyvų bendradarbiavimą siekiant bendro rezultato;
  • sisteminis ir analitinis mąstymas, gebėjimas matyti visą kliento kelionę, numatyti kelis žingsnius į priekį, nustatyti prioritetus ir kryptingai siekti rezultatų;
  • stiprūs komunikacijos, derybų ir lūkesčių valdymo įgūdžiai, gebėjimas konstruktyviai spręsti sudėtingas situacijas;
  • proaktyvumas, orientacija į klientui kuriamą vertę ir rezultatą, iniciatyvumas įgyvendinant pokyčius;
  • puikios lietuvių kalbos ir labai geros anglų kalbos žinios.

Privalumai:

  • patirtis energetikos, infrastruktūros ar kitoje techniškai sudėtingoje ir / ar reguliuojamoje B2B aplinkoje;
  • patirtis dirbant su verslo klientais, investuotojais, valstybės ar savivaldos institucijomis;
  • klientų savitarnos, CRM, paslaugų katalogo ar kitų klientų ir paslaugų valdymo įrankių diegimo ar vystymo patirtis;
  • techninis smalsumas ir gebėjimas greitai perprasti sudėtingus technologinius, infrastruktūros bei reguliacinius procesus.

Prisijungusi (-ęs) prie mūsų komandos tapsi organizacijos, kuriančios Lietuvos energetikos ateitį, dalimi. Mums svarbu, kad kolegės (-os) ne tik prisidėtų prie itin svarbių ir visai Lietuvai reikšmingų projektų, bet augtų ir jaustųsi įgalinti.

Mes siūlome:

  • kurti ir įgyvendinti projektus, keičiančius Lietuvos energetikos sistemą;
  • galimybę auginti savo kompetencijas, įsitraukiant į unikalius projektus, dirbant kartu su savo srities profesionalais;
  • mokymus profesiniam ir asmeniniam tobulėjimui;
  • dirbti lanksčiai – derinant darbą biure ir nuotoliniu būdu;
  • karjeros galimybes „EPSO-G“ įmonių grupėje;
  • papildomą sveikatos draudimą;
  • socialinių naudų paketą, kuris suteikia paramą darbuotojams ir jų šeimos svarbiomis gyvenimo akimirkomis;
  • pozityvią darbo aplinką, kur kiekvienas gali jausti svarbus, girdimas ir vertinamas;
  • papildomas apmokamas atostogas.

Siūlomas atlygis:

6600-8800 EUR (su mokesčiais), priklausomai nuo kompetencijų ir patirties.

Vertiname darbuotojų pastangas ir už individualius bei komandos pasiektus rezultatus taikome papildomą finansinį skatinimą pagal „EPSO-G“ grupės vidinę tvarką.

Dokumentų pateikimo terminas iki 2026 m. rugsėjo 07 d. imtinai.

Dokumentus prašome siųsti el. paštu ina@masterclass.lt temoje nurodant „Atranka į „Litgrid“ Klientų paslaugų valdymo centro vadovės (-o) pareigas“.

title: Vehicle Mechatronics Architecture / Integration Engineer
description:
Your Impact

As a Mechatronics Concept Engineer, you will be at the heart of shaping the next generation of commercial vehicles, working at the intersection of software, electronics (ECUs), and mechanical integration.

In this role, you transform future mobility trends, emerging technologies, and customer needs into innovative vehicle concepts and system architectures. You will play a key role in ensuring that Daimler Truck remains at the forefront of industry evolution — from software-defined vehicles and connectivity to data-driven services and intelligent transport solutions.

Rather than focusing on detailed development, your mission is to define strong, forward-looking concepts, enabling engineering teams worldwide to deliver scalable and competitive solutions.

Key Responsibilities

- Define, describe, and continuously refine holistic vehicle concepts integrating hardware and software systems
- Collaborate closely with system experts (e.g., TT/S, E/E, software, and integration teams) to align concepts across domains
- Translate customer, market, and technology trends into clear and structured system-level requirements
- Drive concept definition in key areas such as:
- Mechatronics and E/E Architecture (concept level)
- Global Feature Lists and EE compatibility
- Low Voltage (LV) Architecture concepts
- Cross-domain mechatronic integration strategies
- Define Powertrain-related system concepts and performance hypotheses
- Act as a key contributor in connecting vehicle-level thinking with system-level execution
- Support global alignment across development teams, ensuring consistency in concepts and approaches
- Contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of concept development methodologies

Your Profile

- University degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or similar
- Strong and holistic understanding of complete vehicle systems, with focus on E/E and software integration
- Proven experience in vehicle or system-level development, ideally in a cross-functional environment
- Experience in translating complex requirements into structured technical concepts
- Solid knowledge of:
- Functional Safety (ISO 26262)
- Automotive software and E/E architectures
- Vehicle communication networks (CAN, Ethernet)
- Experience in TT/S (Truck Technology / Systems) is a strong advantage
- Exposure to tech-driven environments, digital ecosystems, or connectivity topics is a plus
- Strong analytical mindset combined with creativity at system level
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across domains
- Ability to thrive in a global, fast-evolving engineering environment
- Curiosity and passion for future technologies, innovation, and mobility transformation

title: Smed til alsidigt smedearbejde i Herning
description:
Er du smed og kan du lide en hverdag, hvor du selv har fingrene i arbejdet og får ansvar for dine egne opgaver?

Her får du mulighed for at blive en del af en veletableret metalvirksomhed i Herning, hvor der arbejdes med mange forskellige typer smedeopgaver. Hverdagen er alsidig, og du kommer til at arbejde med både sort stål og rustfri materialer.

Der er fokus på godt håndværk og kvalitet, og du bliver en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor der er plads til at tage ansvar for sine egne opgaver. Virksomheden arbejder blandt andet med konstruktioner, plade- og rørbearbejdning samt forskellige specialopgaver.

Det kommer du til at lave

  • MIG/MAG svejsning

  • Elektrode svejsning

  • TIG svejsning, hvis du har erfaring med det

  • Fremstilling og samling af konstruktioner og emner

  • Arbejde ud fra tekniske tegninger

  • Tilpasning, montage og færdiggørelse af emner

  • Kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde.

Det lægger vi vægt på

  • Du har erfaring som smed eller fra en tilsvarende stilling

  • Du kan svejse med MIG/MAG og elektrode

  • Du har gerne kendskab til TIG svejsning

  • Du har erfaring med arbejde i sort stål og gerne også rustfrit

  • Du kan læse og forstå tekniske tegninger

  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Du er mødestabil og går op i at aflevere et ordentligt stykke arbejde

  • Du har lyst til at være en del af et fagligt stærkt team.

Det tilbyder virksomheden

  • En stilling med alsidige smedeopgaver

  • En hverdag med både sort og rustfrit stål

  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø med dygtige kollegaer

  • Moderne produktionsfaciliteter og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med forskellige typer konstruktioner og specialopgaver

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer samt pension og gode ansættelsesvilkår.

Har du spørgsmål, eller ønsker du at høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Møller hos BECH Personale, afdeling Byg og Metal, på telefon 72 10 85 47 i vores åbningstid:

Mandag - torsdag kl. 07:00 - 15:00
Fredag kl. 07:00 - 14:00.

BECH Personale står for rekrutteringen på vegne af vores samarbejdspartner. Alle ansøgninger og henvendelser behandles naturligvis fortroligt.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne dit CV allerede i dag.

Vi har ikke behov for en ansøgning. Dit CV er nok til at komme i betragtning.

title: Snickare till snickeri och byggbolag
description:
Din nya arbetsplats!

Lövdals Snickeri är ett snickeri- och byggbolag som arbetar med hyresgästanpassningar och specialsnickerier. Vi planerar och genomför små som stora byggprojekt åt framför allt företag. Framtagning av specialsnickeri gör vi i samråd med beställare och arkitekt där vi under hela processen bidrar med vår kunskap som vilar på gedigen tradition.

Våra kunder anlitar oss för att de vill ha en hög standard vad gäller service, utförandet av arbetet och en perfekt leverans.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I din roll som snickare kommer du ha ansvar över dina uppdrag samt arbeta självgående. Du kommer ha ansvar för att dina projekt drivs från ax till limpa. På daglig basis ska du se till att tidsplan följs, rätt material är på plats samt kontrollera att projektet sker enligt ritning, riktlinjer och lagar.

Vem vi söker

Som person är du lösningsorienterad, strukturerad och proaktiv. Du gillar att arbeta metodiskt och organiserat, har ett gediget intresse för bygg och snickeri samt strävar alltid efter bästa möjliga leverans. I alla lägen ser du till arbetsgivarens intressen och är en stolt representant för företaget. Ditt driv inspirerar dina kollegor och du värdesätter kvalité.

På Lövdals arbetar du i en familjär atmosfär där det din höga professionalism värderas högt. En välmående arbetsplats präglas av välmående medarbetare. Lövdals vet att en del av vår styrka är våra medarbetare där vi håller högt i tak inför alla möjligheter och utmaningar.

Vi söker en person som har lång erfarenhet med bred kunskap och hög servicenivå som kan arbeta helt självgående men även ta ansvar för andra medarbetare och underentreprenörer.

Om du tycker du passar in på beskrivningen i annonsen så är du välkommen att skicka in din ansökan. Ansökningar granskas kontinuerligt och intervjuer sker löpande. Anställningen startar efter vald kandidat.

title: Senior Project Leader Infra CAPEX
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a Project Leader – Infrastructure CAPEX who is technically credible, delivery-focused, and collaborative to join our Engineering, Sites & Facilities team, based at our UCB campus located in Braine-l’Alleud, Walloon Brabant, Belgium.

About the role:
As Project Leader – Infrastructure CAPEX, you will lead complex infrastructure, utilities, and site facility projects from concept through execution and handover to operations. You will be the key point of accountability for project delivery, ensuring projects meet safety, quality, compliance, budget, and timeline expectations. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, engineering partners, contractors, and suppliers to deliver projects that support UCB’s long-term infrastructure strategy.

Who you will work with:
You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Engineering, Operations, Quality, EHS, Procurement, Finance, Maintenance, and Automation. You will also partner with external engineering firms, EPC/EPCM contractors, consultants, suppliers, and site leadership to ensure successful project outcomes and alignment with business priorities.

What you will do:

  • You will lead strategic infrastructure CAPEX projects from initial concept to operational handover.
  • You will ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance.
  • You will develop and maintain project execution plans, schedules, budgets, and governance frameworks.
  • You will manage project risks, changes, issues, and stakeholder expectations throughout delivery.
  • You will provide technical leadership and challenge engineering solutions to ensure long-term value.
  • You will coordinate internal teams and external partners to achieve successful project outcomes.

Interested? For this role, we are looking for the following education, experience, and skills:

  • Master's degree in Engineering, preferably Civil, Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical, or equivalent.
  • Proven experience delivering complex CAPEX projects in regulated industrial or pharmaceutical environments.
  • Strong expertise in project management, budgeting, cost control, and schedule management.
  • Solid understanding of infrastructure, buildings, utilities, engineering governance, and project controls.
  • Knowledge of cGMP, quality systems, HSE, and compliance requirements.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and decision-making skills.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

title: Maintenance Experience Coordinator
description:
About Clutch

We’re on a mission to reinvent the way people buy, sell, and own cars. Are you game?

Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car buying and selling experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that’s just the beginning.

Named three years in a row to the Globe & Mail’s list of the Top Growing Companies in Canada and also awarded spots on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50™ and Fast 500™ lists, we’re looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017 and currently services Ontario, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including D1 Capital, Altos Ventures, Canaan, Real Ventures, BrandProject, and BMO. To learn more, visit .

About the Role

We are on a mission to build a world-class team that drives innovation, growth, and excellence. As we scale rapidly, The Workplace Experience Coordinator is the owner of Clutch's headquarters workplace experience. This role is responsible for ensuring our downtown headquarters operates smoothly, efficiently, and professionally every day. From maintaining a clean, organized, and fully stocked office to coordinating vendors, managing facilities requests, and supporting employees, you'll help create an environment where people genuinely enjoy coming to work.

In addition, the role is responsible for the remote oversight and weekly inspection of a secondary off-site office facility located in Mississauga, Ontario.

This is a highly visible role that combines workplace hospitality, facilities coordination, office operations, vendor management, and administrative support. You'll work closely with the Real Estate, Facilities & Construction team while collaborating with IT, People Operations, Finance, Security, and external service providers.

The ideal candidate is someone who notices the little things before anyone else does, enjoys taking ownership, and finds satisfaction in solving problems before they become problems.

What You'll Do

Workplace Experience

Responsibilities include:

  • Own the day-to-day operation and presentation of the headquarters office.
  • Remotely oversight and weekly inspections of a second remote office facility.
  • Conduct daily walkthroughs to ensure the office is clean, organized, fully stocked, and operating at a high standard.
  • Keep kitchens, cafés, meeting rooms, collaboration spaces, and common areas clean, organized, and ready for use.
  • Load, unload, and run dishwashers throughout the day to maintain clean kitchens and prevent dishes from accumulating.
  • Restock snacks, beverages, coffee, tea, milk, kitchen supplies, and other pantry items.
  • Manage inventory levels and order workplace supplies, groceries, and consumables.
  • Ensure meeting rooms are reset and presentation-ready after each use.
  • Welcome visitors, candidates, customers, and vendors while providing a professional first impression of Clutch.
  • Coordinate employee lunches, celebrations, holiday decorations, recognition events, and workplace engagement initiatives.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve the employee experience and office environment.

Office Operations & Facilities

Responsibilities include:

  • Liaise with the landlord and property management regarding building maintenance, repairs, and operational issues.
  • Coordinate service providers including cleaners, HVAC contractors, electricians, plumbers, security vendors, and other maintenance contractors.
  • Track facilities issues through completion and ensure timely resolution.
  • Perform routine workplace inspections and proactively identify maintenance or safety concerns.
  • Coordinate office furniture repairs, workstation changes, and workplace moves.
  • Manage office access cards, keys, visitor access, and building communications.
  • Receive, organize, and distribute incoming mail, courier deliveries, and packages.
  • Coordinate outgoing shipments and returns.
  • Maintain office equipment and arrange repairs when required.
  • Support workplace health and safety initiatives, emergency preparedness, and office compliance programs.

Administrative & Team Support

Support the Real Estate, Facilities & Construction team (in various other offices) with day-to-day administrative coordination.

Responsibilities include:

  • Process invoices, purchase orders, and project expense documentation.
  • Obtain vendor quotations and assist with procurement activities.
  • Schedule meetings, coordinate calendars, and prepare meeting materials.
  • Maintain vendor records, contracts, lease documents, and workplace documentation.
  • Track action items and maintain project and facilities trackers.
  • Coordinate contractor access and building logistics for projects and maintenance activities.
  • Assist with budget tracking and departmental administrative tasks.

Project Coordination

Support workplace improvement initiatives and facility projects across Clutch.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assist with office renovations, workplace improvements, and furniture installations.
  • Coordinate deliveries and contractor schedules.
  • Support new office openings, expansions, and workplace changes.
  • Assist with workplace audits and facility inspections.
  • Provide operational support for special projects as assigned.

What We're Looking For

  • We're looking for someone who takes pride in creating exceptional workplaces.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Service-oriented and passionate about creating outstanding employee experiences.
  • Proactive and resourceful, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • An excellent communicator who enjoys working with people at every level of the organization.
  • Comfortable coordinating vendors, contractors, and external service providers.
  • A natural problem solver who takes initiative and follows through.
  • Professional, approachable, and dependable.
  • Continuously looking for ways to improve workplace operations and efficiency.

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience in workplace operations, office management, hospitality, facilities coordination, executive administration, or a related field.
  • Experience coordinating vendors and service providers.
  • Strong organizational, administrative, and multitasking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, Canva, or similar workplace tools is considered an asset.
  • First Aid/CPR certification, Health & Safety training, or Facilities Management experience is considered an asset.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to move throughout office and workplace environments throughout the day.
  • Ability to occasionally lift or move items up to 25 lbs.
  • Comfortable performing light physical tasks such as stocking supplies, setting up meeting rooms, organizing deliveries, and moving office equipment.
  • Flexibility to occasionally adjust working hours to support meetings, events, or operational requirements.
  • Willingness to travel approximately once a week to a remote office facility in Mississauga

Why you’ll love it at Clutch:

  • Autonomy & ownership – opportunity to build your process and influence the company workforce and at every level.
  • Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by leading a critical part of our customer experience.
  • You’ll have a broad and direct ownership over [Field of work] during a phase of rapid growth.
  • We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
  • Above market health & dental benefits.

Employment Type:

  • New, Permanent Full-Time

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Salary range: $60,000-$70,000 per annum
  • Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1.
  • Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca.

title: Kravanalytiker/produktägare
description:

Arbetsmarknaden förändras i allt snabbare takt och arbetslöshetskassornas uppdrag har kanske aldrig varit viktigare.

Syftet är att a-kassorna ska kunna administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen på ett så snabbt och effektivt sätt som möjligt. Sveriges a-kassor sitter i nya fräscha lokaler vid Skanstull samt är en modern arbetsgivare som månar om sina anställda. Rekryterande chef: Karin Björkström, karin.bjorkstrom@sverigesakassor.se

title: Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud
description:
As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. Your role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset as you will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll leverage Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
  • Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol. (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer-facing role.
  • Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience leading technical discovery sessions.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Experience identifying business problems and translating complex hardware/AI constraints for C-suites and technical teams.
  • Experience influencing and driving outcomes with cross-functional teams on engagements of high complexity and large scope and scale.
  • Experience performing discovery interviews to identify business problems and translate hardware/AI constraints for C-suites and technical teams.
  • Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

title: Senior Director, Regional Ecosystem Lead, Shanghai
description:
Help Shape the Future of Biotechnology

At CSL, our work saves lives.

As one of the world's leading biotechnology companies, we are driven by a promise to patients and a commitment to advancing scientific innovation. Every day, our teams work at the intersection of breakthrough science, cutting-edge technology, and global collaboration to develop therapies that improve and save lives.

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Director, Regional Ecosystem Lead to serve as CSL's senior representative within one of the world's leading biotechnology innovation hubs. This highly visible role offers a unique opportunity to influence CSL's future pipeline by connecting groundbreaking science, entrepreneurial innovation, and strategic business partnerships.

Working at the forefront of external innovation, you will help identify transformative opportunities, shape CSL's presence across the biotech ecosystem, and position the company as the partner of choice for researchers, entrepreneurs, investors, and emerging biotechnology companies.

This is more than a business development role. It is an opportunity to help bring the next generation of therapies to patients around the world.

What You'll Do

As CSL's senior leader within the regional innovation ecosystem, you will:

Build CSL's Presence and Influence

  • Act as the face of CSL across the local biotechnology, academic, venture capital, and innovation community.
  • Elevate CSL's reputation as a trusted partner, collaborator, and investor in breakthrough science.
  • Develop new partnership opportunities that strengthen CSL's strategic presence and innovation pipeline.

Discover the Next Breakthrough

  • Identify and source high-value external innovation opportunities aligned with CSL's therapeutic area strategies and long-term portfolio priorities.
  • Monitor emerging scientific advancements, disruptive technologies, and evolving industry trends.
  • Provide critical market intelligence on competitive activity, innovation hotspots, and ecosystem developments.

Create Meaningful Partnerships

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships across leading universities, research institutes, incubators, accelerators, venture capital firms, and biotechnology companies.
  • Connect external innovators with CSL's scientific experts, business leaders, and decision makers.
  • Represent CSL at major scientific, investment, and industry events, ensuring strong visibility and engagement.

Lead Strategic Transactions

  • Play a senior leadership role on regional business development and licensing opportunities.
  • Support transactions from early opportunity identification through evaluation, due diligence, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner closely with R&D, Business Development, Legal, and Therapeutic Area leaders to assess and advance opportunities.

Influence the Broader Industry

  • Pursue leadership positions on industry boards, advisory committees, and professional associations.
  • Represent CSL's perspective in shaping the future direction of the biotechnology sector.
  • Foster strong connections across government, industry, academic, and investment communities.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • 12+ years of experience within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, business development, external innovation, venture investing, or related fields.
  • Strong track record of building strategic partnerships and generating high-value deal flow.
  • Demonstrated success identifying, evaluating, and executing external innovation opportunities.
  • Deep understanding of the regional biotechnology ecosystem and key industry stakeholders.

Leadership and Influence

  • Established credibility with biotechnology executives, academic leaders, investors, and scientific communities.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders and operate effectively within complex global organisations.

Scientific Expertise

  • Advanced scientific or medical degree required (PhD, MD, PharmD, or equivalent).
  • Strong ability to evaluate scientific innovation and emerging technologies.

Additional Requirements

  • Fluency in Mandarin.
  • Experience operating within the local regulatory, business, and innovation environment.
  • Willingness to travel and represent CSL across the broader regional ecosystem.

Why CSL?

At CSL, you'll join a purpose-driven organisation with a proud heritage of scientific innovation and a global footprint spanning more than 100 countries.

You'll work alongside some of the brightest minds in biotechnology, helping to shape a pipeline of innovations that have the potential to transform patient outcomes worldwide.

Together, we are driven by a simple but powerful purpose: to save lives and protect the health of people around the world.

If you're passionate about science, partnerships, and unlocking the next generation of medical breakthroughs, we'd love to hear from you

About CSL Behring

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.


CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit and CSL Plasma at .

Our Benefits

For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL.

You Belong at CSL

At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Senior Platform & Developer Experience Engineer
description:
Please note that for this role we are searching for someone who is already living in the Netherlands and is proficient in the use of the English language on C1 level. No use of the Dutch language is required but it is preferred.

The energy transition needs you as a senior platform & developer experience engineer

As a Senior Platform & Developer Experience Engineer within the PMSO team, you are at the heart of Alliander's digital transformation. As System Operations shifts towards Grid-As-A-Service (GaaS) deployed on top of the Siemens GridScaleX (GSX), your primary mission is to evolve and re-architect our delivery mechanics, maximize developer velocity, embed seamless pipeline security, and build the scaffolding that enables microservices to ship safely at scale.

While PMSO’s dedicated observability specialists focus on Elastic, OpenTelemetry, and APM analytics, you will guide the Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, and Release Automation side of the equation. You will operate with a high degree of technical autonomy—shaping delivery architectures, building local developer tooling, and helping shape future multi-DSO scaling models.

We are creating the energy grid of the future, for everyone, with everyone. And as a platform & developer experience engineer you can play your part in this. Your role will involve:

  • Platform Architecture & Delivery: Enhance and scale CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows (ArgoCD), and internal developer tooling. Build automation in Python and Java to streamline deployments, validation, and dependency management.

  • DevSecOps & Security: Integrate security controls such as image scanning, secret management, access policies, and automated validation directly into developer workflows.

  • Infrastructure & Operations: Support platform operations and incident triage, resolve pipeline bottlenecks, and translate developer requirements into clear RFCs for platform vendors.

  • Multi-DSO & Observability: Contribute to API-driven delivery solutions for external DSOs and ensure platforms provide the telemetry and monitoring capabilities needed for reliable operations.

You complete our network

Did you know that Alliander is made up of different business units? With our large group of talented professionals, we develop and manage the energy grid for millions of people and businesses in the Netherlands. Everything we do, we do with an eye on the people who rely on us: our customers. And thanks to our talents, we have the utmost confidence in the energy future of the Netherlands. Together with you, we make the energy transition possible, for and with our customers.

You will be working at our Liander Alliander business unit. Here, you will work on the management, maintenance or construction of our electricity and gas networks. Safety is always our top priority: you ensure safety in your daily work and we ensure that you are supported in this.

In this way, we supply energy to households, businesses and our other customers in a safe and reliable manner. Monitoring our energy network is only possible with the right motivation. We offer an inspiring working environment that will energise you in your day-to-day work. The System Operations department is made up of smart and committed professionals.

You energise our network
You combine a pragmatic mindset with a healthy dose of critical thinking. You're able to identify risks, bottlenecks, and scalability challenges before they become real issues, and you proactively design solutions that keep platforms reliable and future-proof. At the same time, you're passionate about improving the developer experience and measure success by enabling engineering teams to deliver software faster, safer, and with less friction. You thrive in environments where not everything is defined yet, enjoy bringing structure to complex challenges, and are comfortable helping shape platform standards and future-state architectures as they evolve.
Working with the latest technologies and innovations. With your talent and strengths, you can do that at our company. Will you contribute with your critical perspective and innovative solutions? Great especially if you add the following:

  • 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, SRE, Release Engineering, or a similar role within a complex enterprise, critical infrastructure, or regulated environment.

  • Strong expertise in Kubernetes, GitOps, and cloud-native platforms, with hands-on experience in Helm, ArgoCD, AWS, Terraform, and deployment patterns such as App-of-Apps.

  • Proven experience designing, modernizing, and operating CI/CD ecosystems, including pipeline-as-code (e.g. GitHub Actions), release management, semantic versioning, automation, and self-service developer platforms.

  • Solid software engineering and automation skills, including Python and/or Java, Infrastructure as Code, API integrations, security automation, secret management, image scanning, and application troubleshooting.

  • Strong DevOps mindset focused on security, reliability, and developer experience, with experience in DevSecOps, observability, monitoring, and cross-team collaboration.

​You energise our network

Based on a 40-hour workweek, you can expect:

  • A gross monthly salary between €5.4166,- and €6]7,737,- (scale 10) depending on your knowledge and experience

  • annually an Individual Choice Budget (IKB) of 18% (full time) or 12.8% (part time) of your gross annual salary, including holiday allowance;

  • 24.5 days’ holiday per year, which can be topped up generously from your IKB;

  • an end-of-year bonus of 6% of your annual salary in December;

  • a Sustainable Employability (SE) budget of €700 per year for your wellbeing and development;

  • unlimited learning and development opportunities via relevant courses and training programmes;

  • an NS (Dutch Railways) Business Card for sustainable commuting (or a kilometre allowance when using your own transport).

And we obviously offer much more besides! Read more about Alliander and all your terms of employment on our website.


More information for you

title: Lægesekretær/SAK til OP-booker i Ortopædkirurgi, AUH
description:
Tænker du også nogle gange over, hvad man kan lave som sundhedsadministrativ medarbejder udover de klassiske sekretæropgaver? Så læs med her, for vi søger en ekstra holdspiller til vores operationsbooking, hvor du får mulighed for at specialisere dig i at koordinere patientforløb til operationer.

Noget af det bedste ved vores job er, at vi har tæt kontakt med klinik og patienter, dvs. at vi ser patienter fysisk i øjnene hver dag, når vi i samarbejde med dem planlægger deres operation og forløb. Du skal derfor være serviceminded og kunne lide den direkte patientkontakt.

Vi har ligeledes en stor berøringsflade med læger, sygeplejersker, sekretærer og andre samarbejdspartnere både internt og eksternt, hvor vi har en nøglerolle som koordinerende led, der får puslespillet til at gå op.

Nu tænker du måske: ”Åh nej, hvad så med mine andre kompetencer såsom kodning og skrivning – glemmer jeg alt det?” Bare rolig, vi vedligeholder også alle de klassiske sekretærkompetencer, idet vi også er sekretærer for vores ortopædkirurgiske Rekonstruktionsklinik. Det er et subspeciale i Ortopædkirurgien med kun to læger og derfor begrænset med skrivning, og vi har allerede implementeret talegenkendelse i afdelingen.

Vores hverdag består derfor af mange forskelligartede opgaver fordelt i rul, idet vi booker operationer for alle vores 8 subspecialer i Ortopædkirurgien, både akutte og elektive. I dagkirurgien er der primært tale om elektive patienter. Vi vil meget gerne uddybe opgaverne, når vi mødes personligt til en samtale, men her kan nævnes nogle:

  • Booking af akutte operationer: Vi er hver morgen med til tværfaglig akut morgenkonference, hvor akutte patienter fra bl.a. Skadestuen indplaceres til operation, og OP-bookingen informerer og indkalder herefter patienterne.
  • Booking af elektive operationer for vores 8 subspecialer
  • Indkaldelse til klargøring, røntgen og blodprøver
  • Personlig betjening af patienter
  • Telefonbetjening
  • Rådgivning af patienter ift. rettigheder og omvisitering
  • Bestilling af hjemtransporter
  • Sekretæropgaver i Rekonstruktionsklinikken
  • På sigt oplæring i ortopædkirurgisk dagkirurgi

Du vil blive grundigt og gradvist oplært i alle opgaverne.

Lidt om os

I OP-bookingen er der 4 uddannede lægesekretærer, i Dagkirurgien 2 uddannede lægesekretærer. Begge teams er velfungerende, og vi arbejder på at skabe et stærkt og velfungerende samarbejde de to teams imellem. De to teams er fysisk adskilte, men i det dagligere supplerer sekretærerne hinanden godt, såvel fagligt som personligt.
Der er ikke to dage, der er ens, og der kan være drøn på. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan skabe overblik, tage tingene med et smil og både sige til og fra – det ser vi som en stor styrke.

Vi er meget selvkørende og har stort ansvar, også når opgaverne er tunge eller samtalerne svære. Vi sparer rigtig meget med hinanden, idet vores opgaver er alsidige og dækker så forskelligartede fagområder.

Og så tror vi på, at det er vigtigt at have det sjovt sammen, både på og uden for kontoret.

Lidt om dig

Vi håber, at du har lyst til selv at fortælle os, hvem du er, men vi leder efter en, der er

  • uddannet lægesekretær/sundhedsadministrativ koordinator
  • imødekommende og professionel
  • kan jonglere med flere bolde og prioritere i en travl og foranderlig hverdag
  • har godt kendskab til EPJ
  • har mod på forandringer og ser muligheder fremfor begrænsninger
  • er mødestabil og fleksibel

Arbejdstid

Den daglige arbejdstid ligger som udgangspunkt inden for tidsrummet kl. 07.30–15.30 mandag til torsdag samt kl. 07..30-15.00 fredag.

Hverken weekend- eller helligdagsvagter.

Kontakt

Har du lyst til at høre mere om jobbet eller blive vist rundt på afdelingen, kan du kontakte teamkoordinator Patricia Frank Svare på tlf. 2151 9649.

Du kan også kontakte os i OP-bookingen direkte på telefon 7845 4190. Vi er ret søde (og sjove, hvis du spørger os selv ☺), så hold dig ikke tilbage.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til overenskomst indgået mellem Danske Regioner og HK. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Client Experience Intern for AVD (Altersvorsorgedepot) (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as an AVD Client Experience Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

What you’ll do:

  • Support our clients: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

  • Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.

  • Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

  • Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

  • Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

What you bring:

  • You are fluent in German (C1 or above) and comfortable working in English. This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German.

title: Senior / Principal Consultant, Air Quality - Cardiff
description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A little more about your role…

Working within the Air Quality team, the primary function and duties would include the following:

  • Dispersion modelling, primarily using ADMS and ADMS-Roads;
  • Designing and implementing ambient air quality monitoring plans including both passive and automatic techniques;
  • Contributing to bid submissions, preparing quotes and tenders;
  • Project management to budget, programme and scope;
  • Liaising with both internal and external clients, project teams and Local Authorities;
  • Collation and analysis of data; and
