A degree of business development and profile raising for the air quality team would also be expected at both senior and principal grade.

YOUR TEAM

You would be joining a team of over 35 air quality professionals working on a wide range of projects including, but not limited to, major projects of national significance, international projects (including work within the water and mining sectors), land developments, transport infrastructure, energy (carbon capture/nuclear), indoor air quality and air quality policy including assessment of strategic growth.

Work comprises air quality assessment and monitoring with dispersion modelling forming a key component of many road, power, industrial and odour projects. The team also has experience providing air quality input into Habitats Regulations Assessment (HRA), Health Impact Assessment (HIA), undertaking bespoke modelling (including CFD, dense gas and Calpuff) and implementing behaviour change campaigns.

The role would be based in our Cardiff office, which is easily accessible via public transport.

Whilst sitting within a regional team, there will be extensive opportunities available to work with the wider UK air quality team and internationally across a wide range of air quality projects.

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…

  • Ability to write clear, concise reports/proposals.

  • Experience in data analysis and interpretation using Excel and GIS.
  • Positive and proactive approach, demonstrating accountability for their own utilisation and personal development (and that of the wider team).
  • To be an associate or full member of the Institute of Air Quality Management (IAQM).

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

title: Product Functional Test Mechanical Technician - Level IV
description:
We are looking for a talented Product Functional Test Mechanical Technician to join the Engineering Plant Support (EPS) team at Cummins Daventry, Northamptonshire, United Kingdom.

Working hours: Early shift: 7am to 3pm, Late shift: 3pm to 11pm, One weekend/month - 7am to 3pm

Flexibility to work night shift may be required in the future

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Support Engine Test Operations by providing real-time technical assistance to test cell technicians and engineers, ensuring efficient execution of engine testing activities.

  • Verify and Validate Test Data by reviewing live and historical engine test results, confirming data accuracy, completeness, and compliance with approval requirements.

  • Approve Test Results by evaluating key engine performance parameters, including speed, torque, power output, fuel consumption, temperatures, and pressures, using approved diagnostic tools and software.

  • Troubleshoot Technical Issues by identifying data inconsistencies, abnormal engine behavior, and test anomalies, providing immediate guidance or escalating complex issues to specialist teams when necessary.

  • Coordinate Cross-Functional Support by working closely with test cell operators, engineers, CPE, maintenance, AME, and assembly teams to resolve issues, minimise test downtime, and support engine approvals.

  • Drive Data Quality Improvements by tracking and analyzing recurring data discrepancies, generating summary reports, supporting corrective actions, and contributing to continuous improvement of test processes and standard operating procedures.

  • Support Assembly and Product Quality by providing assembly line technical support, supplying torque specifications, conducting component fit checks, investigating structural issues, and raising deviations when required.

  • Promote Safe and Efficient Testing by ensuring test procedures are followed, identifying potential safety risks from abnormal engine behavior, recommending immediate test shutdowns when critical issues are detected, and maintaining flexibility to support operations across rotating shift patterns.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Demonstrated experience working in an engine test cell environment, with a strong understanding of internal combustion engines, HHP engine performance parameters, and engine troubleshooting techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex engine test data, manage multiple sources of information, and make timely, high-quality technical decisions.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to provide clear technical guidance, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and communicate confidently with technicians, engineers, and stakeholders.
  • Results-driven and action-oriented mindset, capable of responding quickly to technical challenges, working under pressure, and consistently delivering accurate, timely outcomes.
  • Commitment to health and safety, demonstrating proactive behaviors by identifying risks, following safe working practices, and contributing to a culture of continuous safety improvement.
  • Ability to manage complexity and drive continuous improvement, using technical knowledge and data insights to resolve issues, improve test quality, and support efficient engine validation and approval processes.

Education/ Experience:

  • High school diploma, certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience in an appropriate STEM field is required.
  • Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

title: Gatu-parkarbetare
description:
Välkommen till Boxholm – där livet är nära I Boxholms kommun bor du med allt du behöver inom räckhåll. Här bor cirka 5 500 invånare som uppskattar närheten till både service och natur. Tänk dig att ha butiker, skolor, förskolor, simhall och pendeltåg – allt inom bara några minuters promenad från centrum. Och när du vill byta småstadslivet mot storstadspuls, tar du dig enkelt till Linköping med pendeltåget – på bara 30 minuter. Dessutom har du naturen bokstavligen runt knuten – perfekt för återhämtning, friluftsliv och livskvalitet i vardagen. I Boxholm får du det bästa av två världar: det lugna, trygga och naturnära – med storstadens möjligheter bara ett stenkast bort. Samtidigt pulserar samhället av ett levande föreningsliv och människor med starka drivkrafter. Här finns ett rikt utbud av idrott, kultur och ideella initiativ som engagerar både unga och äldre. Tillsammans bygger vi en kommun där gemenskap, engagemang och framtidstro växer starkare för varje dag. 1 plats(er).

Är du en praktisk person med känsla för estetik som drivs av att skapa vackra och tillgängliga utemiljöer? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig.

Gatu- och parkavdelningen inom samhällsbyggnadsförvaltningen i Boxholms kommun består av ett team på sex medarbetare. Vi ansvarar bland annat för att planera, förvalta allmän plats och sköta kommunens allmänna planteringar, parker, lekplatser, gator och torg, naturreservat och skogar för att skapa en attraktiv miljö för invånare och besökare i kommunen.

Arbetsuppgifter

Hos oss får du ett varierande arbete inom gatu- och parkmark, skogsmark samt yttre fastighetsskötsel. Dina arbetsuppgifter inkluderar bland annat trädgårdsarbete, beskärning, klippning av gräs och häckar, ogräsrensning och plantering. Du kommer även att sköta lekplatser, utföra renhållning och gatuarbeten som till exempel vinterväghållning. I rollen ingår även kontakt med hyresgäster, kommunala förvaltningar och entreprenörer. Beredskapstjänstgöring kan ingå i tjänsten.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har trädgårdsutbildning, alternativt gymnasieutbildning kompletterad med ett års trädgårdsutbildning, eller arbetslivserfarenhet som kan bedömas likvärdig. Du har gärna flerårig yrkeserfarenhet inom park- och trädgårdsarbete samt god vana av maskinhantering till exempel gräsklippare, grästrimmer, kompaktlastare och/eller redskapsbärare. Det är meriterande om du har god växtvana.

Har du utbildning inom Heta arbeten och Arbete på väg, B utökad (B96), hjullastarlicens, Motorsågskörkort (A-B), Röjsågskörkort (A) eller annan relevant kompetens inom gatu- och parkskötsel är det meriterande.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker dig som är en lagspelare som samtidigt kan ta ett stort eget ansvar. Du är drivande, tar initiativ och arbetar mot våra uppsatta mål. Vi värdesätter hög arbetsmoral och ett positivt bemötande mot både allmänhet och kollegor. B-körkort för manuell växellåda är ett krav för tjänsten.

Intervjuer och urval kommer att ske löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Löneform: Månadslön. Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning. Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: 2026-10-01 Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Arbetstid: Dagtid.

title: Senior Staff Solutions Engineer (R5320)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer based in New Delhi to support technical capture and pre-sales engagement for the X-BAT and V-BAT aircraft platforms in India. This role will serve as the in-country technical lead for Business Development, bridging Indian MoD operational requirements with Shield AI’s product roadmap. The ideal candidate has prior experience at a major defense prime (US OEM) in roles spanning engineering, technical sales, program management, or advanced capture, with exposure to tactical jet aircraft, CCA/ACA concepts, or Group 3/4/5 UAS programs. This individual will focus on shaping opportunities within the Indian market, supporting Go To Market of tactical aircraft, crafting proposal documentation, and providing technical expertise. This individual will also cross-train in Shield AI’s other products to support integrated solution discussions.

What you'll do:

    • Lead X-BAT and V-BAT technical capture efforts for Indian opportunities, ensuring solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with Shield AI’s product roadmap.

    • Capture efforts will focus on Aircraft, but will require familiarity with the entire Shield AI Product suite.

    • Manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, including customer engagements, pre-sales technical support, proposal contributions, and solution development.

    • Develop and execute technical strategies that result in high-quality, compliant, and compelling proposals to maximize win probability.

    • Serve as the primary technical lead for Go To Market (GTM) engagements in India, interfacing cross-functionally with BD, BD Operations , Engineering, Operations, Program Management, and Product Management to ensure customer needs are met.

    • Manage technical content for proposals, requests for information (RFIs), white papers, and capability briefs, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and compliance.

    • Support early-phase acquisition activities (concept notes, requirements drafts, unsolicited proposals).

    • Shape early operational concepts aligned to X-BAT and/or V-BAT capabilities.

    • Support BD and Account Executives by becoming a Subject Matter Expert in Shield AI products, providing technical expertise in customer engagements, capability briefings, and solution discussions to drive successful sales outcomes.

    • Act as a liaison between BD and Engineering, and the Indian Go to Market team and the U.S. based product team, ensuring that new customer requests are technically feasible and align with product capabilities, timelines, and roadmaps.

    • Contribute to the technical documentation repository, maintaining capability briefs, specifications, FAQs, and other sales collateral for internal and external use.

    • Provide training and mentorship to BD teams on technical aspects of Shield AI’s solutions, enabling them to articulate our value proposition confidently.

    • Support competitive analysis and market intelligence specific to the Indian tactical aircraft market, ensuring the BD team remains informed on industry trends and competitor capabilities.

    • Contribute to process improvement efforts, leveraging lessons learned from customer engagements to refine BD workflows and technical capture strategies.

    • Analyze the unique operational and environmental factors of the assigned region, producing high-impact white papers and briefs that inform the product roadmap and drive solutions aligned to customer mission needs.

    Required qualifications:

      • 10+ years of experience in technical sales, capture, engineering, or program management within defense or aerospace industries.

      • Demonstrated familiarity with Indian Ministry of Defence procurement processes and military force structures.

      • Prior experience at a major defense prime (US OEM or equivalent) supporting tactical aircraft, CCA/ACA, or Group 3/4/5 UAS programs.

      • Experience interfacing with government or military acquisition stakeholders.

      • Strong systems-level understanding of aircraft design tradeoffs, operational CONOPS, and mission-based engineering.

      • Proven ability to translate technical concepts into compelling narratives for senior stakeholders.

      • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, applied science, or related technical discipline.

      • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

      • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.

      Preferred qualifications:

        • Experience supporting international defense sales or industrial partnerships.

        • Familiarity with offset strategies and Make-in-India requirements.

        • Background in autonomy, AI-driven systems, or networked ISR.

        • Experience contributing to early-phase design or conceptual aircraft programs.

        • Prior military service experience (Indian or allied forces).

        • Advanced degree in engineering, aerospace, systems engineering, or business.

        • 5+ years of experience in an presales/solutions engineering role 3+ years of experience working in a startup environment.

        • Demonstrated understanding of specific MOD operational scenarios and systems.

        Why join Shield AI:

          • Help build the defining defence technology company of this century.

          • Work at the forefront of AI, autonomy, and next-generation defence systems.

title: Teknisk Testare
description:
Om oss På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov.

Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad.

Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder.

Arbetsbeskrivning We are looking for a Technical Tester to join a large-scale transformation program within the Asset Finance area. The role is part of the Quality Assurance workstream and focuses on ensuring high quality and reliable deliveries across a complex system landscape.

You will work hands-on with manual and technical testing, planning and executing test activities in line with the overall test strategy. The role includes designing test cases based on business requirements and user stories, performing exploratory testing, validating critical business processes and ensuring adequate test coverage across systems and integrations.

You will collaborate closely with developers, business stakeholders and external vendors to understand business flows, verify functionality and support successful deliveries. Responsibilities also include defect management, integration and end-to-end testing, API testing where applicable, and contributing to the continuous improvement of testing processes, documentation and quality practices throughout the program.

Qualifications:

  • Solid experience as a tester in IT projects, with a technical understanding.

  • Hands-on experience of manual testing (this is not an automation role).

  • Experience working with APIs and tools such as Postman or similar is highly valued.

  • Experience with Jira, Xray or similar test management tools.

  • Strong ability to understand requirements and translate them into effective test cases.

  • Experience from leasing systems or leasing processes is a must.

  • Good understanding of test methodologies (e.g. ISTQB).

  • Analytical, structured and detail-oriented.

  • Able to work independently and drive your own testing work.

  • Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders.

  • Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

    Ansökan När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder.

Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

title: Tømrer i mindre håndværksfirma i Vejle
description:
Er du tømrer og vil du have firmabil og en hverdag med godt humør?

Vi mangler en tømrer til nybyg og renovering i Vejle.

Du lander i en lille håndværkerflok, hvor nybyg og renovering er den brede retning. Pladserne ligger i Vejle og omegn, så hverdagen holdes tæt på området. Firmabilen følger med, så du har styr på transporten i hverdagen.

Det her er til dig, der helst vil lave ordentligt tømrerarbejde uden at drukne i korte forløb. Stemningen skal være jordnær, og mottoet er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Du får fastansættelse og en hverdag, hvor opgaverne er til at forstå.

Det får du

Løn: 100-300 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Vejle og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Nybyg, renovering og tømrerarbejde

Din hverdag

På nybyg handler dagen om at få tømrerarbejdet gjort i den rækkefølge, der passer med resten af pladsen. På renovering skifter tempoet mere, fordi eksisterende mål og løsninger ofte skal tilpasses undervejs. Du tager fat, siger til hvis noget ikke stemmer, og afleverer ikke noget halvt.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Tømrerarbejde på nybyg
  • Renoverer og bygger om i eksisterende byggeri
  • Sætter vinduer og døre op efter mål
  • Laver tagarbejde når opgaven kræver det
  • Bygger carporte, udhuse og terrasser

Mottoet her er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Når en opgave ændrer sig undervejs, er det vigtigt at du siger til i tide. Så kan planen rettes til, og kunden får en løsning der holder.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Vi forventer ikke at du har lavet det hele før. Men du skal kunne se en opgave og tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som tømrer
  • Har gerne mindst 1 års erfaring fra faget
  • Møder stabilt og holder dine aftaler
  • Kan arbejde ordentligt på både nybyg og renovering
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både nybyg og renovering før. Men det vigtigste er, at du gider dit fag og kan levere et stykke arbejde du vil stå inde for.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Job Description:

Role Overview

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale technology solutions that accelerate business transformation, innovation, and operational excellence.

This role requires a visionary technology leader who can bridge business strategy and technical execution, shape enterprise architecture decisions, drive modernization initiatives, and guide engineering teams in delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud-native solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise across application architecture, cloud platforms, integration patterns, security, and software engineering practices, while influencing stakeholders at all organizational levels.

Key Responsibilities

Business & Technology Alignment

  • Partner with business leaders, product owners, and delivery teams to translate business capabilities and requirements into actionable technology solutions.
  • Develop architecture blueprints, target-state architectures, design patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Provide strategic recommendations on technology investments, modernization opportunities, and platform selection.
  • Drive adoption of modern architectural practices including microservices, event-driven architecture, API-led integration, cloud-native development, and domain-driven design.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams.
  • Influence architecture decisions across multiple portfolios and initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Master's degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, systems integration, or enterprise technology roles.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience designing and leading enterprise-scale architecture solutions in a Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect capacity.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale digital transformation, modernization, cloud migration, or enterprise integration initiatives.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep expertise in architectural styles and patterns including:
    • Microservices Architecture
    • Event-Driven Architecture
    • Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
    • API-First Architecture
    • Distributed Systems
    • Monolithic and Hybrid Architectures
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Expertise in cloud-native services, containers, Kubernetes, serverless computing, and platform engineering practices.
  • Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data architecture, analytics platforms, and integration technologies.
  • Extensive experience designing secure APIs, enterprise integration solutions, and authentication/authorization frameworks.
  • Experience implementing DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and automated quality controls.

Good to Have:

  • TOGAF Certification
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect

This position can be based in any of the following locations:

Chennai

title: Senior Engineer, Application Security
description:
Bring more to life.

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we’re committed to hiring and developing from within. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

At Danaher, the Senior Engineer, Application Security embeds security into the SDLC and product engineering. Enterprise AppSec strategy and standards are set by leadership/architecture; the Engineer executes within that design — secure design reviews, threat modeling, testing, and developer enablement. The Engineer works independently on complex problems across product teams that each own their own codebases.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Application, Product, and Manufacturing Security and is part of the Danaher Information Security (DIS) located in Pune/Bangalore and will be an onsite role.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Engineer AppSec testing: SAST/DAST/SCA/secret scanning, IaC scanning, API and mobile security, and container/cloud-native app security in CI/CD.

  • Contribute to secure-by-design patterns and guardrails defined by senior architecture.

  • Build automation and pipeline integrations to scale testing coverage.

  • Support the sustainability model: secure-coding standards and SBOM/OSS-risk workflows.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in application/product security or security-focused software engineering (GCRF P3 Bachelor's-track minimum; recommended, pending Comp sign-off).

  • Hands-on experience with application security testing: SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC and secret scanning, plus secure design review, code review, or threat modeling.

  • Experience with application security tooling (such as Snyk, Veracode, Checkmarx, Semgrep, or GitHub Advanced Security) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience working independently with product engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities and apply secure-coding practices.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience with API security, cloud-native/Kubernetes security, or software supply chain/SBOM.

  • GWAPT, GWEB, CSSLP, or a cloud security certification.

  • Exposure to AI/LLM application security.

  • Perform secure design reviews and threat modeling with product teams.
  • Triage and prioritize application vulnerabilities; partner on remediation.
  • Tune and operate SAST/DAST/SCA tooling; reduce false positives.
  • Enable developers with secure-coding patterns and guardrail adoption.
  • Assess OSS/supply-chain risk; support SBOM and release checks.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit .

For improved work life balance, WSP offers the “WSP Hour” which enables you to take one hour per day to do as you wish and make up the time earlier or later that day. We also offer part time working where required, and the ability to flex your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development?

title: Verksamhetsutvecklare/Projektledare
description:
Om oss På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov.

Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad.

Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder.

Arbetsbeskrivning Vi söker en verksamhetsutvecklare/projektledare.

I denna roll ansvarar du för att processer följer gällande lagar, förordningar, föreskrifter och EU-direktiv samt tillämpliga regler för informationssäkerhet. Du säkerställer att processen kan utföra sitt grundläggande uppdrag och att den utvecklas när brister identifieras, exempelvis vid incidenter, revisioner, klagomål eller till följd av förändringar i omvärlden eller i den strategi som implementeras.

Arbetet innebär att samla in kunskap från produktstödsteamet, genomföra genomgångar av kontroller och sammanställa årsrapporter samt ta fram och förvalta regeldokumentation. Du bidrar med kunskap i kravställning för utveckling av processer och produkter.

Du följer upp processens prestation, genomför kostnadsanalyser och utför riskanalyser. I rollen ingår även att genomföra informationssäkerhetsklassning med stöd av informationssäkerhetsfunktionen, modellera processer, begrepp och information samt ta fram kontinuitetsplaner för de processer och produkter du ansvarar för. Nätverkande inom relevanta områden ingår i uppdraget.

Vidare arbetar du med kontinuerlig förbättring genom kunddialoger och andra former av interaktion, tar fram mål och fångar förbättringsinitiativ samt leder processen framåt i både större och mindre uppdrag. Du ansvarar för att skapa och detaljera features, inklusive regler och beroenden, och för att överlämna dessa till leveransteamen. Du följer upp genomförande och dokumentation av förbättringar, säkerställer att önskade resultat uppnås över tid och leder retrospektiv och erfarenhetsreflektion för att bidra till en lärande organisation.

title: Senior Product Manager | Capital Management (f/m/d)
description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As the Senior Product Manager for Capital Management, you will play a critical role in building the infrastructure that powers how private funds move and track capital—from capital calls to distributions, treasury workflows to accounting integrations. These are some of the most high-stakes and operationally intensive processes fund managers handle, and you’ll help make them seamless, scalable, and audit-ready. Your work will directly contribute to our mission of reshaping private markets through modern, intuitive software.

This is a high-impact position where you’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build products that deliver tangible value, including engineering, design, operations, and customer success.

Top responsibilities

  • Define and drive the product roadmap for capital-related workflows, including capital calls, distributions, treasury, and accounting integrations

  • Identify opportunities to transform complex operational processes into intuitive product experiences, automation logic, and scalable infrastructure

  • Conduct customer interviews and market research to understand user needs deeply

  • Translate customer insights into precise product requirements and user stories

  • Partner with engineering and design teams to deliver high-quality products on time.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all product-related decisions

  • Ensure cross-functional alignment and effective communication throughout the product lifecycle

  • Define success metrics and use data to track product performance and inform decision-making

  • Continuously gather feedback to iterate and improve our product

  • Stay ahead of industry trends in fund finance, treasury tools, and accounting systems to identify new opportunities for innovation

About You

  • 7+ years of product management experience, preferably in fintech, private markets, or back-office financial operations

  • Experience owning mission-critical, data-intensive product areas with high compliance or audit requirements

  • Proven ability to ramp up in complex financial domains

  • Demonstrated success in a startup or fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to translate vision into actionable plans.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Excellent facilitation and collaborative skills

  • Data-informed mindset with experience defining and measuring product success metrics.

  • Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, comfortable navigating ambiguity.

  • Passionate about simplifying complex workflows and enabling customers to do their best work

  • Domain understanding of fund mechanics (capital calls, LP notices, distributions, treasury, accounting, etc.) is a plus

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid setup

  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring Process

  • First interview with the People team (30 min) to get acquainted with the bunch and to understand if what we’re offering is what you’re searching for

  • Deep-dive interview with the VP of Product (60 min) - discover the role in more detail and discuss how your journey has prepared you for it, your learnings along the way, your goals, and your overall personal purpose

  • Case Interview with Product & Design (60 min) to demonstrate your way of thinking, working, and communicating your output. Based on a small case we will share beforehand.

  • Final meeting with key Stakeholders (3 x 30 min) to further learn about our vision and discuss any open questions.

Curious to learn more?

Get a feel for who we are, how we work, and what we’re building:

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

  • Glossary – Explore commonly used private market terms

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Udviklingskonsulent med analytisk profil til Handicap og Psykiatri
description:
Udvikling kræver mere end gode idéer. Det kræver mennesker, der kan skabe overblik, samle tråde og omsætte ambitioner til handling. Er det dig?

I Handicap og Psykiatri søger vi en udviklingskonsulent med analytisk profil, der trives i krydsfeltet mellem ledelsesunderstøttelse, udvikling, analyse og koordineringsopgaver. Du kommer til at arbejde med en bred vifte af opgaver inden for ledelsesunderstøttelse og organisationsudvikling, herunder tværgående koordinering, temadage, MED-samarbejde, beredskab og beslutningsoplæg til ledelsen. Analyseopgaver indgår naturligt i stillingen, men først og fremmest søger vi en kollega, der kan hjælpe organisationen med at omsætte ideer, strategier og ambitioner til handling.

Vi tror på, at stærke resultater skabes af mennesker, der både kan tænke sig om og mærke efter. Derfor leder vi efter en kollega med et klogt hjerte: én der kan kombinere faglighed, nysgerrighed og analytisk sans med gode relationer, samarbejde og blik for den virkelighed, vi er sat i verden for at understøtte.

Om dig
Vi forestiller os, at du har en samfundsvidenskabelig eller forvaltningsrettet uddannelse, for eksempel cand.scient.soc., cand.scient.pol., cand.merc., cand.oecon., cand.polit., cand.soc. eller tilsvarende.

Derudover håber vi, at du kan nikke genkendende til flere af disse punkter
  • Du trives med at arbejde tæt på ledelse og organisation
  • Du skaber overblik, også når opgaverne er komplekse
  • Du forstår kommunal styring og gerne lovgivning
  • Du skaber fremdrift og følger op på aftaler og indsatser
  • Du arbejder med data og analyser som et redskab til at understøtte beslutninger
  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og struktureret, men ved også, hvornår det er klogt at spørge en kollega
  • Erfaring fra det sociale område er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi leder ikke efter én, der kan alt fra dag ét. Det ville være lidt urimeligt, og ærligt talt også lidt kedeligt. Vi leder efter én, der er nysgerrig, fagligt stærk og har lyst til at lære området, organisationen og kollegerne godt at kende.

Dine opgaver
Som udviklingskonsulent får du en bred opgaveportefølje. Nogle dage er du dybt inde i analyser, andre dage planlægger du processer, temadage eller tværgående indsatser. Det er med andre ord en stilling for dig, der kan lide variation, og som trives med, at opgaverne varierer fra uge til uge.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at
  • Understøtte både den centrale og den decentrale ledelse med udviklings-, analyse- og koordineringsopgaver
  • Bidrage til implementering af Handicap og Psykiatris udviklingsplan og øvrige strategiske indsatser
  • Arbejde med klassiske stabsopgaver på tværs af organisationen
  • Planlægge, gennemføre og til en vis grad facilitere temadage og andre fælles aktiviteter
  • Arbejde med opgaver omkring beredskab
  • Understøtte MED-samarbejdet og øvrige organisatoriske processer
  • Understøtte indsatser, der retter sig mod medarbejdere, blandt andet uddannelse, udvikling og rekruttering
  • Bistå decentrale enheder med projekter som for eksempel ansøgning om midler og aflæggelse af regnskaber.

Kort sagt: Du skal være med til at få ting til at hænge sammen. Både på papir, i regneark og i praksis.

Hvorfor vælger du os som din næste arbejdsplads?
I Handicap og Psykiatri får du mulighed for at arbejde med meningsfulde opgaver tæt på ledelse og organisation. Du bliver en del af en velfungerende stab, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og udvikling går hånd i hånd med humor, hjælpsomhed og en uformel omgangstone. Vi har høje ambitioner, stor frihed i opgaveløsningen og en kultur præget af tillid, respekt og psykologisk tryghed.

Om os
Handicap og Psykiatri varetager sociale opgaver i forhold til voksne med udviklingshandicap, autisme og psykiske lidelser. Vi er optaget af at skabe gode tilbud til borgerne og attraktive arbejdspladser for vores medarbejdere.
Handicap og Psykiatri består af fem borgerrettede centre, en afdeling for Samarbejde, Rådgivning og Visitation samt en stab. Du bliver en del af staben, som består af en leder og ni medarbejdere med både administrativ og akademisk baggrund.

Øvrige informationer
Hvis du er nysgerrig på, hvad vi mener med et ”klogt hjerte” kan du læse mere via Kloge hjerter på Facebook eller Handicap og Psykiatris LinkedIn-side.

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte leder af staben, Dorthe Høy, på telefon 20 93 33 98.

Praktisk information
  • Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid
  • Din arbejdsplads er på rådhuset, hvor du deler kontor med to kollegaer
  • Der indhentes referencer fra tidligere ansættelsesforhold, hvis du kommer i betragtning til stillingen
  • Du kan læse mere om Herning Kommune via kommunens jobside

Ansøgningsfrist
7. september kl. 8.00.
Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler den 10. september.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

I Herning Kommune lægger vi vægt på ligestilling og diversitet og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst, herunder de fastsatte bestemmelser i forhold til lokal løndannelse. Vi følger principperne for løngennemsigtighed, og du kan finde oplysninger om lønniveauet i Herning Kommune via dette link: KRL. Vi behandler dine personoplysninger i overensstemmelse med GDPR og modtager derfor kun ansøgninger gennem vores rekrutteringssystem. Klik på SØG STILLINGEN øverst for at søge denne stilling.

title: Connected Services Coach
description:
The Connected Services Field Coach will be responsible for delivering targeted coaching and consulting to assigned client's dealerships. You will empower dealership personnel with the knowledge, tools, and skills necessary to effectively sell, activate, and support connected services. This role requires a strong understanding of technology, excellent communication, coaching skills, and a proven ability to drive results. You will work closely with dealership staff, client field representatives, and the program team to achieve program objectives.

Responsibilities:

  • Coaching & Development:
    • Deliver engaging and effective coaching sessions to dealership personnel on all aspects of client's connected services, with a specific focus on working with the dealership's leadership team and creating a process within the dealership.
    • Ensure dealership staff are proficient in using the Dealer Rewards Portal, including selling one-time pay options and activating free trials.
    • Host Monthly Performance Reviews, presenting to client’s Zone Team. Highlight success, drawbacks and best practices with the goal of aligning dealers and other org members.
  • Consulting & Support:
    • Conduct regular in-person and virtual visits to assigned dealerships to provide ongoing consulting and support.
    • Analyze dealer performance data, identify areas for improvement, and recommend strategies to increase activation rates and OTP sales.
    • Coach dealership personnel on best practices for selling and supporting connected services.
    • Collaborate with clinet field representatives to align coaching and consulting efforts with regional strategies.
  • Performance Management:
    • Track dealer progress toward activation and OTP sales targets.
    • Develop and implement action plans with dealerships to address performance gaps.
    • Regularly report on progress, challenges, and successes to the program team.
  • Communication & Collaboration:
    • Maintain open communication with dealership personnel, client field representatives, and the program team.
    • Participate in reviews to provide updates and discuss program strategy.
    • Share best practices and insights with other coaching to continuously improve the program.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    • Gather dealer feedback and identify opportunities to improve coaching materials and program processes.
    • Stay up to date on the latest connected vehicle technology and client's connected services offerings.
  • 3+ years of experience in automotive, coaching or consulting, preferably with a focus on vehicle or dealer technology.
  • Strong understanding of connected services and their value proposition.
  • Strong coaching skills
  • Proven ability to deliver engaging and effective coaching sessions.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to build rapport and establish trust with dealership personnel.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in using CRM and other sales-related software.
  • Must love travel – 80% travel required
  • Bachelor's degree is preferred
  • High school diploma or General Equivalency Diploma (GED) is required

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology.
  • Chance to make a significant impact on client's connected services strategy.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate may not have been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At MSXi, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $80k to $90k based on current experience.

title: Servicemedarbejder
description:
Vi leder ikke efter en superhelt.
Bare én, der kan finde en løsning, når andre ser et problem.
Hos SJ Feriehusudlejning er to arbejdsdage aldrig ens. Den ene dag leverer du en barneseng, den næste koordinerer du en VVS-opgave, og inden fyraften har du reddet en families ferie ved at få gang i deres tv. Hvis det lyder som en god arbejdsdag, så læs videre.
Hos SJ Feriehusudlejning søger vi en servicemedarbejder, der kan lide en aktiv hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens, og hvor god service handler om at finde løsninger – hurtigt, professionelt og med et smil.
Hvem er vi?
Vi er områdets største og ældste lokale feriehusudlejningsbureau og har i mere end 40 år hjulpet feriegæster med at få en god ferie og sommerhusejere med at passe godt på deres feriehuse.
Vi udlejer omkring 700 feriehuse, har 12 fastansatte og omkring 130 timeansatte. Mange af os har været her i mange år, fordi vi trives med friheden, fællesskabet og den gode stemning. Vi holder til i Vrist – midt i feriehusområdet – og det betyder, at du aldrig er langt fra din næste opgave.
Hvad kommer du til at lave?
Din vigtigste opgave er at sikre, at vores gæster og husejere får den hjælp, de har brug for. Nogle problemer kan du løse med det samme. Andre kræver, at du koordinerer med en håndværker. Fælles for dem alle er, at du følger opgaven helt til dørs.
Du kommer blandt andet til at:
• Køre ud til feriehusene og løse mindre akutte opgaver.
• Hjælpe gæster og husejere med alt fra tekniske udfordringer til praktiske leveringer.
• Koordinere og følge op på opgaver med eksterne håndværkere.
• Samarbejde tæt med dine kolleger i serviceteamet – vi hjælper hinanden, når der er travlt.
• Bidrage med idéer og løsninger, så vi fortsat kan levere branchens bedste service.
Du skal kunne lide, at telefonen kan ændre dagens planer – for det er netop dét, der gør jobbet spændende.
Hvem er du?
Du er måske uddannet håndværker. Måske har du arbejdet som vicevært, servicetekniker eller noget helt fjerde. Det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt og trives med at løse problemer.
Vi håber, at du:
• Har hænderne skruet godt på.
• Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar.
• Bevarer roen og overblikket – også når tempoet stiger i højsæsonen.
• Kan lide kontakten med både gæster, husejere og håndværkere.
• Taler dansk og kan forstå tysk evt. tale tysk men som minimum engelsk.
• Har kørekort.
Hvad får du hos os?
Hos os bliver du ikke bare endnu en medarbejder.
Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi stoler på hinanden, hjælper hinanden og har det godt sammen – også når der er travlt.
Vi tilbyder blandt andet:
• Fuldtidsstilling med opstart efter aftale.
• Pension, sundhedsforsikring og fritvalgskonto.
• Grundig oplæring og gode kolleger, der gerne deler ud af deres erfaring.
• En hverdag med stor frihed under ansvar.
• Fleksibel arbejdstidsplanlægning i samarbejde med dine kolleger.
• Løn efter kvalifikationer.
Praktisk
Stillingen indebærer sæson- og weekendarbejde. I højsæsonen skal du forvente at arbejde hver anden weekend, mens weekendarbejde uden for sæsonen sker efter behov.

title: Ambulancebehandlere og paramedicinere søges til stationerne i Sallinge og Assens
description:
Vil du arbejde et sted, hvor faglighed, udvikling og sammenhold går hånd i hånd?

Vi søger ambulancebehandlere og paramedicinere til flere attraktive stillinger i både Sydvestjylland og Sønderjylland

Det drejer sig om følgende stillinger:

  1. Døgnvagt i Billund med alternativt rul
  2. PHV i Esbjerg
  3. Effektiv i Sønderborg
  4. Døgnvagt i Tønder
Et fleksibelt arbejdsliv

Som ambulanceredder i Præhospital Syd skal der være plads til både arbejdet og livet udenfor. Derfor har vi skabt Frihedsportalen, vores interne ”friheds- og vagtbyttecentral” for vores reddere.

Via Frihedsportalen kan du som redder få hjælp, når du har brug for at få fri eller få en vagt flyttet. Du sender et ønske, så arbejder planlæggerne videre med at finde en løsning.
Det betyder mere fleksible vagtplaner og mulighed for at tage fri til fx familieliv eller vigtige begivenheder, uden at gå på kompromis med driften.

”Vi har virkelig god mulighed for at hjælpe hinanden.
Vi arbejder i et mere fleksibelt planlægningsunivers, hvor vi kan droppe de faste rul og skræddersy arbejdslivet, så det passer godt med privatlivet.
Samtidig har vi mulighed for i Driften at omplacere ressourcer til dage, hvor vi er udfordrede. Det bliver et samarbejde mellem reddere og planlæggere, som alle i sidste ende drager fordel af.

Indtil videre er det en kæmpe succes – vi får kun positive tilbagemeldinger, og det er en enorm tilfredsstillelse at kunne hjælpe redderne med frihed, hvor de virkelig har brug for det.
Det giver mange glade mails retur! Vi har pr. dags dato fra 1. januar omplaceret eller givet fri på omkring 2.000 vagter.”

Anja, Vagtplanlægger

Dagligdagen i Præhospital Syd

Du bliver en central del af det lokale sundhedsvæsen og får rig mulighed for at bruge hele din faglighed – med fast tilknytning til én station.

Som fast tilknyttet redder på én station betyder det, at du:

  • har din daglige gang det samme sted og bliver en integreret del af stationens kultur og fællesskab
  • lærer lokalområdet, dets borgere og samarbejdspartnere indgående at kende
  • oplever både opgaver tæt på sygehus og øvrige ressourcer – og situationer, hvor du i længere tid står med patienten, før der er adgang til lægebil eller nærmeste sygehus
Du er med til at sikre en hurtig, sammenhængende og professionel præhospital indsats i området. Sammen med dine kolleger:

  • løfter du opgaven med stolthed og høj faglighed
  • tager du aktivt del i de præhospitale beslutninger og skaber tryghed for borgerne
  • bidrager du til velfungerende og sammenhængende patientforløb
Du arbejder i et tæt, tværfagligt samarbejde med lokale læger, kommunal hjemmepleje og plejecentre og mærker tydeligt, at I sammen gør en reel forskel for både borger og sundhedsvæsen.

Uanset om du kommer til at arbejde på stationerne i Sønderborg, Tønder, Esbjerg eller Billund, vil du opleve:

  • et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og tæt makkerskab
  • en kultur, hvor alle løfter i flok, hjælper hinanden med vagter og får hverdagen til at hænge sammen
  • ledere, der er nærværende, og hvor du bliver set, hørt og inddraget i udviklingen af både stationen og den præhospitale indsats
Hos os er der gode muligheder for work‑life balance og et fleksibelt arbejdsliv, hvor der er plads til både et aktivt arbejdsliv og et velfungerende privatliv.

Et job hos Præhospital Syd er til dig, der ønsker faglige udfordringer, motiveres af fællesskab og sammenhold og har lyst til at tage ansvar, tænke i løsninger og være en stolt medspiller i den præhospitale indsats i Region Syddanmark.
En bonusinfo om stationen i Billund er, at vi står over for at skulle opføre en ny og lækker station dér.

At arbejde i Ambulance Syd

Vores arbejdsfællesskab bygger på værdierne stolthed, sammenhold, tillid og fremsynethed. I praksis betyder det, at vi er stolte af vores fag, vi løfter i flok, vi har tillid til hinandens dømmekraft, og vi er nysgerrige på nye måder at hjælpe borgerne hurtigt, klogt og sammenhængende, altid med borgeren først.

Vi tilbyder et arbejdsmiljø, hvor du kan gøre en reel forskel – hver dag. Her bliver du hørt, set og værdsat!

Vores administration i Odense deler adresse med AMK-Vagtcentralen og er derfor i tæt samarbejde med kollegaerne på AMK, på daglig basis. Her bruger vi bl.a. vores medarbejderes gode input til at optimere samarbejdet og få en bedre forståelse af hinandens arbejdsopgaver. Det har bl.a. udmøntet sig i, at vi har ansat flere reddere i kombinationsstillinger med AMK, for at vi på den måde kan spille hinanden endnu bedre - til gavn for os og patienterne.

Du kan være nyuddannet eller have +30 års erfaring.
Det vigtigste for os er, at du er stolt af dit fag, vil arbejde på at give hver enkelt patient, du møder, en god oplevelse, samt ønsker at være en del af et unikt fællesskab. Du er en holdspiller, der bidrager positivt til teamet – også på de travle vagter.

Og du kan selvfølgelig dokumentere:

  • en godkendt uddannelse som ambulancebehandler eller paramediciner
  • en børneattest og en straffeattest forenelig med jobbet som ambulanceredder
  • gyldigt kørekort til minimum kategori B og C
Kan du se dig selv hos os?

Så send din ansøgning senest d. 30. august.
Vi holder samtaler d. 8. september i Odense.

Du bedes vedhæfte kopi af gyldigt kørekort samt kopi af dit svendebrev.

Løn
Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i Ambulanceuddannet personale - overenskomst 32.44.1 - løn pr. 1.4.2026. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer. Se startløn for stillinger i Region Syddanmark.

Har du spørgsmål, så kontakt endelig én af vores områdeledere:

  • Camilla Simonsen på mail camilla.simonsen@rsyd.dk
  • Peter Stolberg på mail pstolberg@rsyd.dk
Vores mission, vision og værdier
Det er vigtigt for os, at vores medarbejdere kan se sig selv i Præhospital Syds værdigrundlag:
Stolthed – Sammenhold – Tillid – Fremsynethed

Vi er samtidig en del af Region Syddanmark, hvor værdierne er:
Ordentlighed – Faglig vækst – Fornyelse – Begejstring

Alle medarbejdere spiller en central rolle i at omsætte vores mission til konkret praksis:
“Vi yder en professionel og omsorgsfuld præhospital indsats – døgnet rundt i Region Syddanmark. Vi er der, når du har brug for hurtig hjælp, og vi tager ansvar for, at regionen er forberedt på alle typer beredskabshændelser.”

Vores vision er:
“Vi sætter borgeren først i alt, hvad vi gør. Som en del af det samlede sundhedsvæsen udvikler vi nye måder at hjælpe hurtigt, klogt og sammenhængende – med respekt for den enkelte og til gavn for alle i regionen.”

description:

Job Description:


3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

Accountable for leading the delivery, engineering, and support of the EUC Systems Management portfolio within a diverse Agile Scrum team, including Intune, MECM, Windows, and macOS, with responsibility for endpoint security, compliance, patching, application lifecycle management, device provisioning, vulnerability management, automation, reporting, and user experience optimization.

Managed Service Partner Governance

  • Lead engagement with Managed Service Partners (MSPs) to drive seamless operations, service excellence, and the successful delivery of technical initiatives, ensuring commitments, priorities, and business objectives are achieved.

Project & Delivery Management

  • Lead, prioritize, and govern delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams, managing timelines, dependencies, risks, and execution to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Support the Global team with Lifecycle upgrades of the Operating System and Systems Management tools.
  • Lead the validation, testing, deployment, and operational readiness of new software deployments and configuration changes.
  • Lead MSP and partner with cross-functional teams to ensure all devices comply with Security and Device Configuration Standards.
  • Lead OS and third-party application patching, ensuring remediation activities are completed within defined SLAs while maintaining high compliance and operational stability.
  • Own Endpoint Vulnerability Management activities, driving identification, prioritization, tracking, remediation, and reporting of endpoint security vulnerabilities in collaboration with Security Operations, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams.
  • Manage and evolve Endpoint Image Management, including standardized Windows image creation, maintenance, application provisioning, and deployment modernization through Intune, Autopilot, and MECM.


End User Experience & Automation

  • Lead strategic initiatives to identify and eliminate recurring operational issues, reducing manual overhead to improving service quality, reduce IT process friction and improve client satisfaction leveraging expert knowledge of Microsoft endpoint management technologies and automation platforms.

Stakeholder Communication & Leadership Reporting

  • Provide clear, concise, and timely updates with insightful reporting, compliance metrics, and actionable recommendations on operational performance, project progress, risks, issues, and key metrics to Leadership team and stakeholders.

Continuous Learning & Technology Innovation

  • Evaluate, implement, and promote emerging technologies, modern management capabilities, and best practices that improve endpoint management.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the advancement of endpoint management capabilities across the organization.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution OR High School diploma/GED or higher.
  • 9+ years of IT experience in lieu of the education requirement, including 6+ years of hands-on experience leading the administration and engineering of both Microsoft Intune and MECM in enterprise environments, and 2+ years of experience managing Managed Service Partners (MSPs), with deep expertise in device configuration management, modern device provisioning and deployment strategies, compliance and security policy implementation, Conditional Access integration, Windows Update for Business (WUfB), software deployment, vulnerability management, patching, and endpoint lifecycle management.
  • Proven track record of evaluating, recommending, and adoption of emerging technologies, modern management capabilities, and automation solutions across the EUC ecosystem to enhance user experience, drive innovation, strengthen security, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication, leadership reporting, project and delivery management skills, with experience working in Agile environments and successfully managing multiple concurrent workstreams, priorities, dependencies, risks, and cross-functional initiatives

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Deep technical knowledge of pcs, desktop hardware, current protocols, operating systems, and standards
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on project management experience with a focus on delivering complex projects in an organized and efficient manner
  • Software and Hardware Troubleshooting Experience in provisioning, imaging and deploying devices and device management
  • Scrum Master Certification

Work location: Bangalore: Hybrid

description:
Bij een parttime baan als werkstudent die van echte waarde is, hoort een organisatie die voor echte waarde staat. Voor klanten, de maatschappij en de mensen om je heen. Dat is BDO. Bij ons kun jij een bijdrage leveren en aandacht geven aan wat er echt toe doet.

Die bijdrage lever je binnen een unieke werkcultuur met volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Pal naast het station in Zwolle vind je het BDO-kantoor waar bijna 100 werkplekken zijn. De mensen die hier werken zijn erg gedreven, betrokken en gepassioneerd over hun vak. De personeelsvereniging is er actief en collega’s haken graag aan bij allerlei activiteiten. Ook buiten het werk zien de collega’s elkaar geregeld.

Hiermee voeg jij waarde toe
Wij zijn nieuwsgierig. Naar wie jíj bent én wat je kunt. Dus hoe kwaliteitsgericht en leergierig ben jij? Wat maakt jouw persoonlijkheid uniek? Op welke manier zien wij jouw overtuigingskracht terug in wat je doet? Verder kijken we voor deze vliegende start bij BDO of je:

  • studeert aan een fiscaal recht of fiscaal-economische bachelor of master.

title: Data Analyst II
description:
The Data Analyst II is a practitioner-level role designed for an analytics professional eager to master the intersection of marketing technology and healthcare business outcomes. In this role, you will play a vital part in delivering product and data analytics solutions for leading healthcare organizations, specializing in the healthcare digital experience.

You will work within a collaborative, cross-functional consulting team, using data-driven insights to support strategic business decisions, improve digital experiences, and drive measurable outcomes. This role requires hands-on experience in product and web analytics with proficiency in Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA). The ideal candidate is a curious "builder" who is ready to move beyond the "how" to master the "why," bridging the gap between complex technical features and tangible business value for our clients


Here's a list of duties and responsibilities you'd take on as a Modea Data Analyst II:

  • Analytics Implementation and Tracking

  • Set up, configure, and maintain tracking on healthcare websites and mobile apps to capture critical data points across user journeys.
  • Serve as a contributor on Adobe CJA implementations and ongoing support engagements—configuring data views, building workspace projects, and troubleshooting data discrepancies.
  • Work with engineering teams to implement and test tags and scripts using tools like Freshpaint or Tealium, ensuring accurate and HIPAA-compliant data collection.
  • Design and maintain tracking plans, including event naming conventions.

  • Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Produce high-quality client deliverables, including initial performance reports and solution documentation.
  • Analyze web and product analytics data to identify user behavior patterns, conversion trends, and opportunities for optimization.
  • Develop insights, dashboards, and regular reports using platforms like GA4, Heap, and Adobe CJA, ensuring clarity and relevance for healthcare stakeholders.
  • Utilize SQL, Python, or R to query, clean, and transform large datasets, enabling detailed analyses that drive client decision-making.

  • Consulting and Client Communication

  • Own individual work streams within larger enterprise projects, hitting deadlines consistently while proactively communicating progress and potential blockers.
  • Present findings and recommendations clearly and conversationally during ad-hoc project milestone meetings, adapting to client needs and anticipating concerns.
  • Educate clients on best practices for analytics tracking, data interpretation, and the strategic use of analytics for business growth.
  • Analyze client requests to surface underlying business drivers and identify when to escalate risks or flag expansion opportunities.

  • General Expectations

  • Operate with a "builder" mindset, staying updated on industry trends in healthcare analytics, compliance, and data privacy.
  • Travel Expectations: Occasional travel to client sites (approx. 5-10%) and attendance at the annual company meeting.
  • Performs other duties as assigned that are reasonably within the scope of this position.

Some critical competencies we'd like you to have are:

  • Curiosity: Demonstrates a self-directed interest in generating original queries and digging into complex client questions for ad-hoc reporting and superior service.
  • Adaptability: Ability to remain flexible as toolkits and client needs change, maintaining proficiency across a wide range of tools, concepts, and datasets.
  • Communication Skills: Must be a polished oral and written communicator, capable of presenting findings to diverse audiences and translating complex technical concepts into business-friendly language.
  • Reliability: Proven ability to manage multiple work streams in parallel with a high degree of organization and a "self-starter" mindset.

Here's a list of minimum requirements that are necessary for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience with digital analytics, technical consulting, or related analytical fields.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) (implementation, workspace analysis, or configuration).
  • Proficient in data analysis, including data cleaning, transformation, and interpretation.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience (CS, MIS, or Data Science preferred).
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Candidates with the following will be considered preferred:

  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in tag management platforms (Freshpaint, Tealium) and data visualization tools (Looker Studio, Tableau, PowerBI).
  • Advanced Skills: Strong SQL skills (complex queries, database optimization) and experience with R and/or Python.
  • Certifications: Adobe certifications (e.g., CJA Business Practitioner) are strongly encouraged.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience in healthcare analytics, including familiarity with HIPAA compliance and unique healthcare data challenges.

Who is Modea?
We are a technology consultancy with a mission to infuse greater control, transparency, and choice into the consumer healthcare experience. To do this, we work with large healthcare providers to help them build out a digital roadmap, then design and build mobile, web, and other digital experiences. We fundamentally believe that this work helps consumers have better information and access to care, and our clients to build stronger customer relationships.

Here are a few ways to get to know our work in healthcare:

  • Learn about our award-winning EHR-integrated mobile app development for Children’s Wisconsin. This app delivers a fully integrated MyChart to allow parents to manage their children’s health in one place.
  • Discover Luminis Health’s website development that was built with a firm accessibility standard and patient-centric solutions.
  • If you’re interested in learning more, we encourage you to dive into some of our other work.

Here are a few other reasons why you should apply:
First, you’ll love the work we do and the people you’ll get to do it with. We’ve assembled an exceptionally smart and hardworking team and you’ll enjoy the work associations and general camaraderie with other “Modeans.” We also work with great clients who value our contributions and work side-by-side with us.

Second, Modea offers a great benefits package that provides both a fun and enjoyable workplace and great perks that will improve your quality of life:

  • Generous paid time off
  • Generous health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401k with fully vested company matching
  • Long-term & short-term disability

Some of these benefits, like parties and snacks, have had to adapt to the remote work environment we are currently in, but our operations team has found innovative ways to support our employees. We take care of our team.

Capable of occasionally transporting items of 10 lbs or less to and from the office.

title: Senior External Relations Officer (Internal and Executive Communications)

title: Operations Intern for AVD (Altersvorsorgedepot) (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

What you’ll do:

  • Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.

  • Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

  • Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

  • Support our client teams: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

  • Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

What you bring:

  • You are fluent in German (C1 or above) and comfortable working in English. This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German.

  • You're a student in Business, Economics, Finance, Law, or a related field — or on a gap year between degrees.

  • You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up.

  • You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You're confident with spreadsheets. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required.

  • You're available for a minimum of 4 months (6 preferred) and based in Berlin.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
