title: DTICI_Techstack_DC & Cloud_T6
description:
Solution architect ensures that compute platforms are scalable, resilient, secure, standardized, and aligned with business growth, application requirements, and enterprise technology strategies. Working closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Teams, Security, Operations, Application Owners, and Managed Service Providers, the role drives modernization, automation, and transformation initiatives across global infrastructure environments.

Data Center & Cloud Architecture

  • Define enterprise architecture standards, blueprints, and reference designs for compute infrastructure across data center and cloud environments.
  • Design scalable and resilient architectures for:
    • Physical Server Infrastructure
    • Virtualization Platforms
    • Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI)
    • Private Cloud Platforms
    • Public Cloud Compute Services
    • Hybrid Cloud Environments
  • Establish reusable architecture patterns supporting business-critical workloads and applications.
  • Develop target-state architectures aligned with enterprise technology roadmaps.

Compute Platform Strategy & Governance

  • Define technology standards and lifecycle strategies for enterprise compute platforms.
  • Govern infrastructure architecture across global regions and service providers.
  • Ensure standardization, scalability, availability, and operational consistency.
  • Lead technology evaluations, architecture reviews, and design governance activities.
  • Support infrastructure investment planning and technology refresh initiatives.

Virtualization & Hyperconverged Infrastructure

  • Define architecture standards for virtualization platforms including VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, and related technologies.
  • Design highly available and resilient virtual infrastructure solutions.
  • Develop HCI architecture patterns supporting scalability and operational efficiency.
  • Establish best practices for compute resource allocation, clustering, resiliency, and disaster recovery.
  • Support modernization and consolidation initiatives across data center environments.

Cloud Architecture & Hybrid Cloud Enablement

  • Design secure and scalable cloud compute architectures across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud platforms.
  • Define hybrid cloud connectivity and workload placement strategies.
  • Establish governance models for cloud adoption and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Support cloud migration, modernization, and transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure cloud architectures align with security, compliance, and operational requirements.

Capacity Planning & Infrastructure Scalability

  • Design and govern enterprise compute capacity management frameworks.
  • Forecast infrastructure demand and future growth requirements across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM.
  • Ensure compute, storage, and virtualization platforms scale ahead of business demand.
  • Define performance and utilization thresholds supporting proactive capacity management.
  • Support infrastructure investment planning and lifecycle management activities.

Infrastructure Automation & Modernization

  • Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and cloud-native operating models.
  • Define architecture standards supporting automated provisioning and configuration management.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve operational efficiency through automation.
  • Support CI/CD integration and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Promote standardized and repeatable deployment methodologies.

High Availability, Resilience & Disaster Recovery

  • Define architecture standards for business continuity, resilience, and disaster recovery.
  • Design highly available compute and cloud environments supporting critical workloads.
  • Establish recovery objectives, failover strategies, and resiliency frameworks.
  • Ensure infrastructure architectures meet enterprise availability requirements.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Incorporate monitoring, telemetry, observability, and operational intelligence requirements into infrastructure designs.
  • Define architecture standards for platform monitoring, performance management, and capacity analytics.
  • Utilize operational insights to drive architecture optimization and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure visibility across hybrid infrastructure environments.

Transformation & Migration Architecture

  • Lead architecture activities supporting:
    • Data Center Modernization
    • Cloud Migration Programs
    • Virtualization Refresh Initiatives
    • Infrastructure Consolidation Projects
    • Hybrid Cloud Transformation
  • Develop migration strategies from legacy environments to target-state architectures.
  • Define rollout approaches, transition plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Support global deployment and transformation programs.

Provider & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Managed Service Providers, Cloud Service Providers, Infrastructure Engineering teams, and Regional IT organizations.
  • Provide architecture guidance throughout project and service lifecycles.
  • Support global rollout activities and technology adoption initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment between business requirements and infrastructure capabilities.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Develop and maintain:
    • High-Level Designs (HLD)
    • Low-Level Designs (LLD)
    • Architecture Standards
    • Technology Roadmaps
    • Reference Architectures
    • Best Practice Documentation
  • Govern architecture repositories and documentation quality standards.
  • Deliver technical training and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Promote adoption of architecture standards and reusable design patterns.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Engineering, or related discipline.

title: Tahseen Front Office
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Tahseen, an interdisciplinary hospitality leadership development program; aims at successfully driving increased levels of engagement and interest of Local Nationals into this ever-growing professional sector. Tahseen is a 12 – 18 month program in cooperation with Cornell University.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years’ experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years’ experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Discipline Work, Projects, and Policies

• Coordinates and implements accounting work and projects as assigned.

• Coordinates, implements, and follows up on audits for all areas of property operations.

• Complies with Federal and State laws applying to operations procedures.

• Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.

• Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

• Compiles, codes, categorizes, calculates, tabulates, audits, or verifies information or data.

• Balances ledgers.

Supporting Property Operations

• Works with operations teams to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.

• Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

• Evaluates if discipline teams are meeting service needs and provides feedback to teams.

• Participates in walk-throughs on property to ensure that all areas are well maintained and preventative maintenance processes are in place.

• Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.

• Reviews findings from comment cards and guest satisfaction results with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.

• Works with team to put sustainable work processes and systems in place that support the execution of the strategy.

• Reviews reports and financial statements to determine operations performance against budget.

• Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

Managing and Monitoring Activities that Affect the Customer and Guest Experience

• Provides excellent customer service by being readily available/approachable for all customers and guests.

• Takes proactive approaches when dealing with customers and guest concerns.

• Extends professionalism and courtesy to customers and guests at all times.

• Responds timely to customer service department request.

• Ensures all team members meet or exceed all hospitality requirements.

Supporting Profitability

• Supports annual quality audits.

• Reviews financial statements, sales and activity reports, and other performance data to measure productivity and goal achievement and to determine areas needing cost reduction and program improvement.

Supporting Safety Standards and Work Procedures

• Implements property emergency plan.

• Provides a safe working environment in compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration/MSDS.

• Implements and sustains property accident prevention programs.

• Follows property-specific recovery plans.

Additional Responsibilities

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Demonstrates self confidence, energy and enthusiasm.

• Manages group or interpersonal conflict.

• Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

• Manages time and possesses organizational skills.

• Presents ideas, expectations and information in a concise, organized manner.

• Uses problem solving methodology for decision making and follow up.

• Makes calls if necessary.

Leadership Development

• Interpreting financial statements, managing people, and the essentials of hospitality marketing and planning.

• Includes a combination of specialized industry knowledge and leadership skills. It will allow you to learn from the best experts in the School of Hotel Administration. This certificate program consists of a mix of core courses and selective courses.

Education for Employment (EFE)

• The EFE component uses a blend of locally and internationally developed Hospitality courses that have been especially created to prepare Local nationals for careers in the hospitality industry.

• This six-weeks part of Tahseen includes approximately 260hrs of hospitality training, with many components specific to workplace readiness and better understanding of the work environment and the nature of the jobs.

General Training

• Occurs in the first six months of the program. Each participant will rotate through the six key disciplines on property, spending between 2 – 3 weeks in each discipline. The six disciplines are:

• Rooms Operations

• Food & Beverage

• Sales & Marketing (BMSC)

• Human Resources

• Safety & Security (Loss Prevention)

• Finance

The Specialization Course

• Occurs in the last six months of the program and will focus on one discipline of the participant’s choice and leadership feedback. You will complete additional required training in this discipline and begin to gain deeper knowledge and develop skills necessary to become an effective leader in this discipline.

• The customized program includes local culture training, business English and is translated locally in Arabic so you are empowered to achieve success.

• Through Tahseen, you will gain fundamental knowledge and exposure to a wide array of hospitality disciplines. You will train with, and lean from, best-in-class hospitality leaders from around the globe – developing vital skill and be part of shaping your country’s economic future.

• Upon completing the Tahseen Program, you will be an expert in a discipline you are passionate about and have pride and confidence in the accelerated career path you have chosen.

title: Lead PAM Risk Analyst
description:
Job Description:

Position Summary

We are seeking a Lead PAM Risk Analyst to strengthen enterprise privileged access governance, risk management, compliance, and access controls. The role will identify and mitigate privileged-access risks, lead access reviews and remediation, support audits, and partner with technology and security teams to improve the organization’s security posture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Governance and Risk
    • Conduct privileged access reviews and entitlement assessments across critical systems.
    • Identify, analyze, and drive remediation of risks involving privileged accounts, service accounts, and elevated access.
    • Review exceptions, policy violations, and privileged access requests to confirm that appropriate controls are in place.
    • Monitor compliance with PAM policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.

description:

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

title: Kalder alle supersælgere! Circle K Fredericia søger nye sælger på 25 timer om ugen
description:
Kære fremtidige kollega

Først og fremmest, lad os starte med at sige, at et job som Sælger hos Circle K ikke er for alle. Men det er et job der passer til mange, og måske også dig?

At arbejde som sælger på Circle K er ikke som ethvert sælgerjob. Os der arbejder her er vilde med det, og spørger du en af vores uundværlige sælgere om hvorfor, vil de bla nævne: Selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og ansvar.

Vi leder efter en positiv teamplayer som:

  • Har en sælger gemt I sig, motiveres af salg og kan levere en service lidt ud over det sædvanlige

  • Kan bevare overblikket og humøret, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft. Også selvom der er lang kø

  • Har en interesse for at tilberede mad. For vi elsker det! Og vi ser derfor gerne, at du har lyst til, at lave de lækreste sandwich og de bedste burgere.

  • Forstår vigtigheden af, at vores kunder får den bedste oplevelse når de besøger os. Dette indebærer også at butikken, kundetoilet og forplads er ren og pæn.

  • Du forstår betydningen af, at arbejde i et team, hvor alle er afhængige af- og stoler på, at hver løfter sit. Og til tider er villig til at give lidt ekstra.

Hvad kan I tilbyde mig?

Vi er en dynamisk, handlingsorienteret organisation, hvor vi arbejder sammen som ét team. Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt og engagerer os ikke i politik eller bureaukrati. Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på.

Udover helt unikke udviklingsmuligheder, tilbyder vi et job med yderst attraktive fordele og personalegoder. Som en del af vores Circle K familie vil du bla få medarbejderrabat på brændstof, bilvask samt på mad og drikkevarer i vores butikker. Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring

  • Fordelagtige lønninger og forskudttidstillæg

  • Og ikke mindst, Danmarks bedste kollegaer

Mange der i dag driver vores stationer eller arbejder på vores kontor, startede deres karriere som sælgere på stationen, måske var tanken bare at blive hos os et stykke tid, men det var begyndelsen på en lang karriere! Og for dig der har andre mål og drømme i din karriere, er Circle K et fantastisk sted til at få erfaring, der er værd at tage med sig videre i arbejdslivet.

Så hvis du vil have et job, hvor du kan være med til at give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse, udvikle dig og blive en del af et fantastisk team på Circle K Fredericia, så er det nu du skal sende din ansøgning afsted. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Store Manager Stine Greis på tlf nr.: 75 93 42 44

Antal ledige stillinger og timer:

Vagterne kan være placeret på hele døgnet, men primært aften og nat. Der vil være vagter på hverdage og weekender. Arbejdstiden er placeret på tidspunkter, der betyder, at stillingen er forbeholdt ansøgere over 18 år og ikke egner sig som studiejob.

Ansøgningsfrist og tiltrædelse:

Løbende, Jobsamtaler afholdes efter 1/9-2026

På vej i den rigtige retning - vil du være med?

Hos Circle K arbejder vi på en mere bæredygtig og klimavenlig transport. Vi arbejder for at elbiler, flydende el og biobrændstoffer er både tilgængelige og effektive, da de får en afgørende rolle i den bæredygtige fremtid, vi sætter kursen mod.

title: HRIS Consultant
description:
Werken bij Septeo als HRIS Consultant betekent:

  • Verantwoordelijk zijn voor de volledige implementatie van onze HR-oplossing, mpleo, bij onze klanten, afgestemd op hun specifieke HR-behoeften.
  • Analyse van bestaande HR-processen en advies geven over best practices en geschikte oplossingen.
  • Configureren en personaliseren van de functionaliteiten van de mpleo-software op basis van de geïdentificeerde functionele behoeften.
  • HR-gebruikers opleiden in het gebruik van onze applicatie.
  • Beheer van een gevarieerd klantenportfolio en fungeren als hun vaste aanspreekpunt voor alle vragen over de software.
  • Op maat gemaakte rapporten voorbereiden en de implementatie opvolgen.
  • Projecten coördineren met alle interne en externe stakeholders.
  • Actief deelnemen aan interne discussies over continue verbetering en de ontwikkeling van nieuwe functionaliteiten.
  • Samenwerken in een team, in een collaboratieve omgeving waar het delen van best practices en expertise wordt aangemoedigd.
  • Regelmatig klanten bezoeken om nabijheid en ondersteuning te garanderen.
  • Flexibel werken, op kantoor of thuis, met een autonome en efficiënte tijdsindeling.

Bij mpleo geloven we in groei en ontwikkeling: hoe meer je je expertise ontwikkelt, hoe meer verantwoordelijkheden je krijgt.

  • Opleiding: Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma en een passie voor human resources, digitalisering en software-implementatie.
  • Ervaring: Aantoonbare professionele ervaring in HR en projectmanagement, bij voorkeur in een consultancycontext. Ervaring met software-implementatie is een echte troef.
  • Talen: Uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands (mondeling en schriftelijk). Goede kennis van het Frans.
  • Technische vaardigheden: Zeer vertrouwd met Excel, in staat om relevante analyses te maken en een basiskennis van databanken is een plus.
  • Soft skills:
    • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden.
    • Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken en tegelijk goed samen te werken in teamverband.
    • Analytisch en flexibel denkvermogen.
    • Nieuwsgierig en leergierig.
    • Flexibel en goed in het omgaan met verandering.

Ons aanbod:

  • Een sleutelrol in een groeiend bedrijf : Bij mpleo krijg je de kans om een cruciale bijdrage te leveren.
  • Dynamisch en geëngageerd team: Je wordt onderdeel van een resultaatgericht en gedreven team.
  • Moderne werkomgeving: Onze werkplek in Zaventem biedt een aangename, moderne sfeer waarin je je snel thuis zult voelen.
  • Aantrekkelijk salaris en extralegale voordelen: Voltijds contract voor onbepaalde duur inclusief firmawagen met tankkaart, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, groepsverzekering, hospitalisatieverzekering, representatiekosten en meer.
  • Goede werk-privébalans: Flexibele werkuren, 20 vakantiedagen en 12 ADV-dagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid tot home-working na een introductieperiode.

Passie voor human resources, digitalisering en software-implementatie is een pluspunt, maar alles kan worden aangeleerd. Als deze job je aanspreekt, neem dan zeker contact op!

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
In our line of work, life isn’t a given - it’s the ultimate goal. When life takes an unexpected turn, our technology and solutions enable caregivers to make informed diagnostic decisions to improve patient care. This is our shared purpose at Radiometer and what unites all +4000 of us - no matter our roles or where in the world we’re located. Creating impactful innovations like ours, doesn’t happen overnight - it requires uncompromising persistency, passion, and a desire to make a difference. Here, you can learn, grow, and chart an uncommonly diverse career.

Radiometer is proud to work alongside a community of six fellow Diagnostics Companies at Danaher. Together, we’re working at the pace of change to improve patient lives with diagnostic tools that address the world’s biggest health challenges.

The Field Service Engineer for Radiometer is responsible for ensuring Customer Excellence through troubleshooting, installation, preventative maintenance, and service repair needs on Radiometer analyzers. The FSE is an external representative of Radiometer and must convey a keen sense of expertise in Radiometer products, services and capabilities and serve as a key educator to our customer business accounts.

This position is part of the Customer Support function located in Arar-Northern Border, Saudi Arabia. At Radiometer, our vision is to improve global healthcare with reliable, fast, and easy patient diagnoses.

You will be a part of the Service Team and report to the Service Team Leader C/E. If you thrive in a fast-paced role and want to work to build a world-class Service organization—read on.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Advanced troubleshooting, installation, preventative maintenance, and servicing of analyzers for the assigned installed base. Maintain tools and test equipment to ensure they are properly calibrated.
  • Complete assigned Regulatory Field Action Notes and Technical updates within the specified due dates and meet all applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Install our analyzers and conduct customer user training as required.
  • Order and manage spare parts cycle time by accurately recording spare parts used on service jobs.
  • Comply with company regulations, guidelines, policies, and compliance requirements.
  • Upgrading Operating system and keeping devices cybersecurity compliant
  • Basic IT troubleshooting for devices with Windows 7/10/11
  • Adding/editing IP addresses on the devices and confirming connection to Middleware or LIS\HIS\EMR

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • University graduation in biomedical engineering, mechanical/electromechanical engineering, electronic engineering, or equivalent qualification.
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience as a field service engineer in healthcare industry in Medical & POC devices/Diagnostic equipment, expert in troubleshooting, Networking/connectivity setup and IT system upgrades, basic command prompts command, connectivity testing of devices with middleware or LIS\HIS\EMR.
  • Excellent analytical, interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical issues in an easy-to-understand manner.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Working with SQL database, Java, Mirth.
  • Working with Microsoft Office Tools & CRM.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: Tyrkisktalende telefoninterviewer i Odense
description:
Wilke hjælper danske virksomheder og organisationer med at blive klogere på mennesker og deres holdninger. Det gør vi blandt andet gennem telefoniske interviews, og det er her, du som interviewer kommer ind i billedet.

Vi søger tyrkisktalende interviewere til telefoninterview (CATI) på samfundsvigtige forbrugerundersøgelser, hvor vi indsamler data, der bruges i officielle analyser og statistikker.

Det er et krav, at du taler tyrkisk flydende og samtidig kan kommunikere godt på dansk.

Arbejdet foregår på vores centralt beliggende kontor i Odense, Gråbrødrepassagen 9, 2. sal, og der er ikke mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

Om jobbet

Som interviewer ringer du til et repræsentativt udsnit af befolkningen og gennemfører interviews ud fra faste spørgeskemaer. En del af interviewene gennemføres med tyrkisktalende respondenter, og derfor er det afgørende, at du kan føre en naturlig og professionel samtale på tyrkisk.

Du arbejder struktureret og neutralt og følger metodiske retningslinjer nøje for at sikre valide og brugbare data.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Gennemførelse af CATI-forbrugerundersøgelser

  • Telefoniske interviews på både tyrkisk og dansk

  • Professionel og neutral dialog med respondenter

  • Korrekt registrering af svar i spørgeskemaet

  • Dataindsamling, der bruges til analyser og statistikker

Du bliver en del af et professionelt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet og ordentlighed.

Om dig

Vi søger dig, der taler tyrkisk flydende og har gode danskkundskaber.

Det er en fordel, hvis du er studerende på en videregående uddannelse og har erfaring med eller interesse for metode, analyse eller dataindsamling, men det er ikke et krav.

Vi forventer, at du er:

  • Flydende på tyrkisk

  • God til at kommunikere på dansk – både mundtligt og skriftligt

  • Mødestabil

  • Struktureret og detaljeorienteret

  • Kvalitetsbevidst og lærenem

  • Selvstændig og ansvarsfuld

  • Tryg ved at ringe til mennesker og skabe en god dialog

  • I stand til at kommunikere neutralt og professionelt med forskellige typer respondenter

Arbejdstid

Du vil primært arbejde på følgende vagter:

  • Aftenvagter, typisk kl. 16.30–20.30

  • Weekendvagter, typisk kl. 10.00–16.00

Vi søger især interviewere, der kan arbejde minimum 2 aftenvagter om ugen.

Antallet af timer kan variere, og i perioder vil der også være mulighed for at arbejde på hverdage mellem kl. 8.00 og 16.00. Vi har desuden mulighed for at lave vagtplaner, der passer til din hverdag.

Praktisk info

Som interviewer hos Wilke kan du forvente:

  • At blive en del af Wilkes Fieldwork-afdeling med ca. 200 medarbejdere

  • Vagtfleksibilitet og et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø

  • Grundig oplæring, briefing og løbende sparring

  • En flad organisation med mulighed for mere ansvar

  • Fast timeløn på 125 kr. + feriepenge

Hvem er Wilke?

Wilke er en dansk rådgivnings- og analysevirksomhed, der hjælper virksomheder og organisationer med at skabe værdifulde indsigter.

Vi arbejder for nogle af Danmarks største private og offentlige aktører og gennemfører dataindsamling, analyser og rådgivning, der bruges som grundlag for beslutninger og officielle undersøgelser.

Ansøgning

Send en ansøgning, hvor du kort beskriver:

  • Din nuværende situation, fx studerende, pensioneret eller andet

  • Din alder, bopæl og kontaktinformation

  • Dit niveau i tyrkisk og dansk

  • Hvorfor du søger jobbet

  • Hvordan dine kompetencer og erfaringer kan bruges til at blive en god interviewer

  • Relevant erfaring, kort og præcist

Send ansøgning og CV til: job@wilke.dk

Angiv [Telefoninterviewer – “NAVN”] i emnefeltet.

Du kan også ansøge via GoHire.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: SMB Account Representative
description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a SMB Account Representative who will drive incremental expansion, upsell, and cross-sell revenue within our existing Small and Medium Business (SMB) customer base. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a SMB Account Representative, your key area of responsibility will be utilizing consultative selling techniques to articulate value propositions and ROI, execute strategic marketing campaigns, and guide platform migrations to ensure long-term customer retention, maximum account value, and overall client satisfaction. You will need to work closely with New Logo Sales, Marketing, and Partner teams. To be successful in this role, you will be a high-drive, self-confident professional with strong communication, negotiation, and closing skills. In addition, the successful candidate will have a proven track record in consultative sales and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

How you'll make an impact:

Account Expansion & Upsell Sales

  • Engage and close expansion and upsell sales opportunities to generate new revenue streams within existing SMB accounts.

  • Focus on high-potential, complex SMB clients using a consultative sales approach.

  • Execute Go-To-Market strategies for new product offerings, delivering tailored up-selling and cross-selling solutions.

  • Articulate value propositions and clear ROI to decision-makers to increase share of wallet.

Campaign Execution & Platform Migration

  • Execute targeted vertical market, feature-matching, and customer marketing campaigns to convert leads into closed expansion opportunities.

  • Lead and manage strategic migration campaigns to transition existing clients to updated solutions and product platforms, driving customer retention.

  • Support and drive the launch of new features across designated account segments.

Collaboration & Client Advocacy

  • Collaborate closely with New Logo Sales, Marketing, and Partner teams to ensure aligned expansion efforts yield strong ROI for both the company and the customer.

  • Cultivate positive brand relationships to generate referrals and build a robust portfolio of referenceable clients.

  • Function as an internal stakeholder providing feedback on customer needs and process improvements as the customer experience evolves.

What you'll bring to this role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent practical experience in sales, marketing, or business operations.

  • 1–2 years of professional experience in sales, marketing, and/or product management.

  • Proven track record in consultative sales, value proposition selling, and ROI delivery.

  • High level of drive, self-confidence, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and closing skills.

  • Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets/quotas and executing expansion campaigns.

  • Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally across marketing, sales, and partner networks.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.

Why job seekers choose Geotab:

Flex working arrangements
Home office reimbursement program
Fantastic state of the art office
Electric vehicle purchase incentive program
Public transportation reimbursement Employer pension contributions
Subsidized fitness membership
Co-pay tuition reimbursement

How we work:

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!

title: 🪚 Snedkere og bygningssnedkere – nyt er ikke altid bedre
description:

Vi søger flere udlærte snedkere og bygningssnedkere, der kan lide den del af faget, hvor godt håndværk, præcision og respekt for de gamle byggemetoder går hånd i hånd.

Du kommer til at arbejde med restaurering, specialfremstilling og traditionelt snedkerarbejde – blandt andet på historiske bygninger rundt omkring i Danmark.

🪵 Hvad skal du arbejde med?

Her er ikke meget samlebånd over hverdagen. Opgaverne spænder blandt andet over:

Nogle opgaver kræver maskiner. Andre kræver godt gammeldags håndelag. Fælles for dem er, at finishen skal sidde i skabet. 🔨

  • Synes, at traditionelle håndværksmetoder stadig har deres berettigelse

Arbejdspladsen er et veletableret tømrerfirma på Fyn med eget savværk og mere end 30 års erfaring.

Det betyder også, at du får mulighed for at arbejde med nogle opgaver, man ikke lige støder på hver dag.

title: Operations Supervisor, Quick Commerce
description:
Please be aware that this role requires a commitment of 32 hours per week.

Location: Walthamstow
Site Location: Unit 16, Chiltonian Industrial Estate, Lewisham, SE12 0TX

Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.

About the team
Quick Commerce (QC) delivers ultra-fast convenience through our network of small warehouse in city center locations, partnering with last-mile delivery providers to get products to customers in 30 minutes or less. We combine creative thinking and technological innovation to fulfill millions of urgent shopping missions, offering a curated selection of grocery items and Amazon essentials.
Our operations have two key components. Our 'under the roof' associates process orders with industry-leading speed, picking and packing customer orders to enable our 30-minute delivery promise. We operate with a people-first approach, with teams working across morning and afternoon shifts to serve customers seven days a week.
Meanwhile, our 'on the road' delivery network primarily utilizes Amazon Flex delivery partners on e-bikes specially optimized for rapid urban delivery. We continuously innovate to improve customer experience, focusing on sustainable delivery solutions in dense urban areas while maintaining strict quality and food safety standards.
Our team combines the best of Amazon's retail and logistics expertise, leveraging both Fresh and AMZL operational excellence. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages creative problem-solving and continuous improvement, as we work to revolutionize convenience shopping through ultra-fast delivery.

title: Principal Data Scientist (User Understanding Platformisation)
description:
Get to Know the Team

You will join our Search and Personalization team — a group of engineers and data scientists building the intelligence that helps millions of users discover and engage with food, groceries, mobility, and services across Southeast Asia. We work with engineering, product, and business teams to develop foundational machine learning capabilities that allow Grab to better understand users and deliver relevant experiences across the platform.

Get to Know the Role

Reporting to the Head of Data Science, Business Ecosystem, you'll be based onsite in the Grab One North Singapore office. This is a Principal Data Scientist and senior individual contributor role in the Search and Personalization team, focusing on user understanding platformization and generative recommendation.

You will provide technical leadership in building shared user understanding capabilities that power personalized experiences across Grab, including search, recommendation, chatbot, notification, and other user-facing applications. You will work across Data Science, Engineering, and Product to shape the long-term technical direction, turn latest artificial intelligence research into practical solutions, and drive adoption of these capabilities across teams.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • You will define the technical strategy and roadmap for user understanding and generative personalization, identifying foundational ML capabilities that can be shared across search, recommendation, chatbot, and other personalized experiences.
  • You will architect and develop large-scale user understanding systems that capture long-term preferences, real time intent, behavioral patterns, interests, and contextual signals from heterogeneous user interactions across Grab.
  • You will develop reusable user representations and foundation models that support diverse downstream tasks, including retrieval, ranking, recommendation, conversational personalization, targeting, and engagement.
  • You will advance generative recommendation, exploring foundation models, generative retrieval, sequence modeling, and unified user-item representations to complement and evolve conventional retrieval and ranking architectures.
  • You will drive the platformization of user understanding, turning successful modeling approaches into reusable representations, models, features, APIs, and serving systems adopted by multiple teams.
  • You will establish rigorous offline and online evaluation methodologies to measure the quality, generalizability, and incremental impact of user understanding and generative models across downstream applications.
  • You will partner with senior machine learning and platform engineers to design production architectures for large-scale model training, representation generation, real-time user understanding, and low-latency serving.
  • You will evaluate emerging research in generative recommendation, foundation models, user modeling, generative retrieval, and representation learning, and lead promising approaches from research and prototypes into production.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Operations Research, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience developing large-scale machine learning systems.
  • At least 7 years of relevant industry experience, including substantial experience designing and deploying production deep learning systems for recommendation, search, user modelling, NLP, or related applications at scale.
  • Expertise and technical leadership in user modelling, recommendation systems, information retrieval, representation learning, or sequence modelling, with experience transforming large-scale behavioural data into representations that generalise across multiple downstream tasks (Theory and domain)
  • Expertise with modern deep learning architectures, including Transformers and sequence-based models, with hands-on proficiency in frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow.
  • Experience designing large-scale ML systems, including distributed training, feature and embedding computation, real-time user representations, online inference, latency optimization, model monitoring, and retraining.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with large-scale data processing technologies such as Spark, Scala, or equivalent distributed data systems
  • Experience with experimentation and evaluation, including offline evaluation, A/B testing, metric design, and measuring the incremental impact of shared models and representations across heterogeneous downstream applications
  • You can bridge latest research and production systems — particularly in generative recommendation and foundation models — and identify where new modelling approaches provide meaningful advantages over established architectures
  • You can define technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and influence senior engineers, data scientists, product managers, and leaders across organisational boundaries.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For at Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!

Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

  • We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries
  • We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
  • We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.

The role:

You will be the product owner for the full Recommendations portfolio - Ads, Business Messaging, Premium and Growth - working out of Stockholm and reporting to the Associate Director. This is a broad, senior IC role: you own the roadmap across several monetization surfaces at once, translate business goals from commercial, growth, and premium stakeholders into ML product bets, and decide where a specialized engineering and data science team spends its time. You will work close to the metal - experiments, ranking metrics, revenue per impression, conversion funnels - and close to the top - steering-committee roadmaps and quarterly commitments.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product roadmap for the Recommendations portfolio across Ads, Business Messaging, Premium and Growth - one coherent strategy across surfaces that today compete for the same models, data and engineers.
  • Turn commercial targets into ML product work: define the opportunity, size it, frame the hypothesis, and prioritize it against everything else the team could ship.
  • Drive the experimentation cadence end to end - hypothesis, A/B design, guardrail metrics, readout, ship/kill decision - and keep the bar high on what counts as a win.
  • Partner daily with engineering, data science and analytics in Stockholm, and with commercial, sales and growth stakeholders across Stockholm and Bangalore.
  • Own the numbers: revenue and engagement KPIs per surface, forecast impact of roadmap items, and report progress to senior leadership on a monthly and quarterly cadence.
  • Act as the product voice in architecture and platform decisions - reusable, config-driven ML systems over one-off solutions.

What you bring in:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with several of those years owning ML-driven or data-intensive products in production - recommendations, ads, ranking, personalization or similar.
  • Fluency in experimentation: you can design an A/B test, argue about statistical power and guardrails, and read your own dashboards without waiting for an analyst.
  • Comfort with the technical substance - you don't need to build the models, but you can hold your own in a discussion about retrieval vs. ranking, exploration vs. exploitation, or online vs. offline metrics.
  • A track record of managing a wide portfolio: multiple stakeholder groups, competing priorities, and the judgment to say no with a reason.
  • Strong written and verbal communication - you will write documents that go to the leadership team and defend them.
  • Experience working with distributed teams across time zones.

It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience in ad tech, martech or consumer monetization - auctions, attribution, pricing, or advertiser-facing products.
  • Hands-on comfort with SQL and data exploration.
  • Experience taking over an established product area and earning trust with an existing senior engineering team.

What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:

  • A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
  • Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
  • A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
  • Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

Come as you are:
Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.

Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code:

Sounds like a great opportunity?

We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.

We only accept applications in English.

title: Warehouse Receiving/ Putaway Full Time 3rd Shift
description:
8:00pm-6:30am/Monday-Thursday (4X10)

Join our Staples World Class Supply Chain Team and deliver essential products to our customers.

What you’ll be doing:

As a warehouse associate you may work in one of the following six areas:

Warehouse Bulk/Material Handling Equipment Operator: You will be operating material handling equipment such as forklifts, cherry pickers, turrets, or electric pallet jacks to pick product up to 100 lbs and move product within the warehouse while adhering to safety procedures. Not all work will be completed on Material handling equipment.

Warehouse Porter: You will be responsible for general cleaning and basic maintenance duties both inside and outside of the facility while adhering to safety procedures. You will be operating material handling equipment such as forklifts, cherry pickers, turrets, or electric pallet jacks to move product within the warehouse while adhering to safety procedures. Not all work will be completed on Material handling equipment.

Warehouse Replenishment: You will be operating material handling equipment such as forklifts, cherry pickers, turrets, or electric pallet jacks to pick product up to 100 lbs and move product within the warehouse while adhering to safety procedures. Not all work will be completed on Material handling equipment.

Warehouse Receiving/Putaway/Returns: You will confirm accuracy of product and work with colleagues to address discrepancies and damages. You will communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external contacts to clarify and resolve issues. You will be manually unloading trucks and palletizing products. You will be operating material handling equipment such as forklifts, cherry pickers, turrets, or electric pallet jacks to move product within the warehouse while adhering to safety procedures. Not all work will be completed on Material handling equipment.

Warehouse Returns: You will be operating material handling equipment to move product within the warehouse. You will be matching item quantities and descriptions to packing slips on returned items, checking in returned product and tagging it appropriate. You will be operating material handling equipment such as forklifts, cherry pickers, turrets, or electric pallet jacks to move product within the warehouse while adhering to safety procedures. Not all work will be completed on Material handling equipment.

Shipping: You’ll be responsible for organizing, stacking, and shrink-wrapping customer orders on pallets. You’ll be loading trucks manually; lifting, lowering, and carrying product in a fast-paced environment and stacking empty pallets while maintaining a safe and clean workspace as you go.

Please note, as an SC2 associate you may be moved into any of the above roles, or SC1 roles, as needed.

You will be essential to the success of Staples Supply Chain as we deliver to our customers.

Safety is our utmost priority so, in this role, we will look to you to ensure safe work practices and embrace our safety culture.

What you bring to the table:

  • An ability to be Material Handling Equipment Operator certified and safely operate necessary material handling equipment.

title: Associate Director, Project & Sustainable Finance
description:
JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION


The Associate Director, Project & Sustainable Finance is an integral part of the Asset & Project Finance (APF) team, working closely with senior team members to support the origination and execution of Asset & Project Finance transactions across the CIB and FIG client base, contributing to revenue generation for Global Corporate Finance. The role involves developing an understanding of airlines, lessors, project developers, banks, Export Credit Agencies (ECAs), and other aviation and project finance participants to identify asset financing opportunities aligned with FAB’s client and credit appetite. The position also requires close collaboration with Corporate and Financial Institutions coverage teams, product partners, and other key stakeholders, while supporting business strategy, transaction execution, ESG initiatives, financial analysis, client advisory activities, and the continued development of the bank’s asset, project, and export finance capabilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the APF team in originating, structuring and executing APF transactions for FAB clients globally across the CIB and FIG segments and help the team to deliver a revenue target in contribution to the overall Global Corporate Finance budget.
  • Support the Team Head in developing and implementing the Aviation Industry Business Strategy as well as the Project Finance Business Strategy.
  • Providing strategy updates as required based on market environment.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the Aviation sector including but not limited to Airlines, Lessors, Manufactures, Aviation Banks & and other financiers.
  • Support the Team Head on the various ESG initiatives for the loans business and regularly provide updates internally to the team on development in the ESG space.
  • Support the team on Project financing transaction inclusion Equator Principle reporting etc.
  • Preparing projections, analyzing cash flow models, running sensitivities.
  • Support the team on advisory mandates selectively undertaken for strategic reasons for key clients of FAB.
  • Join discussions with Credit on specialized transactions including review of the green light memos, credit memos, specialized waiver and amendment requests with a view to understand the transactions.
  • Assist the team in researching certain topics as required for internal or external purpose.
  • Prepare pitch books, term sheets, information memorandum, financial models, mandate letters etc.; and review feasibility report, financial statements and financial, legal and technical due diligence reports.
  • Support the team in their review and conclusion of financing and security documentation – to ensure compliance with credit approved terms.
  • Maintain pricing details for all APF transactions.
  • Assist the Team Head in ensuring the APF Team is up to date on all internal training programs.


REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related discipline.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in Project Finance (PF) and Aviation Finance.
  • Good knowledge of Global and Regional Aviation and Project Finance sector.
  • Good understanding and knowledge of International Aviation debt markets and syndicated loan markets.
  • Good understanding of PF structures, typical participants, assessment tools, and knowledge of PF markets, syndicated loan & debt capital markets.

title: Product & Process Development Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Product & Process Development Engineer to Husqvarna Construction in Jönköping.

Do you want to help shape the future of diamond tools used by professionals around the world? At Husqvarna Construction, you will play a key role in developing innovative diamond segment technologies and manufacturing processes that drive performance, quality, and efficiency across our global product portfolio.

What We Offer

You will be part of a global R&D environment focused on developing diamond tools and manufacturing processes. Working closely with colleagues in R&D, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality and Purchasing, you will contribute to the development and industrialization of new products.

About the Role

As a Product & Process Development Engineer, you will focus on the development of diamond segments and related manufacturing processes. You will participate in the development of new products, establish manufacturing parameters, support prototype and pilot production, and coordinate the transfer of product and process data to manufacturing sites.

The role also involves evaluating new materials and metallurgical solutions, supporting product transfers between factories, and driving activities to improve product quality and reduce manufacturing costs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop diamond segments and related manufacturing processes.
  • Establish process parameters and quality requirements for new products.
  • Coordinate prototype manufacturing, pilot production, and validation activities.
  • Support industrialization and product transfers between factories.
  • Evaluate new product designs, raw materials, and metallurgical recipes.
  • Maintain technical data and support Manufacturing Engineering.
  • Drive activities to improve quality and reduce manufacturing costs.

Who You Are

You are comfortable working both theoretically and practically and can collaborate effectively to achieve results. You are solution-oriented and able to take ownership of tasks and navigate new challenges while collaborating with colleagues and meeting project objectives.

Qualifications

We see that you have:

  • A degree in Material Science or Engineering.
  • Interest and knowledge in metallurgy and material science.
  • Good communication skills in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

If you also have experience in powder metallurgy and related processes and have used CAD/SolidWorks, we see that as a plus

Location

Jönköping, Sweden

How We Work

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

The Application

Apply as soon as possible, as we work with continuous selection. Please note that applications are not accepted via email due to GDPR regulations.

If you have questions regarding the position, please contact hiring manager Tobias Nilsson, R&D Manager at tobias.nilsson@husqvarnagroup.com.

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact recruiter Katarina Engberg at katarina.engberg@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

  • Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
  • Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
  • Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.


Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

Learn more about our culture here: https://www.husqvarnagroup.com/en/our-culture

About Husqvarna Construction Division

For more than 325 years we have driven innovation and technology development exceeding end-customers’ expectations. Husqvarna Construction, a division of the Husqvarna Group, is a world leader in machinery and diamond tools for construction-industry. The foundation is built on product and technology leadership ensured by high investment levels in user-focused product development to offer professional end-users the most effective and efficient solutions. Products and services are distributed globally on all relevant sales channels. Please read more at https://www.husqvarnagroup.com/en/husqvarna-construction-division

title: Social- og sundhedshjælpere søges, 1 medarbejder til fast aftenvagt og 2 medarbejdere til fortrinsvis dagvagt på plejehjemmet Skelager, Aarhus Kommune
description:
Om jobbet:

Brænder du for at skabe ro og dermed en god hverdag for beboere på plejehjem? Så er det her job noget for dig!

Vi søger en dygtig social- og sundhedshjælper til fortrinsvis aftenvagt samt 2 til fortrinsvis dagvagt.
Du skal være uddannet og have lyst, hjerte og faglighed til, sammen med os, at skabe de bedste rammer for et godt liv for vores beboere på Skelager.

Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt fællesskab med assistenter, sygeplejersker, terapeuter, ernæringsassistenter, aktivitetsmedarbejdere osv.

Skelager huser 72 borgere fordelt på tre afdelinger. Plejehjemmet er placeret i smukke omgivelser i Aarhus Nord og emmer af hjemlighed med gode rammer til aktiviteter og udeliv.

Vi ønsker at sætte dine kompetencer i spil hver dag og understøtte din udvikling – fagligt såvel som personligt. Sammen ønsker vi, at alle bidrager til at fastholde det meningsfulde hverdagsliv for vores beboere, høj trivsel samt fastholde og udvikle en høj sundhedsfaglig kvalitet.

Din profil:

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har lyst til at skabe ro omkring vores beboere og dermed bidrage til forudsætningen for at vi kan skabe hjemlighed, sundhed, glæde og tryghed i hverdagen.
  • Tager udgangspunkt i beboernes behov og kan skabe en rød tråd igennem døgnet for beboerne.
  • Kan se og understøtte den enkelte borgers muligheder og arbejde rehabiliterende
  • Yder pleje og omsorg af høj kvalitet
  • Er med til at skabe hyggelige aftener sammen med vores beboere.
  • Kan spotte forandringer i borgers tilstand og reagere på disse
  • Er fagligt reflekterende og opmærksom på egen kompetenceudvikling

Derfor skal du vælge os:

  • Du får en arbejdsplads, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med husets øvrige faggrupper
  • Vi arbejder målrettet med tidlig opsporing, triagering, forløbsmodellen, forbedringsteam, UTH og personcentreret omsorg
  • Arbejdsmiljø og trivsel er i fokus
  • Vi gør os umage – hver dag

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt 1.oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og efter konkret forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område.

Hvis du vil vide mere:

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Viceforstander Vibeke Meedom Nielsen 51553258

Ansøgning:

Klik på ”søg jobbet” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 27. august 2026.

Vi forventer at afvikle jobsamtaler løbende og senest den 31. august 2026.

I Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg har vi en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelser indhentes referencer og evt. straffeattest. Du må derfor forvente at blive anmodet herom, hvis vi tilbyder dig stillingen.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet. (obligatorisk afsnit)

Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:

Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.


Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Executive Director, Head of Carbon Markets
description:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop FAB Carbon Markets franchise (both Compliance Markets and Voluntary Markets).

title: Teknisk servicemedarbejder søges til Ishøj skole
description:
Da vores tidligere servicemedarbejder har søgt nye udfordringer, søger vi en engageret og alsidig teknisk servicemedarbejder.

Har du håndværksmæssig snilde og lyst til at være en del af hverdagen, på en skole, hvor det gælder om at skabe gode rammer, for både kolleger og børn, så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet

Som teknisk servicemedarbejder bliver du en del af skolens daglige drift og får en alsidig arbejdsdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt og sammen med gode kolleger.

Du bliver en del af et lille team på 3 medarbejdere, hvor vi servicerer og vedligeholder skolen og skolens udearealer. Det gælder mindre reparationer og vedligeholdelsesopgaver, samt tilsyn og betjening af tekniske installationer.

Du vil også indgå i Ishøj kommunes TST Vagtordning, hvor man har opsyn med kommunens bygninger og tekniske installationer. Tilkaldeordningen er hver 6 uge.

Vi forventer, at du:

Har en håndværksmæssig uddannelse eller relevant praktisk erfaring

Er serviceminded og fleksibel

Er god til at indgå i samarbejde med forskellige typer af mennesker

At du har kørekort til bil (B)

Har relevante IT-kompetencer og er fortrolig med almindelige digitale værktøjer

Er glad for at omgås børn og unge samt har et positivt sind

Du er stabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst

Ishøj skole tilbyder dig:

En skole i naturskønne omgivelser i Ishøj landsby, med pt. 319 elever fordelt fra 0. – 9. klasse. Skolens størrelse gør, at det er et meget nært og trygt miljø.

En afvekslende hverdag med engagerede og imødekommende kolleger.

Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling, samt relevante kurser.

Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med humor og godt samarbejde.

Hvis du ønsker at høre mere om stillingen eller besøge skolen, kan du kontakte Serviceleder Martin Olsen på telefon: 21 67 89 84

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling

Ansættelsen sker fra 1/10-2026 eller snarest derefter. Er du den rette, venter vi gerne på dig.

Ansøgningsfristen er 4.9.2026 kl. 12.00.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende eller umiddelbart efter ansøgningsfristens udløb

Bemærk, at Ishøj Kommune er en røgfri arbejdsplads

title: Assembly/Powder Supervisor
description:
Position Summary

The Powder Coating & Assembly Supervisor is responsible for leading and coordinating all powder coating and assembly operations to ensure production goals, quality standards, safety requirements, and delivery schedules are achieved. This position provides leadership to hourly team members, promotes continuous improvement, and ensures compliance with company policies and manufacturing best practices.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Supervise and coordinate daily activities of the 3rd shift powder coating and assembly departments.
  • Lead, coach, and develop employees while fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure production schedules are met while maintaining quality and efficiency standards.
  • Monitor workflow and staffing levels to maximize productivity and minimize downtime.
  • Conduct shift start-up meetings and communicate production priorities, safety topics, and quality expectations.
  • Ensure all powder coating processes meet customer specifications for coating quality, color, thickness, and finish.
  • Monitor assembly operations to ensure products are built accurately according to engineering drawings and work instructions.
  • Perform regular quality inspections and address defects through corrective actions.
  • Ensure compliance with all OSHA regulations, environmental requirements, and company safety policies.
  • Investigate accidents, incidents, and near misses and implement corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with Maintenance to resolve equipment issues and reduce production interruptions.
